tei:div.tei:p: byaḥ/bka'agu/ //shā chi/hā sbya 7717shā 0'aḥcuXng060jib jing 505533 7 bci kho zhugaX 50 yokhog
༄tsho//〈rba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/mi rigasadapesbunakhang/
snye//〈rba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/bde skyid kyisabasgrigs/mi rigs dpe skrun khang /

'go brjod rlabs kyi zegs ma/bod kyi chos 'byung lo rgyus kyi dpe deb mang po'i khrod du 〈〈rgyal bzhed 〉〉ces pa khri srong lde btsan gyis brtsams pa dang / 〈〈bla bzhed 〉〉ces pa bla chen po dgongs pa rab gsal gyis bcoms par bzhed pa/ de min sba gsal snang nyid rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyi bla mar gyur rjes bcoms pa'i dpe deb la 〈〈bla bzhed 〉〉dang / 〈〈sba bzhed 〉〉ces pa dam pa'i chos kyi byung ba mngon par mtshon pa'i phyir sba gsal snang gis brtsams par brjod pa las dpe deb snga ma gnyis kyi brjod bya'i snying po ci yin thad da lta'i char kha tshon gcod dka' ba dang / 〈〈dkar chag ldan dkar ma 〉〉dang rgyang ro paṇa chen gyis pho brang 'phang thang du bshus pa'i 〈〈dkar chag 'phang thang ma 〉〉gnyis la mjal ba'i skabs rgyal bzhed dang bla bzhed/ sba bzhed skor gyi ming tsam yang bkod yod pa ma red/ chos 'byung lo rgyus rtsom pa po yongs grags kyi lugs la bstan pa phyi dar te khu ston brtson 'grus g.yung drung gis 〈〈lo rgyus chen mo 〉〉dang 〈〈yul bris chen mo〉〉zhes pa'i dpe deb brtsams pa de nas bzung phal cher 〈〈sba bzhed 〉〉'di yang chos 'byung smra ba tsho'i khrod du dar khyab che ru phyin yod pa ma zad 〈〈sba bzhed 〉〉la sba bzhed che ba dang / sba bzhed 'bring ba/ sba bzhed chung ba bcas kyi rnam grangs su dbye zhing sba bzhed der lhad zhugs med pa'i sba bzhed gtsang ma zer ba yang snang mod/ de ni phal cher sba gsal snang nyid kyis brtsams pa'i khri srong lde btsan dus ji ltar nang bstan gdan 'dren zhu

2 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/lugs dang bsam yas ji ltar bzhengs tshul skor yin pa dang / sba bzhed 'di dngos gnas sba gsal snang gis bcoms pa yin na dang thog pho brang gi rtsigs pa dang ka ba/ yang na brag brkos dang rdo ring dang rdo leb kyi ngor bris pa zhig yin pa dang / phyis su mkhas pa gang gis phab bshus byas te dpe deb du bsgrigs pa dang dpe deb kyi mtshan byang la'ang sba gsal snang gis bzhed pa yin pa'i cha nas sba bzhed ces btags par snyam/ 'on te 'di ni bdag gis tshod dpag tsam ste nga tshos de ring gi dus rang gi mig mdun du byung ba'i gnas tshul dang gnad don gang yin yang gsal por brjod dka' na lo ngo chig stong nyis brgya'i gong byung ba'i gnas tshul de rigs gsal por bzo 'dod tshe chos 'byung lo rgyus smra ba'i lo rgyus la brten rgyu las gzhan du na thabs lam ci zhig yod/ der brten 'dir 〈〈sba bzhed 〉〉kyi par gzhi mi 'dra ba kha shas phyogs bsgrigs byas te klog pa por dpyad gzhir phul yod pa la gsal bshad zhu dgos pa ni par gzhi gang yin yang 〈〈sba bzhed zhabs btags ma 〉〉rkyang rkyang yin pa dang / rgyu mtshan ni bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang gis 1988lo'i zla 3par dpar du bskrun pa'i 〈〈nyang chos 'byung 〉〉(shog ngos 494par gsal ) du/ 6 bstan pa phyi dar gyi lo rgyus zhabs su btags pa'o mizhes gsungs pa ltar 'dir bkod pa'i 〈〈btsan po khri srong lde btsan dang mkhan po slob dpon pad+ma'i dus mdo sngags so sor mdzad pa'i sba bzhed zhabs btags ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so 〉〉ces par/ 6 rgyal po mu tig btsan po nas bzung zhabs su btags pa'o mi zhes zhabs btags mar 'dod pa'i rgyu mtshan la'ang bzhed tshul kha shas yod na'ang / gal srid 〈〈sba bzhed 〉〉'di nyid kyi rtsom pa po sba gsal snang yin par ngos 'dzin byas tshe btsan po mu tig btsan po nas bzung ste chos 'byung lo rgyus skor zhabs su btags par brjod na 'tsham par snang ste btsan po khri srong lde btsan zhal bzhugs pa'i dus

༄༅//'go brjod rlabs kyi zegs ma// 3su sba gsal snang nyid dgung lo chen por son yod pa dang / gal srid btsan po khri srong lde btsan nyid dgung lo bdun cu yas mas bzhugs pa yin na skabs de dus sba gsal snang nyid da dung 'tsho sdod gnang yod med thad dpyad dgos pa yin pa dang / yang sog zlog pa blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis brtsams shing si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis 1997lo'i zla 10par dpar du bskrun pa'i 〈〈dgag lan nges don 'brug sgra 〉〉 (shog ngos 12par gsal ) zhes par/66bla bzhed sba bzhed gnyis kyi lo rgyus de'ang bla bzhed ni/ bla chen pos sba bzhed ltar du bris pa yin la/ sba bzhed rim pa gsum byas nas/ gcig rje'i phyag sbal du bzhag gcig dbon sras la bzhag gcig bod kyi rab tu byung ba rnams la bzhag go / zhes pa'i tshul 'di sdig blon rnams kyi ngor byas pa yin cing / 'di la rnying ma ba rgyus med kha cig sba ye shes dbang po slob dpon pad+ma la mi dad pas de ltar bcos pa yin/ phyis slob dpon gyis rjes su bzung bas de lta ma yin zhes zer te ma go ba yin cing / sba bzhed ni sdig blon rnams kyi ngor rgyal blon rnams kyis bsgrigs pa yin la/ ye shes dbang pos byas pa ma yin no/ / de la sogs pa go ba longs na rnying ma'i lo rgyus dang sba bzhed mi mthun pa mi 'byung ngo /mi zhes gsungs pa 'dir yang nga tshos nges par do snang byed dgos pa zhig red/ gang ltar da lta'i 〈〈sba bzhed 〉〉kyi yig cha kun las snga shos su 'dod pa 〈〈dba' bzhed 〉〉ces pa de'ang zhabs btags ma lta bur mthong ba dang / 'dir bkod pa'i 〈〈chos 'byung gi yi ge zhib mo 〉〉'di'i mtshan gzhan la 〈〈bsam yas rtsigs kyi yi ge rba bzhed ces bya ba bstan pa snga dar gyi chos 'byung dang phyi dar gyi 'phros cung zad dang bcas pa rnal 'byor ba kun blo 〉〉zhes mdzad pa po'i mtshan yang zur du bstan yod/ 〈〈rba bzhed zhabs btags ma 〉〉'di da lta'i char dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang du bzhugs pa dang / 〈〈btsan po khri srong lde btsan dang mkhan po

4 ༄༅//(sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/slob dpon pad+ma'i dus mdo sngags so sor mdzad pa'i sba bzhed zhabs btags ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so 〉〉zhes bya ba'i rba bzhed zhabs btags ma 'di'i nang bsam yas ji ltar bzhengs pa'i lo rgyus skor 〈〈rba bzhed zhabs btags ma 〉〉gzhan dang bsdur tshe gsal por bkod yod pa la brtags na de mdzad pa po ni khu ston brtson 'grus g.yung drung min nam snyam ste/ rgyu mtshan ni chos 'byung lo rgyus smra ba tshos khu ston brtson 'grus g.yung drung gis mdzad pa'i 〈〈bsam yas dkar chag chen mo'am rba bzhed zhabs btags ma 〉zhig yod par khas len pa'i phyir/ 'on te lo rgyus smra bas deb 'di nyid du 'dod pa'i zin tho zhig bdag gis ma mthong bas da dung mu mthud dpyad par 'tshal/gzhan kho bos lag rtser ma son pa sger gyis nyar tshags gnang ba'i 〈〈rba bzhed zhabs btags ma 〉〉gnyis dang / dpal 'bras spungs gnas bcu lha khang du bzhugs pa 〈〈sba bzhed legs par bzhugs 'di ni sba bzhed zhabs btags ma'o 〉〉(lag bris ma shog ngos 17bzhugs )zer ba dang 〈〈bsam yas dkar chag sba gsal snang gis bzhed pa'o 〉〉(lag bris ma shog ngos 38bzhugs )zer ba'ang snang bas dpyad yig 'tshol sdud thad do snang yod mkhan tshos rjes su kha skong yod pa 'tshal/ de min dbus pa blo gsal gyis btsams pa'i 〈〈rba bzhed 〉〉zer ba'i lag bris ma zhig kyang kho bos lag rtser pon pa da mus dag bsgrigs byed pa'i sgang yin pa dang dbus pa blo gsal gyis brtsams pa'i 〈〈rba bzhed 〉〉'di'i mtshan dngos sam yang na mtshan gzhan la 〈〈sangs rgyas bstan pa bod du byung tshul skor le tshan gnyis dang glang dar mas bstan pa bsnub rjes slar yang bstan pa dar tshul 〉〉zer ba min nam snyam pas brtag mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis 1986lo'i zla 6par dpar du bskrun pa'i 〈〈chos byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston 〉〉du/ 6 rba bzhed che ba dang / rba bzhed 'bring ba/ rba bzhed chung ba/ rba bzhed/ rba bzhed gtsang ma ’ sogs kyi tha snyad kyang sbyar

༄7/'go brjod rlabs kyi zegs ma// 5yod pas yang snying rba bzhed de dag gi dbye mtshams ji ltar yin tshul skor la'ang dpyad zhib byed dgos pa zhig red/ yang phyogs gzhan zhig nas bsamacho btang ba yin na sba gsal snang dang sba ye shes dbang po/ rba rat+na dang rba khri gzigs bcas su 'bod pa de rba gsal snang gi mtshan gyi rnam grangs yin pa'am yang na mi so so ba yin min/ sba gsal snang rab tu ma byung gong bu dang bu mo'i lo tshod lo na bco lnga dang nyi shu yas mas su slebs yod pa dang rba gsal snang ni bu dang bu mo bgrongs rjes rab tu byung bar brjod pa la brtag tshe sba gsal snang de rab tu byung ba'i skabs lo tshod chen por slebs yod pa ma zad skyes dman zhig yod pa rang bzhin gyis rtogs thub pa dang / des na skabs de dus (rab tu byung rjes )khyo shug gi gnad don de ji ltar thag bcad pa/ de min rba gsal snang gi tshe mjug gi 'tsho ba de yar klungs lho brag tu sbas pa'i rab byung ba'i brtul zhugs la hur brtson byas pa/ cig car ba dang rim can pa'i rgyal pham gyi rtsod pa de'i khrod du rba gsal snang gis btsan por dgongs pa zhus te rgyal pham gyi rtsod pa de dang g.yol gang thabs byas pa des yang snying don gnad gang zhig gsal bshad byas yod pa/ sba gsal snang bgrongs rjes bu mo spyan ras gzigs zer ba zhig glo bur du byung ste yab kyi gdung rten bzhengs tshul/ de min sba gsal snang nyi dang 'ba' de bu'i bu sang shiganyis kyi dbye ba'i skor la'ang dpyad zhib byed dgos pa dang / de ni rba gsal snang dang 〈〈rba bzhed 〉〉gnyis kyi 'brel ba'i skor la dpyad pa gtong byed kyi sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen zhig kyang red/ mdor na/ 'dir 〈〈rba bzhed 〉〉dam 〈〈rba bzhed zhabs btags ma'i 〉〉par gzhi mi 'dra ba kha shas phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs te dpe skrun byas pa'i dmigs yul ni dpyad yig phun sum tshogs por bzo rgyu ma zad dpyad yig de dag brgyud dpyad yig gi rnam rdzun thad dbye 'byed legs po 'ong thub pa dang / 'dir bsgrigs pa'i 〈〈rba

6 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/bzhed 〉〉de dag la mtshon na dus rabs mi 'dra ba'i nang rang 'dod ltar bzo bcos ga tshod brgyab yod med de dag red/ der ma zad chos 'byung lo rgyus thog gi gnad don skor la zhib 'jug byed pa'i dus nges par du chos 'byus lo rgyus smra ba'i lo rgyus kyi zin tho la rgyab rten dang der dbye zhib byas te sdom tshig bzo rgyu las sher rtogs rig pa nang ltar rang gi 'du shes la brten te dris lan gsab pa dang lta tshul bshad rgyu de chos 'byung lo rgyus skor la zhib 'jug byed pa'i thabs shes legs shos shig dang dge mtshan zhig min pa shes rtogs 'ong ba'i ched du dka' ba'i las du ma zhig dang len byas te dpe deb 'di nyid bsgrigs pa yin la/ dpe deb 'di bsgrigs pa'i dus ma yig gi dag cha'i thad nga tsho deng rabs pa'i blo ngo dang mi 'tsham pa'i rnam 'gyur gang mang mthong na'ang rang 'dod ltar bzo bcos gang yang brgyab med/ 'on te tshig kha shas kyi 'bri stangs thad 'gyur ba mang po byung ba ni 〈〈rba bzhed 〉〉rnams su bkod pa'i 〈〈rgya'i hen khang 〉〉zer ba der 〈〈lde'u chos 'byung 〉〉dang 〈〈nyang chos 'byung ta〉 lhag par phyis kyi chos 'byung rnams su 'bri stangs sna tshogs byung ba des tshig de'i don la rjes dpag gi rig pas 'grel ba zhig byed rgyu phar zhog tha na tshod dpag kyang byed dka' ba zhig tu gyur yod mod/ kho bos h+pha ren si'i dpe mdzod khang che ge mo zhig tu snar thang lo tsā ba seṅga shri'i gsung 'bum la mjal ba'i dus gsung 'bum gyi khrod nas 〈〈rgyal po srong btsan sgam po dang /rgya bza' bal bza' rnam thar 〉〉zhes pa zhig rnyed pa las 66rgya'i 'asnyi hang zhes bris yod pa dang / der brtag tshe rgya ni rgya gar dang 'asnyi hang ni rgya gar skad de grwa pa'i don yin pa dang / de ltar na 6 rgya'i nyen khang ’ zer ba ni 6 rgya'i 'alha tang mi zhes pa'i sgra dod de 'gyur ba 'dra ste 64rgya'i grwa pa'i gtsug lag khang zer ba yin pa ltar tshig don brdar sha chod pa'i khungs zhig kyang nga tshos nges par btsal dgos par snang zhes sgrig pa pos phul/ /

dkar chaga'ago brjod rlabs kyi zegs ma/ ( 1 )btsan po khri srong lde btsan dang mkhan po slob dpon pad+ma'i dus mdo sngags so sor mdzad pa'i sba bzhed zhabs btags ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ( 1 )sba bzhed ces bya ba las/ sba gsal snang gi bzhed pa bzhugs/ (80)chos 'byung gi yi ge zhib mo/ (159)dba' bzhed bzhugs so/ (237)

༄//btsan po khri srong lde btsan dang mkhan po slob dpon pad+ma'i dus mdo sngags so sor mdzad pa'i sba bzhed zhabs btags ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so//rigs gsum mgon po'i rnam 'phrul gyis/ / sha za gdong dmar 'dul mdzad pa/ / mes dbon gsum la phyag 'tshal te/ / bka' tshigs yi ge zhib mo bris/ / btsan po khri lde gtsug btsan gyis mes srong btsan gyi bka' chems kyi yi ge mching (mchim)phu'i phyag mdzod na blon po 'gar gyis zangs kyi byang bu la bris nas sbas pa de bltas pas nga'i dbon sras kyi ring la rgyal po lde zhes bya ba'i ring la dam pa'i lha chos 'byung / de bzhin gshegs pa'i rjes su rab tu byung ba dbu reg dang zhabs rjen sku la ngur blag gi rgyal mtshan gsol ba/lha dang mi'i mchod gnas kyang mang du 'byung ngo // de la rang dang gzhan gyi 'di dang phyi ma mtho ris dang thar pa thams cad kyi bde ba 'byung bas nga'i dbon sras rje blon rnams kyis 'tsho ba bla nas sbyor/ chab 'og nas bde byin la dbu'i mchod gnas su khur cig ces bya ba bris nas 'dug pa de gzigs pas/ lde zhes bya ba de nga yin par dgongs nas/ bran ka mu lo ko sha dang /gnyags dzñā na ku ma ra gnyis rgya gar du chos 'tshol du btang pas/ paṇ+ḍi ta sangs rgyas gsang ba dang / sangs rgyas zhi ba gnyis gangs ti se la bsgom mo zhes thos te/ de gnyis spyan drangs pas spyan ma 'drongs te de gnyis kyi thugs

2 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/la mdo sde las rnam par 'byed pa dang / gser 'od dam pa'i mdo gnas pa dang gnyis spyan drangs nas rgyal po'i mchod gnas su phul de'i bzhugs khang lta bur lha khang lnga bzhengs te lha sa mkhar brag brag dmar 'gran (mgrin)bzang / mchims phu ne ral/ brag dmar ka chu/ mangs (rgyan) gong gi gtsug lag khang dang lnga bzhengs pas/ zhang blon kun rtsed blo chag brel bas ma dga' nas nged kyi btsan po 'di dad pa che la dga' ba byad mi mtshar bas bram ze yin nam zhes gleng / de'i rje'i snyan du gsol pas/ rje'i zhal nas nga bram ze yin na nga'i khab ljang mo khri btsun 'di bu nga bas kyang dad pa che ba byad mi sdug pa cig shog nga btsan po ma nor ba cig yin na/ bu zhang blon rnams kyis bshas mi thub pa cig shog ces dmod gtsugs (btsugs)so//khri btsun la sras lha'i bu pho 'dra ba/ sgra'i bzangs (sna'i gzengs )mtho ba/ dpral ba'i dbyes che ba shin tu mdzes pa zhig btsas pa/ zhang blon rnams na re/ bod kyi btsan po 'di rgyal po yang dag pa'o// zhes zer/ sras la 'di mi min lha'i dbon yin pas ming yang ljang tsha lha dbon du gsol/ de la khab ran par gyur tsa na/ bod thams cad spre'u'i bu yin pas 'di'i jo mor mi 'os/ 'di la rgya'i bu mo zhig blang bar chad/ bod kyi rgyal po la bzang pa mes srong btsan yin te ār+ya pa lo'i sprul par grags/ de'i gnyen zla rgya rje kong tse 'phrul chung yin pa/ de yang ār+ya pa lo'i sprul par grags/ sras me kong rtse yin/ de la gtsug lag khang gi gab rtse sum brgya drug cu yod de/ rgya nag gtsug (lag) gi rgyal por grags pa de'i sras rgya rje 'brom shing hān/de'isras rgya rje tho ba/ de'i sras rgya rje hwang phan zer/ de'i sras rgya rje cang bzang / de'i sras rgya rje li khri bzher lang mig ser bya ba/ da lta bzhugs pa de'i sras mo gyim shang ong jo bya ba de blang bar rigs so mchi nas/ gnyags khri bzang blon 'khor sum cu gnye bor btang nas/ rgya rje la pho nya bas sgrom bu

༄༅//sba bzhed zhabs btags ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 3phul bas bu mo byin nas/ yong jo la 'phrul gyi me long yod pa bltas pas/bod kyi yul yar lung bzang ba dang / de'i rgyal po byad legs par mthong nas 'ongs so/bod kyi rgyal bu grongs nas bang so skye bu rtsig pa'i tshe na/ ong jo 'phang thang du byon pas rgyal po yin zer nas gon po ag tshom can cig las mi gda' bas/ byad kyi blta cha yin nam me long gi blta bya yin snyam yid ma dga' nas/ nyin mo bzhin dngul gyi tam bu ras ram bu btegs nas sdug glu len/ mtshan mo zhing mchu sbrang gis ram bu btegs cing rgya gar yul na dam pa'i chos bdog ste bal yul tshad pa che/ de la bsams nas bsam thag chad/rgya nag yul na ju zhag gi spyad yod de pha yul shul thag ring / de la bsam nas bsam thag chad/ bod yul dbus na rje rgyal gyi mi yod de/ blon po gdug pa che/ bod kyi blon po sdig po che zer zhing glu len/ blon pos rje'i snyan du gsol pas/ rje'i zhal nas da mo la skyes bskur nas pha yul du skyel ces gsungs/de skad du gsol pas/ yong jo na re rgyal bu legs pa cig yod ltar na nga dang las ma mthun pa yin pas/ da pha yul du mchi bar spobs shig da mes dang 'du'o mchi/ phyis ong jo na re nga'i ne ne mo kong co'i mchod gnas gser gyi lha shākya mu ne zhal blta'o zer nas/ rgya stag ra mo che na lha mi bzhugs nas/ de kun tu mchod pa re byed cing btsal yang ma rnyed nas/ ra sa'i lha khang du mchod pa byas pas/ gtsang khang sgo lnga'i phud rabs 'dug pa la/ gtsang khang sgo bzhi las med nas 'di na gtsang khang ka 1 yod par nges zhes glo 'bur gyi ya lad kyi 'og tu brdung pas/ ser kha byung de brkos nas sgo phye ba dang /gser gyi lha shākya mu ne sbas pa mthong nas ne ne+e mo'i lha la zhal ston cig gsol zer nas mchod pa btsugs/ blon po shi tsad pa (shi tshad la ) zan skal med pas nged rgya nag chos dar bas mi shi ba la bdun tshigs yod/ bod la chos ma

4 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/dar bas blon po snying rje zer nas mi shi ma thag tu lha mi stong tsam la mtshal ma re 'tshal/ de la bod kyi tshe zhes bya/ phyis yong jo la yos bu'i lo la rgyal bu bltams/ de'i dus na rgyal po ni pho brang brag dmar 'om bu tshal na bzhugs/yos bu lo dpyid zla ra ba'i tshes bcu tsam la bab pa na/ rgyal po'i hwa shang na re/rgyal po khyod kyi btsun mo la sras byang chub sems dpa' nges pa 1 btsa' bar nges/ de la rim gro bskyed cig mchi/ nam phyed na mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad bzhengs/ 'byin pa'i lhag ma la nga'i bu'i sku tshab byed ces nas mchod rten bre thag can yang brtsigs/ nang par pho nya byung ste/ ong jo la sras bltam mo mchis/ rgyal po ('phang)phang thang du byon pa dang / ong jo'i bu rnam snang gza' (bza')bzhi stong kyi phyogs (phyogs)nas 'di nga la skyes so mchi/blon po kun gyis thang rtsigs bug sar bu bzhag nas sus thob byed du bcug pas/ ong jos sngon la zin pa bzhi stongs kyi then pas btang ste yin dang nga'i ste/ 'dre mo khyod zer nas btang / bu ong jo gi yin par shes/ lo 1 song tsa na zhabs tshugs kyi dga' ston byas te/ sna nam pas ber chung re lag na thogs nas zhang po'i dpang du shog zer/ rgyal bu na re/ khri srong de btsan rgyal tsha legs(lags)/sna nam zhang gi ci bgyi 'tshal gsungs nas/ rgya'i dpang du song nas ming kyang rang gis btags so// de nas rgyal bu lo 4 bzhes pa pho brang 'om bu tshal na bzhugs/ rgya rje rgyal po la skyes chen po skur ba'i pho nya ba 'ba' de'u la bu rgya phrug gar mkhan med pa (mad pa)de rgyal bu'i rtsed zlar phul/ yab rgyal po dam pa'i chos mdzad par bzhed nas chos rgya gar na grags pas/ rgya gar gyi rgyal po'i thugs bzung ba'i don du skyes dang pho nya ba lho bal du rdzangs pas/ shul deng 'phab kyis 'phrang du dgung phabs dgung bdun bab/ 'tsho ba chad nas gnam du bltas pas/ bya lnga 'phur ba la mda' 4 dus 1 tu 'phangs nas/ bya 4 dus 1 tu kum/ de gnod pa che ba

༄༅//sba bzhed zhabs btags ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 5kun gyis gleng pa de/ rgyal bu brag dmar rdzing gong na brtse bas gsan/ rtsed zla khyung po tse tse/ khyung po dum tshugs/ cog la smon lam 'bar/ rgya phrug gar mkhan dang lnga rdzing nang na rtse ba'i 'dam khrod rkang pa'i 'og nas srin bu dmar nar nar byung bas rgyal bu na re/ dang po 'bab kyi 'phrang du 'ba' de bus dus 1 la pho ron 4 bsad pa de gnod pa che'o mchi nas/ 'di kun bsad na gnod pa che'am mi che zer/ dum tshugs kyi mchi na/ srin 'di lta bu'i ma nyes pa bsad na shin tu sdig che/ tshur gnod pa byed pa dang nya bsad na phyugs bzan 'phel zer/ rgya phug skad nas/ rgya'i hur bya'i (zhes bya ba'i)gtsug lag las/ 'di lta bu kum na te por sdig pa che mchi zer/ rgyal bu na re/hur gyi gtsug lag na ji skad 'byung gsung ba la/ sang shis mchid nas/dge ba bcu'i chos cig snyan du gsol nas/ dus rtag tu de gleng ba kun gyi tshor bas/ 'di sgom zhes mos nas/ rgyal bu chos dga' zer bas/ sgrom bu bskur nas sang shi dang mi 4 rgya'i gtsug lag de len du pho nyar btang /bka' bzhin du grub na bya dga' byin no/ ma grub na skum mo byas te btang /de nas nye'u le'u yi 'phrang la phyin/ de'i dus su rgya rje'i bum sangs dbang po'i drung na ju zhag mkhas pa cig na re/ da ste zla ba gsum na nub phyogs nas byang chub sems dpa' 1 'dir pho nyar 'ong mchi/ de ci 'dra byas pas/de'i cha tshugs dang rtags 'di 'dra'o mchi nas 'bag cig dbang pos de rgya rje'i snyan du gsol pas/ rjes pho nya btang nas de de ru sdod du ma gzhug par/de la rim gro bskyed la mar nga'i drung du thong bya ba gsung / pho nya de dus su byung nas de la rgya'i hwa shang gis phyag byas te/ bsgo ba bzhin du byas mar btang bas rgya rjes kyang de la phyag byas pa dang / pho nyas rgya rje la btsan po'i sgrom bu phul/ rgya rjes sgrom bu dang sbyar nas rdzong bar 'chad byas te/ rgya rje na re khyed 'ba' de bu'i bu yin na 'dir nga'i nang blon bgyi mi rung ngam gsungs/

6 ༄7//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/de la bsam pas nga 'dir 'dug na tshe 'di la ni skyid de bod yul du lha chos bzang po'i khungs 'byung ba'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i dpe tsam zhig btsan po'i phyag tu phul la/ slad kyi thabs byas la snyan du gsol snyam te/bdag 'dir bsdad par gnang ba ni bka' drin che na bod kyi btsan pos bka' nan cher gsal/ bdag gi pha stobs las kyi gum na blo ba la bcags slar bod du mchi la pha dang gros byas te thabs kyis 'bangs su mchi'o zhus pas/rgya rje na re nga'i snying du khyod las sdug pa ni ma byung khyod bya dgar ci 'dod/ pho nya'i mchid nas bya dga' gnang na/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab bam po stong zhu'o mchi ba dang / rgya rje na re/ khyod nyi'u le'u yi 'phrang la 'ong ba na yang gnod pa ma byas par rim gro tshar byas/ bum pa dbang po na re/ khyod bo rnyi satwa'i sprul pa 'ong ba mchi/ ha shang mngon shes can gyis kyang khyod la phyag byas/ khyod kyi spyod pa dang sbyar na sangs rgyas kyi lung nas lnga brgya'i tha ma la/gdong dmar gyi yul du dam pa'i chos kyi khungs 'byin pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'ong bar lung bstan pa de khyod yin par gor ma chag ngas kyang grogs bya'i zer thing shog la gser chus bris pa'i chos bam po stong gnang / bya dga' gzhan yang che thang du gnang nas pho nya lnga slar bod yul du mchi ba'i sdum // pha bong mgron bu rgyu mi phod pa sus mthong ba de sbos grir 'gum pa da de// grong khyer chag cu'i nyi ma ha shang stag la ga sha bkal ba de mkhan por bskos nas/ chag cur 'ongs nas pha 'ong skum nas lha khang brtsigs pa la/pho nya bas sgom lung mnos nas/ nga'i pha dang 'phrad dam/ bod du mthar sangs rgyas kyi chos tshugs sam/ bod du sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab bsgrags na bod kyi bgegs srin srog la sdo ba mi 'byung ngam/ btsan po yab sras bde'am dris/ de'i mngon shes kyi bltas pas btsan po sku gshegs/ rgyal bu sku nar

༄tsho//sba bzhed zhabs btags ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 7ma son pas/ blon nag po la dga' bas khrims bu chung bcas nas chos gshigabrag dmar 'gran (mgrin) bzang ba'i thugs dam 1 'dug pa rmang nas dgyel/ khyod de btsan po'i zhabs 'breng pa mdzod la slad kyi rgyal bu de sku nar son pa dang / de'i zhal nas mu stegs byed (gshed)kyi chos gcig gleng du 'ong cig de tsa na 'di snyan du gsol dang / de la rgyal po dad pa cher skye'i/de'i rjes la 'di snyan du gsol bas/ rgyal bu chos byed par 'gyur ro// ces lung bstan nas glegs bam gsum bskur ro// bod la chos kyi skal ba yod/mthar chos rgyas par 'ong / de'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen za hor rgyal po'i bu dge slong shan+ta rak+ṣi ta zhes bya'i 'dul skal yong yin gsungs nas zla ba 2 zan drangs/ de nas nyin lam gnyis su bskyal/ de nas sang shi 'gran (mgrin)bzang (bshig)pa glo ba la bcags nas bsad/ mi lnga po rgya'i ri mgo rde'u shan gyi rtse la/ mi ma yin gyi na bun stib pa'i khrod na zhags (zhag)bdun la rtsigs pa'i 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi pho brang las dpe len du phyin te mi1 gis ri la 'jog ma shes/ 1 gis ri rtse la phyin kyang cang ma mthong 1 gis lha khang mthong ste sgo ma rnyed/ gcig gis sgo mthong ste dra bas bkab ste 'gro ma shes/ sang shes nang du phyin nas 'phags pa la phyag byas/ de'i dpe blangs nas sgor phyin pas gcan gzan kun gyis phyag nas ri'i sgab du skyal nas bod du mchi/ bod du yab rgyal po yar 'brog sba tshal du chib (chibs)gron pas grongs pa dang / rgyal bu sku na ma lon pas/ zhang ma zhang khrom pa skyes na re/ rgyal bu sku tshe 'thung (thung)pa chos byams (byas) pas lan bkra ma shis/ tshe phyi ma skye ba len pa rdzun yin/ tshe 'di'i rkyen bzlog bon bya/ su chos byed pa de pho rang du mthar gtan du bshug da phyin chad bod la tshe byar mi gnang / ra mo che'i rgya lha shākya mu rna slar rgya yul du bskyal zer nas 'greng ('breng)pa'i dra bar bcug nas sgor ston/ de nas mi sum brgyas drud nas

8 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/mkhar brag dmar gdong nas ma 'khul nas bye dam du sbas/ lha sa'i dkon gnyer hwa shang rgan po rgya yul du skrad/ de'i lham ya gcig bod yul du lus pas de na re da dung chos me stag tsam cig myur du 'ong mchi/ mkhar brag rmang nas 'gyel/ 'gran bzang bzhig nas de'i lcong chims phu'i rdza la sbas/ ra sar bzo grwa btsugs/ bshas byas nas lde tsho la pags dmar g.yog phyag la nang cha skam/ chos la dga' ba'i blon mang dang 'bal 2la skyon phab/ bod nag por btang/ de'i dus na sna nam thog rje thang la 'bar byang thang du bskyal nas a ma zhes lan gsum tsam 'bod kyin rgyab gas nas gum/ cog ro skyes bzang rgyal ma lce dang rkang lag ril por skam te gu gul thul du song nas gum pas/ bla 'og gi mi dang ltas mkhan kun mthun par rgya lha 'phros te sa thems su sbas pa sdig che'o// rgya lha'i mes po dang po rgya gar yul nas 'ongs nges te/ rgya gar dang nye ba mang yul du bskyal bar chad nas bye dong nas bton nas/ dre'u gnyis la khyogs bgyis nas yar la bskyal/ de'i dus su yul ngan chen mo byung nas/ 'bangs gum pa la tshe bgyir ma gnang ba'i khrims bu chung bcas pa'i 'og tu ba lam rlags na sba gsal snang gi bu tsha ming sring 2dus gcig la gum/ lha'i yab mes kun na re/ chos bden zer/ hā shang la dri snyam nas khon (nyen)khang nas hā shang god po bos te nga'i bu tsha 2 lam bstan du gsol dang tshe snga phyi bden nam zhus bas tshe phyi ma yod zer bas phyi tshul du bon byas nang du gyod kha dang bgrod de tshe bgyis/ hwa shang na re/ bu tsha lhar skyes na dga'am bur skyes na dga' zer ba la/ pha na re lhar skyes pa dga' zer/ ma na re rang gi bur skye ba dga' zer/ bu'i rus pa la cho ga byas te gdung sha ri ram du song bar lhar lus gsal/ bu mo'i khar mu tig sran ma tsam ldan yon du tha ma mtshal chus skor ba cig bcug nas yid ches pa'i rtags bgyis te cho ga byas nas rdza gog tu bcug nas/ ma'i mal 'og tu sbas te/

༄༅//sba bzhed zhabs btags ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 9sang phod khyod rang gi bur skye'o zhes lung mtshal yang sang phod gsal snang gi khab la bu 1 skyes pa'i kha nang na mu tig ldan yon dmar po de byung / mas mal 'og gi rdza gog kha phye bas shul ha re 'dug ma bslab par zhing dang ne no ma'i ming kyang shes pas tshe phyi ma yod par yid ches nas sgom lung mnos nas bsgoms pa'i tshe/ rje'i snyan du bdag budarnya'i chos 'tshol ba'i slad du rgya yul dang bal yul mchi byas pas rje'i zhal nas 'o na ngas mang yul gyi kha blon du bsko yi gsungs/ gsal snang yar la song ba'i 'og tu/ sangs shi pho nya'i sug las sgrubs/ slar bod yul du mchis tre na rgyal bu sku nar ma son nas/rgya'i chos chims phu rdza la sbas/ de nas re zhig na/ rgyal bu sku nar son pa dang yab kyi yi ge 1 gzigs nas/ zhang blon rnams dang mos pa mdzad pas/nga'i yab mes na re/ nga'i 'bangs bde ba'i tshis rgya'i le'u tshe kyang dang sbyar na nga'i pha mes kyis 'khrul snyems (snyams)pa 'dra ste zer/ blon dag na re/rgya'i yab mes kyi le'u tshe kyang de ci 'dra mchi/ yi ge rgya mes mgos le'u tshe kyang klags pas btsan po na re nga'i yab mes kyi chos lugs bzang po 1 sku nyams su bzhes zer/da'ajig rten gyi spyod pa bzang po 1 byung ba brda'/ sang shi snyam na kim ha shang gis lung bstan pa'i dus 'di yin snyam du bsams te/rgya'i lha chos bzang bo byung na yab mes le'u tshe skyang ste 'khrul ma'i gor yang mi chud byas pas/ btsan po'i zhal nas/ rgya'i lha chos bzang po de gtan tshigs khyod la med dam gsungs/ bdag rgya la mchis pas yod mchis nas mchims phu'i rdza las blangs te kim hā shang gi lung 4na (bzhin)du bris snyam pa dang /dang por dge ba bcu'i mdo klags/ de la rgyal bu dad pa skyes/de nas rdo rje gcod pa klags pas rgyal bu dad pa cher skyes/ de nas sa lu ljang pa bklags pa dang / dang po spyod pa dag par go/ gnyis pas lta ba dag par go tha mas ltaspyod zung du 'brel bar go bas chos la yid ches te/ 'di 'dra ba'i chos

10 ༄༅//(sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/lugs bzang po nga'i sku ring la brnyes pas/ sa byams so// gnam byams so//lha thams cad btang rag btang ngo // gsal snang na re chos mi byar mi rung zer ba de bden/ gsal snang la dngul g.yung drung dang gser chen po sbyin/sang shi khyed la phra men g.yung drung gi thog tu gser chung pa sbyin/ da khyod kyi rgya yul gyi rtarma dang / mang yul gyi rnyarma/ mes mgo dang / rgya a nan ta dang mkhas pa su yod kyi bsgyur cig gsungs/ de 2dang sang shi dang gsum khas so// ri'i byi khung na skad sgyur ba'i drung du blon stag ra dang / zhang ma zhang 'ongs nas sgro'u khyod gsum po de ci byed 'dug mi phod pa bya ba mang na/ de ni chos kyi skad 'dra na/ khrims bu chung las chos byas pho rang du gtan sprug pa ma thos sam/ snyan du ma gsol bar bye khung du kha sub la/ phyis khrims dang sbyar la shags gdab sam zhes mchid drag tu gdab/ de rje'i snyan du gsol pas/ 'o na gsal snang ma byung bar du skad ma bsgyur cig gsungs/ blon chos la dga' ba rnams na re/ sang shi ('di nas shog nye gcig chad yod pa 'dra/ zhib rtsad byed rogs/ ma yig bris ma ru'ang shog lhe 'chol 'dug) ri dang / ja skyong dang / snam gos dar zab dang go ru thams cad phul/ da dung phul cig gsungs/ cang med lus la tshal ba'i skye rag dang / ral gu'ang phul sems skyed pa dang / dbul ba slar tshur gnang nas khyod skye ba 'di ngo shes pa yin par ma zad/ skye ba du ma'i snga rol nas sems skyed pa'i sras kyi thu bo yin pas/ khyod kyi ming yang ye shes dbang po zhes bya bar 'gyur ro gsungs nas mgo bo la byil byil mdzad/ gsal snang gi khang par gshos gsol ba'i rjes la slob dpon bod du byon nas bod kyi btsan po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mdzad par ci gnang zhus pas/ nga bod kyi 'dul skal yin bod kyi thi btsan po dang khyod ma skyes te/ skye ba lan dgu dgu thogs kyi bar du nga bal yul dang / za hor du phar 'gro tshur 'gro byed sdod cing 'dug da shri

༄༅//sba bzhed zhabs btags ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 11btsan po dang khyod gnyis kyang nar son nas dus la bab pas/ ngas bod kyi shri btsan btsan po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen byas la/ yul byar dkar du chu'o lo hi ta'i 'gram/ ri has po ri'i drung du dpal brag dmar bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa ces bya ba'i gtsug lag khang cig kyang bzhengs su gsol zhes gsungs/ a tsar+ya slar bal yul du gshegs/ gsal snang gi bal yul du sba se bya bas chos bslab rkyen ris bskum/ gsal snang mar 'ongs/pho brang rlung 'tshub su mchis nas rgyal po dang zhal mjal ba'i po nya btang bas tshes 1 la mjal bar bka' gnang nas rje la zhe sa phul bas rje'i zhal nas gsal snang khyod chos sha stag byed cing 'dug zer na/ chad pa byung ma dogs sam/ lan du kho bo mang yul gyi kha dod na mchis pas/ bshugs pa dang yang 'dra mchis zhes gsungs/ rjes sam 'bangs gnang ba'i rjes la dben pa 1 tu rgyal po lha chos bzang bya ba'i rigs mkhas pa shan+ta rak+ṣi ta bya ba cig bzhugs pa'i mchid zhib tu mol ba phul bas rje'i zhal nas khyod zhang blon kun gyis bsad de 'gro bas yul du song la yib la sdod/ ngas zhang nya bzang khad kyis gsol du bzhug go gsungs/ gsal snang re zhig yul du song / btsan pos zhang nya bzang dang / khri bzang la sogs pa chos la dga' ba'i blon po kun dang chos bya ba'i mol gtam byas pas/ zhang nya bzang gi mchid nas zhang ma zhang ro ngan na chos la mi dga' bas thugs dgongs mi 'grub mchi/ blon po khri bzang na re de la thabs kyi bar mnga'o thog kho bo'i rjes su gting gnon/ slad kyi rje'i dgongs pa ltar sgrub bo zer de ltar chad/ khri bzang gi bla 'og gi phyag sprin dang mo ma dang ltas mkhan 'dur la lkog tu bya dga' stsal nas rgyal bu'i sku chags che chab la gnon pa 'ong bar lung mthun par smrar stsal/de la ci bya ba'i lung stsal bas/ rje'i sku'i rim gro zhang blon che ba zung dgung lo sum cu chad par dal du bcug na rje'i sku che la srid 'phel lo// zhes lung phog

12 ༄7//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/go de kun na mang du gleng ba dang khri bzang gi shul la 'grim pa'i 'gron po rnams la/ zhang ma zhang 〉 〉skad pa de bden no zhes thos tsam du gsol du bcug gis thos pas glo ba la bcags par gyur/ nub phyogs rgan mo 1 gis zhang blon gyi ngo la ce re bltas te/ zhang ma zhang gi rje'i gdong sob pa rgyal 'bangs yongs la gces te snyun chen po 'bebs zer ba bden nam mchis pa zhang ma zhang de ni nges snyam ste/ rang gi khyim du nub nyal byas nas bshums rgyal po na re/ zhang blon chen mo bshums pa ci nongs zer/ nga la nad chen po byung ngo zhes rgyal 'bangs kun gleng na zer/ rgyal 'bangs kyi kha la ra ma med tsang mi bden zer bas/ zhang gi me long la bltas pas rgyal po 'bangs kyi kha la ye shes kyi spyan yod zer ba de bden zer nas mya ngan cher byed/ de blon khri bzangagi thos nas rjes 'bangs kun tshogs pa'i dus su/ zhang nya bzang gi rgyal bu sku chags che sel ba'i rim gro bya bar gsol pas/ blon khri bzang gi skad nas/ rje'i sku blud (glud)bya ba'i rigs so zhib tu smras nas/ da rje'i zhabs tog su che khas long zhes mchi bas/ blon po mgos khri bzang na re/rje'i zhabs tog nga de che/ bu tsha'i dge yig tu'ang de che/ blon nga las che ba su yod/ 1 nga byed zer/ 'ang ma zhang na re/ blon nga las che ba ni med na rje'i zhabs tog 1 byed par khas bslangs/ mchad pa gar rtsigs ces gleng pas/mgos na re phag rir bya'am/ yang na ju'i spang bzang su byed mchi pas/zhang ma zhang na re/ sna nam brag phug rtsig go mchi nas/ dmangs bres bas ma zhang gi gsungs nas/ rdo dga' mo sna nas skyos cig zer/ chus mi brel ba'i thabs byed pa dang / 'chad pa 'byongs nas blon po 2nang du mi rung bas/lo ste gung gong dang mgos rgan gros byas nas rkang la bya rgod kyi lham gon lus pha ba bgo bgo'i thul pa gon nas/ blon chen mo dang / zhang ma zhang nang du btsug tsa na/ blon chen mo na re/ kha ma bcad cig zer/ 'dir zhang gi

༄7/sba bzhed zhabs btags ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 13gzims mal bya/ 'dir nga'i bya/ 'dir chu bzhag go zer cing 'gro ba dang /ma zhang phyir tril li li 'breng / thal mo btabs nas pha gi ci yin zer nas bros pa dang / bros pa'i rkang pa nas bzung bas/ bya rgod spu spa ra gang lag na dga'/ pha ba bgo bgos kyi mig gi cang ma mthong bas/ mgos rgan gyi lho 'og tu song ba zhes 'khun/ lo ste gus sgo pha bong gis bkab/ ring zhig na khyim bya skad grags nas/ chu shor snyam te dre'u yos zan lag pa brdungs pa'i sar brkos pas/ chus mi brel ba'i rwa 'thud pa'i thabs de bshig nang nas mda' la yi ge bris nas/ sna nam pas nga brus zhes bya ba phyir 'phen/ der zhang ma zhang la skyon phabs stobs las grub pa dang / rje blon tshogs pa'i dus su zhang nya bzang gis gsol pa/ mes srong btsan gyis lha chos mdzad pas legs/ lha sras yab kyis kyang lha chos bzang po mdzad pa'i 'og tu zhang ma zhang gis bshig rgya'i lha shākya mu ne sngon rta pa'i dpang du phebs/ phyis rgya yul du skyal bas mi stong gis kyang ma thegs/ mang yul du skyal bar chad pas dre'u gnyis kyis theg rgya'i lha mar spyan drangs pa la mchod/ zhang blon chos snub pa gsum kyang ma rungs par gum ste de 'dra bla 'og gi phyag sprin dang /ltas ngan dang sbyar na rgya lha khros te chab srid nongs par glo bar chud/ sngon yab mes chos mdzad pa ltar mdzad pa 'dra zhes gsol bas/ rgyal bu na re/zhang zer ba de bden/ nga 'am de bsam zhang blon kun kyang gros bya gsung /slad kyi rjes blon mang po tshogs nas bka' stsol du bcug nas/ nga'i yab mes kyis lha chos mdzad pa zhang gis bshig pa de 'dra/ rgya lha yang slad mar spyan drangs/ nged rang yang chos byar la rung ngam gsungs pas chos bya bar 'cham nas/ da chos byed pa la mtha' nas 'ongs pa'i mi lo rgyus can su yod zhes gleng pa dang / ba lam klag na sba gsal snang mang yul nas 'ongs pas rje'i spyan sngar bos mchi nas gsal snang rje'i spyan sngar mchis te/ de la zhang nya

14 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/bzang zer ba des zhib tu bka' stsal nas/ rgya gar dang bal yul na mkhas pa su yod/ spyan drongs shig par bsgo bas gsal snang gis gsol pa/ sngon ni za hor na mchis/ da lta bal yul na za hor rgyal bu dge slong shan+ta rak+ṣi ta bya ba gtsug lag la mkhas pa cig mchis zhes gsol pa dang / rje'i zhal nas khyod yul du ma 'gro bar der mi dgug du mi rung bas/ bal rje la nga'i bka' sgrom de phul la mkhas pa de spyan drongs shig par bka' bstsal/ gsal snang bal yul du mchis nas bal rje la pho nya btang nas zhal mjal/ btsan po'i bka' sgrom bu phul nas a tsar+ya spyan drangs par chad/ a tsar+ya mang yul na sdod do zhes snyan du gsol bas/ 'khor lang 'gro snang ra dang snyeng btag btsan ldong gzigs dang / 'brang rgya ra legs gzigs gsum mang yul du mkhan po bsur mchis nas/ ston khang dper har du phyag phebs par mchi/lang 'gro snang ra dang / a tsar+ya der bzhag nas pho brang du rje la zhe sa phul bas phyag bya ba'i gtol ma mchis par gsal snang gnyer bcum/ zhang blon dag na re/ lho bal gyi mi ngan sngags dang / phra men gyi bag bgyid mi bgyid de la rtog mi btang mchi nas/ sang shi dang seng 'go lha lung gzigs dang mchims mo lha gsum btang pas a tsar+ya'i skad ma go/ dar tshag sgong gsog gi tshong 'dus na/kha che skyes bzang gi bu a nan ta lo tsā pa slob 'phro la tshad pa byung nas/ tshong byed pa de la lo tsā bcol nas/ a tsar+ya ci 'dra dris pas/ spyod pa legs po cog la mi bya ba med/ nyes po cog la mi btang ba med/ lha dkon mchog gsum mchod/ gtso bor sems can la phan pa bya zer nas mchi de rje la gsol nas spyod pa rgya chen por 'chad/ thugs 'khrig bzhes mi 'tshal byas pas/ pho brang du spyan drangs te nga la phyag bya bar gsol/ nga la nye brtag go gsung / pho nya bas a tsar+ya sgo nas byon zhes gsol bas gser zho gang phyag rten du phul nas phyag byas pa dang / a tsar+ya'i zhal nas rgyal po kho bo mi mkhyen

༄༅//sba bzhed zhabs btags ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 15nam gsungs/ a tsar+ya dang sngan chad zhal ma mjal zhes bka' stsal pa dang /sngon sangs rgyas 'od srung gi bstan pa la gtsug lag khang gi rgyan srung gi byis pa gsum gyis bye ma'i mchod rten byas te/ ma 'ongs pa na ngas paṇ+ḍi ta bya ba/khyod kyi mtha' khob kyi rgyal po bya ba/ gsal snang gis bang chen byas la mtha' khob kyi rgyal khams su dam pa'i chos dar bar bya bar smon lam btab pa de bsnyel lam gsungs pas/ rgyal po'i zhal nas de med gom yun thung pas lan ces lan btab/ a tsar+ya la lteng btab bam zhus pas/ rgyal bo khyod de dbu la la thod gsol ba dang sbyar na/ stod du mnga' ris zhwa tsam pa dang / zhabs la lham gsol bas/ rmad du mnga' ris lham tsam gcig la khrims chags/ sku la sko rags ma bcings pa dang sbyar na/ bar khams 'dir rgyal po'i khrims myur du 'jig nyen yod/ 'on kyang ran+ta'i phyag rten phul bas dam pa'i chos byar btug gsungs/ de nas pho brang rlung 'tshubs su kha che a nan tas lots+tsha bgyis te zla ba bzhir/ dge bcu dang / khams bco brgyad dang / rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi chos bshad pas/ 'dre srin nag po kun ma dga' ste/pho brang 'phang thang chus khyer/ lha sa dmar po ri la thog brgyab/ mi nad dang lo nyes byung ba btsan pos chos byas pas lan no/ a tsar+ya phar shugs shig mchi nas/ bod 'bangs tsam kha log dam pa'i chos bgyid ma 'tshal a tsar+ya khang steng na dar dkar gyi yol ba na sgom byed pa la/ rgyal pos spyang lag nas gser phye bre gang khyer nas sba gsal snang dang / sang 'go lha lung gzig dang /zhang nya bzang dang / 'ba' sang shi dang snyer stag btsan ldong gzigs dang lnga khrid nas/ a tsar+ya dar gur na bzhugs pa la skor ba byas/ phyag bzhes nas gser dngul de 'dra ba nub gsum du phul nas/ bdag skal ba chung ste bod thams cad nag po la dga' ba'i dus su skyes te thabs nongs na lha chos 'grub tu rang glo ba chung / a tsar+ya slar rgya gar du gshegs shig bdag gis zhang

16 ༄༅//(sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/blon thams cad thabs kyis brid la brngan pa byin te/ chos mi bgyi mi rung bar gling la nga chos byed du btug (bcug) ma thag tu spyan 'dren btang ngo zhes zhus/ a tsar+ya'i zhal nas/ sngon yab mes kyi sku ring la/ lha klu gdug pa can rnams dam 'og tu ma tshud pas bod khams su gnod sbyin gdug pa chos la mi dga' bas ltas ngan des rgyal po'i sku tshe thung pa de las gyur pas/ slad kyi lha chos bgyi bar 'tshal bas/ lha klu dam 'og tu btsal 'tshal/ u rgyan gyi yul na dge slong pad+ma sam bha wa zhes bya ba mthu can cig mchis/ de spyan drangs la mthu dang rdzu 'phrul 'gran/ chos la 'gran zla byung na gtan tshigs dang 'gran no/ lnga brgya'i tha ma la babs pas bod du mu stegs pa mi mchi gsungs nas gagaser phye khyor gang bal rje la bsnams nas gzhan btsan po la slar phul nas/ a tsar+ya skud pa ltar byas nas yar bzhud/ seng 'go lha lung gzigs kyis sngan chad sha mi 'tshal ba'i sdom pa bsrungs pas/ phyis mar mi 'tshal ba'i sdom pa blangs te/ a tsar+ya glang sna gru tshugs su bskyal/ lang 'gro snang ra dang gsas (gsal)snang gis/ a tsar+ya bal yul du bskyal te slar pho rang du mchis/ btsan pos sba gsal snang chos kyi sar bskos nas/ chos kyi ched du rgya yul du phor nya bsgo ba ste/ grub na bu la dngul chen bya dga' bla thabs su gnas par chad byas/ khad dpon du sbrang rgya ra legs gzigs bskos/ 'og dpon sangs shi bskos nas pho nya ba'i bang chen sum cu mar btakā / btsan po chos mi byar mi rung bar gros mol bar rje 'bangs chad byas du//sa der rgya rje'i bum sangs na ju bzhag mkhas pa 1 na re/ da ste zla ba drug dang zhag drug na nub phyogs nas rgya rje la pho nya ba byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa 2 'ong zer/ de cis shes dris pas/ nga'i ju bzhag gi rtsis la byung ste/de'i rtags dang sha tshugs 'di 'dra 'ong zer nas 'bag 2bris/ de rgya rje'i

༄༅//sba bzhed zhabs btags ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 17snyan du gsol pas/ de 2 la rim gro cher skyed la nga'i drung du thong 1 par lung byung / phyis dus btab pa'i dus/ pho nya sum cu byung bas/ 'bag dang 'og dpon dang spyan pa 'thun (mthun)pas dar gyi lding khang byas/ shing rta la skyon rim gro bskyed nas ke shing phyin pas/ pho nya ba gzhan yar la chags pho nya ba rnams kyi rgya rje la phyag byas/ rgya la pho nya byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa gnyis byung bar grags pas/ ming kyang dar khang dar mkhar zhes zer/ ha shang dang dad pa can sprin bzhin du 'dus/ khang pa dang rtsig ngos dang ka ba dang nam mkha' thams cad dar gyis bkab spos dang rol mos mchod cing ci dgar spyod du bcug rgya rje na re/ gsal snang la mi khyod las nga'i thugs su byon pa ni ma byung na/ rgya'i ju bzhag mkhan na re'ang / byang chub sems dpa' pho nya 'ong zer ba'i 'bag kyang khyod 'dra/ khyod byang chub sems dpa'i rta skad bya ba'i sprul pa yin no zer/ khyod ci 'dod pa'i bya dga' sbyin no zhes bka' stsal/ gsal snang na re rje'i zhal mthong ba glo ba dga' ba'i steng du gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i bka' lung stsal ba las bya dga' che ba ma mchis na/gzhan ci yang mi 'tshal/ ha shang gcig la sgom lung len pa'i ched du sprod par ci gnang mchi ba dang / da rgya rje gnang ste gsal snang nyung 'dus shig la go du skyon nas btang ba dang / eg cu'i kim hā shang gcig bkug nas/gsal snang gis sgom lung blangs nas bsgoms pa'i dus su/ gsal snang la bya dgar rgya byi'u gser shog srang brgya pa 1 mu tig sran ma tsam pa phreng bcu/dar yug lnga brgya/ za 'og pe tse han yug 1 gzhan pas khyad par du gnang /bod kyi btsan po'i bka' sgrom dang bstun par chad byas/ btsan po la skyes dar yug khri phra men gyi zhwa 1 gla go zho zha'i sder 'dom gang pa 1 bskur/ pho nya gzhan rnams la'ang bya dga' phye thang du gnang nas/ pho nyan (nyar) lan dang bcas nas slar bod yul du mchis te/ btsan po'i spyan sngar skyes phul pa

18 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/nas sug las grub/ btsan pos kyang thabs kyis zhang blon rnams dang chos bya bar ni chad/ a tsar+ya ni spyan ma 'drongs par gda'/ gsal snang yul du mchis pa dang / btsan po na re/ khyod kyis a tsar+ya spyan drongs shig ces bka' stsal/ gsal snang gis mang yul du phyin tsa na bo rnyi satwas/ 'dzam bu'i gling na mthu che ba'i dge slong pad+ma sam bha wa dang / lha khang rtsegs pa'i phywa mkhan dang / sa gsum rtog nas 'dug der mang yul nas rdzing bcas nas chu klung la spyan drangs te/ snye mo thod dkar du byon pa dang / pad+ma sam bha wa'i zhal nas sang ni chu phar kha na nye tshe ba'i dmyal ba yod pa la snying dbye'o gsungs nas/ rdzing chu la bskur nas/ 'o yug tu gtor ma btang dgongs pa mdzad pas chab 'jam tsam du gyur/ sang shi ku la la byon nas/ byang snam du zangs khal tshad ma 1 tu bong bu'i sha btsos pa dang / klung tshang bya ba'i mi tshang cig na re gnod sbyin 'dul ba'i thabs blta ba dang / slob dpon pad+mas gnod sbyin chen mo la dmar thab stsal gsungs nas/ zangs la rdog pa brgyab pas thang lha khros pas gangs la btun bcom byung / sprin nag chags nas 'brug dang glog dang ser ba babs/ de nas gal ta la thog la snying drung du byon nas bod chos byed ma ster ba'i klu dkar po mi srun pa cig yod/ de dam 'og tu bcug la 'dul dgos gsung ba dang / klu de phyi'i rgyab sgor shor/ de bzung la dam 'og tu gzhug gsungs nas/ dkyil 'khor lnga bzhengs nas zhag gsum dgongs pa mdzad pas/ gangs kyi dug bcom zhi/ yul kyang 'jam par gyur/ klu'ang dam la thogs/ thang lha bka' nyan du khas blangs/slob dpon gyi 'khor tho yul du byon na zan drang bar bya la ma le bsher byon pas/ 'phan yul yul ngan rta ro kha phye ba 'dra bar mi 'byon gsungs nas/stod lung spa ral na mar byon btsum (btsun) mo 'phrang gi brag a tsar+ya gro drengs pa 'dra ba 'di'i gong ma bcad na bod mu stegs kyis 'gongs gsungs

༄tsho//sba bzhed zhabs btags ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 19nas gzhong par tshong sa tsho gro thab gsungs pa la chu ma mchis pas chab ngas byung gsungs nas/ gsag shang yu ba sa la tham tham brgyab pas chus ka bcu byung / de la gzhong pa'i lha chur grags/ de nas snye 'phreng du nga'i gro ran gsungs pa dang / mkhar nag gi mtsho 'di la klu btsan drag mo 'dug 'di 'dul lo gsungs/ 'di shin tu mthu ba 1 'dug 'di la 'dul byed cig bya gsungs nas brag la bcom ldan 'das sems dpa'i sku 1 mdzad/ bal po rdo mkhan na re/ bod kyi rdo la bzo btub bam bltas mchis nas/ brag la sha po'i gzugs 1 brkos so//de nas ngam shod la byon nas zung mkhar 'phrang la rdo'i mchod rten lnga mdzad nas/ pho brang du byon nas btsan po dang zhal mjal ba'i pho nyas brda sbyar nas btsan po la phyag bzhes pas/ btsan pos rab tu byung ba'i phyag mi thub gsungs nas pha bong la phyag mdzad pas shags kyis gas/ btsan pos phyag phul nas/ slob dpon gyis snyun med pa mdzad/ phyag gar 'bebs ces pa dang / sang shi de'i bar du ston pa cig rtsigs ces nas brag dmar 'gran bzang 'khor sa der sgo ma mchis pa cig rtsigs tsa na/ nang lha khang mgo de'u shan la dpe blangs pa cig rtsigs lags pa/ der phyag phebs par zhus/ a tsar+ya bo dhi sa twas btsan po la gsol pa/ sngon sangs rgyas 'jig rten nang zhugs pa'i tshe/ lha ma srin dam 'og tu ma tshud pa ma mchis par rigs pa la/bod yul nas dam 'og tu ma chud pa'i gdug pa can mang du mchis pas/btsan po chos mdzad du ster ster mi 'dra bas dang / lha 'di na 'dzam bu gling na nus pa che pa'i pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes bya ba spyan drangs nas bzhugs pa/bod kyi btsan po chos mdzad du mi ster ba thams cad skud cing gzir ba dang /dam la 'dogs pa ni sngags mkhan 'dis rngo thog/ btsan po chos mdzad pa la rtsod cing rgol ba byung ba'i phyir rgol gyi gtan tshigs smra ba ni kho bo las mkhas

20 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/pa ma mchis/ gtsug lag cig na ltas dang bkra shis mi shis rtog pa dang /chos tshugs sam mi tshugs rtog pa la phywa mkhan 'di tsam su mkhas pa med pas 'khrid 'ongs pa yin zhes snyan du gsol pas/ sang shi na re 'gran bzang gis mnga' gsol/ slob dpon pad+ma la zhu'o mchis pa dang / blon chen mo ni ma mchis/ snang chen po dang / snang chen gzims mal ba kun mchis te/ slob dpon pad+ma lha mnga' gsol ba lha thams cad nang nas ston par byon/ nam phyed na slob dpon kun gyis mar me khyer nas bltas pas nang na 'jim gzugs 1 kyang med nang stong par 'dug nang par ltar phyin tsa na/ 'jim gzugs thams cad snga ma kho na 4na (bzhin)bzhugs/ de nas slob dpon pad+ma mchod pa byed pa dang / lha rnams gtam gtong zhing bshos gsol ba mthong / ston par bltas pas 1 kyang mi 'dug/ mar me thams cad rang 'bar/ rol mo thams cad rang khrol/ spos rang 'bar zhing / btags 'phan lnga btags pa'ang lnga brgyar 'phel/ cong rang rdung zhing 'phel/ rgun 'brum rdog po snyim pa tsam gda' ba de sus kyang 'tshal bar sngo ma thog/ de'i nang par dkyil 'khor bris nas/ gzims mal nas lha lung 'tsho bzher snyan legs pa spra stan byas te/ spra se na sa ta phan nas smrar gsal bas/ bod kyi lha klu mi srun pa rim gyis ming smras te/ 'phang thang du chu phab pa sham po/ lha sar thog phob pa thang lha/ mu ge dang lo nyes mi nad gtong ba bstan ma bcu gnyis la sogs pa kun smras/ de'i sang cho rigs bzang po'i bu tsha pha ma dang mi phyi tshang pa la spra bstan bgyis nas/ rgyal po chen po bzhi'i spra (pra)phab nas gnod sbyin me lhas mngon sum bstan/ lha klu ma rungs pa dngos su mi la phab nas/ sdigs shing gzir ba ni pad+ma sam bha was mdzad/ dkar po la chos bshad nas dam la 'dogs pa ni bolha su tos mdzad/ des ma thul pa pad+mas sbyinasreg byas nas ma mchis par byas/ de 'dra ba lan 2 bgyid de/ slob

༄༅//sba bzhed zhabs btags ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 21dpon pad ma'i zhal nas lha klu dam 'og tu tshud legs te/ da rung de 'dra ba lan cig bgyid 'tshal/ slan chad lha chos ci bder mdzad pa dang / gtsug lag khang dgongs pa srin (bzhin)du rtsigs shing gsungs nas zur phug kyang bu tshal du klu brtul bas/ gzi chen dngos su byung nas sa'i steng na rgyal po khri srong lde btsan che/ sa'i 'og na rgyal po nga che ste nged cag grogs po byas la/rgyal po lha khang byed pa'i gser dre'u khal bcu gnyis ngas sbyin cig gser khung glang po snar blon po kun len du thong zer la dam la btags/ sham bu brtul bas slob dpon gyi thog tu chu phab/ slob dpon gyi rtsa ba ni nas rdo rje gdengs nas chu gyen la zlog slar lha rdzing bang rdzing du btags nas rdo rje brgyab nas chu 'khol bas sham po gangs zhu ba'i rtse la sdad nas/ slob dpon nga la de tsam du mtho 'tshams pa zer/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas khyod nga la mtho 'tshams pa/ da nga'i dam 'og tu mi gzhug na da khyod skrag go gsungs pas/nga nag po'i rigs yin/ chos bgyi ba'i bag ma mchis da man chad gnod pa mi bya yis/ nga'i drung du ser chags ma btang cig zer nas dam la btags/da sbyin sreg cig bgyi'o gsungs pa dang / de ring btsan po dbu 'khru'o mchis/de la a tsar+ya bo lha sa twas gsan nas/ chu ga nas len ces dris pas/ chu brag dmar 'om bu tshal nas len mchi/ chu ri rab kyi byang ngos na chu mig sta na bya ba yod/ de nas blangs te dbu bsil nas sku tshe ring lha sras rigs rgyud 'phel/chab srid che gsungs/ chab de len pa sus nus/slob dpon sngags mkhan na re/de ngas sngo thog gsungs nas/ ga sha'i 'og nas bkra shis kyi bum pa gser las byas pa 1 kha dar gyis bcad nas bzhes/ slad kyi rgyas btab te 'dzab byas nas nam la 'phangs pas je mtho je mthor song / slob dpon gyis 'dzab khung der rma bya'i sgros byab pas/ zan cig za yun na bum pa gser gyang ngo slob dpon gyi dpang du byung / kha phye ba'i nang na chu skya nar ba 1 gda'/ de

22 ༄༅//(sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/dbu khrus zhes blon po kun la gtad pas/ de mdun sar grims nas lho mon gyi ston chu yin/ pho las mthong zer nas ma mchis par bgyis/ slob dpon zhal nas btsan po khyod kyi yul bzang po bya ngams shod bye ma na dang tshal du bya/gra dang dol stag la dang phul po tshun chad chu med pa rnams su chu byung / gram pa thams cad la zhing byas la bod kun 'tsho bar bya/ sgom sha ra marnyi la nor blangs la bod skyid cing phyug par btang / 'dzam bu gling gi dkar bo yod do cog bod du dbyung / gtsang po dang mtsho dbyugs su bcug las 'chongs pas chog pa bya/ ngas dbu rgyan du chab 'di bas che ba cig dbugs su bcug ces rgya cher gsungs/ de ltar 'ong ngam sad pa'i ri snga dro 1 dgongs pa mdzad nas/ klu rdzing du chu byung / da dung bsad do ces pas brag dmar mtsho mo 'gul nas sngo tsham la btang / de'i phyi 'phrod brag dmar gla ba'i tshal nags su btang / yang sang nang par snga dro dgongs pa mdzad nas bsgoms te/zung dkar chu rjes nar byas chu byung bas 'ong nges pas/ blon dag na re/bod yul bzang por byas nas sngags mkhan gyi mthu dang sbyar na rgyal srid rgya gar gyi pho brang te 'gro zhes mdun sa chung ngur gror byas nas 'gro dgum par chad/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas da zhing bya'o gsungs pas/ zhing yar lungs kyi chog zer nas sngags mkhan la bya dga' cher phul nas/ slar rgya yul du bzhud par zhu ba phul bas/ btsan po de la thugs ma dgyes nas/ slob dpon la skor ba byas nas gser bre gang phul bas/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas gser 'dod pa ma min te/ bod mtha' khob tu 'dre srin gdug pa brtul la btsan po chos byar btub par bya/ bod yul bzang por byas la/ 'bangs bde ba la 'god pa'i phyir ngas 'ongs na gser 'dod na 'dug byas pas chog gsungs nas rtsa dang sa rdo la reg tshad gser du song / 'on kyang btsan po'i ngo bsrungs ba'i phyir khyo ra gang tsam phyag tu bzhes te/ lhag ma phyir btsan po

༄༅//sba bzhed zhabs btags ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 23la phul/ der blon po zer ba ltar chad nas/ slob dpon yar gshegs khar rje blon nyi shu la man ngag lta ba'i phreng ba bshad nas/ rgyal po chen po nga'i gsang sngags 'dir lta ba chos kyi sku dang bstun la/ spyod pa byang chub kyi phyogs dang bstun/ lta ba'i phyogs su spyod pa ma shor ba mdzad/ shor na dge med sdig med du song nas chad lta skyes nas phyir gsor mi rung / spyod pa'i rjes su lta ba 'brengs na/ dngos po'i mtshan mas bcings nas grol bar mi 'gyur/ ba'i gsang sngags sems phyogs 'di lta ba shas che ste/ ma 'ongs pa na tshig gi gdengs ni shes te/ lta ba'i gdengs ni ma rnyed pa mang po zhig ngan song du 'gro/ 'dra men 'ga' res sems can mang po'i don byed gsungs nas dpe cha mang po zhig rdzo la sbas so//btsan po la rim pa mdzad/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang mdzad nas gsang sngags kyi lung gnang / phur bu 'bum sde bshad nas/ bdag dang bstan pa med pa'i sbyin bdag rnams tshe rabs 'di dang tshe rabs gar skyes kyang / 'og min zhes bya'i gnas mchog dam pa ru/ rnam thar theg chen 'bras bu spyod par smon/ zhes gsungs nas/ sbyin sreg gi 'phro bya ba ma grub par slar yang gshegs/ skyel mas chab khrid nas yar spyan drangs pas/ blon kha cig na re/ sngags mkhan de ma bsad na nus pa che ste/ bod la byad byas par 'ong mchis nas/ gsod mi bco brgyad go ru skyon nas btang / slob dpon mang yul du byon pa dang / sang 'o cag la 'tshe ba byed pa'i mi 'ga' 'ong gsungs/ dong bas kyi phrang la byon pa dang / skag snar mi bco brgyad po la las mda' bkang / la las kyi (gri)phyung nas slob dpon la bzed pa'i tshe/slob dpon gyis phyag rgya bcings pas/ 'jim gzugs bzhin du gyur te smra ma shes/ mtshon 'phen pa dang sdud ma shos (shes)te rengs/ de'i bar na yar byon nas mang yul gyi la khar byon pa dang / slob dpon na re ngas bod kyi lha klu

24 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/'dre srin lan gsum du 'dul dgongs pa'i 'phro lan cig lus/ de ma lus na rgyal po'i sku tshe ring chab srid che chos yun ring du gnas pa las/ 'phro lus pa de yid la bcags so gsungs/ chos skor cig ni 'byongs nas 'ong ste/ der 'khrug pa chen po cig kyang 'ong / chos la ske nyag bag re 'ong nyen yod/ kha sang gi 'tshe ba byed pa'i mi de la 'di gtor gsungs nas yungs dkar spar ba gang gtad nas skyel mi mar bzlog da re shig nga la mi yul na gdul bya med pas/ nga lho nub mtshams su srin po 'dul du 'gro gsungs nas/ chib kha nas 'phur nas sprin bseb na par chos gos su ru ru gzhag shang khro le le bzhud/ skyel mis gsod mi la yung dkar gtor bas smra shes shing 'gro shes par gyur to/ mi rnams pho brang du mchis nas/ sngags mkhan gsung ba rje'i snyan du gsol bas/ btsan po'i thugs la shin tu bcags par gyur/ de nas chos kyi mdun sa mtsho mo 'gur du phub/ gsal snang rnam phye g.yas (gnam phyib)kyi tshul du dpon du bskos/ dus der bon po dang blon po rnams kha log te chos mi byed bon bya'o zer bas/ bo bhi sa twa'i zhal nas/ rgyal khams cig la chos lugs 2byung na shin tu sdig che/ 'o cag rtsod pa byas la/ khyod rgyal na bon spel nga yar 'gro/ chos rgyal na bon snub la dam pa'i chos bya gsungs/blon dang chos 'gran par chad pas dpang po med/ pho rang zur phu skyang bu 'tshal du btab nas chos kyi khad dpon zhang nya bzang dang / stag btsan ldong gzig dang / seng 'go lha lung gzig dang / nyang sha mi rnams bo lha sa twa'i kha 'dzin dang shags 'debs su bskos/ stag ra klu gong dang / rtsis pa chen po khyung po dum tshugs/ khyung po tse tse/ lcog la smon na lam 'bar dang / tshe mi la sogs pa bon gyi kha 'dzin shags 'debs su bskos nas/ shags btab pa'i dus su/ bon khungs ngan la gtan tshig chung / chos khungs bzang la rgya che bar byung ste/ shags bzang la rno ste bon gyis ma thub/ phyis bon pos

༄༅//sba bzhed zhabs btags ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 25'phan yul du shi kha bsdur bas thams cad bse rags su gyur pas/ slad char bon mi bya ba dang / shi ba mi 'dur bar chad/ zhang zhung dang tshe mis rje'i sku'i bar chad sel ba'i phyir/ 'dre srin la dus bon re bya ba las gzhan mi bya ba dang / gshin ched du rta gsod pa dang / dngos su sha mi za bar chad/ bon gyi dpe kun chab la bskyur/ lhag ma phyis mchod rten nag por gnan/ des slad chad chos bya ba dang / lha khang rtsigs par chad pas/ blon 'gos rgan bshums/ rjes khyed chos byed pa la mi dga' 'am byas pas/ mon bu 'di'ang smra re mkhas/ dam chos 'di'ang gting re zab/ dam chos byar yod tsa na nga rgas mchi bas/ 'o na blon chen 'or che gsung sho la gyes/ de nas mang yul nas/ rgya lha shākya mu ne spyan drangs te slar ra mo cher bzhugs/ yos bu lo'i dpyid bsam yas kyi rmang 'dings par chad tsa na/ gsal snang gis sngon du glag mda'i lha khang rtsigs nas sba ba tshan chos la bkod/ 'ba' lha gzigs kyis myang ros kong la dge ba'i bshes gnyen byas/ khrims rnga phog myang rigs dkar por btang / de nas chos dang bon rtsod pas chos rgyal nas rje blon rnams chos bya bar chad nas/ slob dpon bo lha sa twa dang / btsan po dang /gnyer stag btsan ldong gzigs gsum/ thugs dam dpal gyi brag dmar bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa bzhengs par mol nas/ khas su ti'i gong chad nas/ slob dpon gyis sa dpyad mdzad nas/ shar ri rgyal po gdan la bzhugs pa 'dra ste bzang / ri chung bya mas bu bkab pa 'dra ste bzang /sman ri rin po che spangs pa 'dra ste bzang / khas su ri btsun mo dar dkar gyi gu zu gsol ba 'dra ste bzang / ri nag lcags phur sa la btab pa 'dra ste bzang mo/ yar dre'u rta chu 'thung 'dra ste bzang / dol thang dar dkar gyi yol ba gting ba 'dra ste bzang / sa gzhi 'di mkhar gzhong gur kum gyis bkang ba 'dra ste thugs dam 'dir bzhengs na bzang bya bar bstan ste/ phyag

26 ༄7//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/mkhar gyis sa bres mdzad/ sa gzhi de 'jag skya chad de/ sgrung phung ci mi skye ba dang / skya gsal mtho re 'dug pa'i steng du/ snyir stag btsan stong gzigs kyis rtsa mthos skor nas/ nga 'dir btsan po'i chibs bres byed do zer/ de nas zhang blon lha khang rtsigs pa'i bka' bgros pas/ blon khri bzang gi mchid nas/ rje 1 legs thabs kyi ma mdzad na bod 'bangs kha log nas dam pa'i chos mi btub/ thugs dam kyang mi 'grub par gor ma chag mchi thabs ji ltar bya bar mol ba la/ rje'i bka' gnyan pas/ bka' khrims dang bka' nan drags tu gsal bar 'dem ka bor ba sogs pa lkog tu chad nas/ bod 'bangs kun tshogs te bka' stsal pa/ 'dzam gling na bod kyi rgyal po mi che/bod kyi rgyal po la nga las che ba ni sngar ma byung / nga las phyag ris med pa/phyag ris zhig byed pas/ khyod bod 'bangs 'dzangs pa rnams gleng ces gsungs/ blon po khri bzang langs nas/ rje'i bka' stsal ni bdud pas gnyan/ khrims kyi la rtse ni gung las mtho/ phyag rjes gang mdzad pa bka' lung zhu'o mchi/ rje'i zhal nas nga mkhar pa zhang po rgya'i yul mthong ba zhig rtsig gam/ yang na shel gyi mchod rten gangs ri tsam pa cig rtsigs/ yang na wa lung grog po gser phyes dgang ngam/ yang na khas su ri gser cha zangs kyi bskum mam/ yang na gtsang po zangs ma'i sbubs su 'jug gi/ yang na ka chu'i thang la khron pa 'dom dgu brgya dang dgu bcu pa bru'am/ yang na lha khang bre tsam cig rtsig gam/ 'doms kha bor shig bka' stsal/ rje'i bka' lung che la sgrub dka' bas/ 'dam kha ga yang khas len ma phod/ 'bangs kun dred pa dang / zhang nya bzang gi mchid nas/ rje ci lags/ mkhar po de tsam pa phra na ni 'jig ches na ni mi 'byongs/ shel rin po che dka' bas/ sa'i mchod rten de tsam sa yang mi 'byongs/ wa lung grog po gser bas bye mas kyang mi khengs/ khas su ri zar khog tshun chad zangs su song yang mi thums/ gtsang

༄༅//sba bzhed zhabs btags ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 27po dgun sbubs su chud kyang dbyar chus 'khyer/ sa 'dom gang brus pas chu rdol te 'ong bas brur mi gtub/ lha khang bre zhabs tsam zhig bya/ de las 'os cang gdam nga'i mchis pas/ bod 'bangs kun g.yar 'cham nas de la 'or ches btab bo// de la blon ta ra klu gong chos la gnag pas/ / sbas lcag sa la brdab ste lha khang rtsig pa de chos yin pas nga mi dga'/ nged rang bon bya zer bas rje'i zhal nas nga'i bka' cog pa khyod kyi rta ra byang du byugs cig ces pa dang / 'bangs skabs mi gnyis kyi rtsa thag btags te tsher bcags kyis brab byang du byugs/ de la kun byed nas cang mi zer/ de nas lha khang gi sa chog byas te/ ya rab kyi bu tsha pha ma mes phyi tshang ba rgyan du mas brgyan pa rat+na'i snod du bog gsal/ la rgyags smra'i thig then/ btsan pos gser gyi 'byor 'jor khru gang pa cig thogs te sa brkos pas/ gyo dum dang sol ba dang gsog ma ni mi gda' sa skya nar 1 gda' bas 'jor bor/ der zhang blon rigs bzang gi bu tshas brkos pas/ nas dkar mo phul do dang / 'bras dkar mo phul do ma 'dres ba btsong yin zer ba cig byung / de bos nas khang pa btsan po dang slob dpon dang bal po phywa mkhan dang bzhi mol ba byas te/ lha bzo ba na re/lha rgya gar lugs su bya'am/ rgya nag po'i lugs su bya zer/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas burnya rgya dkar por byon pa yin pas/ rgya dkar po'i lugs su bya'o gsungs/ btsan po na re/ slob dpon la nga bod nag po la dga' ba rnams dad pa skye re ba lags pas/ lha bod kyi lugs su bya bar cis kyang gnang byas pas/ 'o na bod 'bangs kun bsdus shig/ bod kyi lugs su bya'o gsungs/bod kun tshogs pa'i nang nas/ pho la mtshar ba khu stag tshab la dpe byas te/gtso ar+ya pa lo kha sar pa ṇi bzhengs/ mo la mtshar ba lcog ro gza' bu chung la dpe byas te/ lha mo 'od zer can g.yon du byas/ mo la mtshar ba lcog ro gza' lha bu sman la dpe byas te/ sgrol ma g.yas su byas/ thags bzang stag

28 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/leb la dpe byas te/ ar+ya pa lo yi ge drug pa de'i g.yas su byas/ sman g.yas skor la dpe byas te/ ar+ya pa lo rta mgrin sgo srung su byas/ de nas dgu stong la btsan pos yo byad sta gon mdzad/ dar gyi gab rtse gnyis rtsigs/ lha khang la mnga' gsol par byung bas/ a tsar+ya dgos te/ pha la pha la si ti si ti gsungs/ de btsan pos ma go ba lo tsā ba la/ a tsar+ya ci zer byas/ lo tsa ba na re/ bzang ngo bzang ngo // 'grub po 'grub po gsungs zer/ der mchod rten chen po bzhi'i phur pa btab/ de nas btsan pos slob dpon lha khang bzhengs par zhu ba phul bas/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas/ rgyal po khyod dang po byang chub tu sems skyed pa'ang jo mo sgrol ma yin/ tha ma sangs rgyas tsa na'ang rdo rje'i gdan du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gsol 'debs pa'ang jo mo sgrol mas byed/ da lta rgyal po'i thugs dam gyi bar chad sel ba'ang jo mos byed pa yin pas/ sngon la rgyal pos jo mo'i sgrub khang rtsigs shig par lung phog/rgyal pos kyang lho ngos su ar+ya pa lo'i khang pa rtsigs te/ thog phebs legs pa dang slob dpon la khang pa tshar legs te lha ma mchis zhus pas/ btsan pos yo byad bdog bgyid shig/ lha byed pa 'ong gis gsungs pa dang / nyen khang dpe har nas tshur rgya mtshan ma can bya ba mchod rten rtsi'i skong bu skor dze gang khur/ spyir chag pa gang lag tu thogs te/ 'jim gzugs dang ri mo byed pa la 'dzam bu gling na nga mkhas te/ bod kyi btsan po lha khang rtsigs pa'i lha zhu zhing / lha bzo la bya dga' dbul byas pa dang / lha bzo gar song gi tol ma mchis te/ sprul pa yin par blta/ slob dpon gyi mchod pa bsham du gsol te/ dgung smus pa dang / ar+ya pa lo'i yang thog nas 'od nyi ma shar ba tsam dkar ba byung de ci yin zhus pas/ de bod la a mi de was bod la dgongs pa'i 'od yin pas/ rje a mi de wa'i yang thog bya'o gsungs nas/ yang thog tu a mi de wa gtso 'khor lnga bzhengs so//

༄7//sba bzhed zhabs btags ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 29de nas rgyal po a tsar+ya la rta mgrin sgrub pa'i lung zhus nas sgrub pa byas pa dang zla ba phyed nas ha ya ṣ+ṭṛ was ni phyed na skad lan gsum bton pas/ rtse sgod rnams kyis thongs nas/ bred de ci yin dris pa dang / a tsar+ya na re/rgyal pos sgrub pa brnyes nas rta mgrin gyi rta skad lan gsum bton pas/'dzam bu gling sum 2su thos te/ rgyal po'i chab srid kyang de tsam mo gsungs/de nas 'brang bting par zhus pas/ a tsar+ya na re/ dpal brag dmar bsam yas mi 'gyur gyis grub pa 'di/ 'dzam bu gling na byin che ba/ mdo sde dang /'dul ba dang / mngon pa dang / gsang sngags tham sa cad dang mthun zhing mi 'gal ba 'gran gyi do med pa cig bgyi 'tshal gsungs/ a tsar+ya de lta bu mkhyen nam zhus pas/ ngas shes de lta bu zhig o tan spu ri na yang yod/ de ci 'dra na sngon mu stegs rig 'dzin gyi sgrub pa pos dngos grub sgrub grub pa'i dngos grub len pa'i rtags dang ldan pa kun tu btsal bas ma rnyed pa de/ ma ga ta'i dge slong sgrub pa po'i nye gnas byed pa la tshang ma de zhu ba'i ched du slob dpon la maṇ+ḍal gser gyi nye bus bkram pa yang dang yang du phul bas/ dge slong na re khyod la gdams ngag 'dod dam gsungs/ rig 'dzin gyis smras pa/khyod kyi nye gnas dpa' ba'i rtags can 'di zhu'o zer des de la phul lo// de na sgrub khang du phyin pa dang ro sog phon tsam cig dkyil 'khor gyi steng ga 'dug go/ de la dge tshul khyod ro la dpa' ba'i rtags yod pas ma 'jigs par de'i lce gcod cig/ lce de gser gyi ral grir song ba dang nga la byin cig de gar gtad par 'gro bar nus pa yin te nga 'og min tu rig 'dzin sgrub tu 'gro ba yin/ ro 'di gser du 'gro bas de khyod la rngan par sbyin zer/ der des mnyam par bzhag go/ dge tshul ro la zhon nas lce gcod du bcug pa dang / ro 'gul zhing mig 'phrul/ kha btab btab byed pa dang / lce dar sham tsam cig byung ba ma zin no/ lan gnyis su ma zin pa dang / da res lce

30 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/ma chod na dang po nged rang gnyis gsod/ de nas stong gsum srid pa gsum gyi mi sems can gsod du 'ong bas/ sgrims las chod cig zer ro// des ro dang kha sprad nas sgrims pa dang / lce sos zin nas bcad pas ral grir gyur nas/ nam la dbyugs pas/ nam la dge tshul 'phur ba la/ rig 'dzin na dekhyod nang pa la pham pa 'ong ba yin/ ral dri (gri)ni nga dbang na da mar shog cig zer ba la/ de ltar yin mod ngas ltad mo blta zer nas/ ri rab kyi khar song nas gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla dang bcas pa lcog 4la sogs pa legs par bltas nas 'dzam bu gling du gri dbyugs pas/ rig 'dzin gyi drung du byung nas/ ro langs gser du sgrub pa de dge tshul gyis shig/ 'di dge slong lnga brgya'i 'tsho ba ldang ste rus pa la ma bcad log 'tsho la spyad na mi skye/ gzhan du na nang par bcad kyang nub mo skye 'ong zer nas ral dri nam la dbyugs te 'og min du song ngo // dge tshul des de slob dpon la smras pa dang / 'o cag dge slong lnga brgya'i bzhugs pa/ gtsug lag khang cig bya dgos pas/ mgon po la sa gzhi zhu ba'i gtor ma bya'o zer nas/ gtor ma byas pa bya rog gis khyer nas mtsho'i dkyil na de'u 1 yod pa de'i khar bzhag go/ de'u khar gtsug lag khang rtsig pa de'i dpe ri rab bzhi nyi zla gling phran bcas pa la dpe byas te bzhengs pa/ o tan pu ri bya ba yod/ btsan po'i thugs dam gyi dpe de la bya'o gsungs/ de nas yos bu'i lo la/ btsan po lo bcu gsum lon pa dang /mkhas su ri las pha bong shing rta la drangs te/ dbu rtse'i rmang gting / sa yar lung gad pa thog nas blangs/ shing shug pa dang tsan dan la legs pa dang /'di nas ma tshang ba 'dra/ btsan po nyal ba'i rmi lam du/ mi dkar po 1 na re/rgyal po khyod kyi lha ji lta bu 1 la bya bar sems zer/ de slob dpon la 'dri byas pa dang / de na re sa gzhi 'di jo mo sgrol mas byin gyis brlab pa yin/ sngon zhabs kyi bcag pa yin/ mkhas su ri'i rtse na/ shākya thub pa gtso 'khor bcu

༄༅//sba bzhed zhabs btags ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 31gnyis bcom ldan 'das dngos kyi byin gyis brlab pa yod/ de spyan drongs la gyis zer/ de ga na yod ston dang byas pas/ ba dmar mo 'us 'debs pa'i sa na yod zer/ der byin tsa na lha bcu dgu 'dug dgyes nas te te byas pas/ mnal sad pas rmi lam du red/ nang par blon kham pa 'khrid nas ltar phyin pas cang med 'di na 'dug pa yin pa la byas te/ btsan pos bye ma la zhabs sug byas pas ne gu bya ma lug tsam cig 'dug/ de bsal bas rdo rje'i sku rang byung the'u'i rjes med pa gtsug tor nag ldem pa/ spyan bkra hrig pa'i byang chub chen mo gcig gda' ste shing rta la bzhugs pa dang sa lan cig g.yos/ spyan drangs te shar sgor byon pa dang sa lan cig g.yos/ dri gtsang khang du byon pa dang sa lan cig g.yos/ khri la bzhugs pa dang btsan po dgyes te/ man de dang gser ka gsol/ phywa mkhan na re/ btsan po'i khang pa dang sbyar na lha chung mchis nas 'jag ma la ras g.yogs nas/ 'dag pa la gser gyi gyim 'bag lan bdun gsol nas bzhag rgyu rdo la byas bzo ni bod kyi lugs su byas te/ g.yas lho ngos kyi gral la byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po dang / rgyal ba byams pa/ thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs pa'i snying po/ dga' pa dpal/ khro bo khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba dang drug byang ngos na kun tu bzang po/ phyag na rdo rje/ 'jam dpal/sgrib pa rnam sel/ dge bsnyen chen po li tsa byi dri ma med par grags pa/ khro bo mi g.yo ba dmar po dang gtso 'khor bcu gnyis/ gsang ba 'dus pa la 'grel pa brgya rtsa brgyad yod pa las/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi lugs/lha bcu dgur mdzad pas drug sha nas byang chub chen po'i sku rgyab tu logs ldeb ri mos bris nas yod do// lte ba'i rgyud ris ni sku gsungs 'byung ba'i mdo bris/ lte ba'i kha phyir blta ba la mdo sde pad+ma dkar po'i brgyud rim bris/ kha nang lta'i skor khang la rin po che'i tog gi gzungs bris/ rnga khang la rje'i

32 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/thugs dam mdo sde dkon mchog sprin gyi brgyud rim/ 'og khang gi chos skyong mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i ral pa can la gtad/ de nas bar khang ge shing gla ba dang seng ldeng la byas/ lder bzo rgyu ba men gyi ko ba/ bzo rgya nag po'i lugs/gtso bo dpal rnam par snang mdzad/ g.yas na 'das pa'i sangs rgyas mar me mdzad/ g.yas na ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas byams pa bzhengs kha ma/ mdun na snang stong gi lha shākya thub pa/ tshes brgyad kyi lha sman gyi bla be+eḍūr+ya/ nya'i lha snang ba mtha' yas/ g.yas g.yon gyi byang chub sems dpa' 9 'am/'khor nye ba'i sras brgyad/ dge bsnyen chen mo dri ma med par grags pa/ byang chub sems dpa' dga' ba'i dpal khro bo gang dang ging zhes bya ba te rgya nag po'i skad/don 'og khang dang mthun/ kri ya'i lha tshogs bco lnga dang bstun/ nang gi rgyud ris yum rgyas pa'i gleng gzhi'i le'u brgyud ris su bris/ gdong la rgyal po chen po bzhi/ skor khang kha phyir blta ma mchod rten brgyad pa myang ngan las 'das pa'i brgyud ris/ kha nang blta la mdo sde sprin chen po'i brgyud ris/rnga khang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang / gshin rjes gshed kyi lha tshogs dang /bsam yas na gnas pa'i chos skyong ba rnams kyi 'bag chos skyong ba rgyal po shing bya can la gtad/ de nas steng khang gi shing thams cad thang ma dang gsom la byas/ lde bzo rgyu ras dang 'jag ma bzo rgya dkar po'i lugs/gtso bo sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad kun tu zhal bzhi ngo bo gcig re re la 'khor gnyis byang chub sems dpa' nye ba'i sras brgyad/ nang gi lha tshogs byang chub sems dpa'i rdo rje rgyal mtshan la sogs pa phyogs bcu nas lhag pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i khro bo mi g.yo ba bzhi/ phyag na rdo rje bzhi ste/ 'bu ta'i (budarnya'i)lha tshogs bzhi bcu zhe gnyis/ rgyud ris mdo sde sa bcu pa/ chos skyong ba rgyal po zangs ma'i bī log can/ thog rgya phebs za 'og gi ris can du phib/ lcog bzhi na steng gi zhing khams mdangs dga' ba can gyi sangs rgyas

༄༅//sba bzhed zhabs btags ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 33dga' ba'i dpal/ 'khor byang chub sems dpa' dga' ba byin la sogs pa'i rgyud ris bzhi/ de'i chos skyong gnod sbyin lag na rdo rje gos sngon can bzhi la gtad/ gañdzir spor la shel gyi tog can du btsugs/ de nas 'khor sa bar pa rtsigs te/ thang rtsigs khang mig dgus bskor ba rtsigs te/ lho phyogs rol khang klu'i bang mdzod gsum chos bkang ste/ gnod sbyin lag na dbyug pa thogs pa mched gsum la gtad/ nub ngos mdo rgyud chos kyi bang mdzod gsum rgya dpe bod dpe rgya nag gi dpe'i glegs bam rnams kyis bkang ste/ a tsa ra lag na spu gri thogs pa mched gsum la gtad/ byang ngos rin chen gter gyi bang mdzod gsum gser dngul zangs sder po la sogs pas bkang ste/ gshin rje lag na be con mched gsum la gtad/ brgyud ris mdo rgya cher rol pa bris/ bar gyi so rgyas su la bskal pa bzang po 'di la sangs rgyas stong 'byung ba dang / de'i 'og tu ngan 'gro'i bskal pa drug cu'i rjes la/bskal pa gnyan po chen po la/ sangs rgyas khri 'byung ba bris te/ ma shong ba gru skas kyi rtsig logs la bkod nas yod do// de nas 'khor sa chen mo'i skor te/dpal rnam par snang mdzad ngan song sbyong ba'i dkyil 'khor du bzhengs so//mda' yab kyi ngos bzhi la rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa rigs bzhi'i lha rnams zhal phyir blta ba/ nang du mdo stug po brgyan pa'i rgyud ris dang /nor bu bzang po dge ba'i bshes gnyen brgya rtsa bcu gnyis bsten pa bris so//des ma khengs pa 'phags pa snang brgyad kyis bkang / chos skyong klu'i rgyal po a nan ta u li ka la gtad do// rgyab tu rdo ring pad+ma can la bka' rtsigs kyi yi ge mdor bsdus bkod pa/ steng du seng ge bzhag nas/ chos skyong sing ha mu le la gtad do// dbu rtse'i sgo gsum shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa'i sgo gsum dang bstun/ rtsigs pa bskos te rmangs gzugs chu khung 'don/ nang

34 ༄7//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/du rka rmangs bya/ de'i steng du ka ba/ ka ba'i steng du ka lo/ de'i steng du gdung / de'i steng du phyam/ de'i steng du spang leb/ de'i steng du so phag dgram kha lan nyan gyis bskor/ logs la sum cha'i 'og tu/ dge khung phyi rub la nang yangs pa rgya mtsho lta bu bya/ bya gag mi 'jug pa'i phyir dra ba/ sbrang bu mi 'jug pa'i sgo gleb de rlung gis mi 'byed pa'i phyir 'khor brtan bya/ de 'byed pa'i dbyu gu skam kha bya/ stong du 'jog pa'i gru skas rmang rdo la byas/bar so phag steng shing las byas/ 'jus pa'i gdang bu byas te mi 'gul ba'i lcags gzer gdub bya ba la sogs pa/ rtsig pa 'dul ba dang bstun/ rgyud ris thams cad la mdo sde dang bstun/ de ltar na bzo bdun bcu don drugamado brgyud rgyud ris bcu bzhi/ ka ba stong dang rtsa gnyis/ sgo mo chen mo sum cu so drug sgo chung bzhi bcu zhe gnyis/ gru skas chen po drug bcong chen po brgyad/ dar thang chen po gsum/ 'phan chen po brgyad la sogs pa dang /mngon pa dang bstun pa'i gling 4gling phran bcu gnyis nyi zla dang bcas pa bzhengs te/ shar lus 'phags po gling g.yog dang bcas la dpe byas te/dang po rnam dag khrims khang gling zla gam du byas te/ lder bzo shākya thub pa gtso 'khor lnga bzhugs/ zla 'od gzhon nur bsgyur ba'i rgyud ris chos skyong tshangs pa dkar po dung gi thor tshugs can/ lte ba la sgo re/ 'khor sa la sgo gnyis 2gleng phran bcu gnyis po la yod do// mkhyen rab 'jam dpal gling na/'jam dpal rgyu ko ba la byas pa gtso 'khor bdun/ sgo srung gshin rje 2/nang gi lte ba la 'jam dpal gyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan bkod pa'i rgyud ris/ 'og khang na phal po che'i rgyud ris/ sgo mo che ba drug/ chos skyong pa gshin rje me'i 'khor lo can/ brda sbyor tshad ma gling na/ shākya thub pa gtso 'khor bdun/ lte ba mdo rin po che sna tshogs kyi rgyud ris/ phyi btsun pa'i g.yos khang / chos skyong rgyal po 'brug gi rlog (slog)pa can/ lho'i gling

༄༅//sba bzhed zhabs btags ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 35sogs (sog)kha gsum la/ bdud 'dul sngags pa gling na/ shākya mu ne bdud 'dul lugs ma/ lder po 4/ lte ba la mdo sde sa bcu pa/ 'khor sa la gtsug na rin po che'i mdo/ chos skyong ba dbyug ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ ar+ya pa lo'i gling na/ kha sar pa ṇi gtso 'khor lnga/ steng na a mi de wa gtso 'khor lnga/glo 'bur na sku gsung thugs kyi rten/ sku'i rten tsan dan gyi rus pa la gu gul gyi sha/ dngul gyi pags pa g.yogs pa'i rgyal po'i 'dra 'bag gcig bla 'bum yum chen mo 1/ phra men gyi mchod rten gcig rgyud ris mdo sde za ma tog bkod pa/ bso'i lha mo stong rtsa 2/ 'khor sa langs (sa lu ljang pa)bcu'i mdo/ chos skyong ba drang srong ta ma ra 'khor long ba rgyab 'brel dang bcas pa/ rgya gar gyi gling na jo bo byang chub chen po lugs la gtso 'khor lnga rgyud ris/ mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa dang / 'dul ba rnam par dag pa/mdun na lo paṇa sgra bsgyur ba'i khungs 1 la/ sgo so blta ba/ chos skyong ba gnod sbyin ra thod/ nub kyi gling zlum po gsum la/ be+e ro tsa na'i gling na rnam par snang mdzad zangs las byas pa/ 'khor gsang ba'i yum 4/ rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud ris/ chos skyong gnod sbyin glang gi mgo can/ byams pa gling na 'phags pa byams pa gtso 'khor bdun/ sgo srung gshin rje gshed gnyis/ rgyud ris mis mi dge ba spyad pas/ shākya thub pa'i bstan pa mar 'grib pa dang / tshe lo bcu pa nas mis dge ba byas pas byams pa'i bstan pa yar 'phel bris/ sna nam rgya tsha lha snang gis las dpon po byed thabs dang / byang chub ltung bshags kyi lha tshogs bkod/ chos skyong mkha' 'gro ma gu gling gi gos can/ bsam gtan gling na rnam par snang mdzad yab kyi thugs dam gnyan po byin can rigs lnga/ 'khor nyan thos chen po bcu drug dang bcas pa/ rgyud ris gser 'od dam nye 'don gyi lugs/ chos skyong ba rgyal po gtum pa'i mgo bo can/ byang gi gling gru bzhi gsum pa/ rin chen sna

36 ༄7//(sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/tshogs gling na shākya mu ne gtso 'khor lnga/ rgyud ris dga' ldan du yum la chos bshad pa/ drin lan bsob pa'i mdo/ chos skyong ba rgyal bo dbyi yi par ra can/ sems bskyed byang chub gling na phyag na rdo rje'i pho brang ngo // ri bo mchog rab na phyag na rdo rje rdo phur pa/ bdud rje 'khyil pa gsum/ bar chad srung ba rigasum/ gtso bo sangs rgyas ma chags pad+ma'i spyan nam mkha' la byon pa la byang chub sems dpa'i sgrib pa rnam sel gyis zhus sna ba byas te sa bcu pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rdo rje snying po la sogs pa sems bskyed zhu ba/ de'i bar bar na phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas de la byin gyis brlab pa zhe gnyis/ rgyud ris mdo dkon mchog sprin/ 'khor sa la 'phags pa rtag tu ngu shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'tshol ba/ chos skyong mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i 'gros can/dkor mdzod dpe har gling na shākya thub pa gtso 'khor dgu/ yab dang sras mjal ba'i mdo'i rgyud ris/ glo 'bur rnams na bsam yas 'byongs pa'i skor lhag ma 'di na 'di yod kyi rtsis yi ge khri shing sgrom gang de'i srung ma khri khang gi rgyal po/ phyi'i chos skyong dpe har la gtad/ yak+ṣa gong ma gang ba bzang po'i khang pa na/ shākya thub pa gtso 'khor lnga/ rgyud ris bskal pa bzang po'i mdo sangs rgyas stong rtsa 2chos skyong thang lha gang ba bzang po/ yak+ṣa 'og ma gnod sbyin nor bu bzang po'i khang pa na/ lder po dang rgyud rim mthun/chos skyong ba sham bu gnod sbyin nor bu bzang po la gtad/ der nyi sa dang zla ba/ shar phyogs kyi gling dang bcas pa kha dog ser po/ lhong ngos mthing ga be+eḍūr+ya/ byang ngos/ dkar po shel/ nus ngos dmar po pad+ma rā ku logs kyi zhal ba gnyer ma chu gnyer 'dra ba/ thang dkar la zhal phyi'i rgya mtsho la dpe byas pa yang byas so//de nas tshang mang ko tu gling na/ steng kha na slob dpon bo rnyi patwa'i gzims zhal dang / na so lha khang 'og khang na dkar thab/ chos skyong gnod

༄༅//sba bzhed zhabs btags ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 37sbyin lag na bhu gu thogs pa/ dag byed khrus kyi khang pa na/ khron pa tsan+da gyis bkang ba/ 'og so khag logs la rab tu byung ba skyo ba skyed pas skong dus kyi rnam pa bris/ chos skyong gnod sbyin lag na bum sa thogs pa/ mthu rtsal klu gling na se ba phung po la sbyin sreg byas pa'i yal ga brgyad la klu chen po brgyad byas/ de'i dbus su phyag na rdo zhig dkar bo 'dul byed du bzhengs/ rgyud ris nya dang sbal pa dang chu srin la sogs pa bris/ chos skyong pa bdag gnyan dgu rang chas su yod/ nang chu shel gyi khyab pa sus kyang balha bar sngo mi thog pa cig mchi/ de nas mchod rten dkar po byang chub chen po'i mchod rten nyan thos kyi lugs de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdung gis brgyan pa shud su nga mi rgyal dor rol las dpon byas te/ chos skyong ba gnod sbyin skar mda' gtong ba la gtad/ mchod rten dmar po chos kyi 'khor lo byang chub sems de'i lugs pad+mas brgyan pa/ sna rnam rgya tsha lha nang gis bzhengs/ chos skyong ba gza' migadamar la gtad/ mchod rten nag po rang sangs rgyas kyi lugs mchod rten gyis brgyan pa/ ngan lam stag ra klu gong gi bzhengs/ chos skyong ba gnod sbyin lcags kyi mchu can la gtad/ mchod rten sngon po dpal lha las bab pa de'i nags pa'i lugs/ lha khang gi sgo mo bcu drug brgyan pa mchis 'od bzhengs spro'u chung gis bzhengs/ chos skyong gnod ni nyi ma'i gdong la gtad/de'i tshe 'dre mo 'od can mas blon po nyal ba'i mgo mjug ltog pa la sogs pa'i 'tsho ba mang du byas nas/ de blon po la zhus pa/ byams pa'i gling du mchod rten 'od 'bar ba rtsigs nas mnan/ mchod rten chen po la 'od 'bar dang lnga/ mchod rten dkar ro gnyan grags pas las dpon shi nas/sdud du khri 'bring khong btsan pa'i rjes bsigs nas rtsigs lag pa dang / nang rdzongs ma mchis nas/ slob dpon la zhus pas ma ga rta'i rgyal po'i khab kyi sgo mdun na/ du lo tsā do bya ba'i nang na rgyal po gzugs can snying po'i skal ba de
