38 ༄༅//(sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/ni bde bar gshegs pa'i gdung ring srel ma ga 'i bre'i khal 1 bzhugs par grags so gsung ba dang / rgyal po de spyan drangs pa'i phyir/ bod kyi rta rngog chags sgas mnan pa cig kyang ma lus par chad la bsngos te/ 'gos kyi phag rer dus btab/ slob dpon gyis sa rgyus pa mdzad na mtha' khob kyi rta pa'i dmag drangs nas/ dpal mo dpal thang du grangs la btab pas/ rta pa bye ba phrag bcu 4byung / rgya gar mtha' 'khob tu rdol ba dang / yul de'i rgyal po bred nas mtha' khob kyi rgyal po de'i rta pa 'di 'dra na dpung gi chung gi tshogs dang / shing rta'i tshogs dang / glang po che'i tshogs ci 'dra bar 'gyur zer nas/ pho brang gi ya lad la btsan po'i lham btags de/ de'i 'og na phar 'khor dang bcas pa 'dzul nas/ nga'i rgyal khams 'di btsan po khyod kyi zhabs 'og tu 'dzul bas khyod kyi chab srid byed de/ bca' dang skyes lo dam du 'jal bar khas blangs nas mnga' 'og tu 'dus pa lags/ de nas chu'o gan rgal nas ma ga rnyar dmag drangs pa dang / ma ga rnya pa rnams kyi nor thams cad o tan pu rir bskyal nas mi thams cad rgya gar shar phyogs su bros nas/ g.yul sprad ma dgos par dpal rdo rje gdan du byang chub kyi shing la mchod pa byas nas mchod gnas spyan drangs pa'i phyir mchod rten kha phye ba'i nang na mtshon cha'i 'khor lo'i dkyil na rat+na'i bum pa 'dug pa/ de sus kyang blangs bar sngo ma thogs/ rgya gar gyi rgad bu 1 'dug pa na re/ nga la sngon gyi mi gleng ba'i lo rgyus yod/ rtse ta 'di'i byang ngos na rdo leb chen po'i dkyil gyi bug pa na rnga ma'i thag pa la bum pa btags te btang bas/ bum pa de chu'o gaṅgār 'byung de nas phar la gzhal bas tse ta dang sged khar thag snyam pa na/rdza'i bar du rtsa shing dang bye mas bkag pas chu chad nas mtshon cha'i 'khor lo ston pa yin zer na zhes zer/ de ji skad zer ba de ltar byas pas bden par byung nas rat+na'i bum pa nas de ni bde bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa'i ring

༄༅//sba bzhed zhabs btags ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 39srel bye drug spyan drangs nas rtsa shing gsal nas chu btang bas mtshon cha'i 'khor lo snga ma ltar 'khor ro// de nas tshur byon nas chu bo gaṅgā'i 'gram du bod kyi mi bzhi bskos nas/ 'di tshun chad bod kyi sa bcad yin pas 'dir rdo ring bgyis shig ces bka' bstsal mi bzhi pos bye khung du lcags kyi 7 ba btsugs te/ phyis bru sha'i dmag gi de gshig pas/ ma shig pas mes bzhu ba'i 'phro yod do// de'i lung phug na 'jug mkhan gyi mi bzhi po phyar pa bho ṭa tha khu ra'i rigs bya ba'i grong khyer chen po gcig kyang yod do// rta dmag bod du log pa shin tu nyung bas btsan po la dris pas/ rgya dkar po yul bzang bas min nam/ phar thang zer/ slob dpon la dris pas/ rgya dkar po cham la 'beb pa'i ched du btsan pos sprul pa byas pa yin/ dmag dang po nas 'di las med gsungs/ grangs pas mi 1 kyang ma lus rta 1 kyang ma chad par tshang bas/ btsan po khri srong lde btsan sprul bar grags so//de nas chos 'khor du byon nas/ ring srel gyi snod rat+na'i za ma tog phrugs byas pa'i bar du/ ring srel 'phel ba snyam pa lhag pa dag mchod rten gyi za ma tog la bzhugs/ mes kyi gnyan po gsang ba dang / mes srong btsan gyi thugs dam lnga dang / yab kyi thugs dam 2kyang der bzhugs pas lhag par byin rlabs che'o// de'i srog shing khas su ri'i rgyab na bal po bzo byed pa dang /sang srog shing 'dzugs par chad byas te/ blon po rnams 'brang zhags dang /shing rta ma sta gon byas pa dang / bal pos kung sang ma thog bzo 'phro la phyin pa dang / srog shing shul ha re'i stor/ de rje'i snyan du gsol bas/ rjes pho nya btang pas/ des srog shing gtsugs legs pa mthong / de skad du snyan du gsol bas/ kun bsags te nga'i 'bangs las stobs che ba 'di su yin bya dga' che thang du gnang ngo ces pas/ khas len pa su yang ma mchis sgyu mkhan pa na re/ 'dang nga'i rmi lam na mi bzhis srog shing gtsugs te/ khyod

40 ༄༅/〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/kyis mchod rten bdun rtsigs pa la 'di legs rab/ mchod rten 'di 'dzam bu'i gling na byin che ste 'di la su phyag dang skor byed pa de yid bzhin du 'grub/khyod kyi bya dga' 'di la bgyis mchis nas gser gyi ya lad 1 byin/ gnyid sad tsa na mi 4po mi gnang / ya lad 'di yin zer nas gser khrab 1 gda'/slob dpon na re/ de skad ston pa de rgyal po chen po 4yin pas/ dang por rgyal po chen po bzhi'i gzugs bya gsungs nas/ bum pa'i khar 'bag bzhi byas nas bzhag go/ de nas mgon khang bzhi nang phugs na shākya mu ne gtso 'khor gsum/ mdo na mgon po gnyis gnyis/ de'i sgo dra bar byas pa/sgo'i phyi na rta babs dang bcas pa/ steng na chos kyi 'khor lo gser las byas pa shar na dang / gdugs rgyal mtshan dang bcas pa bgyis te/ chos skyong ba rgyal po bzhi la gtad/ lcags ris zur mas rdo rje 'gros la mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad kyi tshul du mkhar skor nas re re la rang sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel re bzhugs pas/ chos skyong ba rgyal po stong ste bco brgyad la gtad/ bsam yas spyi'i chos skyong dpal mgon po nag po la gtad/ de ltar na dpal brag dmar bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa gzhi rgya che la dpangs mtho ba/ rgyu bzang la bkod pa legs pa/ dung phor gzis bkang ba 'dra ba/ rje'i thugs dam 'bangs yongs spyi mchod gnas/ yos bu'i lo rmang bres nas/ yos bu'i lo la 'byongs pa lags so/jo mo lnga khab tu bzhes pa las/ mchims bza' lha mo btsan dang /mkhar chen bza' 'tsho rgyal 2grub pa mdzad pas phyag ris med/ 'bro bza' khri rgyal yang mo btsan rab tu byung ba'i mtshan/ byang chub rjer gsol ba'i phyag ris/ dge rgyas kyi gtsug lag khang lags te/ snang ba mtha' yas gtso bo mdzad pa/ gtso 'khor dgur mdzad pa lugs stod du btab nas spyan drangs pas/ gnyis chab la shor/ 'khor drug po g.yas na rigs gsum mgon po/

༄༅//sba bzhed zhabs btags ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 41g.yon na sangs rgyas sman gyi lha dang / sangs rgyas kun tu bzang po/ mi g.yo mgon po bzhugs su gsol/ sras mi mnga' bas pha ming gi 'gro yul thag ring / phyis gso mi yong 'ong mchi nas/ lha lugs mar mdzad/ rtsigs pa so phag zha nye'i chus sbyar zangs kyi thog bskal/ rol mor 'gran bzang bshig pa'i cong 'ching phu'i rdza la skyal ba de yin gsung cong btags/ snang bar rin chen mar gad/ a mi de ba'i dpral bar 'phra btab bo// jo mo tshe spong bza' me tog sgron la sras mnga' bas khams gsum zang khang gi gtsug lag khang /yab kyi dbu rtse la dpe blangs nas bzhengs su gsol/ pho yong bza' rgyal mo btsun rgyal po'i yum tshe 'phos par slob dpon gyis lung bstan pas khab tu bzhes nas lan par gsol bas khab tu de la lha lcam las mi mnga' bas lha khang nyis thog tu gnang bas dbu tshal gser khang rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du bzhengs su gsol/ lha bzo ba la zas sna bcu gsum drangs pas/bzo sna bcu gsum byas te/ steng khang logs la rtsigs pa med pa/ nang na ka ba med pa/ gla gor gyi sgo ra rdza'i rgya dang btsun mo'i 'bags thub pa/ sa gzhi ra gan las byas pa g.yu'i gdung ma la gser gyi rta rgyug pa'i 'bur dod pa/gza' chen po brgyad kyis gdung ma brgyad 'degs pa/ mthing gi rgya phigs kha phyir blta nang blta yod pa/ chu thams cad 'dril nas seng ge'i kha nas 'babs pa/ de rul (rus)sbal gyi rgyab tu 'ong ba/ sgo 'byed bcod las gser gyi byi chung skad 'don pa/ nang gi kre ya'i lho phyogs la spyi gdugs re dang sger gdugs re pheb pa/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis 'bur du dod pa/ lha'i bus khyung gi sgo nga las bdud rtsi'i chus lha la khrus gsol ba ngo mtshar ba cig bzhengs su gsol/ de nas slob dpon la mnga' gsol gyi zhu rten gser phye bre drug phul nas zhus pas/ bod 'bangs mnga' ris thams cad la bca' dang khral bsdus la yo byad sta gon gyis shig ces lung gnang / slob dpon ke ru

42 ༄༅//(sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/gling na mtshams bcad nas sgrub pa la bzhugs/ ba so lha khang lo bcu gnyis na bzo tshar/ btsan pos mnga' 'bangs kun bsdus te brag dmar skye bo'i tshogs kyis khengs/ slob dpon ke ru gling na mkhar gzhong me tog gis bkang nas byon pas mchod rten dkar po'i gong du byon pa btsan pos 'jam dpal rdo rje zhal gsum phyag drug pa phyag na rin po che'i me tog thogs pa cig gzigs/ slob dpon gyi ting nge 'dzin gyis dbu rtse'i 'og khang gi lha rnams phyir spyan drangs te mchod rten dkar po la skor ba byas te/ zhal shar phyogs su gzigs nas 'khor sa'i logs na prog zhu zing nge bzhugs pa la me tog gtor/ lha rnams dus 1 tu nang du gshegs te/ sngar gyi gral 4du 'khod/khro bo gnyis kyi rgyab nas ye shes kyi me 'bar bas sa tshig pa slob dpon gyis dri chab gsang gtor mdzad pas me shi ba'i shul gsor ma 'tshal/ btsan pos me tog tu yon gser phye gzhong pa gang phul/zhal spro chen po'i dus su phyi'i lcags ri'i stong mchod rten gyi bar thams cad bzhes pa dang thud skyal gyis bkang / de ltad mo ba rnams la'ang 'tshal bas/ skal pa gnyis gnyis gsum gsum thob/ skal pa chad pa ni ye ma mchis/ de'i rjes la kun ltad mo che thang re byed/ sman ri la lan 'ga' brag chung nyi ma lde ba'i drung du sha ba byung ba la zhags pas bzung nas khrom skor/ltad mo dang po'i byad lugs 'khor sa'i sgo rgyab tu bris nas yod do// sang nang par yang slob dpon ke ru gling nas mkhar gzhong me tog gis bkang nas byon pa/ btsan pos dge slong rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan can gzigs/ slob dpon gyis ting nge 'dzin gyis dbu rtse bar khang gi lha phyir spyan drangs te/'khor sa'i logs la zhal shar du gzigs pa la me tog gtor bas lha rnams dus gcig la nang du gshegs te sngar gyi gral bzhin du 'khod/ btsan pos gser phye gzhong pa gang yon du phul/

༄༅//sba bzhed zhabs btags ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 43zhal spro chen po'i dus su ltad mo ba mtshal mar sngar bzhin du mtshal nas/rjes la ltad mo che thang re byed/ sdog pha las rnga mong bdun la zhon res byed cing byung / la la go ru rgyug pa'i steng na ral gri'i sgo 'phen/ la la mi 2 1 gis 'phan 'phyar ba la sogs pa ltad mo bar sa'i byad lugs rnams 'khor sa'i sgo rgyab tu bris yod/ yang slob dpon ke ru gling nas mkhar gzhong me tog gis bkang ba bsnams nas byon pa de/ btsan pos dge slong 'jam dpal rdo rje dbu rgyan gcig tu gzigs/ slob dpon gyis dbu rtse yang thog gi lha rnams bad smug po'i khar ting nge 'dzin gyis spyan drangs nas dbu rtse thang nas me tog 'thor lha rnams dus 1 tu nang du gshegs te sngar gyi gral bzhin 'khod/ btsan pos gser phye gzhong pa gang yon du phul/ zhal spro chen mo'i dus su ltad mo ba la mtshal mar sngar bzhin mtshal/ rjes la ltad mo che thang re byed/ 'jang rgan po seng ldan gyi gdung ma bcu gnyis thod pa la btsugs nas dbu rtse'i thang la bang rgyug nas lho'i sgo'i them khar bor/ de re re yang mi res ma theg pho shing btang ba mang po shing khar na phar rgyugs sa shing rtse la sgyu ma mkhan lus la me 'bar/ thang shing la byi chung phyang mo nyug pa la sogs pa byung ༵ ltad mo tha ma'i byad lugs kyang ngo mtshar bas 'khor sa'i sgo'i rgyab tu bris phyir slob dpon bo lha sa tas bsam yas kyi chos 'khor ma bu rnams la mnga' gsol lan brgyad byas so// lan bdun byas pa'i rten de sprul pa'i sku dngos dung byin rlab 'dra ba yin no/ de'i rjes la btsan po bsil khang gi mtsho nang du pad+ma'i stong po skyes pa'i khar bzhugs nas/ thugs dam gyi lha khang 'byongs pa la gzigs pas shin tu dgyes te/ nga'i dbu rtse rigs gsum 'di rtsigs pa mi 'dra skyes pa 'dra ste nga re dga'/ bya ba la sogs pa'i dga' glu bcu gsum 'gur du bzhes so// blon po rnams kyis kyang rang rang gi che ba nga

44 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/rgyal re glur blangs te/ mchims kyi nga che rgyang grags la sogs pa'o lo bcu gnyis kyi bar du skyid pa'i bro mo che brdungs/ mi res glu re/ rta res bang re/bya res skad re bton/ bod kyi bde skyid sngar dar bab lags/ de'i dbu rtse'i sgo rgyab byang ngos na bris nas yod do//dus der rje blon rnams rtsed bro dang lo brgyad la yongs pas bsam yas kyi rtsig rmang thams cad byi khung du byas te/ lha khang la mchod cing zhabs tog med pas btsan po thugs ma bde/ 'bangs rnams la chos bya bar rigs so zhes gsol nas/ slob dpon gyis rgya gar gyi skad bslab pas/ sba gsal snang dang / sba khri bzher sang shi ta dang / sa dkar po na 'dod gyi bu be+e ro tsa na dang / mchims a nu'i bu shākya dang / shud pu khong sleb la sogs pas skad lobs/ mchims legs gzigs la sogs pa zhang blon gyi bu tsha mang zhig snyung nas skad mi lob pas/ blon po 'gos rgan gyi mchid nas/ slob dpon la gon pa rnams la long ma mchis pas/ a tsa ra'i skad bslab mi khom pas rgan chos su mchi zhus pas slob dpon gyi bod kyi a pha dang a ma'i skad don thog tu phob te/ chos skad dang mthun par mkhyen nas/ bod skad du chos bshad pas sam kri ta'i skad slob ma dgos/ bod byang chub sems dpa'i sprul ba'i skad yin pas/ chos byar btub bo gsungs/de nas lug lo'i dpyid zla rang gi ngo la slob dpon gyis thams cad yod par smra ba'i sde/ dbus pa bye brag tu smra ba'i dge slong bcu gnyis su spyan drangs nas bod skad sbyang pa dang / btsan po'i zhal nas nga'i blon po dge slong med pas/ nga'i zhang blon po rnams la de btub bam mi btub ces bka' stsal ba'i lan du/ btub bam sad par bya gsungs nas/ bod la dad pa che ba 'ba' khri gzigs dge slong byas ma thag tu mngon par shes pa dang ldan pas btsan po dgyes te de'i zhabs spyi bor blangs nas khyod bod kyi rat+na yin no zhes

༄༅//sba bzhed zhabs btags ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 45bka' stsal pas ming kyang sba rat+na zhes btags te/ bod kyi rab tu byung ba la snga ba de yin no/ btsan po na re/ slob dpon nga'i zhang blon dad pa can da rung rab tu byung gcig ces gsungs pas/ sad cig gsungs nas sba gsal snang dang / 'ba' khri bzher sang shi ta dang / sa dkar po na 'dod kyi bu be+e ro tsa na dang / ngan lam rgyal ba mchog yangs dang / sma a tsa ra rin chen mchog dang / la gsum rgyal ba'i byang chub drug dge slong byas te/ ming kyang ye shes dbang po dang dpal dbyangs la sogs par btags nas/ sad mi drug rab tu byung / btsan po'i zhal nas shākya thub pa'i bstan pa la sgrub pa byed na rab tu 'byung dgos pa yin pas/ da btsun mo srid ma zin pa dang /zhang blon gyi bu tsha dad pa can thams cad rab tu byung gcig ces gsungs nas/blon po rnams na re/ rab tu byung na 'tsho ba med do mchis pas/ btsan po na re/ ngas 'tsho ba bla nas sbyar cig gsungs/ blon po na re/ dmag dang khral ma byas na chad pa 'ong ngo zer/ de la ngas chab 'og nas bde byin la/ dbu'i mchod gnas bya'o gsungs/ sde snod gsum bslab mi nas zer nas/ de la dge ba nyams dang spobs la sbyod cig ces bka' gnang ngo //de nas pra ti ha ti mchod pa byas pa'i dus su jo mo cen khri rgyal mang mo btsan dang / sru btsun mo rgyal la sogs pa rab tu byung ba'i mkhan po sba rat+nas byas/ spyir sum brgya tsam rab tu byung nas/ dbu rtse'i bya 'dab dang /mchod rten chen po bzhi'i rtse mo lcags thag gis sbrel/ de la 'phan mgo btab te nam snam dar la gyis/ sa gzhi gser phor dang dngul phor gyis bkang nas phul/ bka' sho chen po byung chos kyi khrims bcas/ de nas pho mig mi dbyung ba dang / mo sna mi bcad pa/ mtshang can mi kum pa/ skye bo thams cad kyis rje'i bka' nyan pa/ rje 'bangs thams cad kyis rab tu byung ba dbur phyung la phyag dang mchod gnas bya ba/ de ltar bya ba'i ched du btsan po yab sras dang /

46 ༄༅//(sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/sna chen po ma gtogs pas bro bor ro//de nas rje blon kun chos bya bar mos nas/ rgya'i lo tsa ni lo tsa chen mo ye shes dbang po/ mchan bu kha che a nan ta dang / rgya me 'gos byas/ rgya nag po'i lo tsa ni bran ka legs ko dang / lha lung klu gong dang / 'go gom dmul gong gsum de'i mchan bu mkhan bu khyung po tse tse la sogs pas byas/ rgya'i ha shang ma zhang me skol spyan drangs nas rgya nag po'i chos bsgyur/ rgya dkar po'i chos gang bsgyur ba yang / rtsa ba'i sde bzhir gnas pa la/ phal chen pa'i sde pa/gnas brtan pa'i sde pa/ mang pos bskur (bkur)ba'i sde gsum/ sha la yangs pas bod la mi 'tshal ('tsham)bar mkhyen nas ma bsgyur/ dang po lung sde bzhi po bsgyur/ de nas rtsa ba'i lung nyi shu pa dang / gang po'i rtogs pa brjod pa nyung ba bsgyur/ mngon par nyos kyi ka sha bsgyur/ yo ga mu stegs byed dge ba la bzur pa'i chen du gtsang rme med par bstan pa chos gzhung ji lta ba ma gtogs te/ log par 'jal ba'i rtog par gyur pas bod la mi 'tshal bas ma bsgyur/ kṛ ya bram ze dge ba la gzhug pa'i don du gsungs te/bodagatsang sbra chung bas ma bsgyur/ a nu sme bag can la bstan pa bod rnam rtog che bas ma bsgyur/ u pa ya bod la ran par mkhyen nas ye shes dbang pos gsol nas bsgyur/ mdo sde dang / gzungs rgya gar yul du ma lus pa btsan po'i thugs la bcags pa tsam bsgyur/ de nas btsan po na re/ ye shes dbang po/ rgya dang rgya gar gyi rdarma/ theg pa chen po'i chos kyi dpe phal cher/ dpal shri na len tra na yod pa de mes tshig/ de'i dpe da lta rgya nag na tshang bar yod pa shas shig ma 'gyur ba nga'i yid la bcags so gsungs/ de'i tshe gus pa yod pa kun gyis bka' rnyed tshad bsgyur ro// de nas bla chen mo nas 'tsho ba sbyar/ ke ru gling du g.yos mal byas te/ rab tu byung ba sum brgya zas sna bcu gnyis bcu gnyis 'dren/ de'i las dpon jo mo byang chub rjes mdzad

༄7//sba bzhed zhabs btags ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 47gdan non byas pa dang / rgyas pa bam po re la shog dril re byas nas 'bum tshar re sgreng / dus der blon po 'gos kyi mchid nas lha chos ni rgyas par mdzad de skye bo mi chos kyi lo rgyus ci gnang mchis nas rje'i gdung rabs dang /'bangs kyi sa bcad dang / bla rab dkon mchog gsum la phyag dang zhes pa dang / gtam dang lo rgyus dang / dge dang yigs tshangs ji ltar yin lugs rgyas par gnang ngo // de'i dus su mkhan po pho brang rim dgu'i 'og khang du go rus dbu la phra ba rgyab te zhal chems ye shes dbang po la bzhag te sku gshegs/der pur khang has po ri'i rgyab tu bzhus nas mchod rten 1 kyang bzhings/der btsan pos ye shes dbang po ring lugs su bskos/ 'dug sa yang bla'i gong du bton/ rab tu byung ba mang bas chos grwa'i slob dpon dang / nya ma'i slob dpon bskos/ na bza' mang ba la 'phan gyis sbyor/ ring lugs la zla ba re khal bdun cu/ chos grwa'i slob dpon la sum cu rtsa lnga/ chos slob la bcu gnyis thang du bcad/ slad kyi ye shes dbang po mngon shes dang ldan pas/dkon mchog gi rten yun du gnas pa'i ched du/ dkon mchog gi rten la 'bangs mi khyim brgya/ ban de re la 'bangs mi khyim gsum du bcad/'bangs lha ris pa la bla nas dbang mi bya bar chad nas/ dbang dge 'dun la bskur nas/ nyang ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa ye shes dbang po la mi nyan pa kun mi mchi dgu mchi bas/ ye shes dbang po bros nas lho brag khar chu btsan gyi brag phug tu song / stag la gwa bskal sba zi btsugs te sgom pa'i lus la bya sa rdo la bab pa ltar bab/ khrims grogs la bya nyer yang mi btub/de'i 'og tu dpal dbyangs ring lugs su bskos pas/ rgya'i hwa shang ma hā ya na bya ba byung nas/ lus ngag gi chos spyod dge ba byas pas sangs mi rgya/dran pa med cing yid la byed pa sgom pas sangs rgyas zer nas/ sgom bslab pas/ bod rim gyis kho'i chos la slob/ bsam yas la mchod pa 'phro bcad

48 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/slob gnyer dang lus ngag gi dge sbyor 'phro bcad/ sba rat+na dang / be+e ro tsa na dang / 'ba' dpal dbyangs la sogs pa nyung shas cig slob dpon bo rti sa twa'i chos slob/ lta ba ma mthun nas rtsod par gyur/ (gsung rab rin po che'i bang mdzod du/ ston mi dang / rtsen min/ rgya skad yin pas bod skad du cig car ba dang rim gyis pa bya ba yin gsungs/) btsan pos rgya'i ston pa'i chos 'di min byas pas/ ston min pa bya bar grags/ drang srong bzod pas lus la me spar nas mchod par phul nas/ sems can la brtse ba'i sgo nas tshogs bsags pa gal che byas pas btsan po na re/ lus la me spar ba'i rtse ba de yang chos min nam byas pas brtsen min par grags lta ba dang spyod pa 'dzom pa'i chos yin pas/ chos rtsen min pa'i chos ltar yin byas pas/ ston min pa yid chad pa ltar byas nas myang sha mis rang gi sha bcad/ rngog rin po che dang mnya' ba'i mas rang gi pho mtshan brdungs/ rgya'i ston pas rang gi mgo la me btang / gzhan rnams chu gri re gtsugs nas rtsen min pa til le bsad nas nged kyang 'khrul pa'i ngos su mchi'o zer/ de btsan po'i snyan du snyad pas ji ltar bya ba la ma shes te/ ban de ston rtsen g.yon skor/ de ye shes dbang po la zhu ba'i 'bod mi mar btang bas ma khugs nas slob dpon khams pa btang ste/ khyod nyid ye shes dbang po spyan drangs na zangs chen po bya dgar byin ma khugs na bsad do zhes bka' bsgos nas/ btsan pos sgrom bu skur nas btang ngo // khams pas brag phug su phyin bka'i sgrom bu nang du bskur nas/nang du mchi bar ci gnang zhus pas/ mchi bar gnang ste/ zhal mjal nas bdag ngos gtsugs te byon na bya dga'ang gnang / ma byon na bdag 'gum pas bdag brag la mchongs te 'gum mo zhes byas pas/ 'dir bar chad kyi bdud chen po zhig 'ongs te/ khyod nyid srog 'don gsungs nas nga 'ong gi rta ded la shog bya ba'i phrin skur khams pa dga' ches nas pho brang btsan po'i snyan

༄༅//sba bzhed zhabs btags ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 49du gsol bas bya dga' gnang nas go ru bcu drug ded nas ye shes dbang po spyan drangs te pho brang du btsan po la phyag bzhes pas/ btsan pos btsun pa 'khrug pa'i lo rgyus zhib tu gsungs pas/ ye shes dbang po na re/ de la bdag dgug mi 'tshal/ mkhan po bo bhi satwa'i zhal chems bdog / bdag sgom pa'i bar chad ma byas na tshe ring btsan po yang sku tshe ring la dam pa'i chos kyang 'phags pa byams pa ma byon pa'i bar du gnas pa yin pa la/ bod la skal pa ma mchis/ mkhan po mda' khar 'di skad ces gsungs te/ sangs rgyas kyi chos gang dar ba der/ mu stegs kyi rgol ba'i dgra de 'gran du 'ong ba yin te/ bod yul du lnga brgya'i tha mar gyur pas sangs rgyas kyi chos dar kyang mu stegs kyi rgol ba ni mi 'ong na/ nang pa sangs rgyas nang lta ba ma mthun nas rtsod par 'gyur bas de tsa na nga'i slob ma ka ma la shi la bya ba paṇ+ḍi ta chung ba gcig bal yul na yod de khug la chos gyi rtsod pa'i shag 'debs su chug ces rtsod pa chos phyogs su 'dums par 'gyur ro gsungs/ zhes gsol nas/btsan pos ka ma la spyan 'dren pa'i pho nya btang ba dang / ston pa yum rgyas pa spyan drangs te bsam gtan gling du sgo bsdams nas zla ba bzhi'i bar du shar slob/ mdo dgongs pa nges par 'grel pa rdog pas 'grel cing 'di chos min mchis nas 'bor/ de'i bar du ye shes dbang pos mkhan po dang ha shang gnyis kyi lta ba dang dgongs pa ji ltar yin pa/ btsan po'i snyan du gsol bas btsan po'i dgongs pa grol nas dges che ste/ ye shes dbang po'i zhabs phyag 'tshal zhing khyod nga'i a tsa bya'o ces yang yang gsungs/ dus phyis ka ma klung tshugs su byon zhes pho nya ba byung ba dang / rje blon yongs chab khar bsu ba la phyin pas ha shang 'khor dang bcas pa yang chab khar byon/ ka ma la chab pha rga nas/ rgya'i parnyi ta la sgra rtsod dri gsungs nas chags (khams gsum du cis 'khor bya bar )shing dbu la lan gsum bskor bas/ ha shang (gzung 'dzin

50 ༄7//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/gnyis kyi lan bya bar )chab tshur rga nas ber gyi thu ba gnyis nas bzung nas sprug de la lan (gnyis gas go bar)btab 'jigs po gcig 'dug go gsungs/ de nas byang chub gling du seng khri bcas te btsan po gung la bzhugs nas/ ston rtsen shags gdab par byas nas/ ha shang g.yas gral du bzhugs te/ 'khor jo mo byang chub rje dang / sru yang dag dang / ban de lang ka la sogs pa gral ring po byung / a tsar+ya ka ma la g.yon gral du bzhugs te/'khor dpal dbyangs dang / be+e ro tsa na dang / rat+na la sogs pa nyung shas shig byung / btsan pos ston rtsen re re'i phyag tu me tog dkar po'i phreng ba re re phul te/ bka' stsal pa nga'i mnga' ris bod kyi rgyal khams 'dir/ bod thams cad ril nag po la dga' ba'i dus su/ za hor gyi rgyal po'i bu bo lha sazhwaspyan drangs nas/ bod 'bangs nyung shas cig chos la bkod/ dad pa can kha cig rab tu byung / dkon mchog gsum gyi rten gtsugs pa'i skabs su/rgya nag po'i ha shang ma hā ya na byon pas bonakyi btsun pa phal cher de la slob par gyur/ bo lha satwa'i slob mar gyur pa nyung shas tsam slob tu ma btub pas/ston rtsen du chad de 2ma mthun nas rtsod par gyur pa la ngas zhal cher bcad pas ma rangs nas/ myang sha mi dang / rngog dang / snyas rang gi lus la na tsha bskyed/ ha tshang me 'gos rang gi 'dus la me btang bas btsan pos g.yon skor/ bo lha satwa'i 'khor ka ma la shi la yin pas khyed shags su gyis la su gtan tshigs bzang ba de la su ngan pa de la nga rgyal ma byed par me tog phul cig ces bka' stsal/ de la ha shang na re nga gzhi la snga bas/ ngas dri'i lan du gdab gsungs/ ka ma la'i zhal nas khyod kyi dgongs pa ltar shags thob cig gsungs pa dang / ha shang na re/ thams cad sems kyi rnam par rtog pas bskyed pa/ dga' mi dga'i dbang gis/ las dge mi dges mtho ris dang ngan song gis 'bras bu myong zhing 'khor ba na 'khor te gang zhig ci la'ang mi

༄༅//sba bzhed zhabs btags ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 51sems ci yang yid la mi byed pa de 'khor ba las yongs su thar bar 'gyur ro//de lta bas na ci yang mi bsam mo// sbyin pa la sogs pa'i chos spyod bcu spyod pa ni skye bo dge ba'i 'phro med pa blo zhan pa dbang po rtul ba rnams la bstan pa yin/ sngon blo sbyangs pa dbang po rnon pa dag la/ sprin dkar nag gang gis nyi ma sgrib pa ltar dge sdig 2kas sgrib pas/ ci yang mi sems mi rtog mi dpyod pa ni mi dmigs pa'o// 1 car 'jug pa ni sa bcu pa dang 'dra'o gsungs/ a tsar+ya ka ma las smras pa/ de ltar ci yang mi sems zer ba de ni so sor rtog pa'i shes rab spangs pa yin no/ yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi rtsa ba ni/so sor rtog pa'i shes rab yin pas/ de spangs pa'i 'jig rten las 'das pa'i shes rab kyang spangs pa yin no/ so sor rtog pa'i shes rab med par rtog pa thabs gang gi rnam par mi rtog pa la gnas/ gal te chos thams cad dran pa med cing yid la byed pa med pa yin na/ nyams su myong ba thams cad mi dran cing yid la bya bar mi nus so// gal te bdag gi chos bstan par mi bya yid la mi bya'o snyam na/ de shin tu dran pa yid la byas par 'gyur ro// dran pa dang yid la bya ba med pa tsam po la bya ba skad du bya na de 2spyad dgos te med pa ni rgyur mi rung / dran pa med pa tsam gyis rnam par mi rtog par gyur na rgyal ba dang 'bog pa'i dus su'ang dran pa med par rnam par mi rtog par 'gyur ro// yang dag pa'i so sor rtog pa med pa rnams mi rtog par 'jug pa'i thabs med do// dran po ba tsam po bkag kyang yang dag pa'i so sor rtog pa med na chos thams cad ngo bo nyid med pa la ji ltar 'jug nus pa/ stong pa nyid ma rtogs par sgrib pa spangs par mi 'gyur ba kho na'o// stong pa nyid ma rtogs kyang / dran pa med par thar par 'gyur na/ khams gong ma'i lha thams cad thar par 'gyur ro// dran pa cang med pa'i rmongs pas ni rnal 'byor du ji ltar 'gyur/ de ni glen pa'i gnyid log pa dang 'dra'o// de bas

52 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/na yang dag pa'i so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyi phyin ci log gi snang ba rgyang srings pa yin no/ de bas na dran bzhin du mi dran byar mi rung ngo // dran pa dang yid la byed pa med pas sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa dang / thams cad mkhyen par ji ltar 'gyur/ nyon mongs pa yang ji ltar spongs/ de bas na yang dag pa'i so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyi don nges par rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ dus gsum phyi nang thams cad stong par rtogs pas rtog pa nye bar zhi nas/ lta ba ngan pa thams cad spangs te de bstan nas thabs dang shes rab la mkhas pas/ sgrib pa thams cad bsal nas sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad thob par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs so//btsan po'i zhal nas khyed ston rtsen shag gang rgyal ba'i 'khor kun kyang mchid shags thob cig ces bka' stsal pas/ sang shi'i mchid nas/ rgya'i ltar na cig car 'jug cing rim gyis sbyong mchis na/ pha rol du phyin pa drug 'dzin pa ma mchis pa'i slad du sbyin par ming btags kyi khams btang nas/yongs su 'dzin pa med na sbyin pa btang ba yin/ sgo gsum chags sdang bkag na tshul khrims yin/ khro ba med na bzod pa'i mchog legs/ le lo 'dor ba la brtson 'grus su btags/ sems la g.yeng ba ma mchis na bsam gtan/choso rang dang spyi'i mtshan nyid shes na shes rab yin/ ston pa 'das nas ring zhig tu lta ba ma mthun pa ma mchis/ slad nas dbu ma rnam gsum mi mthun te/ston min cig car du 'jug mchis te/ ma mjal ma rtogs pas de ltar gyur/'jug sgo tha dad kyang sangs rgyas pa cig 'bras bu'ang gcig ces don spyi mthun pa skad smra ba/ dpal dbyangs kyi smras pa cig car 'jug bya ba 'di dang / rim gyis 'jug bya ba 'di 2spyad dgos te/ rim gyis 'jug na rgyu ma mchis pas de dang mi 'dra/ cig car 'jug na khyed dpung ci byed dang po nas sangs rgyas na ci nyes/ de bas na ri la 'dzeg pa dka' ste/ gom pa

༄༅//sba bzhed zhabs btags ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 53gcig gis sgrod mi nus pa ltar sa dang po thob pa yang dka' na thams cad mkhyen pa lta ci smos/ khyed la lung bstan pa'i khungs dgos/ ston rtsen min mi 'dra ste/ nged rtsen min pa gsung rab kun bslab/ shes rab rnam pa gsum la brten/ don ma nor bar shes/ chos spyod bcu la bslab/ bsgoms pas sa dang po la bzod pa yang thob/ yang dag pa'i skyon med par yang 'jugade nas sa dgung pa yang dag pa'i shes rab kyis rim par sbyangs pha rol du phyin pa bcu la bslab/ rgyud sbyangs tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas sangs rgyas brnyes lags na/ khyed ltar tshogs ma bsags blo ma sbyangs par 'jig rten gyi bya ba yang mi shes na thams cad mkhyen pa'i rig pa dang shes bya thams cad la 'jug par ji ltar 'gyur/ ji ltar tshogs ma bsags par ci yang ma byas na gum nas zan yang mi myong na ltogs te 'chi na/ sangs rgyas rang gzhan gyi phun sum tshogs pa de'i rgyu ci las grub/ stong pa 1 pus rang la yang mi phan na gzhan gyi don lta ga la 'grub/ khungs med cing thabs shes ya bral ba'i chos kyis sangs rgyas la skur pa btab ste bslus pa yin/ byang chub sems dpa' ni sems can gyi don du sems bskyed nas sems can gyi don lhur byas nas/tshogs bsags nas thabs thams cad la mkhas par bslab/ shes rab rnam pagasum la blo sbyangs/ ye shes gyis tshogs bsags sgrib pa rnam pa 2sbyangs/blo'i dri ma thams cad spangs nas mthu rdzogs pa dang sangs rgyas nas/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god par mdzad pa'i 'phrin las 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du lhun gyis grub pa yin par lung du ma nas gsungs so//ci yang mi'i sems pa ni sgo nga dang 'dra'o// ma btags par gom pa dor kyang rtags gsal te chos ga la rtogs/ de bas na mdo sde che chung zhib par bslab/zhi gnas dang lhag mthong dben par yid la rtog pa yid la myong ba shar/ de ltar rtog pa'i don du tshogs bsags shing / sems ji lta bu ni sgyu ma lta bu ste/

54 ༄༅//(sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/don dam par de ma skyes par rtogs te/ chos thams cad chu shing gi snying po lta bur ma bcos par rtog na dus gsum mi dmigs par gyur te/ chos dang gang zag la bdag ma mchis te/ bying rgod ma mchis par zung 'brel du ngang gis 'jug pa lags te/ sgom pa'ang de ltar lags ces 'chi ba dang / ston min pas shags lan smra bar ma nus te/ me tog gtor nas pham blangs so//de nas btsan po'i zhal nas/ ha shang gi chos cig car 'jug mchi ba des chos spyod bcu la skyon bkal/ sems ni bying / tshogs ni mi gsogagazhan gyi blo sbyong 'phro bcad pas chos kyang nub par 'gyur bas/ 'phro chod la khyod rang bsgoms shig deng slan chad lta ba na ga dzu na'i lta ba bzung / spyod pa pha rol du phyin pa drug la bgyis la chos spyod bcu nyams su blang / sgom pa shes rab rnam gsum la bgyis/ blo sbyong la thabs shes zung du 'brel bar bsgoms/ da slan chad nga'i bod kyi 'bangs rje blon gang dang gang chos bya ba rnams kyis bod mtha' 'khob du gyur pa dang / rig pa blun zhing rang dga' ba mang ste/ chos rtogs par dka' zhing zab par gyur pas/ rgya gar gyi mkhas par rab tu grags pa/ rgyal pos spyan drangs te/ lo tsā mkhas pas gtan la phab pa de la 'jug pa bya'o// rgyal pos yon bdag ma byas lo tsā mkhas pas gtan la ma phab pa'i chos gang la yang 'jug par mi bya bar bka' nan drag tu gsal nas/ bka' tshigs kyi yi ge zhib mo ni g.yung drung mchis te/ 1 ba so'i sgrom bu gsal nas kha la lcags gsal nas rje'i phyag sbal na mchis te/ gnod sbyin dam rgya nag po la gtad/ che long 1 zhang blon rnams la yang dag par byas/ de nas ha shang ma hā ya na gtsug lag khang 1 bzhings nas slar rgya nag tu gshegs/ btsan po'i thugs dgongs grub nas/ tshong dus su bad rngam pa'i lha khang bzhengs nas dga' ston mdzad pa'i dus su bod 'bangs thams cad tshogs pa dang / 'bangs thams cad chos la bzud cing

༄༅//sba bzhed zhabs btags ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 55chos mi bya mi rung ba'i phyir/ dbus mtha' thams cad slob dpon bskos/zhang blon gyi bu tsha dang btsun mo thams cad ka pa li ti thogs nas rdar ma bslab tu bcug slob dpon ka ma la shi la la chos thams cad thos bsam gyis bdag med par gtan la phob pa'i chos de ji ltar lags pa cig yi ger bkod pa zhus pas/ sgom rim dang po bcom nas btsan po la gnang / btsan pos gzigs pas don dgongs nas dges te/ de'i don 1 gi thog tu sgom na ji ltar sgom zhus pas/ sgom rim bar pa rtsom nas gnang / de ltar sgom pas de la 'bras bu ji lta bu mchi zhus pas/ sgom rim tha ma bcoms nas/ 'bras bu bstan pa'i zhar la ha shang gi lta ba nor ba de sun phyung nas gnang de la shin tu dges pas/ de'i don 'grel du bo lha satwa'i dgongs pa la rtsod pa rgol bar dogs pa'i don du lung dang rigs pa 'brel bar dbu ma snang ba bcoms nas gnang / de nas chos 'khor gyi rkyen ris/ brgya lnga bcu bla nas gnang ste ring lugs la lo re la nas khal bdun bcu rtsa lnga/ nam za dgu phrug re re/ spos mar srang stong cig brgya/ 'chib 'og thegs pa re/ shog gu ldeb bzhi/ snag tsha yug gsum/ lan tshwa zas len 'phying bu'i sgom chen nyi shu rtsa lnga la nas khal lnga bcu rtsa lnga lnga/ spos mar srang brgyad brgya brgyad brgya/ chibs sa re re na bza' drug phrug re re/ chos grwa'i slob dpon du bsgo ba bcu gnyis la nas khal lnga bcu rtsa lnga lnga/ na bza' drug phrug re re/ spos mar srang brgyad brgya brgyad brgya/ mtshams kyi ban de rang ga ma rnams la gang zag re re la nas khal brgyad/ shog ldeb gnyis/ snag tsha yug re/ slob gnyer ba nyi shu rtsa lnga la/re re la nas khal nyi shu rtsa lnga lnga/ gos sum phrug re re/ rgyun du gnang nas lha chos dar bar mdzad pas rje bka' drin che ba lags/ slad kyi btsan po slob dpon pad+ma sam bha wa'i chos kyi 'phro lus pa thugs ma tshim nas/ be+e ro tsa na dang gtsang btsun legs grub 'tshol du btang / slar log pa la parnyi ta ma

56 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/byon pas blo ba ma mchis te/ rgya'i snyan khra'i dbang du thal nas/ be+e ro tsa na tsha ba rong du skrad/ ka ma la shi la mu stegs kyi gshed ma btang nas nub mo sgra sgyur gyi khang par gzims mal du mkhal ma snyel nas skyongs/ ye shes dbang po 'da' khar/ btsan po'i pham phab 'bras chan gsol nas/ de slan chad khams kyi zas spangs so// ting nge 'dzin dang chos kyi zas dang rje'o tsas gsungs nas grongs pa'i dus su nam mkha' las sgra byung / bya thams cad gdung ba'i skad 'don/ gdung khang khas su ti'i mar snar rtsigs na legs bya ba byung / ye shes dbang po'i bu mo spyan ras gzigs kyis pa'i mchod rten gyi rtsar na mchod rten rtsigs pa'i sa klus bstan/ de'i rdo la rgya yig byung /mchod rten de la lha mo gsum skor ba byed cing / su bde ba can du 'gro ba des mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad 'di la skor ba gyis shig zer ba dang / btsan po na re/ a tsar+ya'i gsung dang sbyar na kho bo'i tshe kyang ring por mi thub ces thugs ngan mdzad nas/ rje'i thugs las chung ngu la gzhol bar bzhed nas parnyi ta spyan 'dren du btang bas a tsar+ya bi ma mi tra byon nas/ slob dpon pad+ma sam bha wa'i chos 'phro zhus nas sgom mdzad par bzhed nas/ sras mu ne btsan po la chab srid 'bogs pa dang / blon po zhang dbu rings btsan po la bsko ba'i gros dbu rtse'i bar khang gi rnga khang na byed cing bzhugs pa jo mo me tog gyis mthong ste/ thugs gtums pas dogs 'tshal nas/ chab srid sna nam pa la ster bar nges snyam te/ mu tig btsan po la gsol bas/ lha sras kyi 'u ring sgo bar chu gris gsal nas kum/ yab na re btsan bzher gar song ces bya ba dang / gri khrag can bor nas/ 'u ring rgyang ring bar song ces nas bar khang du bros/ rje'i thugs dam 'gyangs nas/ dbyar chu byung bar dogs nas thugs ma bde nas blon 'dzangs pa kun gros byas nas/ blon po 'gos kyi zhal che bka' gsum du bcad/ chab srid mu ni btsan po mnga' bar bgyi gsungs

༄༅//sba bzhed zhabs btags ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 57nas/ zhang ma stong lam phrag gang chod rgyal bu lon du bcug zer ba bcad/thun tshang skar (dran ka yan btsan gyis zhus pa'i mi chos kyi brdos 'dug go)ma mdzad nas gtad/ yab zung dkar du sgom du gshegs so// btsan po'i bka' tshigs kyi yi ge zhib mo gsum las/ gcig lha sa na yod/ 1 khams su khyer/ 1 rje'i phyag sbal na mchis so// sras mu ne btsan po dgung lo bco lnga lon tsa na jo mo ru yong gza'/ myu/ ('di man la zhabs btags mar byed pa yin/)mdo rgyal khab tu bzhes de rgyal srid gtad nas chab srid shin tu rgya che bas yab kyi zhal chems thun tshags skar ma dang mthun par 'bangs kyi tshis bgyi bar dgongs nas/ bla ma'i mchod gnas rab tu byung ba'i mnga' thang dang chos 'khor stod smad kyi zhabs tog yab kyi srol bzhin du mdzad/ dpal brag dmar bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang du dus kyi mchod pa chen po 4btsugs nas bod kyi rje blon yongs kyi 'phral gyi rkyen bzlogayun gyi tshogs sog par mdzad mchod rten bzhi'i gdugs dang dbu rtse'i bya 'dab lcags thag gis sbrel nas nam mkha' dar phan gyis brel/ sa gzhi man 'dzam gling mangs dang gser dngul gyi phor pa la sogs pas bkang / dbu rtse thang mchod rdzas kyis khengs par bgyis nas/ lcags ri'i phyi ngos kyi phyogs 4nas/ 'bangs thams cad rgyan dang chas mchod rdzas dngos bcas te/rtsed (gar mkhan seng ge dang / tsha dag dang rta rdugs la sogs pa'i ) bro byed/ btsan po dbu rtse'i sgo'i thang nas/ seng khri'i steng nas mchod pa 'bul bas/ dad pa skyes nas dbu'i la thod dang na bza' phud nas lha la 'bul/de nas btsan po'i zhal nas nga yi yab mes kyi thugs dam gyi lha khang la khyed bod 'bangs thams cad kyi go ru dang mtshon cha ma gtogs pa thams cad phul cig ces bka' stsal pas/ 'bangs thams cad kyi rjes bka' stsal ba ltar phul te/ kha cig ni ber dang yug la sogs pa phul/ kha cig ni ra klag dang

58 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/gos hrul phul nas/ mchod rdzas kyi bal skal chen po byung / der dkon mchog gi gnyer pa bskos nas/ kun gyi mchod pa byed/ mchod pa'i rgyu bzang ngan byung bas/ btsan po'i zhal nas dad pa che chung khyad re che/ la las ber dang yug 'bul nus la las ra slag tsam las 'bul mi phod pa zhes bka' stsal/mi ltogs kun na re/ rje ci lags/ nged dad pa chung ba ma lags te/ ltogs pas 'bul rgyu de las ma mchis/ 'bul rgyu che ba kun phyug cing nor mchis pa lags so// zhes snyan du gsol bas/ kye ma nga'i mnga' ris su/ la las zas gos tsam yang mi 'byor/ la las lhag dang bcas pa 'di mi rigs so gsungs nas/ las mi bskos nas ru 4phyogs su/ bkren phyag snyoms te yo byad mnyams so// sprode nas mngon byang chub kyi zla ba la/ mngon pa'i mchod pa bgyis te zhing pa kun thong bor nas smon pa btang rol tu gshol ldem me'i bzhag cing mchod pa byed du 'ong / yang sngar bzhin mchod rdzas bzang ngan byung bas/ yang bkren phyug lan cig snyams/ de nas dbyar zla 'bring po'i tshul 'jug gi zla ba la mdo sde'i mchod pa bgyis te/ zhing pa kun yur gra gshig nas mchod pa byed du 'ong yang sngar bzhin mchod rdzas bzang ngan byung pas/ yang bkren phyug lan cig snyams de nas ston zla tha chung la cho 'phrul chung ba 'dul pa'i mchod pa bgyis te/ yang mchod rdzas bzang ngan byung ste/ rang rang gi las su dgongs te/ bod 'bangs ltogs phyug lam gsum/ tshong pa dang mgron po lam du rgyu ba la rgyags phye 'khyer mi dgos te bla nas blug srog gcod dang rku shās 'tsho ba sgrub mi dgos par bde ba la bkod nas bka' drin che ba lags slad kyi jo mo pho yong gza' rgyal mo btsun la/ yab rgyal po thugs la 'dogs pa la/ yum glo ba la bcags pas gshed mi brgyad bskos nas yab

༄7//sba bzhed zhabs btags ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 59btsan po la byad bgyid du stsal/ yab 'da' khar pho yong gza' lha sras kyi khab tu bzhes shig bka' stsal/ yab sku gshegs pa'i 'og tu/ tshes spong gza' pho yong gza' skyongs su 'ong bas pho yongs gza' skra gsar bgyis nas rgyan ma phrog par gda'/ de la snyad byas nas ral gris rgyag snyam tsa na sras kyi g.yon bskor/ de glo ba la bcags nas byon sku ngas lte chung phyag tshangs su bskos nas/ pho brang yon bur sras la gsang ngan drangs nas/ mu ne+e btsan pos srid zla ba bcu bdun mdzad nas/ dgung lo bcu bdun la 'das te/bang so skye'u ldem bu can rtsigs so//tshes spong gza' pho yong gza'i dbu la ral gri gsal ba sman pas gsos pa dang nyin re la shags rgod re btab cing sen mos sha srang re bcad nas skyongs so// de nas mu tig btsan po la dbang bskur bar chad byas nas/mon nas spyan drangs rgyu las sna nam pas brang kha che nas/ srogs te skyongs bang so skya'o bzang bzang rtsigs/ de nas 'bangs yongs gros bgyis te/gcung khri lde srong btsan dbang bskur bar byas pas kha cig na re rgyal (bu)sku nar ma son te 'bangs kyi tshis mi 'ong bas/ blon 'dzangs pa bskos la khrims bu chung bca'o mchi/ kha 1 na re sngon kyang yab sku 'das pa'i dus na rgyal bu sku nar ma son nas/ zhang blon gsum la khrims gtad pas khrims bu chung bcad nas lha chos snub pas gyod ka chen po thug ste 'phung bar byas pas/ rgyal bu dbang bskur la 'bangs kun gyi tshis bgyi bar gsol bas/ rgyal bus 'ong mi 'ong sad par bya bar mchi nas rgyal bu dgung lo 4la dbang bskur nas srid gtad de/ sad pa bzhin du legs par byung bas sad nas legs zhes bya/mjing pa yo la sku dbang che bas glang 'jigs yon zhes kyang grags so// rgyal po de sku nar son nas/ 'bro gza' ma mo lha rgyal khab tu bzhes/ 'bro khri gzung blon du bskos te/ rgyal po de'i zhal nas/ 'dzam bu gling na bod kyi

60 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/rgyal po nga che bas/ nga lag ris lha khang nyi ma tsam cig rtsigs go zhes bka' stsal de slob dpon mdzod mkhan la dris pas/ rgyar dpag tshad lnga bcu rtsa gcig yod ces pas/ bod kyi sa la gzhi mo ma shong bas/ 'o na zla ba tsam cig byed gsungs de la rgyar dpag tshad lnga bcu yod ces pas 'o na skar chen tsam zhig rtsig go zhes bka' stsal/ de la rgyang phrag bco brgyad yod ces pas/byang 'brog sa yangs pas 'dir rtsigs cig ces bkal stsal/ blon po kun gyi mchid nas/ bla blon kun gyi slob dpon dbus su byed pas lha khang stong par lus so gsol bas/ myang ror rtsigs gi gsung bas/ der kyang thugs dam 1 rtsigs pa'i rtsis gzungs/ rgya sde skar ma chung ngu tsam cig rtsigs par chad byas nas/ skar chung lha khang bzhengs su gsol te/ rgyar rgyangs phrag 1 pa 1 rmang bres pa dang / bzo bo rnams khe grags 'chas te/ rtsigs mkhan na re nga'i rtsig pa med na gang yang byar mi btub pas nga gtso bo zer/ shing bzo ba na re nga'i shing bzo med na gang byas kyang gos med pas gtso bo nga che zer/ ldir bzo mkhan na re nga'i bzo med na don med pas nga gtso che zer nas/ dang por ko ba btsos nas lder tsho 'phrul 'khor du bzhengs su gsol/ de nas ka bas bskor nas rgya pheb bkal/ de nas rtsigs pa phyi da la bgyis te/ skar chung rtsigs pas khyad par du 'phags pa lags/ rgyal po des yab mes kyi srol ma shor bar mdzad/ yab mes kyi thugs dam kun gyi zhig ral gso ba dang /rgyan 'dogs pa dang ra sa'i 'khyams khra bo bzhengs pa la sogs pa phyag rjes mang du mdzad/ rab tu byung ba'i mnga' thang ston/ 'bangs srid chos bzhin du mdzad pas bka' drin che ba lags so//de'i sras lnga ste/ khri gtsug lde btsan/ lha sras gtsang ma/ khri dar ma 'u dum btsan/ lha rje lhun grub/ gcen khri gtsug lde btsan la lo bcu lon pa dang dbang bskur nas chab srid gtad/ gco ro gza' dpal gyi ngang tshul

༄za//sba bzhed zhabs btags ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 61can la sogs pa btsun mo khab tu bzhes/ rba mang rje lha lod kyi phyi blon byas/ban chen po dpal gyi yon tan gyis chos kyi blon po chen po bgyis te/ mes kyi bad rngam po'i lha khang la dpe byas nas thugs dam dbu brtsegs bzhengs pa chad pa'i dus su/ rje'i zhal nas yab mes kun gyi ring la btsan po la bya ba rnam pa gsum yin te/ thugs dam du gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa dang /bod 'bangs bde ba la 'god pa dang / sku la rdo ba la dmag drangs pa'o//yab mes rnams kyis la las re re tsam mdzad/ la las gnyis gnyis mdzad/la las gsum ka mdzad nas rim par mdzad/ nga gsum ga dus 1 la byed do ces bka' stsal nas thugs dam gtsug lag khang gi rmang sdings par byas tsa na/lha sa mkhar dang 'dra/ bsam yas grong dang 'dra/ skar chung 'chad pa dang 'dra/ nga lha khang sha ma 1 byed do ces bka' stsal nas/ rgya dkar nag dang bal po dang / kha che dang li yul dang / bod yul gyi bzo bo mkhas pa thams cad bkug ste/ rgya'i ju zhag mkhas pa gcig gis sa btsal nas 'on cang de'u yi bzo bo mkhas pa zhig li yul lcags ra smug po na yod par thos pas/ gla ba 1 lcags kyi dra bar bcug nas 'di bod kyi btsan po'i spos kyi glang po yin pas 'di bzhes la/ li spyod pa'i rgyal po zhes pa bzo bo mkhas pa zhig yod zer ba de bod kyi btsan po'i thugs dam gyi lha khang gi bzo byed pa la gnang bar zhu bya ba dang / de ma gnang na btsan po'i thugs khros nas dmag 'dren nokhya ba'i sgrom bu bskur nas pho nya btang / pho nya bas de li rje la phul bas/li rjes bka' sgrom gzigs nas/ spos kyi glang po'i chu dang rul ma tshur chad spos su byung bas zhu rten la'ang mnyes/ btsan po'i bka' ma nyan na dmag la'ang 'jigs nas/ bka' sgrom nas byung ba ltar rdzong bar chad nas li spyod pa'i rgyal po bod yul du mchis 'tshal bar bsgo bas/ nga rgas pa'i bu gsum btsan po'i phyag tu 'bul lo mchis pas/ li rje na re/ khyod rang btsan po

62 ༄7//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/dang dbyar ma mjal na li yul du btsan po'i dmag 'ong / sngon kyang bod kyi btsan pos rta dmag drangs nas li cham la phab ces zer nas kho de/ li spyod pa'i rgyal po lam du gum kyang mgo btsan po'i phyag tu phul cig ces/ bu li gser gzung / li gser 'od/ li gser tog gsum bod du bzo byed du rdzangs/ pho nya la skyes skur nas yar 'ongs/ li spyod pa'i rgyal po ma gum par btsan po dang zhal mjal/ 'dzam bu gling na rdo bzo mkhas pa la bal bo rdo bzo mkhas la sogs pas bzo bgyis te/ 'og khang gsum sgo'i rib cha yan chad man chad rdo la byas te/ rdo bzo khyad par 'phags te/ phud ra sa'i gtsug lag khang du mes kyi chos srol gtod pas bka' drin che bas/ rdo ring rdo rje'i tshul du phul/ ri mo'i phud du dar gyi be bum brgya rtsa brgyad phul/ lder bzo'i phud du tshangs pa dang brgya byin 2bzhengs su gsol/ lugs ma'i phud gcong chen mo dril bu'i tshul du phul/ bar khang gsum po phag las byas/steng khang gsum shing dang zangs dang ko ba la byas te/ dgu thog tu byas/ rgya pheb kyi 'og nas phar rlung gis 'khor lo skor te/ rab tu byung ba mang po skor ba byed/ bya 'dab las phyogs bzhir lcags thag bzhis mchod rten chen po bzhi la bstod/ rlung chen po nub nas langs pa'i tshe shar gyi lcags thag lhod la rgya phebs shar du yo tsam 'gro/ rlung shar nas langs na nub kyi lcags thag lhod la/ rgya pheb nub tu yo 'gro ba/ ri nag gi rtse la na bun byung ba dang / lha khang gi khyung mgo la'ang 'ong ba'i mthon po 1 bzhengs su gsol/ 'bangs bde ba la 'god pa yang zas dang gos tsam gyis bde ba ni 'phral du bde bar bas la/ yun du bde ba'i lha chos la 'god pa'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa'i pa'i glegs bam mchis par gzigs pas/ chos la la rgya nag po'i skad du smra/chos la la rgya dkar po'i skad du smra/ chos la la bal po dang o rgyan gyi skad du smra bas mes kyi dam pa'i lha chos lugs dang chos skad sna tshogs su 'byung ba ni

༄༅//sba bzhed zhabs btags ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 63ma legs te/ sangs rgyas rgya dkar por byon nas/ chos dang po rgya gar du gsungs pa yin pas/ nga 'ang chos rgya dkar po'i lugs su mgrin gcig tu byed ces bka' stsal nas/ bod phrug blo rno ba bcu drug la gser bskur nas lo tsā slob tu btang ste/ la las smra ma shes/ la las tsha bas gum/ la las thar 'dre rnam gsum la btug ka ba dpal rtsegs ('phan yul ba) dang /sna nam ye shes (ngam shod pa) sde dang / cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan(yar lung pa)dang gsum gyis lo tsā mkhas par slob nas/ parnyi ta dzi na mi tra dang / shri na len tra bo lha dang / dā na shi la gsum spyan drangs te sgra bsgyur/ rgya gar gling du rkyen bla nas sbyar nas/ mes kyi lha khang (bsam yas )na bzhugs pa dang / bod kyi yul na yod pa'i gsungs rab kyi dpe ma lus pa spyan drangs te/sgra bsgyur te sgra thams cad rgya dkar po'i 'gyur du bcos/ skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab nas chos lugs bzang por mdzad/ tha na bre dang srang zho la sogs pa thams cad kyang rgya gar dang bstun na/ skyid shod shong ma rar gtan la dbab/ btsan po dad pa che bas mdun sa chung ngur rab tu byung ba la phul bas/ lo tsā ba'i zhal nas bod 'bangs gdul dka' bas chad pa la brten nas skyong dgos pas/ nged rab tu byung ba ston pa'i bka' bzhin du bgyid 'tshal bas/ chad pa'i las bgyid mi rung zhes gsol bas/ gsungs bzhin mi bgyid pa la ngas zhang blon rnams bgyid du stsal chab srid bzhes par zhu zhes phul/ rje'i la thod phud cing rab tu byung ba'i gdan du 'ding / rab tu byung ma thag 1 gi'ang zhabs spyi bor len/ gos ser po'i lhan pa skye bo'i lus la 'dug pa mthong kyang de la rgyal po phyag mdzad/ zhang blon gang gis rten phul nas/ sngun phyag nyi shu rtsa gcig phul kyang phyag lan mi gnang bod yongs rjes gsang bcas bsdus te/ bla'i dge 'dun la 'tsho bar phul/ rab byung re re la yang 'bangs khyim bdun bdun lha ris su chad phul nas zas dang

64 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/na bza' sbyor/ rab byung gi gos lhan pa can gzigs na dris nas de'i lha ris bka' drag tu gsol/ skye bo khyim pa'i tshis kun rab tu byung ba'i mdun sa chung ngu bzhin chos dang bstun nas shin tu bde skyid mdzad pas rje bka' drin che/ btsan po dbon zhang gnyis 'jam (sku la rdo ba la dmag drang ba )dum bya bar chad pas ma cham nas/ bod du gzhi nas dmag stong sde bco brgyad bco brgyad dar tshan khri phrag 'khrid nas rgya yul du dmag drangs/ rgya'i gen po thams cad bkum nas rgya cham la phob/ rta pa'i nyin lam bco lngar 'dus/ rgya'i ha shang dang bod kyi parnyi ta rnams kyis 'dus nas/ bar dpang mdzad nas dpon zhang 'dums mdzad nas/ rgya'i gong bu dme rur rgya rje'i gtsug lag khang dang / btsan po'i gtsug lag khang re bzhengs su gsol/de'i bar du sa la btsan po dbon 'ang gnam la nyi ma dang zla ba las med par gleng nas/ pha 'ong la nyi zla'i gzugs byas/ gong bu dme ru yan chad du rgyas dmag mi drang ba/ de man du bod kyis dmag mi drang ba'i mna' byas mtho rtsigs dpang du lha klu gnyan po bzhag dbon zhang ji ltar chad pa'i rtsis kyi yi ge ni gsum du mchis te gcig ni rgya ku'i shu'i pho brang gi mdun du rdo ring la yi ge bris/ gcig ni btsan po'i ra pa'i lha khang gi mdun du rdo ring bris/ gong du bud mo ru'i rdo ring la bris so// btsan pos mdun sa chung ngu rab tu byung ba la phul nas/ chab srid tshas dang bstun na dbang dgon la phul na blon nag po la dga' ba kun mi bya dgu bya'i dbang med/ spyad pa shin tu dgu dog pas rje'i snyan du zhang blon rje'i bka'i dgongs pa kun bsgrub pa la ca lo dam du bstun nas dmangs rab tu byung ba la 'bul bcug lags/ nged kyi sngon phyag nyi shu rtsa gcig rten dang chas par byas kyang la na mi gnang bar/ dmangs tha mal pa rab tu byung ba la phar la dgos bzhin du phyag mdzad pa bcug lags zhes pa la sogs pa dris pa'i lan du/ btsan pos bod 'bangs skya btsun

༄༅//sba bzhed zhabs btags ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 65yongs bsdus nas/ rab tu byung ba mnga' thang bstod nas gser thang sha ba can gyi rtsis gnang / 'ang blon rnams la yo ga lha dges ban dang / lhag ma dgu tsag can dang / zings pa sna tshogs can dang / gsang ba phyag rgya can dang / spyan po can lnga gnang nas mi chos dang lha chos nya gtan la phab/ ra sa la sogs pa mos srong btsan po'i lha khang rnams dang / brag dmar dang skar gzigs na dris nas de'i lha ris bka' drag tu gsol/ bod yongs rjes gsang bcas bsdus te/ bla'i dgon pa la 'tsho bar phul/ rab byung re re la yang 'bangs khyim bdun bdun lha ris su chad phul nas zas dang na bza' sbyor rab byung ba'i mdun sa chung ngu bzhin chos dang stun nas shin tu bde skyid par mdzad pas rje bka' drin che/ btsan po dpon zhang gnyis 'jam sku la rdo ba la dmag drang ba dum bya bar chad pas ma chos nas/ bod du gzhi nas dmag stong ste bco brgyad bco brgyad dar tshan khri phrag 'khrid nas rgya yul du dmag drangs/ rgya'i gon po thams bkum nas rgya ching la phob/ rta pa'i nyin lam bco lngar 'dus/ rgya'i ha shang dang bod kyi paṇ+ḍi ta rnams kyis (lus nas/) bar dpang mdzad nas dpon zhang 'dus mdzad nas/ rgya'i gong bu dme rdur rgya rje'i gtsug lag khang dang / btsan po'i gtsug lag khang re bzhengs su gsol/ de'i bar du sa la btsan po dbon zhang gnam la nyi ma dang zla ba las med par gleng nas/ pha 'ong la nyi zla'i gzugs byas/ gong bu dme tu yan chad du rgyas dmag mi drang ba/ de man du bod kyis dmag mi drang ba'i mna' byas mthong rtsigs dpang du lha klu gnyan po bzhag dbon zhang ji ltar chad pa'i lhus kyi yi ge ni gsum du mchis te gcig ni rgya ga'i shu'i pho brang gi mdun du rdo ring la yi ge bris/ gcig ni btsan po'i rang pa'i lha khang gi mdun du rdo ring bris/ gong du bus me ru'i rdo ring la bris po/ btsan pos mdun sa chung ngu rab tu byung ba la yul nas/ chab srid chos dang bstun na

66 ༄7//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/dbang dge 'dun la phul nas blon nag po la dga' ba kun mi bya dgu bya'i dbang med/ spyad pa shin tu dgu dog pas rje'i snyan du zhang blon rje'i bka'i dgongs kun bsgrub pa la ca lo dam du bstun nas dmangs rab tu byung ba la 'bul bcug lags/ nged kyi sngon phyag nyi shu rtsa gcig rten dang chas par byas kyang lan mi gnang bar/ dmangs tha mal pa rab tu byung ba la phar la dges bzhin du phyag mdzad pa bcug lags zhes pa la sogs dris pa'i lan du/btsan pos bod 'bangs skya btsun yongs bsdus nas/ rab tu byung ba mnga' thang bstod nas gser thang sha ba can gyi rtsis gnang / zhang blon rnams la yo ga lha dges ban dang / lhab ma dgu tsag can dang / zings pa sna tshogs can dang / gsang ba phyag rgya can dang / spun po can lnga gnang nas mi chos dang lha chos 2gtan la phab/ ra sa la sogs pa mes srong btsan gyi lha khang rnams dang / brag dmar dang / skar chung la sogs pa yab mes kyi thugs de bzhengs pa'i pho brang thams cad kyang ma lus par sbyangs/ zhig ral kyang gso stong tsam na/ 'bangs nag po la dga' pa kun gyis deng 'di tsam gyi spyod mdog pa cis na che glengs pa/ blon po sbas kyi snying du gdon gsol nas/'di btsan pos chab srid kyi dbang btsun pa la gtad pas nongs zer/ spyod pa tsing du btung de las bka' nan cher rtsal bas/ de pha gi kun rgya'i na zer btsun pa la mdzub mo gtsugs pas/ nga'i rab tu byung ba la mdzub mo gtsugs pas/ nga'i rab tu byung ba la mdzub ker byas nas mtshang can ston pa'i rda byas pas/ khrims la skyon cig ces bka' bsgos nas mdzub mo gcad/ de man chad nga'i rab tu byung ba la mdzub ker byed na mdzub mo chod cig ces bka' stsal yang nged spyod pa dog pa pha gi kun gyi lan ces mchu mo byas pas/nga'i rab tu byung ba la mchu yo byed pa'i mchu chod ces bka' stsal/ de bzhin du mig log byas pas mig byung / btsun pa'i ka cha brkus pas/ dkon

༄༅//sba bzhed zhabs btags ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 67mchog brgyad cu 'jal bcad pa la sogs pa'i chos khrims mdzad pas/ zhang blon nag po la dga' pa rnams gros byas nas chos khrims gshig pa'i lkog gros byas nas/ de la sngon du btsan po ma skyongs na chos khrims mi shig zer/ kha cig dz+re/ ram pa can la sras med kyang gcung lha sras gtsang ma chos la dga' bas srid 'dzin te chos khrims mi shig zer/ gtsang ma bshugs pas chog mchi bas/ de ban chen po chos la dkar ma dbang che bas chos khrims mi gshig zer/ gros byas nas chos khrims gshig pa'i snyan khra bcug ste/ ban chen po dang / ngang tshul ma nal bshis so zhes snyan du gsol nas/ chad pa che thang du zhus pas/ ban chen po yang lcags kyi srog sa rtsa sgrub sa ma grub par snyan 'phra btsan par byas te bkum/ de ma thag tu lha sras gtsang ma rab tu byung nas ljongs chen po dang bcas nas spa gro mon du bshugs/ bod kyi bsod nams nyams pa dang 'dre srin kun mgo rgod pas/ mi nag po kun gyi glo bar gsol nas/ lcog ro lha lon ma dga' nas/ btsan po rgya'i 'bras chang gsol ba'i/lhag pa bcus nas zhal lhag par bstan/ cog ro la bya phu bgyis nas bkum/bod 'bangs chos la gnag pa kun gyi sba rgyal tho re chos la gnag pas blon por bskos nas/ btsan po khri dar ma bu dum lo dgu la dbang bskur nas chab srid gtad/ de nas blon po kun gyis chos khrims dang 'gal ba mang du byas/ lo tsā bas rje mnga' bdag ral pa can gyis 'bangs kyi tshis mdzad pa 'di ltar lags zhes zhib tu gsol pas/ btsan pos chos khrims bzhin du ma byung / der rab tu byung ba kun gyis mnga' bdag ral pa can la sras mi mnga'/ gcung sku nar ma son pas chos khrims nyams su nye zhes drag tu smras pas/ blon po kun gyis btsan po sku nar ma son pas/ 'bangs btsun pa kun gyi mchu sngo bkrabs so mchi bas/ btsan po shin tu phung phung song / der lo paṇa gyis sgra bsgyur ba'i 'phro lus te/ mdo chos kyi rgyal mo/ mya ngan las

68 ༄༅/〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/'das pa chen po'i mdo/ spang kong phyag stong pa yongs su rgyas pa rtogs pa chen po/ phal po che ma ga da chad/ mdo za ma tog bkod pa lnga lus/ chos bsgyur ba'i gra zhig rje'i thugs dam dgu rtsegs dang / jo bo'i thugs dam btsan thang lha khang la zhal spro ma grub par lus/ slad kyi btsan po sku nar son thugs su gdon gsol pas/ chos khrims la sku snyad gsol dgongs pa dang snyad ma rnyed/ parnyi ta da na shi las dme rur mtshams bcad 'dzam pa la bsgrubs pas grub nas/ tsan dan gyi sku la rdo rje rgyab pas gser phye lho khung du sleb pa byung / de la rgyu byas te/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzhengs su gsol ba/sku'i rten bcom ldan 'das kha sar pa ṇi/ gsung gi rten khri phyed sum stong ba/thugs kyi rten dngul bya 'khun bu can/ nye gnas khang phye ut+pa las/ dngul gyi byams pa bzhengs nas dgung dus kyi mchod pa btsugs/ dus der lha sar sad dang tsa dang mu ge mi nad dang phyugs nad byung bas de la btsan pos snyad byas nas/ 'bangs kun la lha sar mi nad la sogs pa byung / 'di cis lan shes sam dris pas/ mi shes zer/ ngas shes rgya mo kong co bya ba'i gnod sbyin sogacig gis/ gnod sbyin gyi lha shākya mu ne zer ba bkra ma shis gcig spyan drangs nas/ ri rab kyi rtse mor 'ongs nas lha 'khrug pham par byas nas lha phung bar byas/ de nas dbu rgyan du 'ongs nas o rgyan phung bar byas/ de nas ma ga dar 'ongs nas ma ga ta phung bar byas/ de nas rgya nag por 'ongs nas rgya nag po phung bar byas/ de nas bod yul du 'ongs nas mo sa dpyad la mkhas pas sa dpyad byas te/ lcags ka ri seng ge dkar mo gnam du 'phyong ba 'dra ba la sgal tshigs nyi shu rtsa 1 la mchod rten nyi shu rtsa 1 gi me rtsa bzhagaspyi bor mchod rten nag po khri 'phangs dgu pas mnan/ ltag khung du lha khang byas nas stod la mnan/ de ma mnan na rgya gar 'bangs su 'du ba yin/dmar po ri stag byi khung du 'dzul ba 'dra ba'i sna la shing sna la'i phur pa btab/

༄༅//sba bzhed zhabs btags ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 69de ma btab na rgya nag mngar 'dus pa yin/ yar lung me sna'i gdong la ri 'bras kyi ljang pa 'dra ba yod pa de sked par bcad/ de ma bcad na bod du mu ge mi 'ong ba yin/ myang ro na ri stag dang seng ge 'thab pa 'dra ba yod de'i bar bcad de ma bcad na bod la dpa'o rgyun ma chad par 'ong ba yin/ ri stag seng gnyis kyi mjug ma bsnol ba yod pa de bcad nas bar du rat+na'i mchod rten gyis mnan/ de ma byas na btsan po 'khrul pa blon po rig pa can rgyun ma chad par 'ong ba yin/ drang srong srin po sna nas rgya nag stong khung gnyis kyi bar na ri pi wang gi rgyud 'breng ba 'dra ba yod pa de la rdzas dang gzhan gyi yon tan rgyun ma chad 'ong ba yin/ de la mos gnod pa bya bar ma nus pas da ltar rgyun ma chad pa yin/ 'bod 'bangs thams cad rab tu byung / bud med nag chos byed do zer nas rabs bcad nas/ bod kyi chab srid pha ming la gtad 'dod pa yin/ bod kyi sa gnyan thams cad la bcos ka byas pas mo rang la mdze byung nas ro lha sar bzhag ste/ bangs so med pa'angade tsug yin/ rgya gar gyi skad pa ra mi ta 'di la go ba med pas chos btub pa ci la 'ong / 'o cag btsun pa thams cad khyim par phab la chos la sku bsnyad btsal ba chos khrims gzhig ces gleng nas blon po bskos nas btsun pa thams cad rtags dang phral/ rtags 'bor du ma btub par kun la mda' 4 gzhu dang rnga shang bskur nas lings la bkod/ de ma btub na kun srog dang 'phral/ pu ti phal cher lha sa'i brag lte ba can la sbas/ brag dmar la sogs pa'i lha khang kun sgo la 'dag sbyar byas/ rgya lha shākya mu ni yas mar 'ongs pa yar skyol/ mas yar 'ongs pa slar mar bskyal bar byas/ blon po dad pa can btsan po'i thugs su gdon gsol bar nges zhes mya ngan byed cing / yab mes kyi yi ge bltas pas/ mes srong btsan stong zhal sprul par 'dug de rjes la rgyal po 'phrul lnga pa yang byon/ blon sba gsal snang la sogs pa rig pa can

70 ༄za//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/kyang mang du byung ba'i rtags mang du gleng nas/ lha shākya mu ni bod kyi bde skyid kun 'byung bar shes te/ spyan mi drang ba'i thabs byas nas/ ra mo che'i sku sgul bas ma nus zhes snyan du gsol bas/ rje'i zhal nas gzu ba chug la bor zhes bsko bas/ khang pa bye mas bkang nas gzu bas bor/ lha'i snyan g.yon pa theb pa la btsal/ de nas 'breng pa'i dra bar ngag bcug nas drud pas them khar mi dang thag pa kun chad/ sngon kyang zhang ma zhang gis sku sa thems su bcugasho mchis nas sku bye dong du sbas/ ra sa'i sku mar skyol ces bsgo bas/byams pa'i sku smad ras kyi sgril nas sku shing sgrom du spyan drang bar byas nas/ra sa'i steng du cho nges btab pas btsan po lho nub kyi dkyil 'khor gyi steng na mi dge ba'i khrims 'cha' bas thos nas ci nyes zer/ shākya mu ne'i 'og na rgyal pos klu mthong ba'i dug can mnan nas 'dug byas pas/ sku phyir thon nam ma thon zer sku phyir thon sku'i khar bye ma blug gam zhes gsol bas/ de yags de ltar gyis zer/ shākya mu ne'i bzhugs khang bye mas rdzangs/ sgo 'dag pas byugs rgyal po dgar re ba'i ri mo btsun pa chang 'thung ba'i gza' zla la sogs pa bris te byams pa phyir spyan drangs/ mi dpung pa bshib/ btsan pos gzigs tsa na/ ma'i bar na byams pa ser lhag tsam re bstan/ nyi ma nub tsa na/ sku ma 'khrud mi dang thag pa kun chad sku 'o dang gi mtshor bor ram zhus pas rung zer/ byams pa sa thams su sbas/ rdor mtshor mtshor bor nas gsol ba btab pas/ de ci tsug yin dris/ lha shākya mu ne chur bor byas pas de shin tu legs zer/ byams pa spyan drangs nas glo 'bur de nyid du bzhugs gsol/ nang par blon mdzad la grol chab khar blta zhing skyid pa skyong skyod byas pas/ btsan pos gzigs nas/ khyod de na ci byed zer/ sku mtshor bor ba yin pa la mi 'dug nyas zos sam zer bas/ de tsug yin de yags zer ba zhig byung / de nas ring zhig na yer pa'i phug be'u na/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje

༄༅//sba bzhed 'bas btags ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 71sgom pa'i drung du nam phyed tsam na/ dpal lha mo bud med kyi gzugs su byung nas/ bod na grub thob ni khyod las med na/ rgyal po sdig can bsad ran zer ba ci byung / de nyal ba'i mi lam du byang ba skad byas pas/ nye ba rnams kyi chos bsnub pa'i gleng lengs zhib tu blangs pas/ dpal gyi rdo rje snying rje skyes nas/ de la thabs bsams/ dus 'khor dang rten 'brel rtsis te rta dkar po la sol byugs/ ber nang dkar la phyi nag po gyon/ lcags mda' lcags gzhu khyer nas lha sar phyin pa'i dus na/ btsan po na re/ khams gcig ma bde/ mdang rmi lam ngan pa zhig kyang rmis/ snying cig kyang ma dga' zer zhing rdo ring gi yi ge klog dpal gyi rdo rje dang mi gcig 'phrad pas/ jo bo mi nag rta nag can gar 'gro zer/ nga btsan po la phyag byed pa yin te/ rje gdan bzhugs byas pas/ rdo ring gi yi ge blta 'dug go zer/btsan pos dpal gyi rdo rje byung ba mthong nas/ mgon po nag po'ang byung zer nas/ gtsug lag khang dang dga' ldan gyi bar gyi mchod rten la sku rten byas nas bzhugs pa'i mdun du/ dpal gyi rdo rje rta bab nas spus mo la brten nas gzhu brtungs (bdungs)pas/ btsan po phyag byed par go nas zhe sa phul zer phyag dang po byed tsa na gzhu brdungs/ gnyis pa byed tsa na mda' ltong /phyag zin ral pa rgyab tu sgyur tsa na mtheb krol ba mda' dpral du brgyab/rgyal po sdig can de ltar gsod/ nga bdud ya gzher nag po bya ba yin zer/rgyal po phyag mda' la 'jus nas/ nga lo gsum gyi bsad sngas pa/ yang na lo gsum gyis bsad phyi pa zer nas grongs/de'i dgongs pa 'grel ba la/ kha cig sras 'ong ba dang / lha sras ma bshugs pa la byed/ kha cig snga na chos mi nub/ phyi na chos byed bya ba yin zer/lha sar btsan po dkrongs rgyug ces ra zlar sbran pas/ la la lha ris rga' rgyud nas mar byung / la la pho brang dmar po nas yar byung / bdud ya gzher gyi

72 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/mtsho 'khor mngal gtad pas/ chu la rtel nyal byas pas rta'i sol phye dgaber phyir ldog lcags gzhu phyar mi nga gnam the dkar po bya ba yin zer nas song / ded pas kha cig ngan pa de do zin pa la drang srong sring bu snar pa bsros nas ma mthong nas shor ba zer/ kha cig grib bse sgrom gyis phur sa bsros pa dang mthong bar shor zer/ kha cig grib bse sgrom gyis phur sa bsros pa dang mthong bar shor zer/ kha cig na re than mo rdo ring sus bsros nas ma mthong bar shor ba zer/ gsum 'ong ba 'di dpal gyi rdo rje'i sprul pa yin par nges 'di gsad do zer nas/ rta pa dgus gsod du phyin pas dpal gyi rdo rje sgom khang mdun du thal rgya btab/ dar dkar gyi yol ba'i nang du spyang klag dang bya rgod kyi thul pa bzhag dkar khung chung ngu ma 1 gi kha khyer la bya spu thul le byas nas mi 'dug mngon pa mdzod dang 'dul ba 'od ldan dang / las skar ma sha stam dang gsum khur nas khams su bros/ rgyal pos chos bsnub pa'i dus su/g.yu ru byang gi shākya mu ne/ lho brag gi g.yo dge ba'i 'byung gnas dang /gtsang rab gsal dang / dge slong gsum dpal chu bo ri la sgom pa'i dus su/btsun pa khyi 'khrid rnga bshang brdung gin mgo la bya sgro btsugs/ sham thabs snga log phyi log byas nas ri dwags la mda' 'phen pa yong ba mthong bas de ya ma sha nas ban rgan 'khrul lam btsun pa smyo zer/ ci gzigs dris pas mthong ba 4na (bzhin)smras/ slob dpon ma 'khrul btsun pa smyo ba min/ rgyal pos chos bsnubs pa'i lo rgyus zhib tu bshad pas 'o na btsun pa de 'dir bos dang zer nas/ de la gtam dris pas khyod la dka' chad kya'i ma phog pa khar rje che zer/ btsun pa gsum pos gos re ba sgril nas sprang chas su zhugs nas bros nas/ dan tig shel gyi dgon par sngar gyi gos gyon pas/ de na gnas pa'i mi kun na re/ a pa rgyal po'i bka' khrims kyis ma khyab pa'i mi gda' bo mchi bas/ brad nas nags su phyin/ 'tsho ba med nas mar snyes nas spras pas

༄༅//sba bzhed zhabs btags ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 73mun rdzu dpal 'bar bon po'i bu/ mu rdzu dge ba 'bar ra 'tsho bas mthong ste/khyed ngan ci byed dris pas/ nged rang dang sdod pa yin zer/ khyod ci za dris pas/ snga sro pra za zer ngas ra bdag la zan blangs la khyer 'ong ngam byas pa dang / nged 'di na 'dug pa mi la ma smra'i byas/ des zan lhag byin pas za 'phro gris bcad nas bor bas de ji ltar yin zer/ 'dul ba'i chos nas mi rung ba bshad byas pas/ kho dad pa skyes nas dpal gyi rdo rje zer ba'i khyed 'dra ba mi 1 shel gyi dgon par yang byung zer/ de ga 'dug dris pas/ ra rdzi na re/ kha ning tsa na/ nga cod gcod pa la btsun pa gsum 'dir 'ong mchi bas de kun 'dir byung na 'di gtod cig zer nas po ti gsum bzhag nas kho gar song cha med zer/ po ti gsum po 'dir spyan drongs las shog byas pas byung ste/ mdzod dang / 'od ldan/ skar ma sha tam gsum byung / 'od ldan gleng gleng bag re byas pas/ ra rdzi na re nga'ang btsun pa byed zer/ chos 'di nas 'byung ba bzhin byed nus na bya'o// 'di ltos shig byas pas/ kho ra ded nas klag kyin song bas dad nas spyi bor blangs te mchi ma byung nas/ bdag sangs rgyas thams cad kyis rab tu dbyung du gsol/ sang nang par nga 'di nas 'byung ba ltar byed na re dga' zer bas/ g.yo dge 'byung gis mkhan po byas/ gtsang rab gsal gyis slob dpon byas nas dge tshul gyi sdom pa phog pas ming kyang dge ba rab gsal du btags/ de nas yang skar ma sha tam ltar byung bas/ 'di dge tshul gyis ltar mi rung / 'di lta na bsnyen par rdzogs pa byed dgos byas pas/ nga dge slong byed do zer/ de la yul dbus su dge slong bcu/ mtha' khob tu dge slong lnga dgos te 'di na gsum las med do byas pas/ nga kha ning gi chos 'khyer byung ba de 'tshol lo zer nas/ de btsal bas rgyal (rgya)dar tse'i tshong 'dus nas dpal gyi rdo rje rnyed/ las kyi kha skong zhus pas ngas mi btub ste/ ngas rgyal bo sdig can bsad pas nga la

74 ༄7//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/sdom pa med/ 'on kyang ngas khyod kyi grogs bya'o zer nas song bas/ rgya nag po nas hā shang bya ba dang gyim phag bya ba'i dge slong gnyis 'khrid nas bod kyi dge slong gsum dang lngas sdom pa phog te/ dge slong dang rab byung gzhan yang mang du byas so// de nas lo lnga na/ sgrub babs shing dang / grum ye shes rgyal mtshan rab tu 'byung ste/ mkhan po la zhus pas/ nga rgas skyong mi nus/bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal nas glang po skyon pa'i sna la ral gri btags nas sems can gsod du bcug pa 'di sla'i/ rab tu byung nas ma skyangs pa ni de ltar ma yin no zhes bka' stsal gsungs/ mun dza dge ba rtsal na re/ sdom pa phog cig skyong ba ngas bya'o zhes zhus pas sdom pa yang khyod kyis phog cig gsungs/ ngas lo lnga las ma lon/ mkhan po byed par gnang ba la dge slong byas lo bcu lon pa dgos par bka' stsal le byas pas/ lo lnga lon pas mkhan po byed pa la nyes byas gcig las med/ ston pa'i bstan pa spel ba'i ched du de khyad du gsod la mkhan po gyis shig ces lung sbyin nas mdzad do//sgrub kyi rgyud la mkhan rgyud ces grags/ grum gyi rgyud la btsun rgyud ces grags so// mched gnyis skabs su tshogs nas chos gtam bag re gleng / dus gcig na 'bel gtam byas nas/ grum gyi zhal nas da gzims par bgyis/nga'i mchis mal gang du bgyis gsungs/ sgrub na re 'dir stabs su bgyis byas pas/ khyod lkog na skyems gsol bar grags pas da bla gab srung mtshal byas pas/ snubs khros te/ e phyir klag can 'dra ba gyong po 'di zer bas/grum phyir klag can bya bar grags/ dus de tsa na dbus na sdom pa dang bshad pa'i gdam ngag gi bka' chad nas gang yang med/ gtsug lag khang thams cad kyi lde mig ni btsun gzugs gtsug phud can/ sham thabs dang gdong pa can gyon pa dgra bcom du ming btags pas 'dzin/ 'ga' re'i lde mig sngags pa dbu skra lcang lo breg te spyod pa 'ban por spyod pa'i gos phu dung mgo

༄༅//sba bzhed zhabs btags ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 75zhabs ldog nas btags pa/ 'ban 'dzi bar grags pas 'dzin/ 'chib phan yul smad na chen po rgyal ba dang / de'i slob ma zhang lcang bya ba gnyis kyis klog shes pas mi shi ba'i dge bar glegs bam klog pa la byis pa dang bu chung shi ba la sum brgya pa 'don/ che mi shi ba la mdo chen 'don/ de gnyis shin tu shes rab che bas da gzhung chen po'i rtsa 'grel rnams la bltas nas/ mkhan po ser po byugs pa ni bsdus par 'dug de'i go ba yag mo/ nag mor bzhag pa 'di na 'dug zer/ rtsa 'grel sdeb shes/ mkhan pos dpe cha gzhig nas/yig chung rnyed nas bltas pas/ de sngon gyi sgres (bgres)po kun gyi rjed do'i (tho'i)yi ger 'dug ste/ de'i yang go ba legs mo mchan phar gyi yig chung 'di na 'dug zer nas slob gnyer dang yig sna'i rtsa bshad bag re 'phel/dus de tsa na mdo smad kyi khams na mkhan slob kyi bka' rgyud ma chad par 'dug par grags/ bod dad pa can chos bya bar 'dod pa kun sdom pa khams su len par 'gro/ phyi (dbus gtsang )klu mes la sogs pa mi bcu gnyis lam nas log pa gcig dang bcu gsum 'ongs/ grum ye shes o rgyan la/ sgro mdzi shri/ de la klu (ba lam pa) mes shes rab tshul khrims/ gsum pa (ba lam pa )ye shes blo gros/ 'bri ye shes ('jam dkar ba ) yon tan/ rab she (kham pa )tshul khrims 'byung gnas/ rma byan rin chen/ bod dge ba yon tan/ spa gong ye shes g.yung drung / lo ston (gtsang pa)rdo rje/ dbang phyug(gtsang pa) tshong khe shes/ rab seng ge/ lag bde/ dge bsnyen gcig rnams 'ongs tsa na/ lam du sba sgom snang dang 'phrad pas/ klu mes dang rag shis sdom pa phog nas/ ming yang blo gros su btags/ mdo smad du ma byon pas de la sdom pa med par grags/ byang thang grang bas ber nag gi phu thung phog la skyigs phyir bzlog mdun hral/ lhag tu sgrog ga byas pa'i zhwa rgyab lag gon nas/ dbus su sna su la gtad gros byas pas/ chos 'khor chen po na

76 ༄༅//(sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/btsan po khri bya ba bzhugs de la sna gtad par byas te/ bsam yas su phyag pheb/ btsan pos sna blangs nas khyed tsho'i dpon gang yin dris pas klu mes yin zer bas/ dbu rtse'i lde mig rtswa can phyag pa gang gtad/ 'khor sa'i sgo phye bas nang 'dre tsher dang skyang 'gal gyis gang / de'i yal ga'i chus ri mo thams cad byi/ mnga' khang nas dbus mtha'i ka ba bcu gnyis 'dug pa'i bzhi khro thag chad/ gzhan skam bu zing ngo gda'/ 'khor sa bar pa'i nang na phong tshang thag chad/ gzhan skam bu zing ngo gda'/ 'khor sa bar pa'i nang na phong tshang chas/ dbu rtse'i lder tsho'i phyag dang dbu rgyan thams cad bya 'tshang 'chas dbu rgyan thams cad bya lud kyis rul/ klu mes kyi dkor mdzod dgu la gzigs pas dkon nor gyis gang bar gzigs nas sgo thams cad la sbrul la sogs pa'i 'khrul thag byas nas phyir zhal byas/ lde mig btsan po la gtad/da nga mkhan por bsgo bas mkhan po dkor la 'bags pas 'di mi 'dzin gsungs/ 'o na khams gsum bzhes par zhus pas ma bzhes nas 'bri la phul/bka' chu phul bas/ g.yu ru'i lam rgyags bya 'di gzung gsungs nas bzhes/sba rag gnyis la de'i dge rgyas phul/ dbu rtse'ang gzung / dbu tshal lo tshong 2la phul bas/ mi gdul bya so so la yod zer nas gtsang du bzhud/ klu mes kyis dbu rtse gso ba'i yo byad rta khal mang po khyer 'ongs pas/ sba rag gnyis kyis gsor ma ster / btsan pos bar byas nas/ klu mes kyis gsos nas zin pa dang lde mig sba rag 2la gtad par byas/ klu mes la mkhan bu mang du byung na'ang / rab tu grags pa 4byung ste/ dog byang chub 'byung gnas/ gru mer yes 'byung gnas/ glan ye shes shes rab/ sna nam rdo rje dbang phyugade rnams kyi gnas gzhi bzhengs pa ni/ sum pa dang blan gnyis kyis rgya sar sgang bzhengs/ rdog gis kun dga' rab dang / yer pa ba rang bzhengs/grum mer kyi sol nag thang chen bzhengs/ sna nam gyis rgyal lug blangs

༄༅//sba bzhed zhabs btags ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 77〉zhengs/ de rnams kyi ma lag gnas gzhi gnam gyi skar ma tsam zhig bzhugs de'i mkhan po'i rgyud pa ni/ za hor rgyal po'i bu/ nyis shan+ta ra k+ṣi ta'i bu/ bod kyi dge slong la snga ba sba rat+na/ des g.yo dge ba'i 'byung gnas/des bla chen po dge ba rab gsal/ des grum ye shes o rgyan/ des sgro mdzi shri/des klu mes shes rab tshul khrims/ des gru mer/ des skyor gdang pa stong pa/des gzus rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ de la gzus kyi bu bzhi la sogs pa mang na yang /gtso bo myang bsams pa rin chen bla ma/ des rgya 'dul ba 'dzin pa dbyug tshul khrims/ de'i mkhan bu dang slob ma nying slob tu ma gyur pa'i rab byung ni med pa lta bu yin no/ de ltar na mnga' ris bod khams na sdom pa'i bka' ni ma chad/ bshad pa'i gdams ngag dang sgrub rgyud kyi gdams ngag ni rgyal pos chos bsnub pas bka' chad/ chos rtog chos rtsa 'grel gzhig kyin rang gi shes rab kyis gzhal nas/ slob dpon su 'don cing gzhung bshad byed/ nyams len shin tu zhan pa'i dus su/ mnga' ris kyi btsan po srong nges/ yul dbus kyi rgyal po de ba pha la la zhu ba phul nas chos zhus pas ma grub/ slad kyi srong nge'i sras lha btsun pa byang chub 'od kyi bod khams kyi mi la phan gdags par bzhed nas/ phan gang che bsams pas/ chos brtags chos la byin rlab mi 'byung bas parnyi ta bzang po zhig spyan drangs na phan che bar dgongs nas/dge slong tshul khrims rgyal ba la sogs pa'i mi lnga la gser srang sum cu rtsa gnyis bskur nas pho nyar btang ste/ rgya brtson 'grus seng ges las dpon gyis nas bod kyi btsan po byang chub sems dpa'i slob dpon du zhus pas/paṇ+ḍi ta di pam ka ra zhes bya ba 'bri ga ma la shi la na parnyi ta sum cu rtsa gnyis bzhugs pa'i nang nas mkhas shing grub pas brgyan pa gcig la zhu rten gser ling ba srang bcu gnyis phul nas zhus pas/ ngas brtags pa bya gsungs nas/

78 ༄༅//(sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/do ker gyi lha khang gi mkha' 'gro mas bod la phan thogs par lung bstan/ jo mo sgrol ma'i zhal nas kyang u pa si ka 1 la brten nas bod kyi sems can la phan thogs par 'ong cig gsungs nas bod du spyan drangs te/ bod kyi lha byang chub 'od kyi mnga' ris skor gsum gyi 'bangs yongs bsdus te/ parnyi ta 'tshal zhing gi gtsug lag khang du phyag phab nas/ lo gcig chos zhu ba'i rten du gser sung drug brgya phul nas/ skye bo mang po bsnyen gnas la bkod/mang pos byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ skye bo mang po la rim rtsa mdzad/sgrub pa'i gdams ngag gnang / lha byang chub 'od dang lo tsā rin chen bzang po la sogs pa'i mi mang pos yi dam lha'i zhal gzigs/ mdo sde'i drang don gyi dgongs pa ma shes par sgra'i rjes su 'brangs nas sbyin pa la sogs pa thabs kyi tshul bsam mi dgos so stong pa nyid 1 pus sangs rgyas zer ba'i log par smra ba dang / blo ma sbyangs kyang sngags kyi sgor zhugs pa thams cad theg pa chen po yin pas/ theg pa 'og ma la dgos pa med zer bas/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa med pa la/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa skye zer ba dang chags sdang sna tshogs spyod cing sdig pa byas kyang nged la mi sgrib pa yin zer ba la sogs chos log smra ba thams cad lung dang rigs pas tshar bcad/ slad kyi lha byang chub 'od kyis zhus nas shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa'i sgrub pa'i gdams ngag khyod rang gis thugs nyams su bzhes pa cig zhus pas/ gdam ngag gi rgyud tshod dang sbyar nas nyams su len pa'i gdams ngag lkog tu sgrong chos su gnang /de'i rgyab tu bstan pa la 'jug pa'i rim pa gnang / de sgrub thabs mdo tsam du yi ger bkod nas byang chub lam sgron gnang / gzhan yang 'gyur mang ba bcos/ mang po bsgyur phan btags so// slad kyi bod ston mang pos mnga' ris su byon dbus su spyan drangs nas/ khu rngog 'brom gsum la sogs pa la bka' drin gyis khyab nas/ bshad rgyud sgrub rgyud gdams ngag chen po spel

༄7//sba bzhed zhabs btags ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 79bas bka' drin che ba lags so// dam pa'i chos kyi me ro mdo khams smad nas slang bar grags/ de'i gdams ngag mi slu ba dang / bshad rgyud ma nor ba jo bo rje lha 1 gis me ro bslang ba yin no chos 'byung gi lo rgyus mi 'dra ba mang du snang na yang / la la ngan smras/ la la zhe 'dod/ la la bsdus pa la la le tshe/la la bcos ma yin te/ 'di sngon gyi btsan po rje blon dang / rgya bod kyi lo paṇa chen po rnams kyi gsung dang / dbus gtsang gi gtsug lag khang chen po rnams kyi bzhugs tshul dang mi 'gal bar mchis pas legs pa yin/ legs par gzung / legs par bris/ legs par bshad/ 'on kyang so so skye bos bkod pas 'khrul kyang srid/ man ngag kun la yod na mkhas pa su yis byed/yi ge mi la ma sbyin blo la bzung la bshos/ bris nas snod du bzhag na bang so'i nor dang 'dra/ ya rabs su la dgos bshams thugs la de ltar zhog bka' rtsigs kyi yi ge zhib mo la 'bas btags pa'o// rdzogs so/ / sba bzhed rgyas par grags pa mchan dkyus su bris par 'dug pas/ yi ge mang ba tsam du 'dug go/ sba bzhed 'di la btags ma zhes pa 'di yin/ sba bzhed rang gi ngo bo bka' tshigs kyi yi ge ni gsum du mchis te/ gcig bse'i sgrom bur rtsal nas kha la lcags kyi btab nas rje'i phyag sbal na mchis te gnod sbyin dam nag po la gtad do che long gcig ni zhang blon rnams la yang dar bar byas so//ces pa yan yin 'dug 'di rnams yi ge rnying pa la mchan bu dkyus su bcug pa sogs bris nor mang rab 'ong gi 'dug na'ang / 'di gnyis gsum dang gtugs pas don la ma dag pa mi 'dug go/ 'di bu tshal pho brang ba'i dpe khyad par gcig dang / gzhan gcig dang gsum bstun pas 'di kho na dag par 'dug go sba rnams kyi rjes 'brang phal cher gsang sngags blor mi shong ༵༵ pad+ma 'byung gnas la mi gus zer ba ni mi bden pa 'dra'o// sarba marga

80sba bzhed ces bya ba las/ sba gsal snang gi bzhed pa bzhugs/ (chosaming sba yeshesadabang pogrags/)rigs gsum mgon po'i rnam 'phrul gyis// sha za gdong dmar 'dul ṭ+wāṃ rdod pa'i// mes dbon gsum la phyag btsal te/ bka' tshigs yi ge zhib btsan po khri lde gtsug btsan gyi mes bsrong btsan gyi bka' chems kyi yi ge 'chims phu'i phyag mdzod na/ blon po mgar gyis zangs kyi byang bu la bris nas sbas pa de bltas pas/ nga'i dbon sras kyi ring la rgyal po lde zhes bya ba'i ring la dam pa'i lha chos 'byung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rjes su rab tu byung ba dbu reg dang zhabs rjen/ sku la ngur blag gi rgyal mtshan gsol ba/lha dang mi'i mchod gnas kyang mang du 'byung / de la rang gzhan gyi tshe 'di dang phyi ma'i mtho ris dang / thar pa thams cad kyi bde ba 'byung bas/ nga'i dbonasras rje blon rnams kyi 'tsho ba bla nas sbyor la zhabs 'og nas bde ba 'byin/ dbu'i mchod gnas su khur cig bya ba bris nas 'dug pa de la gzigs pas/ lde zhes bya ba de nga yin par dgongs nas/ bran ka mu le ko dang / snyags gle na ku ma ra gnyis rgya gar du chos 'tshol du btang pas/ parnyi ta dpal sangs rgyas gsang ba dang / sangs rgyas zhi ba bya ba 2 gangs ti se la bsgom bya ba thos te/ de gnyis spyan drangs pas ma 'grongs('drongs)/ de gnyis kyi thugs la mdo sde las rnam par dbye ba dang / gser 'od dam pa'i

༄༅//sba gsal snang gi bzhed pa bzhugs/ 81mdo dang / kṛ ya dang / u pa ya shas tsam zhus/ glegs bam spyan drangs nas rgyal ba'i mchod gnas su phul/ de'i bzhugs khang lta bur lha khang lnga bzhengs te lha sa na mkhar brag brag dmar na 'gram (mgrin)bzang / 'chims phu na na ral/ brag dmar na ka chu/ ma sa gong gi gtsug lag khang dang lnga bzhengs pas/ zhang blon kun brtse bro chag (1)brel bas ma dga' nas/ nged kyi btsan po 'di ni dad pa che la chos la dga'/ byad mi mtshar bas bram ze yin nam zhes gleng ba rje'i snyan du gsol bas rje'i zhal nas/ nga bram ze yin par gyur na nga'i khab ljang mo khri btsun 'di la bu nga bas dad pa che ba/ byad mi sdug pa cig shog cig nga btsan po ma nor ba yin na/ bu zhang blon gyis bcas mi thub pa cig shog gcig ces dmod btsugs pas/ khri btsun la sras lha'i bu 'dra ba/ sna'i gzengs mtho ba/ dpral ba'i dbyibs(dbyes)che ba/ shin tu mdzes pa gcig btsas pas/ zhang blon rnams na re/ bod kyi btsan po 'di rgyal po yang dag pa'o zer/ sras la 'di mi min lha'i dbon po yin zer nas/ ming yang ljang tsha lha dbon du gsol lo//de la khab ran par gyur tsa na/ bod thams cad kyi mi spre'u dang brag srin gyi bu yin pas 'di'i jo mor mi 'os/ 'di la rgya'i bu mo zhig slong bar chad do// bod kyi rgyal po la bzang pa mes srong btsan sgam po de ar+ya pa lo ke ta'i sprul bar grags/ de'i btsun mo lha gcig kong jo yin/ kong jo'i yul rgya nag po'i yul grong khyer geg shing khri sgo na rgyal po kong tshe 'phrul chung bya ba 'byor pa rgyas pa/ mnga' thang rgyas pa cig yod/ de la gtsug lag gi gab tshe sum brgya drug cu yod pas rgya nag gtsug lag gi rgyal por grags/ mtshan rgya rje 'brom shing hwan zer/ de'i sras rgya rje spyan bzang / de'i sras rgya rje li khri bzher langs mig ser bya ba da lta bzhugs pa de'i sras mo ging shang kong jo bya ba yod zer ba de blang bar 'cham nas/ snyags khri bzang yang ston la/
