82 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/'khor sum cu dang bcas pa mnye (gnye)bor btang nas/ pho nya ba de dag gis rgya rje la sgrom bu phul bas/ rgya rjes byin par dgongs nas bu mo la bsgo bas/ bu mo kong jos rang gi 'phrul gyi me long srid gsum mthong ba yod pa de la bltas pas/ bod kyi yul yar lung yul bzang pa dang / rgyal bu de byad legs pa lha'i bu 'dra ba de mthong nas 'gro bar byas/ de nas rdzongs la sogs pa byas pa dang / gnye bo dang bcas pa bod du 'ongs so//shul du rgyal bus mtshan la rta bcags pas/ 'phang thang dge rar sngags pas zer (zor)mda' 'phangs pas 'phog te grongs so// bang so ko'u (ko'u)rtsigs pa'i tshe na kong jo 'phang thang gi pho brang du byon pas/ rgyal po yin zer pa'i rgad po ag tshom can gcig las mi brda (gda')bas/ byad kyi lha (lta)cha yin nam me long gi lha (lta)cha yin mnyam (snyams)nas yid ma dga' ste/ nyin mo bzhin dngul dkar gyi me long tasbru ras ram bu bteg cing sdug glu len/ mtshan mo bzhin mchu sbrang gis ram bu bteg cing glu len pa/rgya gar gyi yul na dam pa'i lha chos yod de/ lam bal yul de tshad pa che/ de la bsam thag chad/ rgya nag gi yul na ju zhag gi rtsis yod de/ pha yul shul thag ring / de la bsam na bsam thag chad/ bod yul gyi dbus na rje rgyal gyi btsan po yod de/ blon po gdugs pa ched(che)/ bod kyi blon po sdig po zer zhing glu len/ de blon pos rje'i snyan du gsol ba las/ rje'i zhal nas/ 'o na da mo rang la skyes drag tu bskur la pha yul du skyol ces gsungs/ de skad kong jo la gsol pa las kong jo na re/ rgyal bu byad legs pa cig yod pa ltar na/nga dang las ma mthun pa yin pas pha yul du 'chi (mchi)bar mi spro zhing / da mes po dang 'du'o zhes zer/ dus ring zhig gi phyis kong jo na re/ nga'i ne ne mo kong jo'i mchod gnas gser gyi lha shākya mu ne'i zhal blta'o// zer nas dbu ru lha sar byon pa dang / rgya stag ra mo che na lha mi bzhugs nas/ kun tu

༄༅//sba gsal snang gi bzhed pa bzhugs/ 83mchod pa byed cing btsal yang ma rnyed nas/ ra sa'i lha khang du mchod pa byas pas/ gtsang khang sgo lnga'i mchod rabs 'dug pa la bzhi las med/ 'di na gcig yod par 'dug ces glo 'bur gyi ya gtad 'og tu brdungs pas ser kha byangs/ de brkos nas phye ba dang / gser gyi lha shākya mu ne sbas pa mthong nas/sno ne mo'i lha la zhal ston cig gsol zer nas mchod pa btsugs/ blon po shi tshad la zan skal med pas/ nged rgya nag na chos dar bas mi shi tshad la bdun tshigs yod/ bod chos ma dar bas blon po snying re rje zer nas/ mi shi ma thag tu lha mi stong la mtshal ('tshal)ma re 'tshal/ de la bod kyi tshe zhes bya'o//phyis kong jo la yos bu'i lo la rgyal bu chags/ de'i dus na rgyal po ni pho brang brag dmar 'om bu'i tshal na bzhugs/ yos bu'i lo dpyid zla ra ba'i tshes gsum la bab pa na/ rgya'i hwa shang mngon shes yod pa na re/ rgyal po khyod kyi btsun mo la sras byang chub sems dpar nges pa cig btsal (btsa')bar nges/de la rim gro bskyed cig zhes zer/ nam phyed la mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad bzhengs/ 'jim pa lhag ma la nga'i sku tshab byed gsungs nas mchod rten gros (gres)thag can yang brtsigs/ nang par pho nya byung ste kong jo la sras gcig bltams so zhes zer/ rgyal pos yar lungs 'phang thang du sras bltams pa gzigs su byon pa'i tshe/ kong jo'i bu sna rnam (nam) bza' bzhi stengs kyis phrogs nas 'di nga la skyes pa yin zer/ der blon po kun gyi brtag par bya ba'i phyir/ thang tshigs kyi bug gar bu bzhag nas bu sus byed du bcug pas/kong jos sngon la zin pa bzhi stengs kyis shi na'ang shi snyam te phyogs pas/kong jos bu shi dogs nas lhod btang te/ yin dang nga'i yin te dri mo khyod zer nas btang / bu kong jo'i yin par shes/lo gcig lon tsa na zhabs 'dzugs pa'i dga' ston byas te/ sna rnam pa rnams ber chung ngu re lag na thogs nas zhang po'i pang du shog zer/ rgyal bu

84 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/na re/ khri srong lde btsan rgya tsha lags/ sna rnam khang gi ci bgyi 'tshal/kāsungs nas/ rgya'i yul (pang)du song bas/ ming yang rang gis btags de nas rgyal bus lo bzhi bzhes nas pho brang 'om bu tshal du bzhugs/ rgya rjes rgyal po la skyes chen po bskur nas pho nya ba 'ba' de'u la bu rgya phug gar mkhanakhya ba yod pa de rgyal bu'i brtse zlar phul/ yab rgyal po dam pa'i chos mdzad par bzhed nas/ chos rgya gar nang yod pas rgya gar gyi rgyal po'i thugs bzung ba'i slad du skyes dang pho nya ba lho bal du brdzangs pas/ shul dong phabs kyi 'phrang du khu 'phang dgung bdun bab/ 'tsho ba chad nas gnam du bltas pas/ bya phug ron lnga 'phur ba la/ mda' bzhi dus gcig la 'phangs nas (phug ron )bzhi dus gcig la bskum(kum)/ / de sdig che bar kun gyis gleng pa de rgyal bu brag dmar rdzing gong na brtse bas gsan/ brtse zla khyung po dum tshugs/ cog la smon lam 'bar/ rgya phrug gar mkhan dang lnga rdzing na brtse ba'i 'dam khrod rkang pa'i 'og nas srin bu dmar nar byung pas/ rgyal bu na re/ shul dong phabs kyi 'phrang la pho nya ba 'ba' de'us phug non bzhi bsad pa de sdig che'o mchis na/ srin bu 'di kun bsad na sdig che'am mi che zer/ khyung po dum tshugs kyi mchid nas 'di lta bu'i ma nyes pa bsad na shin tu sdig che/ tshur la gnod pa byed pa dang nya bsad na phyugs bzan 'phel zer/ rgya phrug gi skad nas/ rgya'i hur bya ba'i gtsug lag las 'di lta bu bskum na de phur du sdig che'am mi che zer/ rgyal bu na re/ hur las ji ltar 'byung gsungs pas/ rgya phrug na re/ hur las dge ba bcu'i chos yod ces snyan du gsol ba las/ rgyal bus dus rtag tu de gleng ba zhang blon kun gyi (gyis)tshor te/ rgyal bu 'di chos la dga' 'am/ zhes gros mol bas dga' zer/ rgyal bu'i phyir yab kyis sgrom bu bskur nas sang shi dang mi bzhi rgya'i

༄༅//sba gsal snang gi bzhed pa bzhugs/ 85gtsug lag len du pho nyar btang / bka' bzhin du bsgrubs na bya dga' byin no// ma 'grub na bsod (gsod)to byas te btang /de nas ke'u le'i 'phrang la phyin/ de'i dus su rgya rje bum sangs dbang po'i drung na ju zhag mkhas pa gcig na re/ da ste zla ba gsum na nub phyogs bod nas 'dir byang chub sems dpa' gcig pho nyar 'ong zhes mchi'o// de ci 'dra byas pas de'i sha tshugs dang rtags 'di 'dra'o zer nas 'bag bris nas/dbang pos de rgya rje'i snyan du gsol bas/ rgya rjes pho nya btang nas de der sdod du ma bzhugs par de la rims (rim)gro bskyed la mar la nga'i drung du thong bya byung / pho nya de'i dus su byung nas de la rgya'i hwa shang gis phyag byas te bsgo ba bzhin byas mar btang pas/ rgya rjes kyang de la phyag byas pa dang / pho nyas rgya rje la btsan po'i sgrom bu phul/ rgya rjes sgrom bu dang sbyar nas rdzong bar chad byas te rgya rje na re/ khyed rgya de'u'i bu yin na 'dir nga'i nang blon bgyir mi rung ngam gsungs/ de la bsam pas nga 'dir 'dug na tshe 'di la bskyid na'ang bod yul du chos bzang po khungs byung ba'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i sde snod kyi dpe tsam cig btsan po'i phyag du phul la/ slad kyi thabs bya bar snyan du gsol snyam te/ bdag 'dir bstod (sdod)par gnang ba ni bka' drin che na/ bod kyi btsan po'i bka' nan cher bstsal bas/ bdag gi pha las kyi bskums na blo ba la bcags/ slar bod du mchis nas pha dang gros su bgyis te thabs kyis 'bangs su 'chi'o// zhes zhus pas/ rgya rje na re/nga'i snying du mi khyod la (las)sdug pa zhig ma byung na/ khyod bya dga' ci 'dod/pho nya'i mchod nas bya dga' gnang na sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab bam po stong zhu'o zhes zhus pa dang / rgya rje na re/ ke'u le te gcan gzan gyi 'phrang la song tsa na'ang gnod pa ma byas rim gro cher byas byung / bum sangs dbang po'i ju zhag mkhan na re'ang khyod byang chub sems dpa'i sprul par 'ong zer/ hwa shang

86 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/mngon shes can gyis kyang khyod la phyag byas/ khyod kyi spyod pa dang sbyar na'ang sangs rgyas kyi lung nas/ lnga brgya'i tha ma la gdong dmar gyi yul du dam pa'i chos kyi khungs 'byin pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'ong bar bstan pa de'ang khyod yin par gor ma chag ngas kyang grogs bya'i zer te/ mthing shog la gser chus bris pa'i chos bam po stong gnang / bya dga' gzhan yang che thang du gnang nas/ pho nya la slar bod du 'gro ba'i lam na pha bong 'gron po rgyu mi phod pa/ sus mthong ba de sbos grir 'chi ba yod pa'i de grong khyer chag chu'i kim hwa shang nus pa can stag la ga sha 'gel nus pas bkal ba/ mngon shes yod pa de kho rang gi mkhan pos bka' bsgos nas zhag gsum bsgoms pas pha bong grum nas brtul shul du lha khang brtsigs/ lung pa de yang zhing du rmos/lha ris bcad/ de legs chur 'ongs pa la bod kyi pho nya bas bsgom lung mnos/ ci 'gyur gyi lung zhus pa/ ngas bod du sangs rgyas kyi chos tshugs bsam/ bod du sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab bsgrags na bod kyi bgegs srin srog la bsdo ba mi 'byung ngam/ btsan po yab sras bde 'am ces dris pas/der hwa shang gi mngon shes kyis bltas pas btsan po sku gshegs rgyal bu sku nar ma lon pas/ blon po nag po la dga' ba rnams kyis khrims su bcas nas chos bshig brag dmar 'gram bzang bya ba'i thugs dam cig 'dug pa rmang nas bsgyel/ chos dar bar byed na khyod kyis btsan po'i zhabs sring bar mdzod la/ slad kyis rgyal po de sku nar son pa dang / de'i zhal nas mu stegs rig byed kyi chos cig gleng du 'ong gis/ de tsa na 'di snyan du gsol cig dang /de la rgyal bu dad pa skye shing / de'i rjes la 'di snyan du gsol bas/ rgyal bu chos byed par 'gyur ro// ces gsungs te lung bstan glegs bam gsum bskur/ bod la chos kyi bskal ba yod/ mthar chos rgyas par 'ong / de'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen za hor rgyal po'i bu/ dge slong shan+ta rak+shi ta zhes bya ba

༄༅//sba gsal snang gi bzhed pa bzhugs/ 87de khyod bod kyi 'dul skal yin no// gsungs nas zla ba gnyis zan drangs/de nas nyin lam gnyis su bskyal nas gcig la gcig rkang pa la phyag byas te gyes/ de nas zang (sang)shi 'grams bzang bshig pa blo (glo)ba la bcags nas/ khong pho nya mi lnga pos rgya'i ri mgo de'u shan gyi rtse na mi ma yin gyis na bun btibs pa'i khrod du zhag bdun gyis tshar bar brtsigs pa'i ar+ya mdzi'i phreng yod pa las/ des len du mchis pa'i tshe/ mi 1 gis ri la 'dzeg ma shes/gcig gis rtse la phyin kyang ci yang ma mthong / mi gcig gis lha khang mthong ste sgo ma rnyed/ gcig gis sgo mthong ste dra ba 'dra ba gcig gis bkab te 'gro ma shes/ sang shis nang du phyin nas 'phags pa 'jam dpal la sogs te byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag byas/ mchod pa phul/ dgra bcom pa kun la yang phyag byas mchod pa phul/ 'phags pa kun dang gtam byas te de'i 'dug lus dper bya ba'i phyir yid la bzung ste phyir don pa dang / ri de'i gcan zan kun gyis phyag byas nas ri'i sgab tu bskyal nas bod du 'ongs so//bod du yab rgyal po'i mes ag tshoms yar 'brog rba tshal du chibs sgron pas grongs pa dang / rgyal po khri bsrong lde btsan dgung lo brgyad lon pa dang /chab srid gzhes (bzhes)ma thag tu sku nar ma son pas/ zhang ma zhang khron pa skyes na re/ rgyal po sku tshe thung ba chos byas pas lan te bkra mi shes par tshe phyi ma skye ba len bya ba rdzun yin no// tshe 'di'i rkyen bzlog bon gyis bya/ chos su byed pa pho reng du mthar sgyug ces 'og tu bshad pa bzhin zhang ma zhang gis blon chen chos la dga' ba mang bal gnyis la skyon (bkyon )phab ste bod nag por btang / ra mo che nas gser gyi lha shākya mu ne de rgya'i lha yin pas slar rgyal yul du bskyal bar bya zer ba las/ lha de dang po rta pa gcig gis pang du theg pa de ma thag pas 'breng ba'i dra bar bcug nas mi sum brgyas sgor phyung / de nas stong gis/ mkhar brag gdong gi thad kur phyin pa dang / mi stong gis

88 ༄༅//(sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/kyang ma theg nas de nyid kyi bye thang du sbas nas 'ba' rje 'khol la gtad nas bzhag rgya'i hwa shang rgad po gcig dkon gnyer byed cing yod pas/ de yang slar rgya yul du bskrad nas btang ste/ hwa shang gis rgya bod 'tshams su phyin pa dang / hwa shang ba'i mchid lham ya gcig kha sang gi dro lam du lus par gyur pa dang / hwa shang gi mchid nas nga'i lham ya gcig kha sang gi dro lam du lus pa ni da rung du chos me stag tsam gcig bod yul du 'byung zhes zer skad/ mkhar brag gi lha khang ni rmang nas bsgyel/ 'gram bzang gi lha khang bshig te lcong (ste cong )ni 'chims phu'i g.ya' la bskyal te/ de nyid da ltar gyi bsam yas dge rgyas kyi mthong lags/ de ltar chos bshig pa'i tshe/ lha sa dpe dkar du bzo grwa bgyis bshas byas nas lder tsho la lpags pa g.yogs/ phyag la nang bya dang lug khog bskal/ phyin chad bod la mi shi na ni tshe zhes pa dge ba bgyid du mi snang / rgya'i lha chos bgyid pa gcig mchis na/ pho brang du rtag tu sgyug go zhes khrims bu chung bcas pa'i tshe/ dam pa'i chos bshig pas/ dus phyis zhang ma zhang ni lce dang rkan skas (gas)te gum/ zhang khri thog rje thang la 'bar ni thang la rgyal brgyal nas la a a zhes lan gsum 'bod 'bod nas rgyab gas nas shi/ lcog ro skyes bzang rgyal gong ni lce dang rkan dang rkang lag ril gu gu thul du song nas gum/ bla 'og gi mi dang bltas mkhan kun mthun par brgya (rgya)lha 'khros te/ rgya'i lha sa tham du bcug pas rgya'i lha ma dga' ces zer nas/ rgya'i lha'i mes po dang po rgya gar yul nas 'ongs par nges pas shākya mu ne'i mes po rgya gar dang nye ba mang yul du skyal bar mo bzang nas bye dong nas bton nas mang yul du dre'u gnyis kyis khyogs bgyis nas bskyal ba'i dus su yul ngan chen po byung / 'bangs gum pa la tshe zhes pa dge ba bgyid du mi gter bar khrims bu chung bcas pa'i 'og tu/ ba lam klags na sba gsal snang gi bu ming sring gnyis dus gcig tu gum pa'i tshe/ lha'i yab mes kun na re/

༄༅//sba gsal snang gi bzhed pa bzhugs/ 89chos bden zer/ hwa shang la 'dri snyam nas lhun khang nas hwa shang mngon shes can rgan po gcig pa dngos bos te zhus pa/ tshe snga phyi yod dam/ chos bden nam zhes dris pas/ hwa shang na re tshe snga phyi yod/ chos bden zer bas/ sgor ni bon bgyid du bstsal/ nang du ni gyod dang bsdos te lha mi stong la mtshal/bstsal te tshe bgyis/ ra mo che nas hwa shang rgad po de bkug nas bu ming sring gnyis kyi bdun tshigs zhus pas/ hwa shang na re/ lhar skyes pa dga'am/slar khyed kyi bur skye ba dga' zhes gsungs/ pha ni lhar skye bar dga' bas lhar skyes bar zhu byas/ ma ni bdag gi bur skye bar dga' bas de ltar zhus pa la/ hwa shang gis bu'i rus bu la cho ga byas te gdung sha ri ram du song bas lhar skyes par bstan/ yang bu mo'i khar mu tig sran ma tsam ldan pa g.yon du mchol (mtshal) chus bkus pa cig bcug nas yid ches pa'i brtag (rtags)tu cho ga bgyis nas rdza 'og tu bcug te ma'i mal 'og tu sbas nas sang phod khyod rang gi bur skye'o zhes lung bstan pas/ sang phod gsal snang gi khab la bu gcig skyes pa'i kha nas mu tig ldan g.yon dmar por byung pas/mal 'og rdza gog kha che (phye)bas shul ha re 'dug btsas nas lo gcig lon pa dang / ma bslabs par zhing (zhang)dang ne+e ne mo yang ngo 'tshal ming yang ngo shes te/ sngon ma gum pa'i tshe bzhin 'bod pa logs ( )brtags dang mtshan ma mang du byung bas tshe phyi ma yod par shes/de nas rgya'i hwa shang de la gsal snang gi bsgom lung nos te/ gzhan la gsang zhing brtag tu bsgom pa'i rjes la/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung rabs 'tshal ba'i slad nas rgya gar yul dang bal yul du 'gro bar rje'i bsnyan du gsol ba las/ rje'i thugs la 'di chos la dkar bas rgya gar yul du 'gro bar nges snyam du thugs dpag mdzad nas/ 'o na ngas mang yul gyi kha blon du bko'o (bsko)gsungs nas der bkos (bskos)te mang yul du mchis/ slar zhang ma

90 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/'ang gis rgya'i lha chos bgyid du mi gnang ba yang / lung bcag nas thal byung du rgya gar yul du rdo rje gdan gyi ma hā bo rnyi dang / gtsug lag khang shri na te mchod pa bgyis te yon phul bas dgun zla 'bring po la char bab/ byang chub chen po'i byang chub shing las 'o ma byung / bal yul du ston mo sarba wa se bgyis/gtsug (lhun khang )lag khang du yon phul nas/ mchod pa phul ba'i rjes su/dge'o zhes sgra dang 'od byung / bal rje la ngo chen zhus nas/ mkhas shing gsal ba yon tan mang po mnga' ba'i/ shān+ta rak+ṣi ta bod kyi skad du zhi ba mtsho/bo dhi satwa zhes su grags pa de mang yul du spyan drangs/ mang yul du gtsug lag khang gnyis brtsigs/ bal yul du bal rje'i 'bangs byas/ rkyen ris bcad/ rgya gar dang bal po'i mkhas pa kun las chos slabs/ gsal snang gi khyim du bshos gsol te/ yon phul/ chos zhus pa'i rjes la/ bod kyi rgyal po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mdzad cing gshegs par ci gnang / bdag la sems bskyed kyang zhu zhes gsol ba las/ mkhan po'i zhal nas sems bskyed zhu na yon phul cig ces gsungs nas/ der gser dngul la sogs pa'i ran+ta dang / zo rid dang / zab dar dang / ber dang / bya skyogs dang / gu ru dang / snam gos la sogs pa rung ngo mtshal lus par phul/ da rung phul cig ces gsungs pas/ cang med kyang lus la 'tshal ba'i skye rags dang / ral ka yang phul ba dang / sems bskyed gnang nas de'i rjes la/ mkhan po'i zhal nas/ nga bod kyi 'dul bskal yin te/ bod kyi rgyal po shrī btsan po dang /khyed gnyis ma skyes pas/ bod kyi rgyal po gdung rabs dgu rjes kyi bar du ngas rgya gar/ za hor yul dang / bal yul na phar 'gro tshur 'gro byed cing lhod lhod cing 'dug da shrī btsan po dang khyed gnyis nar son te dus la bab pas/ yul byan gar du chu bo lo hi ta'i 'gram ri ha pa pu ri'i drung / yul brag dmar na bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa zhes bya ba'i gtsug lag khang gcig

༄za//sba gsal snang gi bzhed pa bzhugs/ 91brtsig shing dge ba'i bshes gnyen bya'o// khyod ni tshe 'di la ngo shes shing sems bskyed pa ma yin te/ tshe rab (rabs)du ma'i sngon rol nas sems bskyed pa yin te/ tshe rab du ma'i sngon rol nas sems bskyed pa'i chos kyi bu rabs yin/ ming yang ye shes dbang por gdags so zhes gsungs nas spyi bo nas phyag gis byugs nas byil byil mdzad/ zhus pa rnams bkas gnang /de'i tshe nam mkha' las dge'o zhes sgra lan gsum byung ste 'od kyang byung ngo //de nas yon phul ba kun slar stsal nas gcig kyang ma bzhes/ mkhan po ni slar bal yul du gshegs/ gsal snang mar 'ongs/ btsan po'i zhal mjal du tshes gcig la mchi bar pho nya btang te snyan du gsol ba las gnang ste/ rlung tshugs las pho brang du mchis nas rje la zhe sa phul ma thag tu/ rje'i zhal nas/ gsal snang khyod lha chos sha stag byed cing 'dug zer na/ khong gis mi sgyugs ma dgos bsam/ zhes bka' stsal pa dang / lan du mang yul gyisakha bstod na mchis pas sgyugs pa dang yang 'dra zhes gsol/ rjes pham phabs chos ston grangs pa'i tshe/ sa dben par bsangs te/ rje la lha chos bzang po mdzad par rigs dang / mkhan po bo sgyi satwa bya ba mkhas pa btsun pa/ mngon par shes pa mnga' ba la sogs pa yon tan du ma yod pa gcig la dge ba'i bshes gnyen zhu bar phul ba la sogs pa gsol ba las/ mkhan pos 'di skad gsung zhes zhib tu zhus pa la rje'i zhal nas/ zhang dbon gyis khyed gsad par 'ong gis ngas zhang nya bzang la skog tu bsgos te zhang blon gyis mdun grar khan kyis gsol du bzhug go// khyed re zhig yul du song la yibs las sdod cig ces bka' stsal nas/ gsal snang yul du mchi ste sgom mo//de nas de'i tshe/ sba sang shis rgyar phyin pa'i pho nya'i sug las grub nas slar bod du mchis pa las/ rgya rje'i lan dang bskyes dag kyang btsan po'i phyag tu phul/ blon chen po'i thabs stsal/ ming rgya phrug 'dzangs por btags/ rgyal

92 ༄༅//(sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/bu sku nar ma son pas rgya'i chos rnams mchims phu'i rdza bseb tu sbas so//yang rgyal pos zhang zhung yul gyi dkor snyan pa yod pa blangs te dkor mdzod du blug pa'i pho nya mang du btang pa las/ snga phyi gcig kyang ma log pas rgya phrug gi 'di btang na lon 'ong zer nas dkor blug pa'i pho nyar btang ba las/ lam du zhang zhung gi lha mo/ mu tsa men dang 'jal ba la lha mo de ro smad nigayu'i na bun gyi 'khrigs/ ro stod ni mu tig gi se mo do dang dung rin po ches brgyan pa gcig sang shi la thal mo sbyar te phyag bgyis shing / rin po che'i brgyan gyis mchod de smras pa/ byang chub sems dpa' khyed mkhar nag po'i bskor blug tu gshegs pa bdag gi rta ser po rngog nag 'di la chibs la khyung lung gi sgor phyin pa dang / gya (gyal)rta'i lcags 'di snga ru la chings la/ snod nang du dkor blug shig dang / nyes zho ma mchis par gyur to// zhes smras nas mi snang par gyur to// de nas sang zhis rta rngog nag de la zhon nas gya rta'i lcag lag tu blangs nas khyung lung du phyin pa dang / lha mos gdams pa bzhin du mkhar sgor rta btags nas rta'i lcags snga ru la bsgreng te bcings nas bzhag nas/ sang shis bskor gnyan po ril blug te mkhar bdag mchis pa'i khang pa ci sgo phye ba las/ nang na mi 'dom bcu gnyis pa gcig nyal nas mchis pa las/ sang shi gda' (gdan)nas langs shing thal mo sbyar te phyag 'tshal te/sngas na gser skyogs rgun chang gis gang ba dang / mdun du g.yu 'od me 'bar ba bzhin du 'dug pa gcig gnyis sang shi la phul/ de nas yang glan gyi mdzod phyi na/ g.yag skad ni ngur/ rta skad ni 'tsher/ ra skad ni sbrid/ mi ya lan can dag gcig kyang yud yud gda'/ sgrom bzhi'i nang na glan gyi me long mchis pa kha phye nas/ zur mo khab kyi mig tsam gcig phye bas rgyal po'i pho brang dang / snang srid thams cad/ bdag gi glo snying nang khrol kun kyang de na gda' nas slar sbas te/ sgor phyung nas gya rta'i lcag chu phyed tshal du gas nas

༄༅//sba gsal snang gi bzhed pa bzhugs/ 93gda' skad/ sang shi dngos bod yul du 'khor te/ de nas ring zhig na rgyal bu sku nar son pa dang / yab mes kyi yi ge gzigs nas 'ang blon rnams dang gros mdzad pas/ nga'i yab mes kyi yi ge na 'bangs bde ba'i tshis rma'i le'u tshe kyang sbyar na nga'i yab mes kyi le'u tshe kyang de ci 'dra gcig bdog zer/der btsan pos rgya bzang me mgo la gsungs pa/ nga'i yab mes kyi sku ring la rgya'i gtsug lag le'u ke tshe zhes bya ba zhig 'byung zhes grags na de ci lta bu zhes gsungs pa dang / mi mgos le'u tse gang ji ltar lags pa'i yi ge bklag pa dang / btsan po'i zhal nas gtsug lag de te phor btang ngo // nga'i yab mes kyi chos lugs bzang po gcig sku nyams su bzhes so zer nas/ da 'jig rten gyi spyod pa bzang po ci 'byung ba ltar zhes gsungs pa dang / sangs shis bsam pa/ sngar gyi hwa shang mngon shes can gyi nam rgyal po mu stegs kyi chos gcig gleng ba'i dus su lha chos snyan du gsol gcig bya ba ni 'di yin pa 'dra zhes bsams nas/ sangs shes gsol pa/ rgya'i lha chos bzang po byung na le'u tse gang de dag de'i phru ma'i sgor yang mi tshud do// zhes gsol pa dang / btsan po'i zhal nas/ rgya'i lha chos bzang po'i gtan tshigs khyod la yod dam/ zhes bka' med (mad)pa dang / bdag cag rgya la mchis so zhes gsol nas/ rje 'bangs dben par gsangs te/ rtarmā mchims phu'i rdza la sbas pa'i nang nas blangs te/ kim hwa shang gi lung bzhin du brims pa dang / dang po dge ba bcu'i mdo bklag de la rgyal po dad pa skyes/ spyod pa dag par go de nas rdo rje gcod pa bklag de lta ba dag par go dad pa cher skyes/ de nas sa lu ljang pa bklag lta spyod zung 'brel du go nas chos la yid ches/ la la nas dang po dge ba bcu dang / phung po lnga spyan sngar brims nas bzang rab ces 'byung / de 'og sa lu ljang pa spyan snga brims nas chos thams cad rgyu rkyen las byung bar thugs ches nas zer btsan po'i zhal nas/ 'di lta bu'i chos bzang

94 ༄7//(sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/po ni nga'i sku ring la rnyed pa gnam byams so// sa byams so// lha thams cad la btang rag btang ngo // gsal snang yang nga la lha chos mi spyad du mi rung zer ba yang bden/ lha chos 'di lta bu phyag du phul ba 'di las dga' ba med kyis/gsal snang la ni dngul gyi g.yu rung (drung )gi steng du gser chen po byin no//sangs shi la ni 'phra men g.yung drung gi steng du gser chung du byin no// khyod kyis spyan drangs pa'i rgya yul gyi rdarma kun dang / mang yul gyis chos rnams/rgya me mgo dang / rgya gar a nan+ta dang / rgya las skad mkhas pa su yod bsgyur cig ces bka' bstsal nas/ de gsum gyis ha sa pu ri'i bye khung du chos bod skad du bsgyur ba'i drung du/ zhang blon chen po ngan lam rtag (stag)ra klu gong dang / zhang ma zhang la sogs pa mchis te/ dri po khyed gsum de na ci byed/zhang ma zhang gi khrims bu chung las/ mi shi ba la tshe byed na pho reng la gtan du sprug lho bal gyi lha mchod du mi gnang ba ma thos bsam/ bya ba mang / 'dug mi phod pa de ni chos kyi skad 'dra na/ rje'i snyan du gsol ba las bye ma'i nang du bsrubs la phyis khrims bu chung dang sbyar te shags gdab sam/ zhes pa la sogs pa bka' yo gal 'chos pa'i mdun sa nas mchid nan drag po bzlas pas de sangs shes rje la gsol bas/ btsan po'i zhal nas/ gsal snang slar la 'ongs kyi bar du dar gcig ma bsgyur bar zhog gcig gsungs/ zhang blon chos la dga' ba dag gis sba sangs shi stod kyi pho nyar gsal snang gi grogs su btang par zhus pas/ btsan po'i zhal nas/ sangs shi lta bu rgya phug 'dzangs pa zho sha phul te dam pa'i chos blangs pa'i steng du/ stod du mngags nas shi na 'phangs so zhes gsungs/ stod nas slar ma log na bu yang med/ rab 'chad do zhes gsungs pas/ sang shis gsol pa/ rje lha sras dang / bo rdi satwa dang /sba gsal snang dang / bdag cag rje 'bangs smon lam gcig pas/ chos gzugs pa la bdag kyang rten tsam du mtshal bar bab kyis/ bdag rab mi

༄༅//sba gsal snang gi bzhed pa bzhugs/ 95'gum/ stod du mchis kyang rgya gar yul nas dge slong khrims nyams pa gcig thig tshe 'das ma thag tu bdag gi bur mchi'o// zhes gsol/ de nas rje blon la 'al ngo zhang nya bzang / 'gos khri bzang dang / chos la dga' ba'i blon po kun tshogs nas chos bya bar mol gtam byas pa la zhang nya bzang gi snyan du gsol ba/ mes bsrong btsan gyis lha chos mdzad pas bod du legs dgu byung ba dang / lha sras yab kyis kyang mdzad pa las/ yab nongs pa'i 'og tu zhang ma zhang gi bshig rgya'i lha de dang po rta pa gcig gis spang (pang)du theg pa slar rgya yul du bskyal bar chad pa'i tshe/ mi stong gis kyang ma theg mang yul du bskyal ba'i tshe dre'u gnyis kyis kyang ma theg chos bshig pa'i zhang blon 'ga' zhig kyang sngar bshad pa ltar gum/ bla 'og gi chab srid bltas mkhan yang rgya'i lha khros pa las byung zer ba dang sbyar na/ sku dang chab srid la mi gnod pa glo ba chung / rgya'i lha yang slar blangs la mchod cing / sngon lha sras yab kyis chos mdzad pa bzhin mdzad na legs pa 'dra yis kyang / zhang ma zham ro ngan la chos la mi dga' bas thugs dgongs mi 'grub te mchi/ zhes gsol pa dang / blon chen po mgos khri bzang yab lhag na re/ de la thabs bgyi bar sngo (rngo)thog gis kho bo'i rjes su rting gnon mdzod/ slad nas rje'i dgongs pa bsgrub bo bar de ltar chad byas/ blon khri bzang gis bla 'og gi phyag sprin dang / mo pa dang bltas mkhan kun la lkog tu bya dga' bstsal nas/rgyal bu sku chags che/ chab srid la gnod pa 'ong par lung mthun par smrar stsal/ de la ji ltar bya ba'i lung smrar stsal ba las/ rje'i sku'i rim gror zhang blon su che ba zung gcig dgung lo gsum chad dal bcug na rje'i sku tshe dang chab srid 'phel lo zhes lung phog de skye bo 'du sa kun na mang du gleng pa dang /yang blon khri bzang gis shul lam 'grim pa'i 'gron po rnams zhang ma zham snyung chen po gda' ba'i gleng yod de bden no thos tsam smrar bcug zhang ma zhang

96 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/gis de thos pas glo ba la bcags par gyur/ nub phyogs kyi gon mo gcig gis kyang zhang gi ngo la ce cer bltas ste/ zhang ma zhang ni rje'i gdung gsob pa bod 'bangs yongs la gces te/ bsnyung chen pos thebs zer ba bden nam zer bas zhang ma zhang mnyam na bden nges mnyam ste rang gi khyim du bub nyal byas te ngus pa/ nang 'khor pa na re/ ci nyes zer/ nga la nad chen po byung ngo zhes rgyal khams kun na gleng zer/ rgyal khams kyi kha la ra ma med cang mi bden zer yang / zhang gis me long la bltas pas rgas 'dug pas/ rgyal khams kyi kha la ye shes kyi spyan yod zer ba de bden zer nas/ mya ngan cher byed do// der blon po khri bzang gis thos nas/ rje 'bangs kun tshogs pa'i dus su/ zhang nya bzang gis rgyal bu sku chags che ba'i rim gro bya bar gsol bas/ blon khri bzang skad nas de'i sku glud bya bar rigs so zhib tu smra na/ de la rje'i zhabs tog pa su che bas khas long zhes zer bas/ blon chen po 'gos khri bzang na re/ rje'i zhabs rtog (tog)du'ang de che/ bu tsha'i dge dang yig tshang du'ang de che/ blon po nga bas che ba su yod/ gcig nga byed zer/ zhang ma zhang na re/ blon po nga bas che ba ni med na/ rje'i zhabs tog pa gcig ngas byed zer khas blangs/ da chad pa gar rtsig ces gleng pas/ mgos na re/ pha rir bya'am/ yang na 'ju'i yang bzangs su byed zer bas/ zhang ma zhang na re/ sna rnam brang phur rtsig go zhes rmangs bres pas/ zhang ma zhang gis 'phrigs nas rdo dga' lo sna nas skyos shig zer/ chus mi brel ba'i thabs byed pa la ra 'thud (mthud )pa'i khron par chu nang du 'ongs nas phyir 'gro ba byas/mi ltogs pa'i zas mang po dang / mi 'khyag pa'i gos dang / mi subs pa'i gseng la sogs pa yang byas/ 'chad pa 'byongs nas blon chen po gnyis nang du mchir mi rung bas/ lo steng dgu sna gong dang / mgos rgan gnyis gros byas nas/ mgos kyis rkang la bya rgod kyi lham gyon/ lus la pha ba go go'i thul

༄༅//sba gsal snang gi bzhed pa bzhugs/ 97pa gyon nas blon chen po dang / zhang ma zham nang du chud pa dang / 'dir zhang si zim mal bya/ 'dir nga yi bya/ 'dir chu bzhag go zer zhing phar 'gro tshur 'gro byed pa dang / 'ang ma zhang phyir spri li li 'brang / de'i mod la mgos kyis thal mo brdab nas pha gi na ci yin na zer nas bros pa'i rkang pa nas bzung pas bya rgod kyi spu spar ba gang lag na gda'/ pha ba go go thul bas mig gis ci yang ma mthong / lo ste gum/(gus) sgo pha 'ong gis bkag mgos rgan gyi lte 'og nas song ba zhes nang na 'khun ring zhig na/ khyim bya'i skad grags pas chu shor snyam ste dre'u yos zan lag pa brdungs pa'i sar brkos pas chus mi brel ba'i rwa 'thud pa'i thabs de bsheg/ nang nas mda' la yi ge bris te sna rnam (nam)pas brus zhes bya ba phyir 'phen/ de ltar zhang ma zhang chos la mi dga' ba la skyon phab pa'i las de grub pa dang / der rje blon tshogs pa'i dus su/zhang nya bzang gis snga ma bzhin gsol ba dang / lha sras kyis bka' stsal pa/zhang zer ba bden/ nga yang de ltar dgongs pas/ zhang blon dag gros bya'o//zhes bka' stsal pa dang / slad kyis rje blon mang po tshogs pa dang / rgyal po bka' stsol du bcug pa/ nga'i yab mes kyi lha chos mdzad pa zhang ma zham gyis bshig pa de pur ma legs/ zhang nya bzang yang 'di skad zer bas/ rgya'i lha yang slar spyan drangs/ nged rang kyang chos byar rung pas bya gsungs nas/chos bya bar gros 'cham nas/ da chos byed pa la mtha' nas 'ongs pa'i rgya gar dang bal po'i mkhan po las/ chos mkhas pa'i lo rgyus can su yod dam smra gos byed kyi ces gleng pas/ rje'i zhal nas/ ba lam klags na sba gsal snang yod/ de nga'i drung du bos zer bas/ pho nya btang te sba gsal snang bos nas spyan sngar mchis te/ rgyal pos zhang nya bzang zer ba'ang zhib tu gsungs nas/ rgya gar dang bal yul na chos mkhas pa su yod/ spyan drongs shig par bka' stsal ba las/ gsal snang gis gsol pa sngon ni rgya gar za hor yul na

98 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/mchis/ da lta ni bal yul na mchis te/ sngon za hor gyi rgyal po'i bu/ dge slong shān+ta rak+ṣi ta zhes bya ba gtsug lag la mkhas pa gcig mchis lags zhes gsol/ lha sras kyis bka' bstsal pa/ de mi dgug tu mi rung bas yul du ma 'gro bar bal yul du song la/ bal rje la khyod kyis nga'i phrin kyang bgyis la/nga yi sgrom bu yang byin la/ za hor gyi brnye de ci khugs su bsgrubs la/ cha khyer la shog gcig ces bka' stsal pa dang / thal byung du mang yul du mchis te/bka' sgrom yang bal rje la phul nas/ mkhan po bod yul du gshegs par gsol te zhus pas/ gnang ste slob dpon gyis bal po'i lo ts+tsha ba zhabs 'bring du khrid byon/ mang yul du spyan drangs nas/ pho brang du pho nya btang te mkhan po mchis par bgyis te/ mang yul na mkhan po mchis zhes gsol ba las/nang 'khor lang gro snang ra dang / snyer rtag btsan stong gzigs dang / sbrang rgyas legs gzigs dang gsum ma yul du bsur btang te/ khyed gsum gyi rims (rim)gro bgyis la/ lha sa dpe dkar du (den khang dpe dkar kyang zer )chags phob cig ces bka' stsal pa dang / bka' las byung pa bzhin/blon po de dag gis bsus nas/ zhabs 'bring byas te mchis nas/ mkhan po dang nang 'khor lang gro snang ba ni dpe dkar du bzhag nas/ btsan po'i zhal sngar phyag 'tshal du btsal bar ni da rung chos pa bzang ngan ci lags btol ma mchis nas/ ra sa dpe dkar du bzhugs su gsol te/ gsal snang ni pho brang du mchis te gnyer brkum pa dang / zhang blon chen po dag gis gsol pa/lho bal gyi brnye chos log pa dang ngan sngags 'phra men gyi bag bgyid dam mi bgyid/ dngas la rtogs su btang par gsol pa las/ mchims mes lhas kyang zer/ sbang legs gzigs dang / seng mgo lha lung gzigs dang / sba sang shi gsum btang pas brtag na a tsa ra'i skad ma go/ dar tshags sgo bseg gi tshong 'dus na/ kha che skyes bzang gi bu ā nan+da lo ts+tsha slob 'phro la chad

༄༅//sba gsal snang gi bzhed pa bzhugs/ 99pa byung nas tshong byed la lo ts+tsha bcol nas ā tsar+ya ci 'dra dris pas/ spyod pa legs so cog la mi bya ba med nyes so cog la ma btang pa med/ lhar dkon mchog gsum mchod/ gtso bor sems can la phan pa bya zer nas mchis/ de rje la gsol nas spyod pa rgya chen por 'chad/ thugs 'khrigs bzhes mi mtshal zhes pa'am/ yang na lugs gcig la/ ngan sngags 'phra men mi mthun pa'i phyogs ni mi bgyid/ khong rang gi lha sangs rgyas ni srog chags kun la phan pa bgyid zhig mkhan po dngos ni spyod lam bzang po nyes so cog dang / gzhan la gnod pa'i bag mi bgyid/ legs so cog dang srog chags kun la phan pa ni lhur bya dgos/ zhes zer te spyod pa bzang po brgya che bshad de/ thugs 'phrigs zhes pa'i bag ma mchis zhes gsol nas/ pho nya bas ā tsar+ya sgo nas bzhugs so zhes gsol nas pho brang du spyan drangs/ pho brang brag dmar du zhal sngar 'jal ba dang / nga la nye brtag go gsungs gser phye bre gang gi phyag rten byas te phyag 'tshal ba dang / mkhan po'i zhal nas bdag ngo mkhyen nam zhes gsungs/ btsan po'i zhal nas/ bdag gis de snga zhal ma 'jal ces gsungs/ mkhan po'i zhal nas/ sangs rgyas 'od bsrungs kyi bstan pa la btsug (gtsug)lag khang brgyan bsrung kyi byis pa gsum gyi tshe/ bye ma'i mchod brten byas te/ ngas parnyi ta bya ba/ khyod kyis thang (mtha')khob rgyal po bya ba/gsal snang gis bang chen byas nas nged gsum gyi thang 'khob rgyal khams su dam pa'i chos dar bar bya bar smon lam btab pa mnyel lam zhes gsungs pas/ btsan po'i zhal nas/ de mad/ sgom yun thung pas ma dran zhes gsungs/ ā tsar+yas la nye brtag pa ni/ rgyal pos/ ā tsar+yas la nye brtag lags bsam zhes zhus pas/ zhal nas brtag te/ rgyal po khyed kyi dbu la thod bcings pa dang sbyar na/ stod du mnga' ris zhwa tsam pa gcig 'chags 'bas la chags gsol ba dang sbyar na/ smad du mnga' ris lham tsam gcig

100 ༄༅//(sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/khrims 'chags/ sku la skye rags ma bcings pa dang sbyar na/ bar skabs 'dir rgyal po'i khrims myur du 'jigs nyen yod/ 'on kyang rin po che'i phyag rten phul bas/ dam pa'i chos byar btub gsungs/de nas pho brang rlung tshugs su kha che ā nan tas lo ts+tsha bgyis nas/ dge ba bcu dang / khams bco brgyad/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi chos la sogs pa'i chos bshad de/ zla ba bzhi (zla ba gnyis lon kyang zer)lon pa dang /'dre srin nag po la dga' ba kun ma dga' nas/ pho brang 'phang thang chus khyer/ lha sa dmar po ri la thog brgyab/ mi nad dang / lo nad byung pas/bod 'bangs tsam kha log nas btsan pos chos byas pas lan no// ā tsar+ya yang sgyugs shig ces zer nas/ dam pa'i chos bgyir ma gter(ster)/ ā tsar+ya sa khang steng na dar dkar gyi yol ba'i nang na bsgom byed pa la/ rgyal pos sba gsal snang dang / sba sangs shi dang / ('ba' sangs zer ba'ang 'dug) zhang nya bzang dang / seng mgo lha lung gzigs dang snyer stag btsan ldong gzigs dang lnga rgyal pos zhabs 'bring du khrid/ gser phye bre gang khyer nas/ mkhan po dar dkar gur nang na bsgom pa la gser phul/ phyag mdzad nas lan bdun bskor ba byas nas/ dpyang glag nas gser phye'i thum po mkhan po'i pang du bor te/ de lta bu nub gsum mdzad pa'i bar la/btsan po'i zhal nas/ bdag bskal ba chung ste bod kun nag po la zhen pa'i dus su skyes pas de las zlog pa rab tu dka'/ thabs mi mkhas na lha chos mi 'grub par 'gyur bar glo ba chung bas/ re shig mkhan po slar bzhud la bal yul du bzhugs shig slad nas zhang blon dag la chos mi bgyir mi rung bar dal bus thabs kyis brid de rngan pa byin nas/ btub ma thag tu spyan 'dren btang ngo zhes bka' bstsal nas/ ā tsar+yas bal rje dang 'khor la gser phye 'khyor gang bsnams nas/ gzhan ni slar rgyal po nyid la phul te/ mkhan po'i

༄༅//sba gsal snang gi bzhed pa bzhugs/ 101zhal nas/ sngar yab mes kyi sku ring la lha klu gdug pa can dam 'og du ma stsal bas bod khams gnod sbyin mthu bo che chos la mi dga' ba'i dbang du song bas/chos mdzad pa'i tshe/ gzigs ltas ngan pa byung ba dang / chos ma tshugs pa dang / rgyal po sku tshe thung ba yang 'di las gyur pas/ slad kyis dam chos mdzad na/ lha klu dam 'og tu stsal mdzad mtshal ste/ u rgyan gyi rgyal po'i sras dge slong / pad+ma sam+bha zhes bgyi ba/ dzam+bha'i gling na sngags mkhan 'di las mthu che ba mi bzhugs te/ bdag gis de spyan drangs la bod khams su chos 'byung ba lnga brgya'i tha ma la bab pas/ mu stegs kyi rgol ba ni mi mchi/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa nyid dam/ gzhan zhig 'gran zla gcig 'tshol ba byung na/ rdzu 'phrul ni/ pad+ma sam+bha wa dang 'gran/ gtan tshigs bdag dang shags su skye la mkhan pos/ 7pad+ma sam+bha was dam 'og tu bstsal na/ rgyal po'i dgongs pa yang 'grub/ sangs rgyas kyi chos kyang slad rjes brtan par 'gyur gsungs pas/ de bzhin rje 'bangs chad nas ā tsar+ya bskrad pa ltar byas te yar bzhud pa la/ seng mgo lha lung gzigs slan chad sha mi 'tshal ba'i sdom pa blangs te bsrung ba las/ phyis mar 'tshal ba'i sdom pa blangs te ā tsar+ya glang sna gru tshugs su bskyal/ de nas lang gro snang ba dang / gsal snang gnyis kyis mkhan po bal yul du bskyal/ de nas slar pho brang du log nas/ btsan pos sba gsal snang chos kyi spyan sar bkos (bskos)nas/ gsal snang rgya nag yul du pho nyar 'chi bar mchid kyis 'tshal te/ bla nas dgongs pa bzhin grub na dngul chen po bla thabs su bud ched po la bstsal bar brtsigs bcas nas chad byas so//slad nas btsan pos ni chos mdzad par zhang blon mtha' dag la thabs kyis bka' stsal bar rje 'bangs chad byas te/ pho nya'i kha dpon ni sbrang gtsang bzhed/ 'og dpon ni sba sangs shi ('ba' zer ba'ang 'dug)/ chos kyi

102 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/spyan pa ni sba gsal snang la sogs pa dpon g.yogs sum bcu 'chi bar chad nas/ de'i tshe rgya'i pho nya bum sangs dbang po'i drung na ju 'ag mkhas pa zhig nyin gcig bzhin du gtsug lag rtsigs pa zhig mchis pa des/ dbang po la gsol pa/ nub phyogs nas pho nya ba zhig de ring sang lam du zhugs te zla ba drug dang / zhag drug na bum sangs su phyin par mchis/ pho nya'i nang nas byang chub sems dpa' gnyis zhig mchi/ zhes gsol pa dang / cis shes dris pas/ nga'i ju zhag gi rtsis las byung ste/ de'i brtags dang sha tshugs 'di 'dra'o zer nas 'bag gnyis bris/ dbang pos kyang rgya rje'i spyan sngar pho nya btang te/ gtsug lag mkhan ji skad zer ba bzhin gsol ba dang / bka' lan las byang chub sems dpa'i sprul ba de gnyis 'bag bris la/ de dang mthun pa'i pho nya 'ongs pa dang / rim gro phud du bskyed la sdod du ma bzhugs par mar thong cig ces bka' bstsal pa dang / 'bag bris pa dang zla ba'i dus bzhin du pho nya bum sangs su phyin pa dang / spyan pa dang 'og dpon 'bag bris pa dang mthun nas/ dar gyi lding khang du bcug nas rim gro dang phud dud bskyed de shing rta la bskyon/ khad dpon dang pho nya phal ni rta la bskyon de geg shir phyin pa'i tshe/ pho nya ba rnams kyis rgya rje la phyag byas te/ pho nya gzhan slar log zer/ sngar byang chub sems dpa'i sprul par grags pa gnyis mchi bar grags pas ming yang dar khang zer/ shul thog thag du hwa shang dang / rgya 'bangs dad pa can sprin bzhin du 'dus te/ pho nya lding khang can gnyis la mchod pa cher bgyis nas keg shir bskyal/ rgya rjes kyang rig ngos dang / ka ba dang / nam mkha' kun gyis g.yogs te bkab nas/ bdug spos dang rol mos mchod rten/ ci dga' bar rang nyams su gnang / sba gsal snang khyed ni byang chub sems dpa' yin par nges/ sngar 'bag bris pa yang 'di yin/ hwa shang mngon shes can na re/ khyod ni byang chub sems

༄7//sba gsal snang gi bzhed pa bzhugs/ 103dpa' rta skad ces bya ba'i sprul pa yin no yang zer/ da yang spyan dang 'dra bar dar yug nyi khri bod kyi rgyal po la 'bul/ nga'i thusas su khyed las 'thad pa ma byung na/ khyod bya dga' ci 'dod pa sbyin no zhes bka' bstsal pa las/gsal snang gis gsol pa/ rje'i zhal mthong te glo ba dga'i steng du gzhan dang mi 'dra bar bka' lung snyan par gnang ba de bas bya dga' che ba ma mchis na/gzhan ci yang mi 'tshal te/ sgom lung 'bogs pa'i hwa shang gcig dang spyad par ci gnang zhes gsol pa dang / rgyal pos gnang chen nyung 'dus shig rgya rje'i go ru la bskyon nas btang bas/ chag cur phyin nas/ hwa shang bkug te mchis pa las/ de las bsgom lung dang man ngag mnos te bsgoms nas 'gro khar yang gsal snang la bya dga' yang rgya bye'u shog sung bya ba gcig dang /dar yug lnga brgya/ phra men gyi bya dang / phra men gyi gzhong pa sung brgya pa dang /mu tig sran ma tsam pa mdom gang pa phreng bcu/ za'u ga 'be'u sen tsam hwan yug gcig gzhan pas bya dga' che ba lhag par spags te bstsal nas/ bod kyi btsan po'i bka' sgrom dang bstun pa'i chad byas/ btsan po la bskyas su dar yug khri/ phra men gyi zhwa gcig bla gor gyi bder 'dom gang pa gcig bskur/ pho nya gzhan rnams la yang bya dga' che thang du gnang nas/ pho nya'i lan dang chas nas slar bod yul du mchis/ bod du yang btsan pos zhang blon dag la thabs kyis bka' gros mdzad nas/ spyir lha chos mdzad par ched(chang)/ bo lha satwa ni da rung spyan ma drangs par gda'/ sangs rgyas kyi chos mdzad par rje blon bka' gros ma thag tu/ gsal snang rgya yul nas bod du sleb te btsan po'i spyan sngar bskyes tsho phul nas phyag bgyis/ sug las grub bo ces gsol/ btsan pos bo lha satwa spyan drongs zhes bka' bstsal nas/gsal snang gis kyang bo lha satwa spyan 'dren du bal yul du mchis pa dang / bo lha satwas kyang pad+ma sam+bha wa dang / lha khang brtsig pa'i phya mkhan dang gsum

104 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/bal yul nas spyan drangs te bsdogs 'dug pas/ mkhan po gnyis ka gsal snangagi mang yul nas rdzings bcas nas chu klung las spyan drangs nas snye mo'i thod dkar du gshegs pa dang / pad+ma sam+bha wa'i zhal nas/ sang gi dro lam na nye tshe ba'i dmyal khams gcig yod kyis/ snying rje gcig bya dgos bka' bstsal pa dang / rdzings chu la bskur nas 'u yug du gtor ma dang dgongs pa mdzad pas chab 'jam tsam du gyur/ de nas gnam gyi chu khol du byon te/der snga dro gcig dgongs pa mdzad de gtong ma btang pas chu yang 'jam tsam du red de/ rlangs pa chad pa yang zhag gsum bgyis/ de nas gal te la yang zer/ gshe chu la la shul phyung nas gshegs pa dang / mkhan po'i zhal nas/bod khams su chos mdzad du mi gter ba'i klu dkar po phru gu (thang lha yin nam ze/) mi bsrun pa 1 yod pas/ de dam 'og tu bzhugs cing 'dul/ de'i drung na yang nye tshe ba'i dmyal ba gcig yod pas der snying rje gcig bya dgos gsungs nas snying drung du byon pa dang / klu tshangs pa bya ba'i mi gcig na re/mkhan po la gnod sbyin 'dul ba'i thabs lta/ zhes zhus pa dang / mkhan pos zangs khal tshan ma gcig phyung nas de'i nang du lung bong gi ro gcig btsos nas zangs la zhabs bsnun nas spub pas/ thang lha khros pas dgun zla 'bring po la thang lha'i gangs rtse la stug chom byung / sprin nag po gcig kyang chags nas ser ba bab/ klog dang 'brug sgra drag po gcig kyang byung pas/de tshun chad yul phyogs de dul te thab kyang son pas g.yung par gyur/ de nas de nyid du dgongs pa mdzad/ gtor ma btang pas snying drung gi chu khol/rlangs pa chad nas 'jam tsam du red pa zla ba gcig bgyis/ yang thang lha dam 'og tu bzhugs pa'i dgongs pa mdzad pa dang / thang lha'i gangs la sprin nag po gcig kyang chags/ klog dang / 'brug dang / ser ba bab pa dang mkhan po'i zhal nas/ klu phru gu mi bsrun rab gcig rgya mtshor bros pas/ de

༄༅//sba gsal snang gi bzhed pa bzhugs/ 105bzung la dam 'og tu bzhugs dgos ces gsungs nas/ yang zhag gsum dgongs pa mdzad pas/ gangs kyi stug chom yang ma mchis/ yul kyang 'jam par gyur/ klu yang dam la thogs/ thang lha bka' nyan du khas blangs/ slob dpon gyi 'khor thong yul du byon na zan drangs par byas/ la la le shor byon pas 'phan yul ngan rta ro dmar po kha phye ba 'dra bar nga mi 'gro gsungs nas stod lungs ya ral na yar byon/ btsun mo 'phrang gi brag a tsa ra ro rengs pa 'dra ba 'di'i gong ma bcad na mu stegs can gyi rigs bod du 'chor gsung nas bcad/ gzhong par tshong pa dro thob gsungs nas chu ma mchis pas chab dbyung bar bya gsungs nas bsog shang yu ba sa la tham tham rgyab pas chu rka bcu byung / de la bzhings pa'i lha chur grags/ de nas snye thang du nga'i dro ran 'dug gsungs dang / mkhar nag gi mtsho 'di la klu btsan drag po 'dug pas 'di 'bul lo gsungs/ 'di shin tu thu ba gcig 'dug la 'dul byed gcig bya gsungs nas brag la bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa'i sku cig bskyed/bal po rdo mkhan na re/ bod kyi rdo la gzo btub bam mi btub blta'o gsungs nas/ brag la sha ba'i gzugs gcig brkos so// de nas ngam shod la byon nas zur dkar 'phrang la rdo rje'i mchod rten lnga mdzad nas/ mkhan po pho brang du gshegs nas btsan po la brda sbyar nas btsan po la phyag bzhes pa la/ btsan po na re/ rab tu byung ba'i phyag mi thub gsungs nas/ slob dpon gyis pha bong la phyag mdzad pas bshags kyis gas/ btsan pos phyag phul bas slob dpon gyis snyun med pa mdzad/ chags gar phebs ces pa dang /sang shes de'i bar du ston pa rtsigs ces nas/ brag dmar 'gram bzang 'khor sa sgo ma mchis pa gcig rtsigs tsa na/ nang lha khang 'god dpyad de'u shan las dpe blangs pa gcig tshar lags pas der phyogs 'bebs par zhus/de dus ā tsar+ya bo dhi satwas btsan po la gsol pa/ sngon sangs rgyas 'jig

106 ༄༅//(sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/rten na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ lha ma srin dam 'og du ma chud pa ma mchis par rigs pa la/ bod yul na dam 'og du ma chud pa'i gdug pa can mang du mchis pas btsan po chos mdzad du ster ster mi 'dra bas/ da lta 'di na 'dzam bu gling na nus pa che ba'i pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes bya ba 'di spyan drangs nas bzhugs pas/ bod kyi btsan po srong btsan sgam po'i sku ring la dam pa'i chos mdzad du mi ster zhing lha rdzing dang / bam rdzings gdol (brdol) nas 'phang thang du chu bo che gtong ba dang / sham po'i gangs rnyil ba dang / bod khams su mi nad dang / rta nad dang / phyugs nad dang / mu ge chen po sngar 'bebs pa dang / dam pa'i lha chos mdzad pa'i lha'i mkhar du thog 'bebs shing mes gtong pa dang / btsan po mes dbon sku tshe thung zhing phyin ci log tu 'da' bar bgyid pa la sogs pa dang / bod khams su gzigs bltas ngan pa gtong zhing dam pa'i chos mdzad du mi ster ba'i bar chad bgyid pa'i 'khor gang lags pa rnams ri rab kyi ngos kyi rgyal po chen po bzhi mi la phab ste/ de'i than las byung ba bzhin dam la 'dogs pa'i cho ga ni sngags mkhan 'dis sngo thogs/ btsan po chos mdzad pa la/ rtsod cing rgol ba byung na phyir rgol gyi gtan tshigs smra ba ni kho bo las mkhas pa ma mchis/ gtsug lag khang brtsigs na ltas dang / bkra shis mi shis rtogs pa dang / chos tshugs mi tshugs rtogs pa'i phywa mkhan mkhas pa 'di tsam du gzhan na med pas khrid nas 'ongs pa yin zhes gsol ba dang / de ltar mdzad na dgos pa yang 'grub bo// ces gsungs pa dang / sangs shis zhus pa/ 'grim bzangs kyi mnga' gsol ba slob dpon pad+ma la zhu'o// zhes zhus pa dang / slob dpon chen po ni ma mchis/snang chen po dang / snang chen gzims mal ba kun mchis te/ slob dpon pad+mas lha mnga' gsol bas/ thams cad nang nas ston par byon/ nam phyed nablon po kun gyis mar me khyer nas bltas pas/ nang na 'jims gzugs

༄༅//sba gsal snang gi bzhed pa bzhugs/ 107gcig kyang med/ nang stong par 'dug nang bar bltar phyin tsa na 'jim gzugs thams cad snga ma kho na bzhin bzhugs nas slob dpon pad+ma mchod pa byed pa dang / lha rnams gtam gtong zhing rang bshos gsol ba mthong /ston par bltas pas gcig kyang mi 'dug mar me thams cad rang 'bar rol mo thams cad rang khrol/ spos thams cad 'bar zhing bsreg 'phan lnga btags pa lnga brgyar 'phel/ cong rang brdung zhing 'khrol/ rgun 'brum rdog po snyim pa tsam pa de sus kyang 'tshal bar rngo ma thogs/ de'i nang par dkyil 'khor bris nas gzim mal ba lha lung 'tsho zher snyan legs pa pra bstan byas te/pra se na pa ta phab nas smrar bstsal bas/ bod kyi glu mi bsrun pa ril gyi ming smras te/ 'phang thang du chu phab pa sham po/ lha sar thog phab pa thang lha/ mu ge dang / lo nyes dang / mi ngan gtong ba bstan ma bcu gnyis la sogs pa kun smras/ de'i sang cho ris bzang po'i bu tsha pha ma dang / mes phyi tshang ba bcu tsam bsags te pra bstan bgyis nas/ rgyal po chen po bzhi'i pra phab nas/gnod sbyin me lha khal mngon sum du bstan/ lha klu ma rung pa dngos su mi la phab nas/ bsdigs shing gzir ba ni pad+ma sam+bha was mdzad/ dkar po la chos bshad nas dam la 'dogs pa ni bo lha satwas mdzad/ des ma thul ba pad+mas sbyin bsregs mdzad nas ma mchis par byas/ de 'dra ba lan gnyis bgyis te/slob dpon pad+ma'i zhal nas/ lha klu dam 'og tu chud lags te/ da dung de 'dra ba lan gcig bgyi 'tshal/ slan chad lha chos ci bder mdzad pa dang /gtsug lag khang dgongs pa bzhin du brtsigs shig gsungs nas/ zur phud klung rgyu 'tshal tu klu btul bas gzi can dngos su byung nas/ sa'i steng na rgyal po khri srong lde btsan che/ sa'i 'og na rgyal po nga che/ nged cag grogs po byas la rgyal po lha khang byed pa'i gser dre'u khal bcu bzhi ngas sbyin gcigagaser khung glang po snar blon po kun len du thong zer nas dam la brtags/

108 ༄7//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/sham po btul bas slob dpon gyi thog tu chu phab/ slob dpon gyis sbas san sna rdo rje gdengs nas chu gyen la bzlog yar lha rdzing bem rdzing du brtags/rdo rje rgyab pas chu khol bas sham po khong rang gangs zhu ba'i rtse la bsdad nas slob dpon nga la de tsam pa 'tho mtshams pa zer/ slob dpon gyis zhal nas khyed nga la 'tho mtshams pa/ da nga'i dam 'og tu mi bzhugs na khyod bsreg go gsungs pas/ nga nag po'i rigs yin/ chos bgyi ba'i skabs ma mchis da man chad gnod pa mi bya'o// nga'i drung du ser chags ma btang gcig zer nas dam la brtags/ de nas da sbyin bsregs gcig bgyi'o zhes gsungs pa dang / de nas btsan po dbu 'khru bar bzhed nas/ mkhan po bo rnyi satwas gsan zhing mkhyen nas/ bod kyi btsan po dbu bsil zer na chu gang las len/zhes gsungs pa dang / bzhes bzlas 'om bu tshal nas len zhes gsol pa dang / mkhan po'i zhal nas/ ri rab kyi byang ngos na chu mig rta sna bya ba yod/de nas chu blangs te dbu bsil na sku tshe yang ring / lha sras rigs brgyud yang 'phel/ chab srid kyang che bar 'gyur/ dgos dgu yang 'grub par 'gyur/chab de sus len nus zhes gsungs pa/ rgyal po'i snyan du gsan nas bzhes pa'i sa slob dpon pad+ma'i zhal nas de ngas rngo thogs gsungs nas/ ga sha'i 'og nas bkra shes kyi bum pa gser las byas pa gcig kha dar dkar gyis bcad nas bzhes slas kyi rgya btab nas/ mkhan pos sngags kyis btab te nam mkha' la 'phangs pa dang / rje mtho je mtho la song nas slob dpon gyi 'dzab khung der rma bya'i sgros byabs pa dang / zan gcig bza' yun lhag tsam na/ bum ser rgyang nge slob dpon gyi pang du byon/ kha phye de bltas tsa na/ nang na chu 'o ma 'dra ba skya nar ba gcig byung nas des dbu khrus zhes blon po kun la gtad nas dbu bshal bar bgyis nas mdun sar brims pas/ mdun sa chung ngu nas lung gsal ba 'di mon gyi smyo chu yin te/ sku'i rim gro la mi sman

༄༅//sba gsal snang gi bzhed pa bzhugs/ 109pas pho la thong zer nas ma mchis par bgyis te btang / gzhan yang bod byin bskyid par bgyi bas/ be+e shra ma na las nor blangs te/ nor med pa la nor sbyin/ 'dzam bu gling gi da skor khung srid do cog kyang bod khams su byung /u rgyan pad+ma'i zhal nas/ bod skyid phyug par bya/ ngam shod stod smad/ grwa dang dol stag la phul po la sogs pa chu dkon pa dang / chu chung pa rnams su chu phyung la/ gram pa thams cad zhing byas la/ zhing gis bod kun 'tsho bar byas/gtsang po dang mtsho kun sgrom du bcug la mchong du rung bar byas/ ngas u rgyan du chab 'di bas che ba gcig sbubs su bcug zhes kyang gsungs/ ngam shod kyi bye ma dang / gram pa thams cad tshal dang brgyar/ bod yul ngan pa kun bzang por byas nas/ yul thams cad nyams dga' bar bya ba la sogs pa bya'o zhes/ mkhan pos de ltar rgya chen por gsungs pa dang / de ltar 'grub bam mi 'grub mdun sa chung ngu nas rje blon mol te bka' gros mdzad nas de ltar 'ong mi 'ong nyams sad pa las/ mkhan pos snga khro (dro)gcig bsgoms pas mtsho mo mgur gyi zhabs nar sngo phyur la btang / de'i phyi dro brag dmar zla ba tshal gyi smad nags su btang / klu rdzings su chu byung / da rung song dang ces pas snga dro gcig bsgoms pas zung mkhar chu rjen nar bsgyur te chu mig byung ba dang / 'ong nges par 'dug pas/ blon po dag na re/ bod yul bzang por byas pa'i sngags mkhan gyi mthu dang sbyar na rgyal srid rgya gar gyis phrogs te 'gro/ zhes mdun sa chung ngur gros byas nas 'phro dgum par chen slob dpon gyis zhal nas/ da zhing bya'o gsungs pas/ zhing yar klungs gis chog zer nas sngags mkhan la phyag byas te bya dga' chen po phul nas slar rgya gar du bzhud par zhu ba phul bas/ rgyal po ma dgyes nas/ slob dpon la gser phye bre gang phul/ bskor ba byas/ sngar ltar zhus pas/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas/ nga gser 'dod pa ma yin te/ bod mtha' khob du 'dre srin

110 ༄7//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/gdugs pa can btul la btsan po chos byar btub par bya/ bod yul bzang por byas la/ 'bangs bde ba la dgod pa'i phyir 'ongs na/ gser 'dod na 'di tsug byas pas chog gsung nas/ mkhan pos rdo dang / shing dang / rtswa dang / bye ma la sogs pa phyag gis bzung tshad reg tshad gser phyer re red/btsan po'i thugs bsrung pa'i ched du gser phye khyor gang zhig bsnams/ lhag ma rnams slar btsan po rang la phul nas/ mkhan po slar gshegs khar/ brag dmar 'om bu tshal du btsan po rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa 1 la man ngag lta ba'i phreng ba bshad nas/ rgyal po chen po'i nga'i gsang sngags 'di lta ba chos kyi sku dang bstun la/ spyod pa byang chub kyi phyogs dang bstun/ lta ba'i phyogs su spyod pa ma shor bar mdzod/ shor na dge med sdig med du song chad pa lta ba skyes nas phyis gsor mi rung / spyod pa'i rjes su lta ba 'brengs na dngos po'i mtshan mas bcings nas grol bar mi 'gyur/ nga'i sngags sems phyogs 'di lta ba shas che ste/ ma 'ongs pa na tshig gi gdeng ni shes/ rgyud la khel ba'i lta ba'i gdeng ni ma rnyed nas mang po zhig ngan song du 'gro bar 'gyur ro// lta spyod ya ba ma bral ba'i 'dra men 'gas sems can mang po'i don kyang byed par 'gyur te gang zag gis bcos te 'dra men mangs pas byin rlabs nyams pas rtogs pa can nyung ma bslad pa 'di kun sbas na nam zhig las can 'ga' zhig gi don du 'gyur gsungs nas dpe mang po zhig rdza la sbas so//btsan po la dbang ril mdzad nas theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi lung gnang / phur bu 'bum sde bshad nas man ngag gzhan smon lam 'og min gyi gnas su btab/ bdag dang gtan sa med pa'i sbyin bdag rnams dang / tshe rabs 'di dang tshe rgyud gar skyes kyang / 'og min zhes pa'i gnas mchog dam pa rgyud(ru)/ rnal 'byor theg chen 'bras bu spyod par smon/ zhes gsungs nas/ sbyin bsregs gi 'phro ma grub par slar yang gshegs/ bskyel mis

༄༅//sba gsal snang gi bzhed pa bzhugs/ 111chibs khrid nas yar la spyan drangs nas/ mkhan po rgya gar yul du skyel mi btang pa dang / blon po kha cig na re/ sngags mkhan de ma bsad na de nus pa che ste/ bod la byad byas par 'ong bas mdun sa nas bced bsod mi bcwa brgyad gu ru la skyon te btang zer/ deng 'phangs kyi 'phreng du dgugs pa dang / slob dpon dpon g.yogs mang yul du sleb te byon pa'i dgongs mo slob dpon gyi zhal nas sangs ni 'o cag la gnod pa byed pa dang 'tshe ba byed pa gcig 'ong ngo zhes skyel ma rnams la gsungs/ de nas deng 'phangs kyi 'phrang du byon pa dang / rtag snar bsod mi bco brgyad po rnams kyis la las mda' bkang / la las gri byung / la las mdung mnan te slob dpon la brdeg par gzas pa'i tshe/ slob dpon gyis phyag rgya bcings pas mi bcwa brgyad pos smra yang ma shes/ mda' 'gengs pa bas 'gro yang ma nus te/'jim gzugs sam gyang la bris pa bzhin du 'dug ste/ 'phen ma shes par rengs pa'i nang nas gshegs ste/ de nas mang yul gyi mkhar byon nas skyel ma kun brdzangs te bkye ba las/ mkhan po'i zhal nas/ bod khams su lha klu dang 'dre srin dam 'og tu lan gsum bcug na btsan po yang sku tshe ring /dbon sras kyang chab srid che/ sangs rgyas kyi chos kyang yun ring du gnas pa zhig na 'phro lus pa yid la bcags so gsungs/ chos 'khor gcig ni 'byongs nas 'ongs te/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi chos gar byung bar mu stegs gyi 'gran zla re byung nas rtsod pa byed dgos pa las/ bod khams su chos 'byung ba lnga brgya'i tha ma la bab pa las chos ma byung / mu stegs la sogs pa'i rgol ba ni mi 'byung na/ sangs rgyas pa nyid nang rtsod pa nyid du 'gyur zhes gsungs nasaskyel mi mar la zlog da re zhig nga la mi yul na gdul bya med gsungs nas lho nub 'tshams su srin po 'dul du 'gro gsungs te chibs kha nas 'phur te/ sprin gyi bseb na phar chos gos spu re bseg shang khrel bzhud do// de nas

112 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/skyel mis gsungs pa bzhin du deng 'phangs kyi bsad mi 'bag bris pa bzhin song ba rnams la nyung kur btab pa dang / snga ma bzhin du 'gro nus pa dang /smra shes par gyur to// skyel mi rnams slar pho brang du phyin nas sngags mkhan ji skad gsungs pa'i lo rgyus btsan po snyan du gsol pa dang / btsan po yang thugs la rab tu bcags par gyur te/ de nas chos kyi mdun sa ni brag dmar mtsho mo mgur du phub/ gsal snang ni gnam phyi ba g.yas kyi tshugs dpon chos kyi blar bkos (bskos) nas/ dur der bon po dang blon po rnams kha log ste chos mi byed/ bon bya'o zer bas/ bo lha satwa'i zhal nas/rgyal khams gcig tu chos lugs gnyis byung na shin tu sdig che/ 'o cag brtsod pa byas la khyed rgyal na nga yang 'gro/ bon spel/ chos rgyal na bon bsnubs la/dam pa'i lha chos bya gsung / slad kyi chos dang bon 'gran par chad nas de la dpang po med/ de nas phag gi lo la pho brang zur phud skyang bu tshal na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ chos kyi kha 'dzin zhang nya bzang dang / gnyer rtag btsan ldong gzigs dang / seng mgo lha lung gzigs dang / nyang sho ma dang bzhi po de bo lha satwa'i kha 'dzin dang bshags 'debs su/ bon gyi kha 'dzin ngam stag ra klu gong dang rtsis pa chen po dang / khyung po dum tshugs dang / khyung po rtse ba dang /tshe mi dang / lcog la smon lam 'bar la sogs pa bkos te brtsod pa las/bonakhung ngan la gtan tshigs chung / lha chos khung bzang la rgya che/ zab la gting ring shags bzang la rno te ma thub na/ 'phan yul gyi byi bon pos bdur ba'i bshin khugs pa thams cad kyang bse rags su gyur pas/ phyin chad bon bgyid du mi gnang par chad do// gshin gyi phyir gnag rta dang /srog chags bsod (gsod)pa la sogs pa srog gcod shing sha 'bebs su mi gnang par chad do// rje'i sku'i rim gro dang / bar chad sel ba la 'dre srin la dus bon re byed na tshe mi dang zhang zhung ma gtogs pa gzhan bgyid du mi

༄༅//sba gsal snang gi bzhed pa bzhugs/ 113gnang par bcad/ bon gyi dpe kun chu la bskyur/ lhag ma phyis mchod rten nag por mnan no// de nas slan chad chos bya ba dang / lha khang gcig rtsig par chad pa dang / blon po chen po mgos khri bzangs yab lhag bshums pa la/btsan pos bka' bstsal pa dang / khyod lha chos bya zhing lha khang brtsig par mi dga'am/ zhes bka' bstsal pa dang / blon po chen po khri bzang gis gsol pa/ lha chos ni bzang na da chos byar yod tsa na yab lhag rgas btugs pas nyams su mi lon te/ glo ba bcags lags mod/ rje lha gcig dam chos de yang gting re zab/ mon bu de yang smra re mkhas/ zhes gsol pa dang / 'o na blon chen po 'or che gsungs nas sha la gyes so// de nas shākya mu ne slar mang yul nas spyan drangs par byas te/ rta pa gcig gi pang du blangs nas spyan drangs te ra mo cher bzhugs so// de nas yos bu'i lo yi dpyid bsam yas kyi rmangs 'dings par chad tsa na/ gsal snang gis bla'i gtsug lag khang ma brtsigs par klags kyi lha khang bzhengs su gsol/ sba pha tshan bon bgyid du mi gnang chos la dkod/ sba lha gzigs kyi grogs po nyang ro kong gis dge ba'i bshes gnyen byas nas chos bslabs/ dge bsnyen gyi khrims lnga phog nyang ro kong gis pha tshan pho nu'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen byas nas nyang ril dkar por bsgyur/ de nas yos bu'i lo de nyid la bsam yas brtsig par chad pa de bla bon lha khang rtsigs par bka' bsgros pa las/ blon po 'gos khri bzang yab lhag gi mchid nas/ rje gcig lags/ thabs kyis ma mdzad na bod 'bangs kha log nas dam pa'i chos bgyir mi btub/ thugs dam bzhengs pa'ang mi 'grub pas 'dem kha bor ba sogs pa bgyi/ gor ma chags ces mchi babs ji ltar bya bar mol bas/ rje'i bka' gnyan pas bka' khrims dang bka' nan drag tu bka' bstsal bar lkog du chad nas bod 'bangs kun 'tshogs te 'dus pa la rjes bka' bstsal pa 'dzam bu'i gling na bod kyi rgyal po mi che/

114 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/bod kyi rgyal po la nga bas mi che ba ni sngar ma byung na/ nga la phyag ris med pas/nga dang phyag ris gcig byed pas/ khyed bod 'bangs 'dzangs pa rnams gleng ba/ ces gsungs pa la/ blon khri bzang na re/ rje'i bka' bstsal ni bdud pas gnyan/ khrims kyi lar rtse ni dgungs pas mtho/ phyag rjes gang mdzad pa bka' lung zhu'o zhes gsol pa dang / lkog tu gros mdzad pa bzhin/ rje'i zhal nas/ nga mkhar po zhang po brgya'i yul mthong ba gcig rtsig gam/ yang na shel gyi mchod rten shangs ri tsam pa gcig rtsig gam/ yang na wa lung grog po gser phyes 'gang ngam/ ya na hal po ri bzangs kyi btums la gzer mgo thams cad nang du bstan pa gcig bya'am/ yang na gtsang po zangs ma'i sbubs su bzhug cing mchod du rung par bya'am/ yang na ka chu thang la khron pa 'dom dgu brgya dang dgu bcu rtsa gcig 'bru'am/ yang na lha khang bre tsam pa gcig rtsig gam/ de rnams gang byed 'dems cig ces bka' bstsal/rje'i bka' lung che la sgrub dka' bas 'dam ga gang yang khas len ma phod de/'bangs kun bred pa dang / zhang nya bzangs na re/ rje gcig lags/mkhar po de tsam pa 'phras na 'jigs/ ches na mi 'byongs/ shel rin po che dka' bas sa'i mchod rten de tsam sa yang mi 'byongs/ wa lung grog po gser phye bas phye mas kyang mi khengs/ has po ri gzar gog tshun chad zangs su song kyang mi thums/ gtsang po rgun sbubs su tshud kyang dbyar chus 'khyer/ khron pa 'dom gang byas kyang chu rdol te 'ong bas shur mi thub/ lha khang bre zhabs tsam pa gcig bya/ de las 'os cang gda' 'am/ zhes zer bas/ bod 'bangs kun gros 'chams nas de la bor che btab/ de la blon rtag ra klu gong chos la gnag pas/ spa lcag sa la brdabs nas lha khang rtsig pa de chos yin pas nga mi dga'/ nged rang dbon (bon)bya zer ba dang / rje'i zhal nas nga'i bka' bcog pa rtag ra klu gong byang du sprugs cig ces gsungs pas/ 'bangs

༄7//sba gsal snang gi bzhed pa bzhugs/ 115thob mi /nyis kyis rtswa thag gis btags te tsher lcag gis brab cing byang du sprugs de la// kun bred nas cang mi zer/ de nas lha khang gi sa brtag pa la/btsan po dang mkhan po dang / gsal snang dang / gnyer ldong gzigs rnams thugs dam brag dmar bsam yas bzhengs par mol nas/ de bzhis has po ri'i rtse mo la phyin nas bltas pa las/ de tsam na bsam yas kyi gzhi de skyi ba tho re ba dang / sgong phung lcem me dang / skyang gal ma tho re dang / rtsi skyang can dang / 'jag skya chad de mchis pa las/ gong bcad de/ slob dpon gyis sa dpyad mdzad pa ni/ shangs ri rgyal po gdan la bzhugs pa 'dra ste bzang /has po ri btsun mo dar dkar gyi gos bzung gsol ba 'dra ste bzang / ri nag lcags phur btab pa 'dra ste bzang / me yar dre rta chu 'thung ba 'dra te bzang / dol thang dar gyi yol ba 'dra ste bzang / sa gzhi 'di mkhar gzhong gur gum gyis bkang pa 'dra ste bzang / thugs dam 'dir bzhengs na bzang bya bar bstan/ phyag mkhar gyis phyag bris mdzad/ snyad chibs bres kyi ra ba gcig rtsig ces snyad btags nas/ rtswa'i spyi bo bsdus te 'dud/ mtho yor bzhin du bskor nas phyi rang sngon la brtsigs/ de ltar sa brtag pa'i cho ga bgyis/ de nas sa chog byas te/ ya rabs zhang blon gyi bu tsha pha mes phyi tshang ba bzhi btsan po dang lnga las/ btsan po ni gser gyi nan ti gsol/ gser gyi 'jor phyag du bsnams/ bu tsha rnams rgyan gyis brgyan te rin po che'i snod du sbog sngon gsal nas kha rgyags smra zhing thig then/ btsan pos thebs gsum brkos/ bu tsha bzhis re mos brkos/ khru gang khru bzhi phyin pa dang / 'bras dkar mo dang nas dkar mo phul do tsam ma 'dres par 'dug gram pa dang /gyo mo dang / rus pa dang / sol ba lta bu ni ma byung / sa zhag skya nar mo gcig byung nas 'jor bzhag de la mkhan po bo ji satwa rab tu dgyes te/ btsan

116 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/po'i dbu la phyugs nas/ pha la pha la si ti si ti/ gsungs pas de btsan pos mgo nas/ lo ts+tsha ba la ā tsar+ya ci zer gsungs/ lo ts+tsha ba na re/ bzang po bzang po/ grub bo grub bo// zhes gsungs zer/ gzhan yang bgegs man+da dgos zhes kyang gsungs nas/ mchod rten bzhi'i bla phur btab/ de nas rgyal pos slob dpon la lha khang gi rmangs 'ding sar zhus pas slob dpon gyi zhal nas/ rgyal po khyod byang chub du thugs bskyed pa yang jo mo sgrol ma yin/tha ma sangs rgyas tsa na yang rdo rje gdan du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gsol ba 'debs pa yang jo mos byed pa yin/ da lta rgyal po thugs dam bzhengs pa'i bar chad sel ba yang jo mos mdzad pa yin pas/ sngon la jo mo'i bsgrub khang brtsigs cig par lung phog rgyal pos kyang thog mar lho ngos su a tsar+ya pā lo'i gling brtsigs te thog pheb legs pa dang / slob dpon khang pa legs te gzugs mkhan med ces btsan pos bka' bstsal pa las/ mkhan po'i zhal nas yo byad bsogs gcig/ gzugs (gzigs) mkhan 'ong gis zhes gsung / de nang nyen khang dpe dkar na tshugs rgya mtshal bu can yang zer/rgya mtshal na mkhan kyang zer ba gcig tshon rtsi'i kong bu kong rtse gang khur/pir chags pa gang thogs te/ 'jim gzugs dang ri mo byed pa la 'dzam bu'i gling na nga mkhas te/ bod kyi rgyal po lha khang rtsigs zer na ngas ni gzugs shes/ zer bar bkug nas/ lha bzo na re/ lha rgya gar dang rgya'i gzugs gang bgyi zhes gsung der 'tshogs te gros bgyis pas/ mkhan po'i zhal nas/sangs rgyas rgya gar du byon pa yin pas rgya gar lugs su bgyis gsung /btsan po'i zhal nas/ bod kyi lugs su bgyis na bod nag po la zhen pa rnams dad bskyer re ba lags pas/ lha bod lugs su bya bar ci gnang zhes slob dpon la zhus pas/ 'o na bod 'bangs kun bsdus shig bod kyi lugs su bya'o gsung / bod kyi lugs su bgyid pa'i dpe bod 'bangs kun tshogs pa

༄༅//sba gsal snang gi bzhed pa bzhugs/ 117las nang na gzugs bzang pa kha stag tshas la byas te/ gtso bo la ār+ya pā lor khar sa pā ṇi bzhengs/ rma sa kong la dpe byas te ar+ya pā lor rta mgrin sgo srungasabyas/ thang bzang stag lod la dpe byas te ār+ya pā lo'i sprul pa yi ge drug pa g.yas su byas/ lha mo'i bu med la mdzes pa lcog ro bza' lha tha sman la bgyis te sgrol ma g.yas su byas/ lcog ro bza' nu chung la dpe byas te lha mo 'od zer can g.yon du byas/ kun tshar lags nas rgyal po yo byad sta gon mdzad de/ gral nyi shu dgu'i gdugs la zhal sros zhu ba'i tshe/ slob dpon gyis mchod pa bsham du gsol te/ nam bsros pa dang / lha khang steng ar+ya pa lo'i steng nas 'od nyi ma shar ba tsam gcig je che je che byung nas brag dmar phu mda' zla ba shar ba bzhin 'od kyis khyab par snang / de'i rgyu ci yin zhus pa dang / mkhan po'i zhal nas 'od de ā mi ta bhā was bod la dgongs pa'i ā mi ta bhā wa'i 'od yin pas/ sang nyin du lha khang gi dbus kyi stengs su ā mi ta bhā wa'i lha khang yang thog gcig brtsigs dgos gsungs nas de bzhin du lha khang yang thog gcig mdo la rtsigs nas lo ā lā mi ta bhā wa gtso 'khor lnga bzhengs/zhal sros/ ar+ya pā lo'i zhal sngos chen po'i tshe/ gzugs mkhan rgya mtshal bu la bya dga' stsal bar bgyis te/ gab tshe yang dar las byas pa gnyis gting ba las/ lha bzo ba gar song gtol ma mchis te sprul pa yin pa blta zhes so//yang mkhan po'i zhal nas/ btsan po khyed dang po byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i dge ba'i bshes bsnyen lha mo sgrol mas byas/ da yang sangs rgyas nas rdo rje gdan la bzhugs pa'i tshe yang chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba yang lha mosakhyed par 'gyur/ da yang bgegs dang bar chad mi 'byung pa yang sgrol mas byed pas/ sgrol ma de la gsol ba thob la bsnyen pa bgyis gcig gsungs nas/ slob dpon las lung mnos nas ār+ya pa lo'i gling du bsgom pas 'phags pa rta mgrin gyis rta skad nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum phyung bas/

118 ༄༅//〈sba bzheng 〉phyogs bsgrigs/rtse rgod rnams kyis thos bred nas/ zhabs 'bring nang pa dang / lha khang bsrungs ma gnyer len kun gyis thos/ de ci yin dris pa dang / slob dpon na re/ rgyal pos grub pa mnyes pas rta mgrin gyis rta skad lan gsum ston pa de 'dzam bu gling sum gnyis kyi thos te rgyal po'i chab srid mnga' ris kyang de tsam du gsung / de nas yos bu'i lo la btsan po lo bcu gsum lon pa dang /dbu rtse'i rmangs 'ding bar zhus pas ā tsar+ya na re dpal brag dmar bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub/ 'dzam bu'i gling na byin brlabs che ba gcig byed pas/ mdo sde/ 'dul ba/ mngon pa ste/ mtshan nyid kyi sde snod thams cad dang / gsang sngags rgyud sde thams cad mthun zhing mi 'gal ba 'gran gyi do med pa gcig bgyi mtshal gsungs/ ā tsar+yas de lta bu mkhyen tam zhus pas/ngas shes te/ de lta bu gcig o taṇ+ḍa pu ri na'ang yod gsungs/ de ci 'dra zhus pas/ de ni mu stegs rig 'dzin gyi sgrub pa pos ro sgrub byed pa la/dngos grub len pa'i sgrub g.yog mtshan rtags dang ldan pa kun tu btsal bas ma brnyed pa la/ ma ga ta'i dge slong sgrub pa po la nye gnas gcig yod pa de de'i mtshan brtags dang ldan nas/ sgrub pa po dge slong la maṇ+ḍal gser gyi nye'u bkram pa yang dang yang du phul bas/ khyod nga la gdams ngag 'dod dam/rig 'dzin gyis smras pa/ nga khyod kyi nye gnas dpa' ba'i brtags can zhu'o//des de la phul la/ de nas bsgrub khang du phyin pa dang / ro sog phon tsam pa gcig dkyil 'khor steng na 'dug go// de la dge tshul ro la dpa' ba'i brtags yod pas ma 'jigs par de'i lce chod gcig lce de gser gyi ral grir song ba dang nga la byin gcig de gar gtad par 'gro bar nus pa yin te/ nga 'og min du rig 'dzin sgrub du 'gro ba yin/ ro 'di gser du 'gyur bas de khyod la rngan pa sbyin no zer/ der des mnyam par bzhag go// dge tshul ro la zhen nas gris lce gcod du bcug pa dang / ro 'gul zhing mig

༄༅//sba gsal snang gi bzhed pa bzhugs/ 119'khrul/ kha btab btab byed pa dang / lce dar sham tsam gcig nyug byung ba la ma zin no// lan gnyis su ma zin pa dang / da res lce ma chod na dang por nged rang gnyis gsod/ de nas stong gsum srid pa gsum gyi sems can gsod du 'ong bas bsgrims la chod cig zer ro// des ro dang kha sprad de bsgrims pa dang / sos lce zin nas bcad pas ral grir gyur nas nam mkha' la dbyugs pas nam mkha' la dge tshul 'phur ba la/ rig 'dzin na re/khyed nang pa sangs rgyas pa la pham pa 'ong ba yin pa la/ ral gri ni nga dbang na mar la shog cig zer ba la/ de lta yin mod/ ngas bltas mo lta yis zer nas ri rab kyi khar song nas/ gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla gza' skar dang bcas pa dang / lcog bzhi sum bcu rtsa sum bkod pa dang bcas pa ltas pas legs par mthong / de nas mar 'dzam bu'i gling ngogs su ral gri dbyugs pas rig 'dzin gyi drung du byung nas/ ro las gser du grub pa dge tshul khyod gyis shiga'adis dge slong lnga brgya'i mtsho('tsho) ba ldang ste/ rus pa la ma bcad gcig bcad na log 'tshor 'gyur te phyis mi skye'o// gzhan du na nang bcad kyang nub mo skye'o// de skad zer te khong rang ral gri nam mkha' la dbyugs te 'og min du song ngo // dge tshul des slob dpon dge slong de la smras pas/ zhal nas/ 'o cag dge slong lnga brgya'i bzhugs sa gtsug lag khang gcig byed dgos pas/ mgon po la sa gzhi zhu ba'i gtor ma bya'o zer nas/ bha bim byas pas bya rog gis khyer nas mtsho gcig gi dkyil na de'u yod pa'i khar bzhag go// de'u de'i khar gtsug lag khang gcig brtsigs te ri rab gling bzhi gling phran dang bcas pa nyi ma dang zla ba dang bcas pa la dpe byas nas bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag khang pas o taṇ+ḍa pu ri bya ba yod/ rgyal po chen po'i thugs dam gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i dpe yang de la byas na 'gran gyi do med pa sde snod gsum dang sngags rgyud sde thams cad nga mi 'gal zhing nga byin

120 ༄7//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/rlabs yang shin tu che ba gcig yod yong mchi bas de la dpe bya'o gsung / de nas gdod bal yul nas gzugs mkhan dang phywa mkhan bkug ste/ sa brtag pa'i cho ga sngar bgyis pa las yang lan cig byas pa'i tshe/ gong gi tsho (mtsho)la shar ri has po ri nas pha bong drangs te/ bzhis dbu rtse'i rmang bting / sa yar klung du gdangs thog nas blangs/ shing shug pa dang / tsan+ta ma byas te brtsigs nas/ khang pa ni tshar lags/ sku gzugs ji lta bu gcig bgyi dgongs pa las/ btsan pos mnal ba'i rmi lam du mi dkar po zhig na re/rgyal po khyod sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs ci la bya bar sems zer/ slob dpon la dri byas pas/ mi dkar po de na re/ sa gzhi 'di jo mo sgrol mas byin gyis brlabs pa yin/ tā re dngos kyis zhabs kyis bcags pa yin/ has po ri'i rtse mo na shākya thub pa gtso 'khor bcu gsum sngon bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis byin gyis brlabs pa yod kyis de spyan drongs la gyis zer/ de gang na yod ston dang byas pas/ ba dmar 'bus 'debs pa'i sa nang yod zer/ 'dong zhes khrid de has po rir phyin pa dang / brag kun la bltar bcug nas/ 'di ni sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 'di dang 'di zhes kun gyi mtshan yang smos nas lha bcu dgu 'dug khro mo dang kun bstan te/ rgyal po dgyes ches nas lde lde byas pas/ mnal sad de rmi lam du red nas/ nam langs ma thog du blon po gnon khams sa khrid de rmi lam du bstan pa'i sa der gshegs nas gzigs pa dang ci yang med/ 'di na 'dug pa yin pa la byas te btsan posakhye ma la zhabs sug sug byas te/ lde gu bya mchu tsam gcig 'dug de bsal bas rdo sku byung / the'u'i rjes med pa gtsug tor nag po ldem me ba/spyan khra hrig ge ba'i byang chub chen mo gcig gda'/ rmi lam du byung ba dang mthun par brag la 'ol ji tsam gda' nas/ dgyes ches nas bal po bzo mkhan 'gugs su btang nas/ mchis ma thag du sku gzugs kun de nyid du

༄༅//sba gsal snang gi bzhed pa bzhugs/ 121bgyis nas shing rta la bzhag pa'i tshe sa lan gcig g.yos/ shar sgo'i them khar phyin pa'i tshe lan gcig g.yos/ dri'i gtsang khang gi nang du phyin pa'i tshe sa lan gcig g.yos/ de nas khri la bzhugs pa dang btsan po dgyes te/ madhe dang gser ga gsol/ na bza' gsol nas btsan po nyid kyi gser gyi sku regs shākya thub pa'i sku la bcings so// bcings pa'i stengs su 'jims pas g.yogs/ phywa mkhan na re/ btsan po'i khang pa dang sbyar na lha chung zer nas 'jag ma dkris/ de la ras g.yogs nas 'dags pa byugs/ de la gser gyis gyim 'bag lan bdun gsol nas bzhag rgyu rdo la byas/ bzo ni bod lugs su byas/ lho ngos kyi g.yas gral na byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po dang / byams pa dang / spyan ras gzigs dang / sa'i snying po dang /dga' ba'i dpal dang / khro mo khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba dang drug go//byang ngos g.yon gral na byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po dang / phyag na rdo rje dang / 'jam dpal dang / sgrib pa rnam sel dang / dge bsnyen chen po dri ma med par grags pa dang / khro mo mi g.yo ba dmar po dang gtso 'khor bcu gsum/ gsang 'dus la 'grel pa brgya rtsa brgyad yod pa las/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi lha bcu dgu la drug ma shong nas/ byang chub chen po'i rgyab du gyang logs la ri mor bris nas yod do// lte ba'i rgyud ris ni sku gsum 'byung ba'i mdo bris/ lte ba'i kha phyir ltas la mdo sde pad+ma dkar po'i rgyud ris bris/ kha nang lta'i bskor khang la 'dus pa chen po rin po che tog gi gzungs bris/ rnga khang la rje'i thugs dam mdo sde dkon mchog sprin gyi rgyud ris bris/ 'og khang gi chos skyong bsrungs ma mkha' 'gro ma seng ge khri ral pa can la gtad/ de nas bar khang gi shing thams cad gla ba dang yeng ldeng la byas/ sder bzo tsho'i rgyu ba men gyi ko ba la byas/ bzo rgya nag po'i lugs su byas/ gtso bo dpal rnam par snang mdzad/ g.yas na 'das pa'i

122 ༄7//(sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/sangs rgyas mar me mdzad/ g.yon na ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas byams pa bzhengs kha ma/ mdun na stong gi lha shākya thub pa/ tshes brgyad kyi lha sman gyi bla be+ergyu nya'i lha snang ba mtha' yas/ nyi shu gnyis kyi lha jo mo sgrol ma bris/ g.yas g.yon gyi byang chub sems dpa' 'khor nye ba'i sras brgyad/ dge bsnyen chen po dri ma med par grags pa/ byang chub sems dpa' dga' ba'i dpal/ khro bo gang ging zhes bya ste rgya nag gi skad yin/ don 'og khang dang mthun/ kri ya'i lha tshogs bco lnga dang bstun/ nang gi rgyud ris yum rgyas pa'i gleng bzhi'i le'u rgyud ris bris/ gdong la rgyal po chen po bzhi/ bskor khang kha phyir blta la mchod rten brgyad pa/ mdo mngon par 'byung ba'i rgyud ris bris/ bskor khang kha nang lta la mdo sde sprin chen po'i rgyud ris snga khang la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang / gshin rje'i gshed kyi lha tshogs dang / bsam yas na gnas pa'i chos skyong rnams kyi 'bag bar khang gi chos skyong rgyal po shing bya can la gtad/ de nas steng khang gi shing cha thams cad thang ma dang bsom las byas/ lder tsho'i rgyu ras dang 'jag ma la byas/ bzo rgya dkar po'i lugs/ gtso bo sangs rgyas rnams par snang mdzad kun tu rig pa zhal bzhi/ngo bo gcig pa'o// re re la 'khor gnyis gnyis/ byang chub sems dpa' nye ba'i sras brgyad/ nang gi lha tshogs byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje rgyal po la sogs pa phyogs bcu nas lhags pa'i byang chub sems dpa'/ khro bo mi g.yo ba la sogs pa bzhi/ phyag na rdo rje bzhi ste budhi'i lha tshogs bzhi bcu gnyis su byas/ rgyud ris mdo sde ba bcu pa/ chos skyong ba'i rgyal po zangs ma'i 'bor log can/ thog rgya phebs can za 'og ris can du pheb/ lcog bzhin steng gi zhing khams mdangs dga' ba can gyi sangs rgyas dpal/ 'khor byang chub sems dpa' dga' bas byin la sogs pa'i rgyud ris bzhi/ de'i chos skyong gnod sbyin lag na rdo rje'i gos sngon po can bzhi la gtad/ snya lji ra gser la

༄7//sba gsal snang gi bzhed pa bzhugs/ 123shel gyi tog can du btsugs/ de nas 'khor sa bar ma brtsigs te/ lho phyogs rol mo mchod rdzas kyis bang mdzod gsum na rol chas bkang pa'o//gnod sbyin lag na dbyug pa thogs pa mched gsum la gtad/ nub ngos mdo rgyud chos kyi bang mdzod gsum na/ rgya dpe/ bod dpe/ rgya nag gi dpe'i glegs bam rnams kyis bkang ste/ a tsa ra lag na spu gri thogs pa mched gsum la gtad/ byang ngos rin chen gser gyi bang mdzod gsum na gser dngul zangs la sogs pas bkang ste/ gshin rje lag na be con thogs pa mched gsum la gtad/ rgyud ris mdo rgya cher rol pa bris/ bar dor sa la bskal pa bzang po 'di la sangs rgyas stong 'byung ba dang / de'i 'og tu ngan 'gro'i bskal pa drug bcu'i rjes la/ bskal pa gnyan pa chen po la sangs rgyas khri 'byung ba bris te/ ma shongs pa gru skas kyi rtsig logs la bkod nas yod/de nas 'khor sa chen mo bskor te rnam par snang mdzad ngan song sbyong ba'i dkyil 'khor du bzhengs so// mda' yab kyi ngos gsum na rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa rigs lnga'i lder tshor zhal phyir blta ba/ nang du mdo sdong po brgyan pa'i rgyud ris dang / tshong dpon gyi bu nor bu bzang pos dge ba'i bshes gnyen rgya rtsa gnyis brten pa bris so// des ma khengs pa 'phags pa snang brgyad kyis bkang nas yod/ chos skyong klu'i rgyal po a nan+ta u li la gtod/ rgyab tu rdo ring pad+ma can la bka' tshigs mdor bsdus bkos/ stong du seng ge bzhag nas chos skyong seng ge nga mu kha la gtad/ dbu rtse'i sgo pradzña pa ra mi ta rnam par thar pa'i sgo/ stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang /smon pa med pa'i sgo gsum dang bstun/ rtsig pa dang shing bzo brkos te/rmangs btsugs/ chu khung gtod/ nang du ka ba'i rmangs byas/ steng du ka ba/ka ba'i steng du ka lo/ de'i steng du gdung / de'i steng du cam/ de'i steng du spang leb/ de'i steng du so phag bkram/ kha lan kun gyis bskor/ logs la

124 ༄༅//(sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/sum brgya'i 'og tu sgo phyi rub la nang yangs pa rgya mtsho lta bu byas/ bya gag mi 'jug pa'i phyir dra ma/ sbrang bu mi 'jug pa'i phyir sgo legs/ de rlung gis mi bskyod pa'i phyir 'khor gtan byas/ de 'byed pa dbyug gu skam kha byas/ steng du 'jog pa'i gru skas/ de'i rmang rdo la byas/ bar so phag steng shing la byas/lag 'ju pa'i sdang bu byas/ de mi 'gul ba'i lcags gzer btab/ bya ba 'dul ba dang bstun/ rgyud ris thams cad mdo sde dang bstun/ lder tsho thams cad gsang sngags dang bstun/ de ltar na lder tsho bdun bcu don brgyad/ mdo'i rgyud ris bcu bzhi/ ka ba stong dang rtsa gnyis/ sgo mo che sum bcu so drug sgo chu (che)chung bzhi bcu zhe gnyis/ gru skas chen po drug lcong chen po brgyad/ dang dang chen po gsum la sogs pa dang / mngon pa dang bstun pa'i gling phran bcu gnyis/ nyi zla dang / phyi lcags ri dang bcas par bzhengs/ de yang shar lus 'phags po'i gling g.yog dang bcas pa la dpe byas te/ dang po rnam dag khrims pa'i gling zla gam du byas te/ lder tsho bstan pa'i bdag po la sogs pa gtso 'khor lnga bzhugs/ zla 'od gzhon nur gyur pa'i rgyud ris/ chos skyong dkar po dung gi thor tshugs can no// spyir gling phran bcu gnyis po mo la lte ba la sgo re/ 'khor sa la sgo gnyis gnyis yod do//de nas mkhyen rab 'jam dpal gling na/ 'jam dpal rgyu ko ba la byas pa gtso 'khor bdun/ sgo bsrungs gshin rje'i gshed gnyis/ nang gi lte ba la 'jam dpal gyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan bkod pa/ 'og khang na phal po che'i rgyud ris dang / sgo mo drug chos skyong pa gshin rje me'i 'khor lo can la gtad/ brda' sbyor tshang (tshangs pa'i) mang gling na shākya thub pa gtso 'khor bdun/ lte ba rin po che sna tshogs kyi rgyud ris/ phyi btsun pa'i g.yos sa/ chos skyong rgyal po 'brug gi klog pa can/ lho'i gling sogs kha gsum la/bdud 'dul sngags pa gling na shākya thub pa bdud 'dul lugs ma/ 'khor
