༄༅//sba gsal snang gi bzhed pa bzhugs/ 125lder tsho bzhi/ lte ba la mdo sde sa bcu pa/ 'khor sa la gtsug na rin po che'i mdo/ chos skyong pa dbang phyug ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ ar+ya pa lo'i gling na khar sa pā ṇi gtso 'khor lnga/ steng na ā mi ta bhā wa gtso 'khor lnga/ glo 'bur na sku gsung thugs kyi brten/ sku'i brten tsan ldan gyi rus pa la/ gu gul gyi sha/dngul gyi lpags pas g.yogs pa'i rgyal po nyid kyi 'bag gcig bla 'bum yum chen mo gcig 'phra men gyi mchod rten gcig rgyud ris mdo za ma tog bkod pa/ bse'i lha mo stong tsa (rtsa)gnyis/ 'khor sa la sa bcu pa'i mdo/chosaskyong ba drang srong rda ma ra 'khor long sa (longs spyod)rgya 'brel dang bcas pa la gtad/ rgya gar gling na jo mo lugs ma gtso 'khor lnga/ rgyud ris mgon po che dpag tu med pa dang / 'dul ba rnam par dag pa / mdun na lo paṇa sgra bsgyur ba'i khang pa gcig la sgo so sor lta ba/ chos skyong pa gnod sbyin ra to la gtad/ nub kyi gling gsum zlum po la/ be+ero tsa na'i gling na rnam par snang mdzad zangs las bya pa/ 'khor gsang ba'i yum bzhi/ rgyud ris rnam snang mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud/ chos skyong gnod sbyin glang gi mgo bo can/byams pa gling na 'phags pa gtso 'khor bdun/ sgo bsrungs gshin rje gshed gnyis/ rgyud ris mi dge ba spyad pas shākya'i bstan pa mar la 'grib pa dang /tshe lo bcu pa nas byams pas dge ba byed du bcug pas bstan pa yar 'phel ba dang / sgrol ma'i phyag 'tshal nyi shu rtsa gcig dang / bsam yas kyi dpe bris/sna nam rgyal tsha lha snang gis lag dpon byas pa'i byas thabs dang / byang chub ltung bshags kyi lha tshogs bkod/ chos skyong mkha' 'gro ma gu ling gi gos can la gtad/ bsam gtan gling na rnam par (19 1)snang mdzad yab rgyal po'i thugs dam gnyan po byin rlabs can rigs lnga/ 'khor nyan thos chen po bcu drug dang bcas pa/ rgyud ris gser 'od dam pa nges don gyi lugs/chos skyong ba rgyal po dngul gyi mgo can byang gi gling gru bzhi gsum la/ rin

126 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/chen sna tshogs gling na/ shākya mu ne+e gtso 'khor lnga/ rgyud ris dga' ldan du yum la chos bshad pa drin lan bsab pa'i mdo/ chos skyong ba rgyal po g.ye'i sbar ba can/ sems bskyed byang chub gling na/ phyag na rdo rje'i pho brang ri bo mchog rab na phyag na rdo rje/ rdo rje phur pa/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa gsum bar chad bsrung ba'i gtso bo/ sangs rgyas ma chags pad+ma'i spyan nam mkha' la byon pa la/ byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa rnam sel gyi zhus sna ba byas/ sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje snying po la sogs pa bud+dha'i lha ba'i bcu zhe gnyis sems bskyed zhus pa/ de'i bar bar na phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi de dag la byin gyis brlabs pa bris/ rgyud ris mdo sde dkon mchog sprin/ 'khor sa la 'phags pa rtag tu ngus pradzha pa ra mi ta 'tshol ba/ chos skyong ba rgyal po bse khyab can dang / mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i 'gros can/ skor mdzod dpe dkar gling na shākya thub pa gtso 'khor dgu/ yab dang sras mjal ba'i mdo'i rgyud ris bris/ glo 'bur rnam pa na bsam yas 'byongs pa'i skor lhag ma 'di ni 'di yod kyi rtsis yig byang shing khram kha gang / de'i bsrungs ma khyam gang gi rgyal po spyi'i chos skyong dpe dkar la gtad/ g.yag sha gong ma gang pa bzang po'i khang pa na shākya thub pa gtso 'khor rgyud ris skal pa bzang po'i mdo sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis/ chos skyong thang lha gang pa bzang po/ g.yag sha 'og ma gnod sbyin nor bu bzang po'i khang pa na/ lder tsho rgyud ris gong dang mthun/chosaskyong pa gnod sbyin nor bu bzang po la gtad/ de gnyis nyi ma dang zla ba'i dod yin/ shar phyogs kyi logs gling dang bcas pa kha dog dkar po shel/lho ngos mthing be+e ḍūr+ya/ nub ngos dmar po pad+ma rā ga byang ngos gser po gser gyi rang bzhin/ yang na ljang gu in+t+ra ni la/ logs kyi zhal ba la chu gnyer 'dra ba/ thang la dkar zhal phyi'i rgya mtsho la dpe byas pa yang byas so//de nas tshang ma mang ke ru gling na steng khang na slob dpon bo bhi satwa'i

༄za//sba gsal snang gi bzhed pa bzhugs/ 127gzims mal dang / ba so lha khang dang / 'og khar dkar thab/ chos skyong gnod sbyin lag na myu gu thogs/ dag byed khrus kyi khang pa na khron pa tsan dan gyis bkang pa dang / 'og so phag logs la rab tu byung ba skyo ba byed par bya ba'i keng rus kyi rnam pa 'dul ba nas bshad pa bzhin bris/ chos skyong lag na dbyug pa thog pa/ mthu rtsal gling na se ba phung po gcig la sbyin bsregs byas pa'i yal ga brgyad la klu chen mo brgyad la klu brgyad byas/ de'i dbus na phyag na rdo rje zhi ba dkar po 'dul byed du bzhengs/ rgyud ris nya dang sbal ba dang / chu srin la sogs pa bris/ chos skyong pa bdag rgyu 'dal gnyan dgu dang bcas pa rang bcas su yod/ nang chu shel gyis khyab pa sus kyang lta bar rngo mi thogs pa gcig mchis/ de nas mchod rten dkar po byang chub chen po'i mchod rten nyan thos kyi lugs su bzhengs/ shud bu nga mi rgyal gtor res las dpon byas seng gis brgyan pa'o// chos skyong gnod sbyin skar mda' gdong la gtad/ mchod rten dmar po chos kyi 'khor lo/ byang chub sems dpa'i lugs pad+mas brgyan pa'o// sna rnam rgyal tsha lha snang gis bzhengs/ chos skyong pa gza' mig dmar la gtad/ mchod rten nag po de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung gis brgyan pa sangs rgyas kyi lugs/ ngan lam stag ra klu gong gis bzhengs/ chos skyong gnod sbyin lcags kyi mchu can la gtad/ mchod rten sngon po dpal lha las babs pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i lugs/ lha khang gi sgo mo bcu drug gis brgyan/ chims rdo rje spre chung gis bzhengs/ chos skyong ba gnod sbyin nyi ma'i gdong can la gtad/ de'i tshe 'dre mo 'od can mas slob dpon rnams nyal ba'i mgo 'jug ldog pa la sogs pa'i tshe ba mang du byas pas/des slob dpon la zhus pas/ byams pa'i gling du mchod rten 'od 'bar ba brtsigs te mnan/ mchod rten chen po bzhi/ mchod rten 'od 'bar ba dang lnga bzhings/ mchod rten dkar po gnyan drags pas las dpon shi nas yang

128 ༄7//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/shu bu khri 'bring khong btsan gyis byas/ de la thams cad kyis nang rdzongs ma mchis pas rjes bsams pa/ slob dpon la zhu dgos dgongs nas zhus pas/slob dpon gyi zhal nas/ ma ga ta rgyal po'i khab kyi sgo mdun na rda ru rtse do bya ba'i mchod rten gcig gi nang na rgyal po ma skyes dgra'i bskal ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdung dang ring bsrel ma ga ta'i bre'i khab gcig bzhugs par grags so gsung nas/ rgyal pos de spyan drangs pa'i phyir bod kyi rta rngog chags lga (sga)mnan ma thag gcig yan chad ma lus par 'chad pa la brngos te/'gos kyis phag rir 'dus/ slob dpon gyis lam rgyus mdzad nas mtha' khob bod kyi rta pa'i dmag phyin pas/ dpal mo dpal thang la grangs la btab pas/ rta pa bye ba phrag bcu bzhi byung rgya gar tha 'khob du sleb ste rtol ba dang /yul de'i rgyal po bred nas mtha' 'khob kyi rgyal po de'i rta pa de'i rta pa 'di 'dra na/ rkang bu chung gi tshogs/ glang po che'i tsheg (tshogs)ci 'dra bar 'gyur zer nas/ pho brang gi ya lan la bod kyi btsan po'i lham btags nas/de'i 'og na phar 'khor dang bcas pa 'dzul nas/ nga'i rgyal khams ni btsan po khyod kyi zhabs 'og tu 'dzul zhing bca' dang skyes lo thang du 'bul zer te/de ltar khas blangs nas mngar 'dus lags/ de nas chu bo gang ga brgal nas ma ga tar dmag drangs pa na/ ma ga ta pa thams cad nor thams cad o tan lurir bskyas nas mi thams cad rgya gar shar phyogs su bros te g.yul sprad ma dgos par rdo rje gdan du byang chub kyi shing la mchod pa byas nas mchod gnas spyan drangs de nas mchod rten kha phye ba'i nang nas mtshon cha'i 'khor lo 'khor ba'i dkyil na rin po che'i bum pa 'dug pa de sus kyang blang bar rdo (rngo)ma thogs/ rgya gar gyi rgyal po gcig 'dug pa na re/ nga la sngon gyi mi gleng pa'i lo rgyus yod/ mchod rten 'di'i byang ngos na rdo leb chen po'i dkyil gyi bug pa na mar rnga mang gi thag pa la bum pa btags te btang pas/ bum pa de chu bo

༄༅//sba gsal snang gi bzhed pa bzhugs/ 129gang gar 'byung / de nas yar la gzhal bas mchod rten dang skyed thag mnyam pa na/ rdzing bu'i gseng khung gi bar du chu 'gro ba ni rtswa dang shing dang byed (bye)mas bkab ste chu bsgags na chu chad nas mtshon cha'i 'khor lo bsdigs pa zin zer te 'khor 'phro 'chad pa yin zer nas/ de ji skad zer ba de ltar byas pas bden par dbyung nas/ rin po che'i bum pa nas de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa'i ring bsrel bre drug spyan drangs nas/ yang rtswa shing gsal nas chu btang pas mtshon cha'i 'khor lo snga ma ltar 'khor ro// de nas tshur byon nas chu bo gang ga'i 'gram du bod kyi mi bzhi bskos nas/ 'di tshun chad bod kyi sa bcad yin pas 'dir rdo rings kyis gcig ces bka' bstsal/ mi bzhi pos byi khung du lcags kyi ka ba btsugs te/ phyis bru sha'i dmag gis de bshig pas ma shigs nas mes bzhu ba'i 'phro yod do// de'i lu 'bugs na 'dzugs mi bzhi po chags pa'i bi tro tha gu ra'i rigs bya ba'i grong khyer chen po cig kyang yod/ rta dmag rnams bod du log pa shin tu nyung bas/ rgyal po la zhus pas/rgya dkar po yul bzang bas bsdad pa/ men nam phar thong gsung ste/ slob dpon la dris pas/ rgya gar chams la 'bebs pa'i ched du btsan pos sprul pa mdzad pa yin/ dmag dang po nas 'di las med gsungs/ bsngo bgrang byas pas mi gcig kyang ma lus rta gcig kyang ma chad par tshang ba/ btsan po khri srong lde btsan gyi sprul par grags so// de nas chos 'khor du byon nas ring bsrel gyi snod/ rin po che'i za ma tog bzhi sprugs pa'i bar du ring bsrel 'phel/ snyim pa gang ma shong ba de mchod rten gyi tog la bzhugs/ mes lha mtho mtho'i gnyan po gsang ba dang / mes bsrong btsan gyi thugs dam lnga dang / yab kyi thugs dam gnyis der bzhugs pas lhag par byin rlabs che'o//de ltar mchod rten bzhi yang brtsigs lags na lho phyogs kyi mchod rten 'thon kha dkar po'i 'khor lo bal po'i shing mkhan dang / rdo bzo mkhan dang /

130 ༄7//(sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/mgar bas bgyis te/ has po ri'i rgyab na bal po bzo byed pa'i drung na bzhag nas/ sang drangs te 'dzugs par chad pa la/ blon po rnams kyis 'breng zhags dang / shing rta grab byas te/ bal po'i bzo bos dgung sangs ma thag tu bzo 'phro la phyin pas srog shing nub mo shul ha re stor/ shing mkhan dang mgar ba bkug te snyan du gsol ba'i tshe/ rjes pho nya btang te bltas pas srog shing mchod rten la btsugs pa mthong / pho nya de na re/ mchod rten nyid la 'khor lo gtsugs lags zhes gsol/ shing mkhan dang mgar ba kun bltar 'dong zhes phyin pas/ bltas na btsugs lags pa mthong te snyam du gsol pa dang rjes kun bsogs te/ nga'i 'bangs las stobs che ba ni su yin/bya dga' cher gnang ngo gsungs pas/ khas len pa su yang ma mchis sgyu mkhan bal po na re/ mdang ba'i rmi lam na/ mi bzhis 'khor lo khyer 'ongs nas btsugs/ khyod kyis mchod rten bdun brtsigs na legs rab/ mchod rten 'di yang legs rab/ mchod rten 'di 'dzam bu gling na byin che ste/'di la su phyag dang bskor byed pa de bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub pas/ bya dga' gser gyi ya lad cig byin te 'di khyer gcig ces zer/ gnyid sad tsa na mi bzhi po ni mi gda'/ ya lad ni 'di yin zhes zer nas gser khrab gcig gda'/ de bzhin du btsan po'i bsnyan du gsol pas/ phywa mkhan 'khor dang bcas pa la rgyal pos bya dga' che thang du gnang / slob dpon gyis zhal nas/ de skad du ston pa rgyal po chen ngo bzhi yin pas rgyal po chen po bzhi'i gzugs kyang bya gsung nas bum pa'i steng du 'bag gzhi byas nas bzhag go// de nas mgon khang bzhi'i nang du phugs na shākya mu ne+e gtso 'khor gsum/ mdo na mgon po lcam dral gnyis/ de'i sgo dra ba byas/ sgo'i phyi na rta babs dang / steng na chos kyi 'khor lo gser las byas pa/ sha ra ṇa dang /gdugs brgyan dang bcas pa bgyis te/ chos skyong rgyal po bzhi la gtad/

༄༅//sba gsal snang gi bzhed pa bzhugs/ 131lcags ris zur mangs rdo rje 'gros la mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad kyi tshul du bskor nas/ re re la sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel re bzhugs pa chos skyong rgyal po sde bco brgyad la gtad/ bsam yas phyi'i chos skyong dpal mgon po la gtad do// de ltar na dpal brag dmar bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang de ni/ gzhi che la 'phangs mtho ba/ rgyu bzang la bkod pa legs pa/ dung phor gzis bkang pa 'dra ba/ rje'i thugs dam/ 'bangs kyi mchod gnas/ sangs rgyas dang chos dkon mchog gi zhing khams/ dge 'dun gyi bzhugs gnas/ mdor na dkon mchog gsum gyi pho brang de yos bu'i lo la rmang bres de yos bu'i lo la 'byongs pa lags so//jo mo lnga khab du bzhes pa la/ chims gza' lha mo btsan dang / mkhar chen gza' mtsho rgyal gnyis bsgrub pa mdzad pa phyag ris med do// 'bro gza' khri rgyal mo btsun sras med pas rab tu byung pa'i mtshan byang chub rjer gsol ba'i phyag ris dge rgyas kyi gtsug lag khang lags te/ snang ba mtha' yas gtso 'khor dgur mdzad pa gzhung gi lugs/ stod du lugs btab nas gtsang po la spyan drangs pas 'khor bra chab la shor/ 'khor drug po la g.yas na rigs gsum mgon po/ g.yon na sangs rgyas sman gyi bla/ sangs rgyas kun tu bzang po/ mi g.yo mgon po gsum bzhugs su gsol/ sras mi mnga' ba dang /yab ming 'bro yul thang ring bas phyis gso mi mi 'ong zhes mchi nas lugs ma byas/ rtseg pa so phag kho nye'i chus sbyar/ zangs kyi thog skal/ rol mor 'gram bzang bshig pa'i lcong chims phu'i rdza la sbas pa de yin gsungs/ lcong btags snang par rin po che mar gad ā mi ta bhā wa'i dpral bar 'phra btab bo// jo mo tshe spong na lan lon par gsungs pas khab tu bzhes te/ lha lcam las sras mi mnga' bas lha khang nyis thog du sgang pas/ dbu tshal gser khang rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du bzhengs su gsol lo/ lha bzo ba la zas sna

132 ༄7//(sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/bcu gsum drangs pas bzo sna bcu gsum byas te/ steng khang logs la rtsig pa med pa/ nang ka ba med pa/ glang gor gyi sgo skyabs dad 'phag thub pa/ sa gzhi rin po cher gan las byas pa/ g.yu'i gdung ma la gser gyi rta rgyug pa'i 'bur gtod pa/ mthing gi rgya phebs kha phyi lta nang blta gnyis yod pa/ chu thams cad 'dril nas seṅge'i kha nas 'bab pa de rus sbal gyi rgyab tu 'ong ba/sgo 'byed gcod las gser gyi byi chung skad 'don pa/ nang gi yo ga'i lha tshogs la spyi gdugs re re pheb pa/ 'khyams na mdzad pa bcu gnyis 'bur du gtod pa/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi rgya phebs 'degs pa/ phebs kyi nang zur bzhi na gser gyi seṅge lug tsam pa brgyad yod pas/ rgya gdugs kyi sham bu la mchod pa'i lha mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad 'bur du gtod pa/ lha'i bus khyung gi sgo nga las bdud rtsi'i chus sku 'khrus gsol ba ngo mtshar ba cig bzhengs su gsol lo/ de ltar lo bcu gnyis na lha khang bzo tshar ba las/ de nas slob dpon la mnga' gsol gyi zhu brten gser phye bre drug phul nas zhus pas/ bod 'bangs mnga' ris thams cad la bco dang khral bsdus la yo byad sta gon gyis gcigaces lung gnang / slob dpon ke ru gling na mtshams bcad nas bsgrub pa la bzhugs pa las/ khyad par du rab gnas mnga' gsol gyi thugs dam mdzad/btsan pos mnga' 'bangs kun bsdus de yo byad tshogs nas mnga' gsol dus bzang po la bab pa'i tshe/ brag dmar skye bo'i tshogs kyis khengs/ slob dpon gyis ke ru gling nas mkhar bzhong me tog gis bkang nas byon te mchod rten dkar po'i gong du byon pa dang / rgyal pos 'jam pa'i rdo rje zhal gsum phyag drug pa phyag na rin po che'i me tog thogs pa gcig tu gzigs/ slob dpon gyis ting nge 'dzin gyis dbu rtse'i 'og khang gi lha phyir spyan drangs nas mchodarten dkar po la bskor ba byas te/ zhal shar phyogs su gzigs nas 'khor sa'i logs la phrog zhu zing nge 'dug pa la me tog gtor ro// lha rnams

༄༅//sba gsal snang gi bzhed pa bzhugs/ 133dus gcig tu gshegs te sngar gyi gral bzhin du 'khod pas/ khro bo gcig gi rgyab nas ye shes kyi me 'bar bas sa gzhi tshigs pa la/ slob dpon gyis dri chab kyi bsang gtong mdzad pas me shi ba'i shul sor chud/ btsan pos me tog tu gser phye gzhongs pa gang phul lo/ zhal sro chen po'i dus su phyi lcags ris kyi steng / mchod rten gyi bar thams cad bzhes pa dang thung skyal gyis bkang /de ltar mo ba rnams la 'tshal bas skal ba gnyis gnyis gsum gsum thob/skal ba chad pa ni ye ma mchis/ de'i rjes kun ltad mo che thang re byed/ sman ri la lan ga brag chung nyi ma 'de ba'i drung du sha ba byung ba la zhags pas bzung nas khrom bskor/ ltad mo dang po'i byas lugs 'khor sa'i sgo rgyab na bris nas yod do// yang nang par yang slob dpon ke ru gling nas mkhar bzhong me tog gis bkang nas byon pas/ btsan pos dge slong rigs lnga'i dbu brgyan can gcig tu gzigs/ slob dpon gyis ting 'dzin gyis dbu rtse bar khang gi lha phyir spyan drangs te/ 'khor sa'i logs la khul shal du gzigs pa la me tog tor/ lha rnams dus gcig la nang du gshegs te sngar gyi gral bzhin du 'khod do// rgyal pos gser phye gzhong pa gang yon du phul zhal bsro bar sa'i dus su ltad mo ba la 'tshal ba sngar bzhin 'tshal/ rjes la ltad mo che thang re byed/sngog pha la bya bas rnga mo bdun la zhon res byed cing byung / la la gu ru rta rgyug pa'i steng na phar la ral gri'i sgo 'phen/ la la mi gnyis brtsegs gis 'phan 'phyar ba la sogs pa'i ltad mo bar sa'i byas lugs kyang 'khor sa'i sgo rgyab na bris nas yod do// yang slob dpon gyis ke ru gling nas mkhar bzhong me tog gis bkang nas byon pa de/ btsan pos dge slong 'jam pa'i rdo rje dbu brgyan can gcig tu gzigs nas/ slob dpon gyis dbu rtse'i steng khang gi lha rnams ting nge 'dzin gyis spyan drangs nas/ dbu rtse thang nas me tog tor/ lha rnams dus gcig nang du gshegs te sngar gyi gral bzhin du 'khod/ btsan

134 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/pos gser phye gzhong pa gang yon du phul zhal bsro phyi ma'i dus su ltad mo ba la 'tshal pa snga ma bzhin du 'tshal/ rjes la ltad mo che thang re byed/ ljang dga' bobya bas seng ldeng gi gdung thod la btsugs nas dbu rtse'i thang la brgyugs nas dbu rtse'i lho sgo'i them khar bob/ de re re yang mi re res mi khyag spo shing btags pa mang po shing kha na phar rgyug pa dang / shing rtse la rgyu (sgyu)ma mkhan lus la me chen 'bar/ thang shing la byis chung spyang mo nyug pa byung ba ltad mo thang ma'i byas lugs kyang ngo mtshar bas 'khor sa'i sgo rgyab na bris nas yod do// spyir slob dpon bo bhi satwas bsam yas kyi chos 'khor ma bu la mnga' gsol rab gnas lan brgya byas so// lan bdun byas pa'i rten dang / lha sku ni sprul pa'i sku dngos dang byin brlabs 'dra ba lags so// de'i rjes la btsan pos bsil sgang gi mtsho nang du pad+ma'i sdong po skyes pa'i khar bzhugs nas thugs dam gyi lha khang 'byongs pa la gzigs nas shin tu dgyes nas/ba'i dbu rtse rigs gsum 'di/ brtsigs pa mi 'dra skyes pa 'dra ste nga re dga'/ bya ba la sogs pa'i dga' glu bcu gsum 'gur du bzhengs so//blon po rnams kyang so so'i nga rgyal re'i glu blangs te/ chims kyis nga che rgyang grags la sogs pa'o// de ltar lo bcu gnyis kyi bar du skyid kyi bro mo che brdungs/ mi res glu re blangs/ rta res bang re rgyugs/ bya res skad re ston/dus de tsa na bod bde skyid kyi mnga' dar ba lags so//de yang dbu rtse'i sgo rgyab byang ngos na bris nas yod do// dus der rje blon rnams rtsed bro dang longs spyod la yengs pa dang / de yan chad bod la dge slong gi ming yang med pa las/ bsam yas kyi rtsig rmangs thams cad byi khung byas te lha khang dang / rten rnams la mchod pa dang zhabs tog byed pa med pas/ btsan po thugs ma bde nas 'bangs rnams la chos bya bar rigs so gsungs nas/ de nas yos kyi lo'i dpyid zla ra ba'i ngo la/ slob dpon

༄༅//sba gsal snang gi bzhed pa bzhugs/ 135thams cad yod par smra ba'i sde/ dbus pa bye brag du smra ba bya ba'i dge slong bcu gnyis spyan drangs nas/ zhan blon bu tsha chims legs la sogs pa la slob dpon gyis rgya gar skad bslab pa las/ chims a nu'i bu shākya dang / pa gor na (he 'dod kyang zer )'dod kyi bu pa gor be+e ro tsa na dang / sba (khri bzhed zer )rma gzigs kyi bu rat+nar/ sba khri bzher gyi bu sang shing ta yang zer de dang / zhang nya bzang kyi bu lha bu dang / lha bse btsan dang / shud pu khong bsleb kyis skad lobs/ chims legs bzang la sogs pa zhang blon gyi bu tsha gzhan mang zhig ni skad ma shes so// blon po 'gos rgan na re/ nged blon po rgan po rnams la long ma mchis pas a tsa ra'i skad lob mi khom pas rgan po'i chos zhu zer bas/ slob dpon gyis a pha dang / a ma'i skad don thog du phebs te/ don la rgya skad 'thun par bod skad mkhyen zhing byang ba dang /bod skad du chos bshad pas sang skyi ta'i skad ma dgos pas/ slob dpon gyi 'al nas/ bod byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa'i skad yin pas chos byar btub sam gsung bas/ btsan po'i zhal nas/ slob dpon nga'i bod la dge slong med pas nga'i zhang blon dag la dge slong btub bam ces zhus pa'i lan du/btub bam sad par bya gsung nas skad lobs pa tsho las thog mar bod la dad pa che ba'i sba/(sang shi ta yang zer/) khri gzigs dge slong byas ma thag tu mtshan sba dpal dbyangs su btags/ lnga mngon par shes pa dang ldan pas/btsan po dgyes te de'i zhabs spyi bor blangs te khyod bod kyi rin po che yin no zhes bka' bstsal nas mtshan kyang sba rat+na zhes btags te/ bod kyi rab tu byung ba la snga ba de yin no// btsan po na re/ slob dpon gyis ba'i zhang blon dad pa can da rung rab tu byung cig ces zhus pas/ sad cig gsung nas sba gsal snang dang / sba khri bzher dang /(sba dpal dbyangs la rgya nag skad sang shi ta zer/ la la khri bzher gyi bu sang shi ta zer/ sba gsal snang skya bo'i dus

136 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/ming / de nas sems bskyed zhus nas dang rab tu byung nas ming ye shes dbang por slob dpon bo lha satwas btags/ bzhed 'bring po las gtsug lag khang tshar/ zhal ma bsros bar du gsal snang rab tu byung / rgya skad bslabs pa rnams kyang de dus lobs/ rab tu byung ba yang de dus su byung bar bshad/) pa gor nas (he 'dod kyang zer/) 'dod kyi bu be+e ro tsa na dang / nga lam rgyal ba mchod dbyangs dang rma a tsa ra rin chen mchog dang /la gsum rgyal ba'i byang chub dang drug dge slong byas te/ ming yang ye shes dbang po dang / de la sogs par btags nas sad mi mi drug rab tu byung ngo //der btsan po'i zhal nas/ shākya thub pa'i bstan pa sgrub par byed na rab tu 'byung dgos pa yin pas/ zhang blon gyi bu tsha dad pa can thams cad rab tu 'byung cig ces gsungs pas/ blon po rnams na re/ rab tu byung na nga la tsho ba med do zhes mchi bas/ btsan po'i zhal nas/ ngas mtsho ba bla nas sbyar gcig gsung / blon po rnams na re/ dmag dang khral ma byas na chad pa 'ong zer/ btsan po'i zhal nas/ de la ngas chags 'og nas bde ba byin la dbu'i mchod gnas bya'o gsung / sde snod gsum bslab mi nus zer bas/ de la dge ba nyams dang dpags la spyod gcig ces bka' gnang ngo // kha cig na re/ de nas lug gi lo'i rgun zla 'bring po'i ngo la bsam yas bzhengs su gsol zin pa'i zhal bsros pra ti na ra'i dus kyi mchod pa chen po mdzad pa'i tshe/ jo mo btsan khri rgyal mo btsun dang / bsru btsan mo rgyal la sogs pa rgya rab tu byung ba'i mkhan po rat+nas bgyis/ spyir de dus su mi brgya rab tu byung nasadabu rtse'i bya 'dab dang mchod rten chen po bzhi'i rtse mo lcags thag gis sbrel/ de la 'phan mgo btags te/ nam mkhar dar la bgyi/ sa gzhi gyi lingari rta las byas/ gser phor dngul phor thams cad chab tshang dang / 'bras chang dang / nas chang gis bkangs/ dus 'di phan chad bka' sho chen po

༄༅//sba gsal snang gi bzhed pa bzhugs/ 137btang te/ chos khrims bcas/ slan chad 'og gi 'bangs las pho mig mi dbyung / mo sna mi bcad/ 'tshang can mi dgum par snang / skye bo thams cad kyis rje'i bka' nyan cing / rje 'bangs thams cad kyis rab tu byung pa la dbu'i mchod gnas su phyung la/ phyag dang mchod pa bya ba dang / bkur ba la sogs 'bangs phyogs su chos kyi bka' drin chen po bstsal ba la sogs pa'i bkas btags/ de ltar bya ba'i ched du btsan po yab sras dang sna chen po la gtogs pa blon chen man chad nas sna la gtogs pa rim gyis bro bor te mna' bskyal ba'o// chos rtsigs mdzad/ bka' brtsigs kyi rdo rings btsugs/rab tu byung pas chos grwa'i slob dpon dang / nya ma'i slob dpon bkos/ de phan chad dkon mchog gsum dang / dge 'dun gyi bshos ni khab so chen mo las sbyar pa la sogs 'og tu 'chad/ sngar ye shes dbang po dang / slob dpon bo lha satwas gsol ba bzhin mthar gyis chos la 'jug par mdzad par chad pas sgra bsgyur btsugs te/ lots+tsha chen pos ni rgya gar gyi lots+tsha byas/ rgya nag po'i lots+tsha ni bran ka legs kong dang / lha lung klu gong dang / 'go gong dbul gong gsum/ de'i mkhan bu khyung po rtse mangs la sogs pas byas/ rgya'i hwa shang ma zhang ma ko lo spyan drangs nas chos rnams bsgyur ba las/ mkhan po sba raṇ+ḍas shes rab 'bum thog mar bsgyur ba'i tshe/ bod khams su 'bum sde rgyas par bsgyur te/ de'i bsod nams dang byin rlabs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams su theg pa chen po spyod pa sha stag gzhi dag par skye bo zhes rmi lam du lung bstan/ dba' bran mkhan po mdzis shes rab 'bum lha sras khri srong lde btsan rje 'bangs la bshad pa'i tshe/ lha sras mnyes nas mgo la byugs nas bya dga' che thang du gsal/ rgyud kun las btus pa yang mdzis bsgyur ro// lugs gcig (bzhed rgyas shos)la rgya nag po'i chos rnams thog mar bsgyur ro zer/rgya dkar po'i chos la nang rgyud sde gsum sha chang la yangs te bod la mi

138 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/'tshams pas ma bsgyur/ thams cad yod par smra ba'i sde pa dbus pa bye brag du smra ba rgyu 'bras/ (zhabs 'bring dge slong dang skye bo kun na re/ chos mkhas rab re gsol zhes grags/ jo mo lha rgyal gyi zhal nas kyang de ltar chos mkhas pa zas su ci gsol gsungs/ ) ston pas de bor la 'tsham par mkhyen nas/ dang po ye shes dbang po la gsol te bsgyur/ de la lung dang po lung sde bzhi las lung ring po dang / gang po'i rtogs pa brjod pa nyung ngu zhig bsgyur/mngon pa'i mdo nyan thos kyi bka' bo bsgyur/ kha cig na re/ 'dul ba la dge 'dun phal chen sde ni khrims yangs ches pa dang / gnas brtan sde dang gsumani ma bsgyur/ nyan thos kyi 'dul ba dang / mdo sde lung ring po dang zer/ mdo sde dang theg pa chen po'i chos mngon pa'i ltos rim bsgyur/ tan+t+ra las/ ma hā yo ga mu stegs dge ba la gzud pa'i slad du gtsang rme med par bstan pa chos kyi dbyings ji lta bu ni ma rtogs par log par 'dzin cing 'jug par 'gyur bas ma bsgyur/ sngags yo ga nus pa che yang bod la nus pa mi 'byung bas dus der ma bsgyur/ bram ze rnams dge ba la gzud pa'i slad du kri ya gsung pa dang / yang bod gtsang sbra chung bas ma bsgyur/ a nu yo ga rme bag can la bstan pas bod rnam rtog che bas ma bsgyur/ u pa ya bod la ran par rtsis nas ye shes dbang pos gsol te bsgyur/ mdo sde dang gzungs rgya gar yul du ma lus pa tsam du bsgyur/ rgyal po'i thugs la ma bcags pa tsam gcig bsgyur/ de nas btsan po'i zhal nas/ ye shes dbang po na re/ rgya gar dang / rgya nag gi chos theg pa chen po'i chos dpe phal cher bsgyur ba las/chos dpe thams cad dpal shri na len+d+ra na yod pa mes tshig/ der ma tshang bar yod pa shas gcig ma bsgyur bar yod pa nga'i yid la bcags so gsungs/ de tshe nus pa yod pa kun gyis bka'i rgya dpe rnyed tshad bsgyur/ 'tsho ba thams cad bla chen po nas sbyar te/ tshang mang ke ru gling nas g.yos pa byas te rab tu

༄༅//sba gsal snang gi bzhed pa bzhugs/ 139byung pa sum brgya la zas sna bcu gsum 'dren pa'i lag dpon jo mo byang chub rjes mdzad/ gdan non pa dang / rgyas pa'i bam po re la shog dril re byas nas 'don te/ nang ma re la 'bum cho re bka' bsgrags so// dus der blon po mgos kyi mchid nas chos ni rgyas par mdzad lags te/ da skye bo mi chos lo rgyus kyang bya bar ci gnang / zhes zhus pas/ rje'i gdung rabs dang /'bangs kyi sa bcad/ dkon mchog la phyag bla dang / ya rabs la zhes sa/gtam dang lo rgyus/ bzang po'i las thabs dang / lag rjes dang / pha mes kyi dge dang yig tshang gi lugs rgyas par bya bar mdzad gnang ngo //de dus ring zhig na mkhan po bo dhi satwa pho brang rim dgu'i 'og khang du rtas phra brgyab ste zhal chems ye shes dbang po la bzhag ste sku gshegs de'i spur khang has po ri'i rgyab tu bzhugs nas mchod rten gcig kyang bzhengs/ der btsan pos ye shes dbang po ring lugs su bkos so// slad kyi ye shes dbang po mngon par shes pa dang yang ldan/ nged rje 'bangs kyi dge ba'i bshes bsnyen lags pas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhal dang 'dra bas mdun sa yang bcom ldan 'das kyis ring lugs su bkos te bla ma'i gong du bton chos kyi bka' la btags/ thabs yig tshangs gser gyi yi ge chung ngu byin nas gral yang zhang blon chen po'i gong du 'dug gcig lha chos kyi mdun sa yang mdun sa chung ngu'i gong du phul la/ springs pa yang bcom ldan 'das kyi ring lugs kyis/zhang blon chen po'i mdun sa chung ngu bzhin gsol ba gyis shig ces rje blon 'tshogs pa'i tshe/ bka' zhal gyis zhal bstsal te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi ring lugs su bka' zhal gyis bkos/ dkon mchog gsum gyi rten bstan pa dang /nam du yang mi bzhin pa'i slad du dkon mchog gsum dang / dge 'dun gyi bshos cha las rje 'bangs rnams kyis mi gsol bar rkyen ris gcig bskul khrims bcas na/ slad rjes su legs zhes ye shes dbang pos snyan du gsol te/

140 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/rkyen ris bcad/ btsan pos ni ban+de gcig la 'bangs khyim bdun/ zhang blon gyi 'bangs khyim lnga/ ring lugs la rmas mi tshan 'ga' brlag pa dang /lung phu ral 'ga' phung ba dang / gnang chen kha cig sne'u 'phrang gis btugs te stsal pa dang / mi gcig gi sgor bran khyim dgu brgya bstsal ba dang sbyar na/sangs rgyas kyi chos bzang po 'di sku dang chab srid la sman par 'tshal te/mtha' yun du rje 'bangs kyi shul bzang po ni phye/ ngan song gsum gyi sgo ni bkag pa la sogs pa yon tan smos kyis mi lang pa gcig 'byung bar mdzad pa'i rkyen bskul pa bzhin mdzad na yang me mangs na/ slad rjes su thugs nongs chen po btud mar byung ngam/ mi phyugs la bro nad chen po byung ngam/nyi 'og gi dgra zhig dbus su byung ngam/ mu ge chen po gcig btud mar byung na/ dgongs pa mthar mi phyin pa dang / dkon mchog gsum gyi brten mi gnas pa dang / dbon sras rje 'bangs la dngos sdig chen por 'gyur ba la sogs pa log pa song cig mchi ba/ dkon mchog gsum la 'bangs khyim nyis brgya/ gang zag ban+de gcig la 'bangs khyim gsum gyi thang du bcad/ dbang dge 'dun la bskur nas/ lha ris kyi 'bangs mi bzhi la bla nas dbang mi mdzad par bgyis na/ nam du yang brtan zhing legs/ zhes gsol pa dang /ye shes dbang pos gsol ba bzhin 'tshal bas/ ban+de nyang ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa ye shes dbang po la g.yar mi nyan pas kun mi mchi dgu mchi ste/ mi zer dgu zer skad/ rkyen ris kyi 'bangs ni rgod/ rang rje dang / khab so'i nang yig can dang / thugs gnyen dang / bzhi bzang ngo 'tshal las su sa bzung / rje'i zhing ni gang bzang ngo 'tshal las gnang chen/ 'brong khyi 'jam gung ston gyis dbus bzung ba bzhin du bcad/ de nas nyang la sogs pas sdig pa bsags pa des ye shes dbang po sgom par gsol te khros nas dben pa lho brag mkhar chu gyi brag phug tu mchis pa'i slad na/ shul du sba dpal

༄༅//sba gsal snang gi bzhed pa bzhugs/ 141dbyangs ring lugs su bkos/ ye shes dbang po lho brag du bsgom pa las/stag la ga sha bkal ba'i 'og tu sba zam btsugs te btsan gyi brag phug tu mchis na/ ri bya sna tshogs kyang rdo shing la babs pa bzhin ye shes dbang po'i lus la gnas/ khrims zla dag la nyer yang mi btub/ de'i tshe rgya nag gi hwa shang ma hā ya na bya ba gcig brag dmar du mchis pa la/ des lus ngag gi chos bya mi dgos/ lus ngag gi dge bas sangs mi rgya/ dran pa med cing yid la byar med pa bsgom pas sangs rgya zer nas bsgom bslabs pas/ bod kyi ban+de ril po phal gyis kho'i chos la bslabs te/ bsam yas la mched pa 'phro bcad/slob gnyer dang lus ngag gi dge sbyor 'phro bcad/ sba rat+na (ye shes dbang po)dang / be+e ro na tsa na dang / dpal dbyangs la sogs nyung shas gcig bo dhi satwa'i chos slob/ der lta ba ma mthun nas rtsod de 'khrugs pas/ btsan pos rgya'i ston pa'i chos 'di bag tsam mnal ba min nam byas pas ston min pa bya bar grags/ cig shos na re/ drang srong bzod par smra bas lus la me btang nas kyang mchod pa phul bas sems can la brtse ba'i bsam pas tshogs bsags pa gal che zer bas/ rgyal po na re lus la me gtong pa'i brtse ba de yang chos min nam byas pas rtse min pa bya bar grags/ spyir lta ba dang spyod pa 'dzom pa'i chos gcig yin par rtse min pa'i ltar yin nam gsung pas/ ston min pa yi chad pa ltar byas nas/ ma hā ya na'i slob ma las/ myang sha mis rang gi sha btubs/ snya bye ma la dang / rngogs rin po ches rang gi pho mtshan brdungs/ rgya'i ston pas rang gi mgo la me btang te/ gzhan ma rnams kyang chu gri re re srel zhing rtse min pa ril te bsad la/ nged kyang ril phru ma'i ngos te 'khrul pa'i ngos la mchi'o// zer ba de btsan po'i snyan du brdas pas gsan te/ rgyal pos ban+de ston rtsen gnyis de'i bar du gnya' g.yas g.yon bskor nas 'dir ban+de kun lta ba ma mthun nas 'khrugs pa la ji ltar mdzad kyang ma

142 ༄7//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/mkhyen pa dang / ji ltar bya zhes ni bka' sprin springs par ye shes dbang po pho brang du shog shig ces pho nya du ma gcig brdzangs pa las ma khugs nas/nang blon kham pa btang te khyod kyis ye shes dbang po khug na khyed la zangs chen po bya dgar sbyin/ ma khugs na khyod gsod de zhes bka' bstsal te/sgrom bu bskur nas btang ngo // kham pas mkhar chur phyin/ bka'i sgro ma bu brag phug tu bskur te btang nas zhal mjal bar ci gnang zhes zhus pas/zhal mjal nas bdag dong rkang gtsugs te 'ongs nas/ byon na shin tu thugs la btags te bdag la bya dga' yang gnang par bdog go// ma byon na bdag gsod par yod pas brag g.yang 'di la 'chong te 'gum mo zhes zhus pas/ bka' zhal gyis bstsal ba bzhin ye shes dbang po'i zhal nas/ 'dir nga'i dge sbyor la bar chad byed pa'i bdud chen po zhig 'ongs na 'on kyang khyod kyi srog dbyung gi/ nga 'ong bas rta khrid de shog gcig ces gsungs nas/der dga' ches te pho brang du slar 'ongs pas/ 'phral du zangs chen po dang bya dga' che thang du bstsal/ chibs gu ru bcu drug gtad de btang pa la/ ye shes dbang po spyan drangs te pho brang nang du 'ongs nas spyan sngar mchis te/zhal sngar phyag bstsal ba dang / btsan po'i zhal nas/ ban+de dag 'di ltar 'khrugs na/ zhes lo rgyus zhib tu gsungs nas de ji ltar bya gsung / ye shes dbang pos gsol pa/ de la bdag 'dir dgug mi 'tshal/ bdag 'dir ma mchis te sgom pa'i bar chad ma byung na/ lha sras kyi sku tshe dang / bdag gi tshe yang yun ring du gnas/ lha chos kyang byams pa gshegs kyi bar du gnas par 'gyur ba zhig na/ bod la skal ba ma mchis pas lan/ mkhan po 'da' khar 'di skad gsungs te/ yong ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gar byung par mu stegs kyi rgol ba'i dgra re 'gran du 'ong ba yang 'byung rgyu yin na/ bod yul du bstan pa lnga brgya'i tha ma la 'byung pas/ mu stegs kyi rgol ba ni mi 'byung /

༄7//sba gsal snang gi bzhed pa bzhugs/ 143sangs rgyas pa nyid lta ba mi mthun te rtsod par 'gyur gyis/ de lta bu byung na/nga'i slob ma kā ma la shi la bya ba cig bal yul na 'dug pa spyan drongs la/ de dang shags 'gyed du chug la/ rgyal pos brkums gyis shig rtsod pa chos phyogs su zlum par 'gyur ro// zhes mkhan po 'da' khar gsungs/ da yang de ltar mdzad du bab/ zhes gsol nas/ btsan pos kā ma la shi la 'gus su bal yul du pho nya btang pa dang / ston min pa dpon g.yog (25 4)sum brgyas shes rab 'bum blangs te bsam gtan gling sgo bcod zla ba bzhi'i bar du bshags bslabs/ dgongs pa nges par 'grel ba ni rtog pas dril te chos min zer nas bor/ de'i tshe kā ma la shī la ma byon gyi bar du ye shes dbang pos hwa shang gi lta ba dang / bo lha satwa'i lta ba dang / rtse min gyi lta ba ji ltar lags pa ril snyan du gsol pa las/ lha sras kyi dgongs pa yang khrol te dgyes ches nas/ dbu btud de ye shes dbang po ni nga'i ā tsar+ya' zhes yang yang gsungs te/ ye shes dbang po'i zhabs la phyag btsal nas bka' bstsal ba'i rjes la/dus phyis kā ma la shī la rlung tshugs la thon zhes pho nya bltar btang / rje blon yos chab khar bsu ba la byon pas/ hwa shang 'khor dang bcas pa yang chab khar byon/ kā ma las chab phar kha nas rgya'i paṇ+ḍi ta la gzung 'dzin gnyis kyi lan bya bar sgra tshad gsungs nas/ chags shing dbu la lan gsum bskor bas khams gsum du rtsis 'khor bya ba'i brda/ hwa shang chab tshur kha na ber gyi thu ba nas bzung nas sprugs/ gnyis gas go te lan btab/ hwa shang na re/'jig po cig 'dug zer/ de nas kā ma la shī la byon pa dang / byang chub gling du salha'i khri bcas te/ btsan po gung la bzhugs te ston brtsen rtsod pa 'gran par byas nas/ hwa shang g.yas su seng ge'i khri la bzhag bzhug la ston min gyi slob ma rnams mang ste/ jo mo byang chub dang / bsru yang dag dang / ban+de laṅka la sogs pa mang ste gral ring por byung / kā ma la shī la g.yon du seng ge'i

144 ༄༅//(sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/khri la bzhag rjes la brtsen min gyi slob ma rnams la sba dpal dbyangs dang /be+e ro tsa na dang / sba raṇ+ḍa la sogs pa dge slong mi mang ba zhig ste nyung shas gcig las ma byung / btsan po mkhan po gnyis dang / ston brtsen gyi ban+de kun la me tog dkar po'i phreng ba re re lag tu phul nas/ btsan po lha sras kyi bka' bstsal pa/ nga'i mnga' ris kyi 'bangs bod nag po la zhen pa rnams kyi don du/ rgya gar yul nas za hor gyi rgyal po'i bu bo lha satwa spyan drangs te/bod mi nyung shas cig chos la bkod/ dad pa can shas gcig rab tu byung /lha khang 'ga' zung bzhengs te dkon mchog gsum gyis rten btsugs nas 'bangs kun la lha chos slob du bcug pa las dad pa can nyung shas gcig rab tu byung ba'i 'og tu hā shang ma hā ya na 'dir phyin pa las bod kyi ban+de phal che ba gcig hā shang la bslabs/ kha cig ni bo rnyi satwa'i slob ma yin pas hā shang gi ltar slob tu ma btub ste/ ston brtsen gnyis su ched/ de gnyis ma mthun nas 'khrugs pa la/ nga'i zhal ches hā shang gi slob ma rnams ma rengs ste/nyang sha mis rang gi sha btubs nas shi/ rgya'i hā shang me mgo ni rang gi mgo la me btang nas shi/ rdogs (rngags/ rngogs)rin po che dang / snya bye ma las ni rang gi pho mtshan brdungs nas shi/ gzhan rnams kyang chu gri re re bsrel zhing brtse min pa ril bsad la bdag kyang phru ma'i ngos la mchi zer nas ngas de ltar byed du ma gnang bar gnya' g.yon bskor ba yin/ brtse min pa'i mkhan po bo rnyi satwa yin/ bo rnyi satwa slob ma kā ma la shī la yin pas/ khyed 'dir 'ongs pa dang / hā shang dang khyed gnyis shes pa bsdur la gtan tshigs gang zab la su gtan tshigs ngan pa des nga rgyal ma byed par chos lugs bzhin du me tog gi phreng ba phul gcig ces bka' bstsal pa'i tshe/ de la hā shang na re/nga gzhi la snga bas ngas 'dri'am lan gdab gsung / kā ma la'i zhal nas/khyed kyi dgongs pa ltar dam bca' bzhog gcig ces pa'am/ bshags thog

༄༅//sba gsal snang gi bzhed pa bzhugs/ 145cig gsung ba dang / hā shang na re/ thams cad sems kyi rnam par rtog pas bskyed pas/ mi dge ba'i dbang gi las dge mi dge mtho ris dang ngan song gi 'bras bu myong zhing 'khor ba na 'khor ro// gang zhig ci la yang mi sems zhing / ci yang yid la mi byed pa de 'khor ba las yongs su thar bar 'gyur ro//de lta bas na ci la yang mi bsam mo// sbyin pa la sogs pa'i chos spyod rnam bcu spyod pa ni skye bo dge ba'i 'phro med pa/ blo zhan pa/ dbang po btul po rnams la bstan pa yin/ sngon blo sbyangs pa dbang po non po dag la sprin dkar nag gnyis gang gis kyang nyi ma sgrib pa ltar/ dge sdig gnyis gas kyang sgrib pas de bas na ci la 4/nga mi sems/ ci la yang mi rtog ci yang mi spyod pa ni mi dmigs pa cig char 'jug pas bcu pa dang 'dra'o// ces gsungs pa dang /ā tsar+ya kā ma las smras pa/ de ltar ci yang mi bsam zer ba ni so sor rtog pa'i shes rab spangs pa yin no// chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin chos dbyings rnam par mi rtog pa de ni so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis rtogs dgos pa yin/yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi rtsa ba ni so sor rtog pa'i shes rab yin na de spangs pas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i ye shes sam shes rab kyang spangs par 'gyur na/ so sor rtog pa'i shes rab med par rnal 'byor pa thabs gang gis rnam par mi rtog pa la gnas par 'gyur/ gal te chos thams cad dran pa med cing yid la byar med pa yin na/ nyams su myong ba thams cad mi dran cing yid la bya bar mi nus so// gal te bdag gis chos gang yang dran par mi bya/yid la mi bya'o snyam na ni/ de nyid dran pa shin tu yid la byas par 'gyur ro//dran pa dang yid la bya ba med pa tsam po la bya skad na/ de gnyis dpyad dgos te/ med pa ni rgyur mi rung ste/ dran pa med pa tsam gyis rnam par rtog par mi 'gyur/ brgyal ba dang / ra ro ba dang / bog pa'i dus su yang dran pa med pas rnam par grol bar 'gyur ro// de lta bas na yang dag pa'i so sor rtogs

146 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/pa med par rnam par mi rtog par 'jug pa'i thabs med do// dran pa tsam po bkag kyang yang dag pa'i so sor rtog pa med na chos thams cad ngo bo nyid med pa la ji ltar 'jug nus/ ngo bo nyid med pa stong nyid ma rtogs na sgrib pa spong bar mi 'gyur ba kho na'o// stong pa nyid ma rtogs kyang dran pa med pa tsam gyis thar pa dang grol bar 'gyur na khams gong ma'i lha thams cad thar par 'gyur ba'o// dran pa ci yang med pa'i rmongs pa'i sems kyis yang dag pa'i lam rnal 'byor du ji ltar 'gyur/ de ni gnyid 'thug po'o// glen pa'i sems dang 'dra'o// dran bzhin du yang mi dran byar mi rung ngo/ dran med yid la byar med pas sngon gyis gnas rjes su dran pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa ji ltar 'gyur/ nyon mongs pa yang ji ltar spong / de bas na yang dag pa'i so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis phyin ci log gi snang ba brgyangs bsrings pa yin no// de brgyangs bsrings shing spangs pas yang dag pa phyin ci ma log pa'i snang ba rnal ma'i don je gsal je gsal rtogs par 'gyur/ de lta bu'i don nges par rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas dus gsum phyi nang thams cad stong par rtogs te/ rtogs pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar 'gyur/ lta ba ngan pa spangs par 'gyur/ de lta bu de brtan tsa na thabs dang shes rab gnyis la mkhas pas sgribs thams cad de gnyis kyi bsal nas/ spangs pa dang ye shes phun sum tshogs pa sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad thob bar 'gyur ro zhes gsu ngas so// btsan po'i zhal nas ston brtsen bshags gang brgyal pa'i 'khor kun —kyang mchid bshags thob cig ces bka' stsal pas/ dpal dbyangs na re/rgya'i bzhed pa ltar na/ cig char 'jug cing rim gyis sbyong mchi na/ pa ra mi ta ya 'dzin pa ma mchis pa'i slad du/ sbyin pa'i ming rtags bsam btang nas yongs su 'dzin pa med na sbyin pa btang pa yin/ sgo gsum chags sdang bkag pas tshul khrims yin/ khro ba med na bzod pa'i mchog lags/ le lo 'dor

༄༅//sba gsal snang gi bzhed pa bzhugs/ 147ba las brtson 'grus su ming brtags/ sems pa g.yeng ba ma mchis na bsam gtan/ chos rang dang spyi'i mtshan nyid shes na shes rab yin/ ston pa 'das nas ring zhig tu blta ba mi mthun pa ma mchis/ slad nas dbu ma rnam gsum ma mthun te rtsod par 'gyur/ da lta ston rtse gnyis lta ba ma mthun te/ ston min pa cig char 'jug ces zer te/ yang dag pa ma rtogs ma 'jal bas de ltar gyur/ 'jug sgo tha dad kyang sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa gcig ces 'bras bu 'dod pa la spyi mthun pa skad du smras/ ye shes dbang pos smras pa/cig char 'jug bya ba dang rim gyis 'jug ces bya ba 'di gnyis dpyad dgos te/ rim gyis 'jug na rtsod rgyu ma mchis te de dang 'dra'o// cig char 'jug na khyed da rung ci byed/ dang po nas sangs rgyas na ci nyes/ de bas na ri la 'dzeg pa la yang gom pa'i re re nas 'dzegs dgos te/ gom pa gcig gis bsgrod mi nus pa ltar sa dang po thob pa yang rab tu dka' na thams cad mkhyen pa thob pa lta ci smos/ ci yang ma byas par sangs rgyal ba ni khyed la bstan pa'i khungs dgos/ ston brtse mi 'dra ste/ nged brtse min la gsungs rab kun bslabs/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi shes rab rnam gsum la brten nas don ma nor bar shes te chos spyod rnam bcu la bslabs te bsgoms pas/sa dang po la bzod pa yang thob/ yang dag pa'i skyon med par yang 'jugade nas sa dgu yang dag pa'i shes rab kyis rim par sbyangs/ pha rol du phyin pa bcu la bslabs/ rgyud sbyangs/ tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas sangs rgyas mnyes pa lags na/ khyed ltar tshogs gnyis ma bsags/ slob ma sbyangs par 'jig rten gyi bya ba yang mi shes na thams cad mkhyen pa thob pa dang / rig pa dang shes bya thams cad la 'jug pa ji ltar 'gyur/ sangs rgyas rang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pa de'i rgyu ci las grub na tshogs gnyis las grub pa yin/stong pa gcig pus rang la yang ma phan na gzhan gyi don lta ga la grub/ tha na

148 ༄7//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/lus srog mtsho ('tsho)ba la'ang zas dang skom dang gos la sogs pa rtsol grub byas pa la brten te 'tsho dgos na/ de dag la ma brten na 'gum ste/ zas ma myong na zhag bdun ltogs te 'chi na/ thar pa bsgrub pa la chos spyod rnam bcu bya dgos pa lta ci smos/ de ltar khungs med cing thabs shes rab ya bral ba'i chos kyis sangs rgyas la bkur te bslus pa yin/ byang chub sems dpa' ni sems can gyi don du sems bskyed nas/ gzhan don lhur byas nas bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags te shes bya thams cad la mkhas par bslabs/ shes rabagasum la blo sbyangs te ye shes kyi tshogs bsags/ sgrib pa gnyis sbyangs/blo'i dri ma thams cad sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god par mdzad pa'i 'phrin las 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du 'byung ba lhun gyis grub pa yin par lung du ma nas gsungs so// ci yang mi sems pa ni sgo nga dang 'dra'o// mi brtags par gom pa 'dor kyang brdegs 'chos te 'gro na chos ga la rtogs de bas na mdo sde chub par klags/ zhi gnas dang mthong dben par yin la byas/ rtogs pa yid la myong ba shar/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i don du tshogs bsags te sems ji lta bu zhe na/ kun rdzob sgyu ma lta bu la don dam par de ma skyes par rtogs te/chos thams cad chu shing gi snying po lta bur ma bcos par rtogs na dus gsum mi dmigs par 'gyur te/ chos dang gang zag la bdag ma mchis par rig pas bying rgod ma mchis par zung 'brel du ngang gis 'jug pa lags te/ sgom pa yang de ltar lags ces mchi ba dang / ston min pas bshags lan smra ba ma spobs te me tog dor nas pham blangs so//yang lugs gcig la/ rgya nag gi dge slong byung nas/ kho na re tshig la snying po med/ tha snyad kyi chos kyis sangs mi rgya/ sems rtogs na dkar po chig thub yin pas des chog zer nas/ de'i chos lugs kyi bsdos bsam gtan nyal ba'i 'khor lo/ bsam gtan gyi lon/ yang lon/ lta ba'i rgyab

༄༅//sba gsal snang gi bzhed pa bzhugs/ 149sha/ mdo sde brgya bcu khungs zhes bya ba'i bsdos lnga brtsams nas/ rgya nag gi chos lugs dkar po chig thub 'di bod khams thams cad du 'phel lo/ der rgya nag gi chos lugs dang rgya gar gyi chos lugs ma mthun nas/ sba ye shes dbang po bsrung ba lho brag nas rgyal pos spyan drangs te/ rgya gar dang rgya nag gi chos lugs gang bden dris pas/ ye shes dbang po'i zhal nas/ 'o ko la slob dpon zhi ba mtshos zhal chems 'di bzhag ste/ bod khams 'di slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gan4kyis bstan ma bcu gnyis la gtad pas mu stegs ni mi 'byung pa/ 'on kyang nyin mtshan dang g.yas g.yon/ yar ngo mar ngo dang /chos dag ma dag gnyis 'byung ba rten 'brel gyi che ba yin pas/ nga 'das pa'i 'og tu rgya nag gi mkhan po zhig 'byung ste/ des thabs dang shes rab la bkur pa 'debs pa dkar po tshig thub zhes bya ba sems rtogs pa 'ba' zhig gis sangs rgya'o zhes zer ba 'byung bar gyur te/ de bcom ldan 'das kyi mdo las/ snyigs ma lnga'i nang nas lta ba'i snyigs ma zhes bya ba stong pa nyid la dga' ba yin par gsungs pas/ bod kho nar ma zad/ snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i gang zag thams cad de la dga' ba chos nyid yin/ de'i chos lugs de 'phel na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa spyi la gnod pas/ de'i tshe nga'i slob ma kā ma la shī la zhes bya ba'i mkhas pa chen po de rgya gar nas spyan drongs la/ rgya nag mkhan po dang / rtsod du chug la gang rgyal ba de'i lugs kyis shig ces lungs bstan pas/ de ltar mdzad 'tshal zhes zhus nas de nas rgya gar nas slob dpon kā ma la shī la spyan drangs/ bsam yas su khri bsham te dbus su rgyal po/g.yas g.yon gnyis su rgya nag mkhan po dang kā ma la shī la bzhag mtha' 'khor rnams kyis bskor ba'i tshe/ thams cad kyi mtshon cha bsdus lag tu me tog phreng ba gtad nas/ gang rgyal ba la btud de/ pham pa'i chos lugs bor nas/ rgyal ba'i chos lugs la 'jug par rgyal pos khrims bcas de

150 ༄7//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/ltar mi byed pa la chad pa bcad par dam bcas pa'i tshe/ kā ma la shī la'i gral du rgya gar gyi chos lugs 'dzin pa 'ga' dang blon po 'gos la sogs pa nyung zad cig las ma byung / rgya nag mkhan po'i gral du rgyal po'i btsun mo 'bro gza' byang chub dang / gzims mal ba co rma rma/ ngan lam stag ra klu gong la sogs pa tshogs shin tu che bar 'dus so// der slob dpon kā ma la shī las rgya nag gi chos lugs ji ltar yin zhes phyogs snga dris pa na/ rgya nag na re/ khyed kyi chos lugs skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nas bzungs nas spre'u shing la 'dzeg pa ltar mas 'jog yin/ nged kyi chos lugs 'di bya byed kyi chos kyis 'tshang mi rgya bas rnam par mi rtog pa bsgom nas sems rtogs pa nyid kyi sangs rgyas te khyung nam mkha' las shing rtser 'bab pa ltar yas 'babs kyi chos yin pas dkar po chig thub yin no// zhes zer ro// de la slob dpon gyis/ khyed kyi dpe don gnyis ka mi 'thad pa las/ khyung nam mkha' las blo bur du 'dab bshog rdzogs par skyes nas shing rtser 'babs sam/ 'on te brag la sogs par skyes nas rim gyis 'dab gshog rdzogs par byas te 'bab/ dang po ni mi srid kā/ gnyis pa ni rim gyis sa'i dper rung gis cig char ba'i dper mi rung de// nas rgya nag mkhan pos dpe la lan ma thebs pa dang / der slob dpon gyis khyed kyi dpe nor bar ma zad don yang 'khrul te/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i bsgom de ci rnam par rtog pa phyogs gcig bkag pa tsam yin nam/rnam par rtog pa mtha' dag bkag dgos/ dang po ltar phyogs gcig bkag pa yin no zhe na/ de ltar na gnyid dang rgyal ba la sogs pa yang rnam par mi rtog par thal/ rtog pa phyogs gcig bkag pa yod pa'i phyir ro// rtog pa mtha' dag bkag pa yin no zhes na/ de ltar na khyed mi rtog pa sgom pa'i tshe/mi rtog pa sgom snyam pa sngon du btang dgos sam mi dgos/ mi dgos na

༄7//sba gsal snang gi bzhed pa bzhugs/ 151khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad la yang bsgom skye bar thal/ sgom snyam pa'i rtog pa sngon du ma btang yang sgom skye ba'i phyir ro// mi rtog pa bsgom snyam pa'i rtog pa sngon du btang dgos na/ de nyid rtog pa yin pas mi rtog bsgoms pa'i dam bca' nyams te/ dper na nga smra bcad byas pa yin zhes brjod na smra bcad shor ba'am/ ca co ma byed ca cor 'gro ba bzhin no// zhes bya ba la sogs pa lung dang rig pas sun byung ba na rgya nag mkhan po spobs pa med par gyur ro// der rgyal pos bka' stsal pa/ lan yod na gsungs shigamakhan pos smras pa/ mgor thog brgyab pa dang mtshungs par lan mi shes so//rgyal pos bka' bstsal pa/ de ltar na slob dpon la me tog gi phreng ba phul la bzod par gsol te/ dkar po chig thub kyi chos lugs bor la lung rigs dang mi 'ga' ba rgya gar gyi chos lugs bzhin du gyis shig slad chad rgya nag gi chos lugs dkar po chig thub 'di byed pa byung na chad pa bcad ces bod khams kun tu khrims bcas te rgya nag gi dpe rnams bsdus nas bsam yas su gter du sbas so// der rgya nag mkhan po yi mug te rang gi gnas su song ngo //chos grwa der lham lus pas lhas de las spags na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'jigs khar nga'i bstan pa yang lham tsam gcig las par 'gyur ro// zhes 'khor rnams la lung bstan to zhes grag go// phyis dge ba'i bshes bsnyen mkhas pa rnams na re/ rgya nag mkhan pos chos mi shes kyang bltas cung zad shes pa zhig ste/ deng sang chos khungs ma rnams bor nas sems ngo 'phrod pa sangs rgyas bar 'dod pa dkar po chig thub du 'gro ba'i rgyu mtshan de yin gsungs/ der rgya nag mkhan po mgo la me spar te nub phyogs bde ba can du kha bstan te gda'/ gzims mal ba co rma rma rang gi dbang po brdungs nas lcebs la sogs sngar bshad pa dang mthun no// de nas btsan po lha sras kyi zhal nas/ hwa shang gi chos ston min pa cig char 'jug ces zer ba ni chos

152 ༄za//(sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/rnam bcu la skyon bkal te mi bgyid/ sems ni bying / bdag dang gzhan gyi slob sbyong gi sgo bkag ste 'phro bcad na/ sems bying zhing chos nub par 'gyur bas 'phro chod la de lta bu de khyed rang rnams ma bsgoms shig da slan chad 'o skol bod rje blon 'bangs gang gis kyang chos bya ba rnams kyis 'di ltar bya ste/spyir bod mtha' 'khob du gyur pa dang / rigs blun zhing rang dga' ba mang pas/ chos ni rtogs pa dka' zhing zab par gyur pas/ rgya gar gyi mkhas pa rab tu byung bar grags pa rgyal pos spyan drangs te yon bdag byas/ lo ts+tsha ba mkhas pas gtan la phab pa'i chos de la 'jug par bya'o// rgyal pos yon bdag ma byas/ lo ts+tsha ba mkhas pas gtan la ma phab pa'i chos de la 'jug par mi bya'o// zhes bka' nan drag tu bstsal nas/ bka' rtsigs kyi yi ge zhib mo ni gsum du mchis te/ bse'i sgom bur bcug kha la sgo lcags bstsal te rje'i phyag dbal na mchis te/ gnod sbyin dam rgya nag po la gtad/ che longagacig ni zhang blon rnams la dar bar byas/ de nas hwa shang mahā ya na gtsug lag khang gcig bzhengs nas slar rgya nag du gshegs/ sngon rgyal po gdung rabs lngar chos ma tshugs par lha sras khri srong lde btsan dang / za hor rgyal po'i bu bo rdi satwa dang / sba (skya ming sba gsal snang zer/)ye shes dbang po dang / sba (chos ming sba dpal dbyangs zer/) sang shi dang bzhis dkon mchog gsum gyi brten mchod gnas btsugs/ dam pa'i chos bod khams su rgya cher bsgrags so// der rje btsan po lha sras kyi thugs dgongs grub nas/'bangs thams cad chos la bzud cing / lha chos mi bgyir mi snang ba'i phyir dbus mtha' thams cad du slob dpon bkos/ zhang blon gyi bu tsha dang btsun mo thams cad kā li re re thogs nas chos slob du bcug go// de nas slob dpon kā ma la shī la la btsan pos chos thams cad thos bsam gyis bdag med par gtan la phab pa'i chos de ji ltar lags zhes yi gor dgod par zhus pas/

༄༅//sba gsal snang gi bzhed pa bzhugs/ 153sgom rim dang po btsan po la gnang / rje lha sras kyis gzigs pas don dgongs te/ da de'i don bstan cig gi thog tu bsgom na ji ltar bsgom zhus pas/ sgom rim bar pa brtsams nas gnang / de ltar bsgoms pas de la 'bras bu ji ltar mchi zhus pas/ sgom rim tha ma 'bras bu bstan pa brtsams nas gnang / de ma shin tu dgyes pas de'i don 'grel ngang bo rnyi satwa'i dgongs pa la rgol ba byung gis dogs pa'i don du lung rigs 'brel bar dbu ma snang ba brtsams nas gnang / de nas chos 'khor gyi rkyen nyis brgya lnga bcu bla nas gnang ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyi ring lugs la/ lo re re'am zla ba gcig la zer/ de la nas khal bdun bcu rtsa lnga/ na bza' ni mang la 'phan gyi blangs las sbyor yang zer/ na bza' phrug dgu re re/ spos mar srang stong gcig brgya/ chibs 'og theg pa re re/ shog bu des (ldeb )bzhi/ gnag tsha yug gsum/ lan tshwa zad len/ chims bu'i sgom chen nyi shu rtsa lnga la/ nas khal lnga bcu rtsa lnga lnga/ spos mar srang brgyad brgya brgyad brgya/ chibs pa re re/na bza' drug phrug re/ chos grwa'i slob dpon du bkod ba bcu gsum la nas khal lnga bcu rtsa lnga lnga/ na bza' phrug re/ chab mar sung brgyad brgya brgyad brgya/ chims kyi ban+de rang ga rnams la gang zag re re la nas khal brgyad brgya/shog bu deb gnyis gnyis/ gnag tsha sug re/ slob gnyer ba nyi shu lnga la/ re re la nas khal nyi shu rtsa lnga lnga/ gos sum phrug re rgyun du gnang nas/ dkon mchog gsum gyi rten yun ring du gnas pa'i ched du rin po che'i rten la 'bangs mi khyim brgya ban+de la 'bangs mi khyim gsum gsum bcad/ 'bangs lha ris la bla nas dbang mi bya bar chad nas dbang dge 'dun la bskur nas/lha chos dar bar mdzad pa rje bka' drin che ba lags/ slad kyi btsan po slob dpon pad+ma sam+bha wa'i chos kyang 'phro lus pa la thugs ma tshim nas be+e ro tsa na dang / gtsang btsun legs grub 'tshol du btang / slar log pa la parnyi ta ma

154 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/byon pas go ba ma ches te/ rgya gar gyi bsnyan phra'i dbang du thal nas be+e ro tsa na tsha ba rong du bskrad/ kā ma la shī la mu stegs kyi gshed ma btang nas nub mo sgra bsgyur gyi gzims mal du 'khul ma mnyes nas bkrongs/ phyis sba (dpal dbyangs ) sang shi 'da' khar jo bo yid bzhin 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i sku gzugs kyi lha'i spyan chab byung / ye shes (sba gsal snang ) dbang po 'da' khar mi ma yin pa dag gis bsu ba'i sgra byung / nam mkha' las mchod pa dag kyang byung / 'phags pa la ye shes dbang po the tshom zhu zhing mchis pa'i drung du btsan po gshegs nas/ nas 'bras thug drangs te gsol nas ye shes dbang po'i zhal nas rje lha gcig gi pham phabs 'di 'tshal nas deng slan chad khams kyi zas spangs so// ting nge 'dzin dang zas su brje'o// phung po zas su brje'o//zhes mchi nas sku gshegs so// grongs pa'i dus nam mkha' las sgra byung / bya thams cad gdung pa'i skad 'don/ btsan po'i zhal nas/ ā tsar+ya chen po tshe 'da' ba dang sbyar nas kho bo'i tshe kyang ring por mi thub po zhes gsungs/yang btsan po'i zhal nas/ bar du ston min gyi tshig nyan te/ chos slob cing rnyarmā'i dpe len du yang mi kun ma btub/ rgya gar gyi dharmā'i dpe thog yid la ma bcags pa tsam blangs te bsgyur zin na/ shrī na len+d+rar rgya gar gyi dharmā mes tshig ste ma tshang ba/ rgya yul du chos byung nas lo stong nyis brgya lon te/ gsung rabs kyi dpe tshang bar bzhugs na/ rgya'i dharmā ma bsgyur ba yid la bcags so zhes gsung nas thugs ngal mdzad/ dge 'dun las chos slob kyi grwa gzug par bgyis pa las/ ye shes dbang po tshe las 'das nas slad kyis bu mo spyan ras gzigs kyi jo mo khri legs la chos slob kyi grwa gzug par gsol ba dang /jo mos btsan po lha sras kyi bsnyan du gsol ste/ btsan po chos slob kyi grwa btsugs/ sras ('di sba gsal snang gi bu mo yin/) mo spyan ras gzigs kyi rje 'bangs mi mang po'i bsod nams su brag dmar ma sa gong du mchod rten

༄༅//sba gsal snang gi bzhed pa bzhugs/ 155brgya rtsa brgyad brtsigs/ mchod rten ma tshar bar du chu mig dang sa bzang po klus btang / rdo ba rgya gar gyi yi ge can byung / rtsigs lags pa dang lha mo bco bco brgyan brgyan pa gsum gyis bskor ba byas/ spyan ras gzigs kyi rmi lam na/ snang ba mtha' yas kyi zhing khams su khyed spun 'gro bar 'dod na mchod rten 'di zhal bsros gcig sgra byung / chab 'og gi 'bangs las/ sum pa las chos la gnag pa ma mchis na/ chos la gnas shing dmigs kyis btul nas dge ba la gzud pa'i slad du/ bse dbang po'i bu mo lha ldem glang zhang blon khri gsum spegs la stsal/ bla ma'i bka' lung bzhin du/ sum pa khri lde bzhi dge ba la btsun pa/ slob ma yang brje glang bu ka rda dang / dpal gyi seng ge dang / ā tsar+ya la sogs pa lags te/ bla nas slob ma gang bzang / gang mkhas/ gang mang / ring lugs nyang sha mi dang / sgrun pa las lha ldem stangs bzang nas bya dga' che thang du bran khyim bcu gnyis la sogs pa stsal/ glang ril dge ba la btsud/ glang klu rgod dang stag tshab ni chos bgyid du ma nyan pas rgyas mgo bcad de bskum/ klu rgod ni dbal gza'i nang nas dad pa che ba dbal gza' legs btsun blon che la slangs nas mna' mar gsal te bon bcad de lha chos bgyis nas dad pa skyes pas legs pa mang / dharmā 'dzangs blun mthong nas klu rgod rab tu byung / sum pa blon spog mda' phan chad/chos la dga' bar 'gyur/ bar du bsam yas kyi dge 'dun bshos chad nas kha shugs su btang / kha so ni zhig gtsug lan khang gi rmang ni byi brun gyis gang /gnas khang kun gyi sgo yang rkun mas khyer skad/ de 'gem shān+ti khams na 'dug pas thos te mi dga' nas gsol byang bris te bsogs shang thogs nas bod yul du mchis pa dang / jo bo khri ma legs kyi bsnyan du brdas nas byang bu spyan sngar brims te bka' bstsal pa/ ban+de spyir dad pa che zhing chos gzugs par dgongs pa ni ma nos na/ glang tshig brdos pas chad pas bcad na ma legs

156 ༄7//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/sam zhes byung ba thos na/ shārnying mi dga' ste/ nyal ba'i rmi lam na/ bud med dkar mo bco bco gcig na re/ khyod kyis bsam yas khab so gzugs (gzigs)par 'dod na/ chos dang po bod khams su sba ye shes dbang pos gtsugs te/ de'i sras mo gnyis zhig has po'i drung na 'dug gis de dang 'phrod la dkon mchog gi mchod pa cher gyis shig 'on kyang bsam pa 'grub par 'gyur ro zhes thos nas/ dga' ches te brag dmar du mchis nas ye shes dbang po'i bu mo btsal bas/ spyan ras gzigs shārnyis rmi lam la ji skad byung ba bzhin bzlas nas/ khab so tshugs shig chos bstan par bgyi ba'i slad du byams pa dang mngon par byang chub gzugs pa'i byad shān+tis ni 'tshong 'dus pa la blangs/ dge ldem gyis dgos dgu sbyar te mchod pa bgyi bar chad pa las/ ring lugs ban+de laṅka'i mchid nas/ 'di ltar mchod pa byed cing dge ldem cha bar nos kyis chad pa spangs pas bcad do zhes bsgo nas/ gnas brtan gnyis kyang bskrag te/ mchod pa bgyi ba'i yo byad rnams 'ga' yang gar du ma ster/ shīn+ti dang spyan ras gzigs la sogs pa yon bdag stod rim kun bskrag te mchod pa btang par bgyis pa las/ dge ldem gyi rjo mo byang chub tu gsol nas/ jo mos gro nas khal bdun/ mar ba lam gcig 'thud nas mchod pa ma bshol bar bgyis/ bsam yas kyi sku gzugs lder tsho re re la lha bshos bre thag pa'i rkyen/ bag phye bre gsum gyi rkyen thang du drangs te mchod/ dge 'dun dang skye bu chos ston gsol/ le'u blon chen klu smas gser sung nyi shu rtsa lnga'i ske rags g.yus spras pa gcig dar yug gnyis/ ras yug gsum phul/ dge ldem gyis 'bru sna lnga las khal sum bcu rtsa gnyis phul/ban+de spyan ras gzigs kyis 'bangs khye'u gcig phul/ rgyams blon klu skyes kyis nas khal bcu gcig phul/ de la sogs pa bus pa yan chad kyis ral dgu yan chad phul nas/ jo mo lcam gyis chibs gcig bra nas khal nyis brgya/

༄7//sba gsal snang gi bzhed pa bzhugs/ 157za 'og yug gcig dar yug gnyis phul/ slad kyis dge ldem gyis nas khal dgu phul/ dge 'dun gyis kyang byams pa dang / mngon par byang chub pa la yon sna sna nas phul/ slad kyi mngon par byang chub pa btsugs pa'i tshe jo mo lci pho yong bza' 'ched/ mkhan po shārnyi dang / sba gza' dge ldem la sogs pas mngon par byang chub pa snga ma bzhin btsugs so// de nas spyan ras gzigs rang gis rang 'gum pa'i dus btsal tu phu na sgom zhing mchis pa las tshe 'das so//kha gcig na re/ ye shes dbang po 'da' khar btsan pos yab 'bangs kyi 'bras chan gsol nas deng slan chad khams kyi zas spangs nas/ ting nge 'dzin dang chos kyi zas dang brje'o// ces gsungs nas/ grongs pa'i dus su nam mkha' las sgra byung / bya thams cad gdung pa'i skad 'don/ gdung khang has pu ris mar snar brtsigs na legs bya ba byung / sba ye shes dbang po'i bu mo spyan ras gzigs kyis/ pha'i mchod rten rtsar mchod rten brtsig pa'i sa klus bstan/ de'i rdo la rgya yig byung / mchod rten la lha mo gsum gyi bskor ba byed cing / su bde ba can du 'gro 'dod pa des mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad po 'di la bskor ba kyis zer ba dang / btsan po lha sras kyi zhal nas/ ā tsar+ya'i gsungs dang sbyar na kho bo'i tshe kyang yun ring po mi thub ces thugs la mdzad nas thugs las chung ngu la gzhol par bzhed nas/ paṇ+ḍi ta gcig spyan 'dren du btang pas/ ā tsar+ya bi ma la mi tra byon nas slob dpon pad+ma sam+bha wa'i chos 'phro zhus nas sgom mdzad par bzhed nas/ sras mu ne btsan po la chab srid bkos pa dang / blon zhang bu ring btsan po la bgo ba'i gros/ dbu rtse'i bar khang gi rnga khang na byed cing bzhugs pa/ jo mo me sgron gyis mthong ste/ thugs gtum pas dogs 'tshal nas chab srid sna nam pa la ster bar nges snyam nas/mu tig btsan po la gsol bas/ lha sras kyi 'u rings sgo bar du chu gri gsal

158 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/nas bskul/ yab na re/ btsun bzhir gar song ces pa dang / gri khrag can de bor nas 'u rings rgyang ring por song / zhes zer te bar khang du bros/rje'i thugs dam 'gyangs nas/ g.yar mchu par dogs nas thugs ma bde ste/blon 'dzangs pa kun gros byas nas/ blon chen po 'gos kyis zhal che dga' gsum du bcad/ chab srid mu ne btsan po mnga' bar gyis/ ces gsungs nas mi chos thun tshogs bskyar ma mdzad nas/ yab gzung mkhar du bsgom du gshegs so// btsan po mnga' bdag gi bka' rtsigs kyi yi ge zhib mo gsum las/ gcig lha sa na yod/ gcig khams su khyer/ gcig rje'i phyag na bzhugs so/ /

159chos 'byung gi yi ge zhib mo/rigs gsum mgon po'i rnam 'phrul gyis// sha za gdong dmar 'dul mdzad pa'i// mes dbon gsum la phyags (phyag)'tshal te// chos 'byung yi ge zhib mo bri// btsan po lde gtsug btsan gyis mes srong btsan gyi bka' chems kyi yi ge 'bying pa'i phyag mdzod na blon po 'gar gyis zangs kyi byang bu la bris nas sbas pa de bltas pas/ nga'i dbon sras kyi ring la rgyal po lde zhes bya ba'i ring la dam pa'i lha chos 'byung / de bzhin gshegs pa'i rjes su rab tu byung ba/ lha dang mi'i mchod gnas kyang mang du 'byung / de la rang dang gzhan/ 'di dang phyi ma mtho ris dang thar pa thams cad kyi bde ba 'byung pas/ nga'i dbon sras rje blon rnams kyis 'tsho ba bla nas sbyor/ chab 'og nas bde ba byin la dbu'i mchod gnas su khur cig ces bya ba bris nas 'dug pa de gzigs pas/ lde zhes bya ba de nga yin par dgongs nas bran kha mu le ko sha dang / snyags dzha na ku ma ra dang gnyis rgya gar du chos tshol du btang bas/paṇa ṭi ta dpal sangs rgyas gsang ba dang / sangs rgyas zhi ba gnyis gangs ti se la sgom mo zhes thos te/ de gnyis spyan drangs pas spyan ma 'drongs/ de gnyis kyi thugs la mdo sde lam rnam par 'byed pa dang / gser 'od dam pa'i mdo gnas pa de gnyis spyan drangs nas rgyal po'i mchod gnas su phul/de'i bzhugs khang lta bur lha khang lnga bzhengs ste lha sa mkhar brag/ brag dmar 'gran bzangs/ mching phu nam ral/ brag dmar ka chu/ ma sa gong gi

160 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/gtsug lag khang dang lnga bzhengs pas/ zhang blon kun rtse bro chag ma dga' nas nged kyi btsan po 'di ni dad pa che ba'am chos la dga' la byad mi mtshar bas/bram ze yin nam zhes glengs te/ de rje'i snyan du bon bas rje'i zhal nas bram ze yin na nga'i khab 'jang mo khri btsun 'di la/ bu nga bas kyang dad pa che la byad mi sdug pa cig shog nga btsan po ma nor cig yin na bu zhang blon rnams kyi sangs rgyas mi thub pa cig shog ces dmod gtsugs so// khri btsun la sras lha'i bu pho 'dra ba/ sna'i gzangs mtho la dpral ba'i dbyes che ba shin tu mdzes pa cig btsas pas/ zhang blon rnams na re bod kyi btsan po ni rgyal po yang dag pa'o zer/ sras 'di ni mi min lha'i dbon po yin no zer nas ming kyang 'jang tsha lha dbon du gsol/ de la khab ran par gyur tsam na bod thams cad spre'u yi bu yin pas 'di'i jo mor mi 'os/ 'di la rgya'am rgya'i bu mo zhig blang bar chad/bod kyi rgyal po la bzang pa mes srong btsan yin te/ ar+ya pa lo'i sprul par grags/ de'i gnyen zla rgya rje kong co 'phrul chung yin/ de yang ar+ya pa lo'i sprul par grags/ de'i sras mo kong co yin/ de la gtsug lag gi gab tse sum brgya drug bcu yod/ rgya nag gtsug lag gi rgyal por grags pa de'i sras rgya rje brom shi hwan/ de'i sras rgya rje the ba/ de'i sras rgya ham phan/ de'i sras rgya rje gcen bzang / de'i sras rgyal rje li khri zher lang dmig ser bya ba da lta bzhugs pa de'i sras mo gying shang kong co bya ba de blang par rigs so mchi na/snyags khri bzang yang ston dang 'khor sum bcu gnye bor btang nas/ rgya rje la pho nya bas sgrom bu phul bas bu mo byin nas/ kong co la 'phrul gyi me long yod pa bltas pas bod kyi yul yar lung bzang pa dang / de'i rgyal bu byad legs pa mthong nas 'ongs so// bod kyi rgyal bu grongs nas bang so skyi'u rtsig pa'i tshe na kong co 'phang thang du byon pas rgyal bu yin zer nas rgad po ag tshom can

༄༅// chos 'byung gi yi ge zhib mo/ 161las mi gda' bas/ byad kyi lta cha yin nam me long gi lta cha yin snyam nas yid ma dga' nas/ nyin mo zhing ngu tam 'bu ra bteg nas glu len/ mtshan mo zhing mchu sbrang gis ram bu bteg cing / rgya gar yul na dam pa'i chos bdog ste bal yul tshad pa che/ de la bsams na bsam thag chad/ rgya nag yul na ju bzhag gi spyad yod de pha yul shul thag ring / de la bsams na bsam thag chad/ bod yul dbus na rje rgyal gyi mi yod de blon po gdug pa che/ bod kyi blon po sdig po che zer zhing klu len te/ de blon pos rje'i snyan du bon pas/rje'i zhal nas da mo la skyes bskur la pha yul du skyol ces byung / de snyan du gsol bas kong co na re rgyal bu legs pa cig yod pa lta na nga dang las ma mthun pa yin pas pha yul du 'chi ba mi spobs shig/ da mes dang 'du'o mchi/phyis kong co na re nga'i ne ne mo kong co'i mchod gnas gser gyi lha shwakya mu ne zhal lta'o zer nas rgya rtags ra mo che na lha mi bzhugs nas kun du mchod pa byed cing btsal bas ma rnyed nas/ ra sa'i lha khang du mchod pa byas pas/gtsang khang sgo lnga'i phud rabs 'dug pa la gtsang khang bzhi las med/ 'di na gtsangakhang gcig yod par nges zhes glo 'bur gyi ya lad kyi 'og tu brdungs pas ser ka byung / de brkos nas sgo bye ba dang gser gyi lha shwakya mu ne sbas pa mthong nas ne ne mo'i lha la zhal ston cig gsol zer nas mchod pa btsugs/blon po shi tshar la zan skal med pas nged rgya nag chos dar bas mi shi ba la bdun tshigs yod/ bod la chos ma dar bas blon po snying rje zer nas mi shi ma thag du lha mi stong tsam la 'tshal ma re 'tshal/ de la bod kyi tshe zhes bya/ phyis kong co la rgyal bu ltam/ de'i dus na rgyal po ni pho brang brag dmar zhum bu tshul na bzhugs/ yos bu'i lo spyi zla ra ba'i tshes bcu 2 la bab pa na rgya'i hwa shang na re rgyal po khyod kyi btsun mo la sras byang chub sems dpa' nges pa gcig btsa' bar nges/ de la rim gro skyed cig mchi/ nam phyed na mchod rten brgya rtsa

162 ༄༅//(sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/bzhengs/ 'jim pa'i lhag ma la nga'i sku tshab byed ces nas mchod rten gres thag can yang bzhengs/ nang par pho nya byung ste kong co la sras cig bltam mo mchi/ rgyal po 'phang thang du byon pa dang / kong co'i bu sna nam za yis phyogs nas 'di nga la skyes so zhes mchi/ blon po kun gyis thang rtsigs kyi bug par bu bzhag nas dus thob byed du bcug pas/ kong cos sngon la zin yang dbyi stengs kyis 'then pas btang ste/ yin lta nga'i yin te dri mo khyod khyer nas bu btang / bu kong co'i yin par shes/ lo cig lon tsam na zhabs tshugs pa'i dga' ston byas te/ sna nam pas bor bu lag du thogs nas zhang po'i pang du shog zer bas/ rgyal bu na re/ khri srong lde btsan rgya tsha la/ sna nam zhang gis ṭā bgyir mchis gsung nas rgya'i pang du song pas ming yang rang gis btags de nas rgyal bu lo 4 lon pa dang / pho brang 'om bu'i tshal na bzhugs/rgya rjes rgyal po la skyes chen po bskur ba'i pho nya ba 'ba' de'u de la bu rgya phrug gar mkhan gcig yod pa de rgyal bu'i rtse zlar phul/ rgyal po dam pa'i chos mdzad par bzhed nas chos rgya gar na yod pas rgya gar gyi rgyal po'i thugs (la)bzung ba'i slad du skyes dang pho nya ba lho bal du brdzangs pas/ shul do 'bangs kyi 'phrang du khu 'bangs dgu bdun bab/ 'tsho ba chad nas gnam du bltas pas bya lnga 'phur ba la mda' bzhi dus rig tu 'phangs nas bya 4 dus gcig tu bkum/ de gnod pa che bar kun gyis glengs pa de rgyal bu brag dmar rdzi gong na rtse bas bsan/ rtse zla khyung po rtse rtse/ khyung po dum tshugs/cog la smon lam 'bar/ rgya phrug gar mkhan dang lnga rdzing nang na rtse ba'i 'dam khrod rkang pa'i 'og na srin bu dmar nar nar byung pas/ rgyal bu na re do 'bangs kyi 'phrang la 'ba' de'us dus gcig la phu ron 4bsad pa de gnod pa che'o mchis na/ srin 'di kun bsad na sdig pa che'am mi che zer/

༄7// chos 'byung gi yi ge zhib mo/ 163dug (dum) tshugs kyis mchid nas 'di lta bu'i ma nyes pa bsad na shin tu sdig che tshur gnod pa dang nya bsad na phyugs zan 'phel zer/ rgya phug skad nas rgya'i hur bya ba'i gtsug lag las 'di lta bu bsad na phur du sdig che mchi zer/ rgyal bu na re hur gyi gtsug lag las ji skad 'byung gsungs la/sangs shi'i mchid nas dge ba bcu snyan du gsol bas/ dus rtag tu de gleng pa kun gyis tshor bas 'di bgam zhes mol nas/ rgyal bus sgrom bu bskur nas sangs shi dang mi bzhi rgya'i gtsug lag len du pho nyar btang / bka' 4na du grub na bya dga' sbyin no// ma grub na bkum mo zhes bya te btang ngo // ke'u lo'u'i 'phrang la phyin/ de'i dus su rgya rje'i bum sangs dbang po'i drung na ju yag mkhas pa 1 na re/ da ste zla ba 2 na nub phyogs nas 'dir byang chub sems dpa' 1 pho nyar 'ong zhes mchi/ de ci 'dra byas pas de'i sha tshugs dang rtags 'di 'dra'o zhes mchis nas 'bag cig bris/ dbang pos de rgya rje'i snyan du gsol bas/ rgya rjes pho nya btang nas de der stod (sdod)du ma bzhug par de la rim gro skyed la mar la nga'i drung du thong bya ba byung / pho nya dus su byung nas de la rgya'i hwa shang gis phyag byas te bka' bsgo ba bzhin du byas nas mar btang pas rgya rjes kyang de la phyag byas pa dang / pho nyas kyang rgya rje la btsan po'i sgrom bu phul/ rgya rjes sgom bu dang sbyar nas brdzangs par chadabyas te/ rgya rje na re khyod 'ba' de'u'i bu yin na 'dir nga'i nang blon byar mi rung ngam gsung / de la bsams pas nga 'dir 'dug na ni tshe 'di la ni skyid na/ bod yul du lha chos bzang po'i khungs dbyung ba'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i dpe tsam ni btsan po'i phyag du phul la/ slad kyi thabs byas la snyan du gsol snyam ste/ bdag 'dir sdod par gnang pa ni bka' drin che na bod kyi btsan pos bka' nan cher stsal bas bdag gi pha stabs las kyis gum na glo ba la gcags/ slar bod du mchis la pha dang gros byas te thabs kyis

1yo ༄༅//(sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/'bangs su mchi'o zhus pas/ rgya rje na re nga'i snying du mi khyod las sdug pa ni ma byung na khyod bya dga' ci 'dod/ pho nya'i mchid nas bya dga' gnang nas sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab bam po stong zhu'o mchi ba dang / rgya rje na re khyod ke'u lo'u yi 'phrang la 'ong ba na'ang gnod pa ma byas par rim gro cher byas/ bum sangs dbang po na re'ang khyod bo lha sa twa'i sprul pa 'ong mchi/ hwa shang mngon shes can gyis kyang khyod la phyag byas/ khyod kyis spyod pa dang sbyar nas sangs rgyas kyi lung nas lnga brgya pa'i tha ma la gdong dmar gyi yul du dam pa'i chos kyi khungs 'byin pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'ong bar lung bstan pa de khyod yin par gor ma chag/ ngas kyang grogs bya yis zer nas mthing shog la gser chus bris pa'i chos bam po stong snang (gnang )/ bya dga' gzhan yang che thang du gnang nas/ pho nya lnga slar bod yul du mchi ba'i lam na pha bong 'gron po rgyu mi phod pa sus mthong pa de sbos drir 'gum pa yod/ de grong khyer eg chu'i kim hwa shang stag la ga sha bkal ba de mkhan pos bskos nas chag chur 'ongs nas pha bong bkrum nas lha khang brtsigs pa la pho nya bas bsgom lung mnos nas nga'i pha dang phrad dam/ ngas bod du mthar sangs rgyas kyi chos tshugs sam/ bod du sangs rgyas kyi gsung rabs bsgrags na bod kyi bgegs srin srog la sdo ba mi 'byung ngam/ btsan po yab sras bde 'am dris pas/ de'i mngon shes kyis bltas pas btsan po sku gshegs/ rgyal bu sku nar ma son pas blon nag po la dga' bas khrims bu chung bcas/ chos bsheg brag dmar 'gran bzangs bya ba'i thugs dam cig 'dug pa rmang nas bsgyel/ khyod kyis btsan po'i zhabs 'bring pa mdzod la slad kyis rgyal bu sku nar son pa dang / de'i zhal nas mu stegs byed kyi chos shig gleng du 'ong gis de tsa na 'di snyan du gsol cig de la rgyal bu la dad pa skye yis/ de'i rjes la 'di snyan du gsol bas rgyal bu chos byed par 'gyur ro ces lung bstan nas glegs bam 2 bskur/

༄7// chos 'byung gi yi ge zhib mo/ 165bod la chos kyi skal ba yod mthar chos rgyas par 'ong / de'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen za hor rgyal bo'i bu dge slong shan ta rak+ṣi ta zhes pa'i 'dul skal yin no gsung nas zla ba gnyis zan drangs/ de nas sang shis 'gran bzangs bshig pa glo ba la gcags nas mi lnga po rgya'i ri mgo sde'u shan gyi rtse na mi ma yin gyis na bun gyis stebs pa'i khrod na zhag bdun la brtsigs pa'i 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi pho brang yod pa las dpe len du mchis te/ mi cig gis ri la 'dzeg ma shes/ gcig gis ri rtse la phyin kyang ma mthong / cig gis lha khang mthong ste sgo ma rnyed/ cig gis sgo mthong ste dra bas bkab nas 'gro ma shes/sang shi nang du phyin nas 'phags pa la phyag byas/ de'i dpe blangs nas sgor phyin pas gcan gzan kun gyis phyag byas nas ri'i rgyab tu bskyal nas bod yul du mchis/ bod yul du yab rgyal po yar 'brog rba tshal du chibs sgron pas grongs pa dang / rgyal bu nar ma son pas zhang ma zhang grum pa skyes na re rgyal po sku tshe thung pa chos byas pas lan/ bkra mi shis tshe phyi ma len pa brdzun yin/ tshe 'di'i rkyen zlog bon bya/ su chos byed pa de pho reng du mthar gtan du sgyug da phyin chad bod la tshe byar mi gnang / ra mo che'i rgya'i lha shākya mu ne slar rgya yul du bskyal zer nas 'breng pa'i dra bar bcug nas sgor bton/ de nas sum brgyas drud pas mkhar brag gdong nas ma 'gul nas bye thams su sbas/ lha sa'i dkon gnyer hwa shang rgan po rgya yul du bskrad/ de'i lham ya gcig bod yul du lus pas de na re da dung chos me stag tsam 1 myur du 'ong mchi/ mkhar brag rmang nas bsgyel/ 'gran bzangs bsheg nas de'i gcong mching bu'i rdza la bskyal/ ra sar bzo gra btsugs bshas byas nas lder so la lpags dmar g.yogs phyag la nang grol bkal/ chos la dga' ba blon po dang 'bal 2 la skyon phab/ bod nag por btang / dus der sna nam khri thog rje thang la 'bar bya ba byang thang la brgyal nas a a zhes lan 2 tsam 'bod kyi

166 ༄༅//(sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/rgyab gas nas gum/ co ro skyes bzangs rgyal 'gong lce dang rkan dang rkang lag ril po skams te gu thul du song nas gum pas 'og gi mi dang bltas mkhan kun 'thun par rgya lha khros te sa thams bcug pas sdig che'o// rgyal lha'i mes po dang rgya yul nas 'ongs nges te/ rgya gar dang nye ba mang yul du bskyal bar chad nas bye dong nas bton nas dre'u gnyis la khyogs bgyis nas yar bskyal/de'i dus su yul ngan chen po byung / 'bangs gum pa la tshe bgyir ma gnang pa'i khrims bu chung bcas pa'i 'og tu ba lam glag na rba gsas (gsal ) snang gi bu tsha mi sring gnyis dus gcig la gum/ lha'i yab mes kun na re chos bden zer/ hwa shang la dri snyam nas/ ten khang nas hwa shang rgan po bos te/nga'i bu tsha gnyis lam bstan du gsol dang / tshe snga phyi bden nam zhus pas/tshe phyi ma yod zer bas phyi tshul du bon byas/ nang du gyod ka dang bsdos te tshe bgyis/ hwa shang na re bu tsha lhar skyes na dga' 'am bur skyes na dga' zer ba la/ pha na re lhar skyes na dga' zer/ ma na re nga rang gi bur skyes na dga' zer ba la/ bu'i rus pa la cho ga byas te gdung sha ri ram du song bas lhar lung stsal/ bu mo'i khar mu tig ldan yon cig tha ma mtshal chus bskor ba gcig byas nas yid ches pa'i rtags bgyis te/ cho ga byas rdza gog tu bcug nas ma'i mal 'og tu sbas te sangs phod khyod rang gi bur skye'o zhes lung stsal/sangs phod gsas (gsal)snang gi khab la bu skyes pa'i kha nas mu tig dmar po ldan yon de 'dra ba cig byung / mas mal 'og gi rdza gog kha phye bas shul hor re 'dug ma bslabs par zhing dang ne ne mo'i ming yang shes pas tshe phyi ma yod par yid ches nas bsgom lung mnos nas bsgom pa'i tshe/ rje'i snyan du bdag sangs rgyas kyi chos 'tshal ba'i slad du rgya yul dang bal yul du mchi byas pas/rjes zhal nas 'o na ngas mang yul gyi kha blon por bsko'i'o gsung / gsas (gsal)snang yar song pa'i 'og sang shis pho nya'i sug las bsgrubs nas

༄༅// chos 'byung gi yi ge zhib rngo / 167slar bod du mchis tsam na/ rgyal bu sku nar ma son nas rgya'i chos mching phu'i rdza la sbas/ de nas re zhig nas rgyal bu sku nar son pa dang / yab kyi yi ge cig gzigs nas zhang blon rnams dang mol ba 'dzad pas/ nga'i yab mes na re nga'i 'bangs bde ba'i tshis rgya'i le'u tsi kyang sbyar na nga'i yab mes kyi 'phrul brnyes pa 'dra zer/ blon dag na re yab mes kyi le'u tsi kyang ci 'dra mchi/ yi ge ba rgya me 'gos le'u tsi kyang klags pas btsan po na re nga'i yab mes kyis chos lugs bzang bo 1 sku nyams su bzhes so zhes zer/ de 'jig rten gyi spyod pa bzang po ci byung ba lta/ sangs shi snyam na kim hwa shang gis lung bstan pa'i dus 'di yin snyam nas/ rgya'i lha chos bzang bo byung na yab mes kyi le'u tsi kyang de 'phrul ma'i sgor yang mi chud byas pas/ btsan po'i zhal nas rgya'i lha chos bzang po de'i gtan tshigs khyod la yod dam gsung / bdag rgya la mchis pas yod mchi nas/ mching phu'i rdza las blangs te kim hwa shang gis lung bstan pa bzhin du brims pa dang / dang po dge bcu'i mdo klags/ de la rgyal bu dad pa skyes/ de nas rdo rje gcod pa klags pas rgyal bu de bas kyang dad pa cher skyes/ de nas sa lu ljang pa klags pa dang / dang pos spyod pa dag par go/ gnyis pas lta ba dag par go/ tha mas lta spyod zung 'brel du go bas chos la yid ches te/ 'di 'dra ba'i chos lugs bzang po nga'i sku (ring )brnyes pas sa byams so// gnam byams so// lha thams cad la gtang rang gtang ngo // gsas (gsal) snang na re chos mi byar mi rung ngo zhes zer ba bden/ gsas (gsal) snang la dngul g.yung drung dang gser byin/ sang shi khyod la 'phra men g.yung drung gi thog tu gser chung pa byin/ da khyed kyis rgya yul gyi dar ma dang bal yul gyi dar ma kun rgya me mgo dang / rgya a nan ta dang / mkhas pa su yod bsgyur gcig gsung / de gnyis dang sang shing dang 2 khas po ri'i byi khung na skad bsgyur ba'i drung du blon stag ra dang / zhang ma

168 ༄༅/〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/zhang 'ongs nas/ gre'o khyed 2 de na ci byed/ 'dug mi phod par bya ba mang na de ni chos kyi skad 'dra na khrims bu chung las chos byas na pho rang du gtan smyug pa ma thos sam/ snyan du ma gsol bar byi khang du kha bsubs la phyis khrims dang sbyar ba bshags gdab bam mchid drag tu gda'/ de rje'i snyan du gsol bas/ 'o na gsas (gsal) snang ma byung bar 'gyur ma bsgyur cig gsung /blon po chos la dga' ba rnams na re sang shi stod du gsas (gsal) snang gi grogs su btang mchi bas/ rje na re nga'i rgya phrug 'dzangs pa dam pa'i chos blangs pas bu yang med/ pho nyar btang bas gum na phangs ces bka' stsal/sang shi'i mchin nas kho bo rabs mi 'chad/ rgya gar na dge slong sdom pa shor bganyis yod/ de gnyis gum nas kho ba'i bur skyes mchi ba dang / blon po kun gyis sangs shi tso lung du dkor lhug tu btang / gsas (gsal) snang mang yul gyi kha blon por bskos pa yang rgya gar du thal byung du mchis nas zhang ma zhang gi lung bcag ste/ ma hwa bo lha dang shī len trar mchod pa byas yon phul/rgya'i nyen kha le har du mchod pa byas pas dgun char bab/ byang chub kyi shing la 'o ma bab 'od zer byung nas/ nam mkha' la dge'o zhes bya ba'i sgra byung /mkhas pa kun la chos bslab bal yul du 'ongs bal rje la ngo chen zhus ste/mkhas shing gsal ba shan ta rak+ṣis ta mang yul du spyan drangs nas/ gtsug lag khang gnyis brtsigs/ rkyen ris bcad/ a tsa r+ya la yon phul nas sems bskyed zhus pas/ nga la yon phul gsung / gser dngul la sogs pa rin po che dang / zo rid dang bya skyogs dang / snam gos dang / dar zab dang / go ru dang thams cad phul/ da rung phul cig gsung / cang ṇa lus la btsal ba'i ska rags dang / rad pa'ang phul/ sems bskyed pa dang slar 'bul ba tshur gnang nas/ khyod skye ba 'dir ngo shes pa ma zad/ de skye ba du ma'i sngon rol nas sems bskyed pa'i sras kyi thu bo yin pas/ khyod kyi ming yang ye shes
