༄༅// chos 'byung gi yi ge zhib mo/ 169dbang bo bya bar 'gyur ro gsung nas mgo la byil byil mdzad/ gsas (gsal)snang gi khang par bshos gsol ba'i rjes la slob dpon bod du byon nas bod kyi btsan po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mdzad par ci gnang zhus pas/nga bod kyi 'dul skal yin/ bod kyi khri btsan po dang khyod ma skyes pas bod kyi rgyal po gdung rabs dgu rjes kyi bar du bal yul dang za hor du phar 'gro tshur 'gros sdod sdod cing 'dug da khri btsan po dang khyod gnyis kyang nar son nas dus la bab pas ngas bod kyi khri btsan po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen byas la yul byan dkar du chu bo lo hi ta ra'i 'gram/ ri khas pu ri'i drung du/dpal brag dmar bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa zhes bya ba'i gtsug lag khang gcig kyang bzhengs su gsol zhes gsung / a tsa r+ya slar bal yul du gshegs/gsas (gsal) snang gis sarba wa se byas/ chos bslabs/ rkyen ris su bkum/ gsas (gsal) snang mar 'ongs/ pho brang rlung tshubs su mchis nas rgyal po dang zhal mjal ba'i pho nya btang pas tshes cig la mjal ba'i bka' gnang nas rje la zhe sa phul bas/ rje'i zhal nas gsas (gsal)snang khyod chos sha stag byed cing 'dug zer na chad pa byung ma dogs sam gsungs pas/ lan du kho bo bal yul gyi kha stod na mchis pas smyugs pa dang 'dra zhes mchi/ rjes pha babs gnang pa'i rjes la dben sa gcig tu rgyal po lha chos bzang po bya bar rigs/ mkhas pa shan rak+ṣi ta zhes bya ba gcig mchis pa'i mchid zhib tu mol ba phul bas/ rje'i zhal nas khyod zhang blon kun gyis bsad de 'gro bas yul du song la yib la sdod/ ngas zhang nya bzang khad kyis gsol du bzhug go gsung ngo // gsas (gsal)snang re shig yul du song / btsan pos zhang nya bzang dang khri bzang la sogs pa chos la dga' ba'i blon po kun dang chos bya bar mol ba byas pas/ zhang nya bzang gi mchid nas zhang ma zhang ro ngan la chos la mi dga' bas thugs dgongs mi 'grub mchi zer/ blon khri

170 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/bzang na re de la thabs bgyi bar rngo thog/ kho bo'i rjes su gting non/ slad kyis dgongs pa 'grub pa mchi ba ltar chad/ khri bzang gis bla 'og gi phyag sprin dang / mo ma dang ltas mkhan kun la lkog tu bya dga' stsal nas/ rgyal po sku chags che chab srid la gnod pa 'ong par lung mthun par smrar stsal/ de la ji ltar bya'i lung smra stsal ba rje'i sku'i rim gror zhang blon su che ba zung shig/dgung lo 2 mchad par dal du bcug na rjes sku tshe dang chab srid 'phel lo zhes lung phog de kun nam mang du glengs ba dang blon po khri bzang gi shul la 'grim pa'i 'gron po rnams la zhang ma zhang la snyun chen po gda' skad pa de bden par 'dug go zhes thos tsam ma thos tsam gsol du bcug ma zhang gis de thos pas glo ba la gcags par gyur/ nub phyogs kyi rgan mo gcig gis zhang blon gyis ro (ngo)la ce re bltas ste/ zhang ma zhang ni rjes gdung sob pas/bod 'bangs yongs la gces te/ snyun chen pos thebs zer ba de bden nam mchis pas/ zhang ma zhang gi khyim du bub nyal byas nas bshums/ byan mo na re zhang blon/ chen po bshum pa ci nongs zer/ nga la nad chen po byung ngo zhes rgyal 'bangs kun gyis gleng na zer/ rgyal 'bangs kyi kha la ra ma med mi bden zer bas/ zhang gis me long bltas pas rgyal 'bangs kyi kha la ye shes kyi spyan yod zer ba de bden zer nas mya ngan cher byed/ de blon po khri bzang gis thos nas rje 'bangs kun tshogs pa'i dus su zhang nya bzang gis rgyal bu sku chags che ba la rim gro bya bar gsol bas/ blon po khri bzang skad nas rgya'i sku'i blud bya bar rigs zhes zhib tu smras nas/ da rje'i zhabs tog sus byed pa khas long zhes mchibs/ blon po 'gos khri bzang na re rje'i zhabs tog tu de che/ bu tsha'i dge yig tu'ang de che/ blon pa nga bas che ba suyod cig ngas byed zer/ zhang ma zhang na re nga las che ba ni med na rje'i zhabs tog pa gcig ngas byed par khas blangs/ mchad pa gar brtsig ces gleng sa pas 'gos na re

༄༅// chos 'byung gi yi ge zhib mo/ 171pha rir / yang na gzhu'i spang bzangs su byed mchis pas/ zhang ma zhang na re sna nam brang phur brtsig go mchi nas rmang bres/ ma zhang gis rig nas rdo rgan mo sna nas skyos cig zer/ chus mi brel ba'i thabs byed pa dang / mchad pa 'byongs nas blon po 2nang du mi mchigs mi rung pa lo ti gu sna gong dang 'gos gros byas nas/ rkang la bya rgod gyi lham gon/ lus la pha ba sgor sgor gyi gos gyon nas blon po chen po dang / zhang ma zhang 2 nang du bcug tsam na blon chen po na re kha ma bcad cig 'dir zhang gi gzims mal bya/ 'dir nga'i bya/'dir chu bzhag go zer cing 'gro ba dang ma zhang phyir tril li li 'brang / thal mo brdab nas pha ki na ci yin zer nas 'bros pa'i rkang pa la bzung bas bya rgod kyi spu par ga lag na gda'/ kha ba sgor sgor gyi tshub mas mig gis cang ma mthong bas 'gos rgan gyi lto 'og tu song zhes nas 'khun/ lo ti gus sgo pha bong gis bkag ring zhig na khyim bya'i skad grags nas chu shor snyam te/ tre'u mos lag pa rdung ba'i par brkos pas chus mi brol ba'i rwa 'thud pa'i thabs de bshig nang nas mda' la yi ge bris nas sna nam nam pas brus zhes bya ba phyir 'phen no/ der zhang ma zhang la skyon phab stabs las grub pa dang / rje blon tshogs pa'i dus su zha nya bzang gis gsol pa/ mes srong btsan gyis lha chos mdzad pa legs/ lha dras yab me dkyil lha chos bzang po mdzad pa'i 'og tu zhang ma zhang gis bshig rgya'i lha shākya mu ne sngon rta pa'i pang du thog pa phyis rgya yul du bskyal bar bcoms pas mi stong gis kyang ma theg mang yul du bskyal bar chad pas dre'u gnyis kyis theg rgya lha slar spyan drangs la mchod/zhang blon chos sgrub pa 2 yang ma rung par gum ste de 'dra/ bla 'og gi phyag sprin dang ltas mkhan dang sbyar na rgya lha khros ste chab srid nongs par glo ba chungs/sngon yab mes chos mdzad pa ltar mdzad na legs pa 'dra zhes gsol bas/rgyal bu na re zhang zer ba de bden yang de sems/ zhang blon kun dang gros bya

172 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/gsung / slad kyis rjes blon mang po tshogs nas rgyal bo bka' stsol du bcug ste/ nga'i yab mes kyis lha chos mdzad pa ma zhang gis bshig pa de 'dra/ rgya lha yang slar spyan drang / nged rang yang chos byas nas ma rung ma gsungs pas chos bya bar 'cham nas/ da chos byed pa la mtha' nas 'ongs pa'i mi lo rgyus can su yod ces glengs pa dang / ba lam glag na rba gsas (gsal)snang mang yul nas yongs pa rje'i spyan sngar bos mchis nas/ gsas (gsal) snang rje'i spyan sngar mchis te/ de la zhang nya bzang bzhin du bka' stsal nas/ rgya gar dang bal yul na mkhas pa su yod pa spyan drongs shig par bsgo bas gsas (gsal) snang gis gsol pa/ sngon za hor nas mchis da lta bal yul na za hor rgyal bo'i bu dge slong shan ta rak+ṣi ta bya ba gtsug lag la mkhas pa cig mchis zhes gsol pa dang / rje'i zhal nas khyod yul du ma 'gro bar de mi dgug tu mi rung pas/ bal rje la nga'i bka' sgrom 'di phul la/ mkhas pa de spyan drongs shig par bka' stsal/ gsal snang bal yul du mchis nas bal rje la pho nya btang pas zhal mjal/ btsan po'i bka' sgom phul nas a tsa r+ya spyan drangs par chad/ a tsa r+ya mang yul na sdod do zhes snyan du gsol bas/kheng lang 'gro snang ra dang / snyer stag btsan gdong gzigs dang / sprang rgya ra legs gzigs 2 mang yul du mkhan po sur mchis nas ter khang pe har du chags phob cig par mchi/ lang 'gro snang ra dang a tsa r+ya 2 der bzhag nas pho brang du rje la zhe sa phul bas/ phyag bya ba'i gtol ma mchis par gsas (gsal)snang gis gnyer bkum/ zhang blon dag na re lho bal gyi mi ngan sngags dang phra men gyi bag mi 'gyid dam rtog mi btang mchis nas/ sang shi dang / seng mgo lha lung gzigs dang / mchims me lha 2 btang bas a tsa bya'i skad ma go/ dar tshag sgor bsog gi tshong 'dus na kha che skye bzang gi bu a nan ta lo tsha slob 'phro la chad pa byung nas tshong byed pa de la lo tsha bcol nas a

༄༅// chos 'byung gi yi ge zhib mo/ 173tsa r+ya ci 'dra dris pas/ spyod pa legs so cog la mi bya ba med/ nyes so cog la mi gtang ba med/ lha dkon mchog gsum mchod/ gtso bor sems can la phan pa bya zer nas mchi/ de rje'i snyan du gsol nas spyod pa rgya chen por 'chad/ thugs 'phrig bzhes mi 'tshal byas pas pho brang du spyan drangs te/ nga la phyag bya bar gsol/ ngas la nye brtag go gsung / pho nya bas a tsa r+ya sgo na byon zhes gsol bas gser phye bre gang gi phyag rten phul nas phyag byas pa dang /a tsa r+ya'i zhal nas rgyal pos kho bo ngo mkhyen nam gsung / a tsa r+ya dang sngan chad zhal ma mjal zhes bka' stsal bas/ sngon sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyi bstan pa la gtsug lag khang gi rgyan srungs byis pa 2 gyis bye ma'i mchod rten byas te/ ma 'ongs pa na ngas paṇa ṭi ta byas/ khyod kyis thang khob rgyal po byas/gsas snang gi bang chen pa byas/ thang 'khob kyi rgyal khams su dam pa'i chos dar bar bya'o zhes smon lam btab pa de bsnyel lam gsungs pas/ der rgyal po'i zhal nas de mad sgom yun thungs pas lan zhes lan btab/ a tsa r+ya la nye btab bam zhus pas/ rgyal po khyod kyi dbu la thod gsol ba dang sbyar na stod du mnga' ris zhwa tsam cig zhabs la lham gsol bas smad du mnga'i ris lham tsam cig la khrims 'chags/ sku la ska rags ma bcings pa dang sbyar bar khams 'dir khrims myur du 'jig nyen yod/ 'on kyang rata na'i phyag rten phul bas dam chos byar btub gsung / de nas pho brang rlung tshub su kha che a nan tas lo tsha bgyis nas zla ba bzhir dge ba bcu dang / khams bco brgyad dang / rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi chos bshad pas/ 'dre srin nag po kun ma dga' ste pho brang 'phang thang chus khyer/ lha sa dmar po ri la thog brgyab/ mi nad dang lo nyes byung bas btsan pos chos byas pas lan no// a tsa r+ya spyugs shig mchi nas bod 'bangs tsam kha log dam pa'i chos 'gyir mi 'tshal/ a tsa r+ya khang steng na dar dkar gyi yol ba'i nang na sgom byed pa la rgyal pos kyang

174 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/gser phye bre gang khyer nas/ rba gsas snang dang / seng mgo lha lung gzigs dang / zhang nya bozang dang / 'ba' sang shi dang / snyer stag tshan gdong gzigs dang lnga khrid nas/ a tsa r+ya dar gur na bzhugs pa la phyag dang skor ba byas nas gser phye phul ste/ de 'dra ba nub 2 du phul nas bdag skal ba ngan te bod thams cad nag po la zhen pa'i dus su skyes pas thabs nongs nas lha chos mi 'grub tu rang glo ba chung pa/ a tsa r+ya slar rgya yul du gshegs shig/bdag gis zhang blon rnams thabs kyis brid la rngan pa byin te chos mi byar mi rung bar glengs la chos btub ma thag spyan 'dren gtang ngo zhes zhus/ a tsa r+ya'i zhal nas sngon yab mes kyi ring la klu gdug pa can rnams dam 'og tu ma stsal bas bod khams su gnod sbyin mthu bo che chos la mi dga' bas ltas ngan dang rgyal po'i sku tshe thung pa rnams de las gyur la/ slad kyis lha chos bgyi bar 'tshal na lha klu dam 'og tu stsal 'tshal/ u rgyan gyi yul na dge slong pad ma sam (bha)ba zhes bya ba mthu can cig mchis/ de spyan drangs la mthu dang rdzu 'phrul 'gran/ chos la 'gran zla byung na gtan tshigs nga dang 'gran/ lnga brgya'i tha ma la bab pas bod du mu stegs pa mi mchi gsung / gser phye khyor gang bal rje la sgoms nas gzhan btsan po la slar phul nas/ a tsa r+ya bskrad pa ltar byas nas yar bzhud/ seng mgo lha lung gzigs kyis sngan chad sha mi 'tshal ba'i sdom pa bsrungs pa las phyis mar mi 'tshal ba'i sdom pa'ang blangs te/ a tsa r+ya gla sna glu tshugs su bskyal/ lang 'gro snang ra dang / gsas (gsal)snang gis a tsa r+ya bal yul du bskyal te slar pho brang du mchis/ de nas btsan pos rba gsas (gsal)snang chos kyi spyan par bskos nas chos kyi ched du rgya yul du pho nyar btang ste/ grub na bu la dngul chen po bya dga' bla thabs su gnang par chad/ khad dpon du sbrang rgya ra legs gzigs bskos/'og dpon sang shi bskos nas pho nya sum bcu mar btang / btsan pos chos

༄cu// chos 'byung gi yi ge zhib mo/ 175mi byar mi rung bar gsol nas rje 'bangs chad byas so//dus der rgya rje'i bum sangs dbang po'i drung na ju yag mkhas pa gcig na re da ste zla ba drug dang zhag drug na nub phyogs nas rje la pho nya ba byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa gnyis 'ong zer/ de cis shes dris pas nga'i ju yag gi rtsis la byung ste/ de'i rtags dang sha tshugs 'di 'dra'o zhes 'bag gnyis bris/de rgya rjes snyan du gsan pas de gnyis la rim gro cher bskyed la nga'i drung du thong cig par lung byung / phyis dus btab pa'i dus su pho nya byung pas/'bag dang mgo dpon dang spyan pa mthun bas dar gyi lding khang byas/ shing rta la bskyon/ rim gro bskyed nas ke shir phyin pas pho nya pa gzhan g.yar bcags/pho nya ba rnams kyis rgya rje la phyag byas te/ rgya la pho nya byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa gnyis 'byung par grags pas ming yang dar khang dar khang zhes zer/hwa shang dang dad pa can sprin bzhin du 'dus khang pa dang / ka ba dang / nam mkha' thams cad dar gyis bkab/ yos dang rol mos mchod cing ci dga' spyod du bcug rgya rje na re gsas (gsal)snang la mi khyod las nga'i thugs su byon pa ni ma byung / rgya'i ju yag mkhan na re yang byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa'i pho nya 'ong zer ba'i 'bag kyang khyod 'dra/ khyod byang chub sems dpa' rta skadabya ba'i sprul pa yin no zer/ khyod ci 'dod pa'i bya dga' sbyin no zhes bka' stsal/ gsas (gsal)snang na re rje'i zhal mthong pa glo ba dga' ba'i steng du gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i bka' lung stsal pa las bya dga' che ba ma mchis na gzhan ci yang mi 'tshal/ hwa shang gcig la bsgom lung len pa'i ched du sprod par ci gnang mchi ba dang / de rgya rjes gnang te snang zhun dus cig la go ru la bskyon nas btang ba dang / eg chu'i kim hwa shang cig bkug nas gsas snang gis sgom lung blangs nas bsgom pa'i dus su gsas snang la bya dga' brgya bye'u gser shog srang brgya pa cig mu tig sran ma tsam pa 'phreng

176 ༄༅//(sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/bcu/ dar yug lnga brgya/ za 'og pe tso tan (1)yug cig gzhan pas khyad par du gnang / bod kyi btsan po'i bka' sgrom dang bstun par chad byas/btsan po la skyes dar yug khri/ 'phra men gyi zhwa cig zla gor zho sha'i sder 'dom gang pa cig bskur/ pho nya gzhan rnams la bya dga' che thang du gnang nas pho nya'i lan dang chas nas slar bod yul du mchis te/ btsan po'i spyan sngar mchis nas sug las 'grub btsan pos kyang thabs kyis zhang blon rnams dang chos bya bar ni chad/ a tsa r+ya ni gdan ma drongs par gda'/ btsan po'i zhal nas khyod kyis a tsa r+ya spyan drong cig ces bka' stsal/ gsas (gsal) snang gis bal yul du phyin tsam na bo rnyi sa tos 'dzam bu'i gling na mthu che ba'i dge slong pad ma sam (bha)ba dang lha khang rtsig pa'i phywa mkhan dang 2 stongs (sdongs)nas 'dug der mang yul nas gzings la klung la spyan drangs te/ snye mo thod dkar du byon pa dang / pad ma'i zhal nas sang shi phar ka na nyi tshe ba'i dmyal ba yod pas de la snying rje bya yis gsung nas/ gzings chu la bskur nas 'o yug tu gtor ma dang dgongs pa mdzad pas chab 'jam tsam du gyur/ sang shi gu la la byon nas gnam du zangs khal tshad ma cig tu lung bong gi sha bcos pa dang / klung tshang bya ba'i mi tshan cig na re gnod sbyin 'dul ba'i thabs lta zer ba dang / pad ma sam (lha)bas gnod sbyin chen po dmar thab gsung nas zangs la rdog pa brgyab pas/ thang lha bros pas gangs la tug choms byung sprin chags nas 'brug dang glog dang ser ba bab/ de nas gal lta la thog la snying drung du byon/ bod chos byed du mi gter ba'i klu dkar po mi srun pa cig yod de dam 'og tu gzhug gsungs nas/ dkyil 'khor lha lnga bzhengs nas zhag 2 du dgongs pa mdzad pa gangs kyi tug choms zhi yul yang 'jam par gyur nas klu dam la thogs/ thang lhas bka' nyan du khas blangs/ slob dpon gyi 'khor tho yul du byon na zan drang par byas la ma le

༄༅// chos 'byung gi yi ge zhib mo/ 177shor la byon pas 'phan yul yul ngan rta ro kha bye ba 'dra bar nga mi 'gro gsung nas stod lung ya ral ma ral na mar byon/ btsun mo 'phreng gi brag a tsa ra gro rengs pa 'dra ba 'di'i mgo ma bcad na bod mu stegs kyis 'gang gsung nas zhongs par tshong pa gro thob gsung pa la chu ma mchis zhus pas/ chab ngas dbyungagasung nas sreg shang yu ba sa la thams thams brgyab pas chu rka bdun byung nas de la zhong pa'i lha chur grags/ de nas snye 'phrang du nga'i gro ran gsung pa dang / 'khar nag gi mtsho la klu btsan drag po cig 'dug 'di gdul lo gsung nas 'di shin tu thu ba cig 'dug 'di la 'dul byed cig bya gsung nas brag la bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa'i sku cig mdzad/ bal po rdo bzo mkhan na re bod kyi rdo la bzo btub bam blta mchis nas brag la sha ba'i gzugs cig brkos so/ de nas ngam shod la byon nas zung dkar 'phrang la rdo'i mchod rten lnga mdzad nas pho brang du byon nas btsan po dang zhal 'jal ba'i pho nyas brda sbyar nas/ btsan pos rab tu byung pa'i phyag bzhes pas/btsan pos rab tu byung pa'i phyag mi thub gsung nas pha bong cig la phyag mdzad pas shags kyis gas/ btsan pos phyag phul nas slob dpon gyis snyun smed pa mdzad/ chags gar 'bebs ces pa dang / sang shis de'i bar du ston pa cig tsig ces nas brag dmar 'gran bzangs 'khor sa sgo ma mchis pa cig rtsigs tsam na/ nang lha khang 'go ste shan la dpe blangs pa cig lags pa der chags 'bebs par zhus/ a tsa r+ya bo dhi sa tas btsan po la gsol pa/ sngon sangs rgyas 'jig rten na bzhugs pa'i tshe lha ma srin dam 'og tu ma chud pa ma mchis par rigs pa la bod yul na dam 'og tu ma chud pa'i gdug pa can mang du mchis pas btsan po chos byed du ster ster mi 'dra bas/ da lta 'di na 'dzam bu'i gling na nus pa che ba'i pad ma 'byung gnas zhes bya ba spyan drangs nas bzhugs pas/ bod kyi btsan po chos mdzad du mi ster ba thams cad skrad

178 ༄7//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/cing gzir ba dang / dam la 'dogs pa ni sngags mkhan/ 'dis sngo thogabatsan po chos mdzad pa la brtsod cing rgol ba byung na phyir rgol gyi gtan tshigs smra ba ni kho bo las mkhas pa ma mchis/ gtsug lag khang rtsig na ltas dang bkra shis mi shis rtog pa dang / chos tshugs sam mi tshugs rtog pa la phya mkhan 'di tsam du mkhas pa med pa khrid nas 'ongs pa 'di yin/ zhes snyan du gsol bas/ sang shes 'gran bzang kyi mnga' gsol slob dpon pad ma la zhu'o zhes mchis pa dang / blon chen po ni ma mchis/ sna chen po dang/ sna chen po gzim mal pa kun mchis te/ slob dpon pad mas lha mnga' gsol bas lha thams cad nang nas par byon/ nam phyed na blon po kun gyis mar me khyer nas bltas pas nang na 'jim gzugs cig kyang med par nang stong 'dug/ nang par ltar phyin tsam na 'jim gzugs thams cad nang na snga ma kho na bzhin du bzhugs nas slob dpon pad ma mchod pa byed pa dang / lha rnams gtam gtong bshos gsol ba mthong / bton par bltas pas gcig kyang mi 'dug mar me thams cad rang 'bar/ rol mo thams cad rang 'khrol yos rang 'bar/ 'phan lnga btags pa'ang lnga brgyar 'phel/ cong rang rdung zhing 'phel/ rgun 'brum jog po snyim pa tsam cig gda' ba de sus kyang 'tshal bar rngo ma thog de'i nang par dkyil 'khor bris nas gzi mal lha lung mtsho bzher gnyan legs la phra stan byas ste pra se na pa ta phab nas smrar gsol bas/ bod kyi lha klu mi srun pa ril gyi ming smras te/ 'phang thang du chu phab pa shom po/ lha sar thog phab pa thang lha/ mu ge dang lo nyes dang mi nad stong pa bstan ma bcu gnyis la sogs pa kun smras/ de'i sang tsho ris bzang po'i bu tsha pha ma dang mes phyi tshang pa la pra bstan bgyis nas rgyal po chen po bzhi'i pra phab nas/gnod sbyin me lha zhal mngon sum du bstan/ lha klu ma rungs pa dngos su mi la phab nas/ sdigs shing gzir ba ni pad ma sam (bha)bas mdzad/ dkar po

༄7// chos 'byung gi yi ge zhib mo/ 179la chos bshad nas dam la 'dogs pa ni bo lha sa tos mdzad/ des ma thul ba pad mas sbyin sreg byas nas ma mchis par byas/ de 'dra ba lan gnyis byas te/ slob dpon pad ma'i zhal nas lha klu dam 'og tu stsal lags te/ da rung de 'dra ba lan cig bgyi 'tshal/ slan chad lha chos ci bder mdzad pa dang /gtsug lag khang dgongs pa bzhin du rtsigs shig gsung nas/ zur phud rgyang (rkyang )bu tshal du klu btul bas gzi chen dngos su byung nas/ sa'i steng na rgyal po khri srong lde btsan che/ sa'i 'og na rgyal po nga che/ nged cag gnyis grogs po byas la rgyal po lha khang byed pa'i gser dre'u khal bcu bzhi ngas sbyin cig gser khung glang po kun len du thong zer dam la btags/ sham po btul ba slob dpon gyi thog tu chu bab/ slob dpon gyis so ba sna nas rdo rje gdengs pas chu gyen la bzlog slar lha rdzing bam rdzing du blugs nas/ rdo rje brgyab pas chu khol bas sham po gangs zhu ba'i rtse la bsdad nas slob dpon nga la de tsam tho 'tsham pa zer/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas khyod nga la tho 'tsham pa dang /nga'i dam 'og tu mi zhugs na khyod sreg go gsungs pas/ nga nag po'i rigs yin chos bgyi ba'i bag ma mchis/ da man chad gnod pa mi bgyid/ nga'i drung du ser chags ma btang cig zer nas dam la btags/ da sbyin sreg bgyi'o gsung pa la/ de ring btsan po dbu 'khru'o mchi/ de a tsar+yal bolha sa tos chu gang nas ces dris pas chu brag dmar zhum bu tshal nas len mchi/ chu ri rab kyi byang ngos na chu mig rta rna bya ba yod/ de nas blangs te dbu bkru ba dang gsol na sku tshe ring / lha sras rigs rgyud 'phel/ chab srid che gsung /chab de len pa sus nus zer/ slob dpon sngags mkhan na re ngas rngo thog gsung nas ka shi'i 'og nas bkra shes kyi bum pa gser las bgyis pa cig la dar gyis bcad/ bzhes kyi rgya btab de 'dzab byas nas nam mkha' la 'phangs pas je mtho je mtho song nas/ slob dpon gyis 'dzub khung der rma

180 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/bya'i sgros byabs pas zan cig bza' yun na bum pa ser rgyang nge slob dpon gyi pang du byung / kha phye ba'i nang na chu skya nar ba cig gda'/ des dbu khrus zhes blon po kun la gtad pas de mdun sar brims pas 'di mon gyi smyo chu yin pho la thong ser nas ma mchis par bgyis/ slob dpon zhal nas btsan po khyod kyi yul bzang por bya/ ngam shod kyi bye ma na dang mtshal du bya/ gra la dol btags pa dang phul po tshun chad chu med pa rnams su chu byung / gram pa thams cad la zhing byas la bod kun 'tsho bar bya/ bhe sha ra ma na la bod kyi mi rnams phyug por btang / 'dzam bu'i gling na dkor yod do cog bod du 'byung /rtsang po dang mtsho sbubs su bcug la mchongs pas chog par bya/ ngas u rgyan du chu 'di bas che ba cig sbubs su bcug ces rgya cher gsungs/ de ltar 'ong ngam sad pa'i phyir snga dro cig dgongs pa mdzad pas klu'i rdzing du chu byung / da rung sad do ces pas brag dmar mtsho mor gyur nas sngo phyams la btang /de'i phyi 'phred brag dmar gla ba'i nags tshal du btang / yang sang nang par snga dro cig dgongs pa mdzad nas sgoms te/ zung dkar chu chu rjen nas bya byungs nas 'ongs pas/ blon po dag na re bod yul bzang por byas nas sngags mkhan gyi mthu dang sbyar na rgyal srid rgya gar gyis phrogs te 'ong zhes mdun sar gros byas nas 'phro dgum bar chad/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas da zhing bya'o gsung bas zhing yar lungs kyis chog gsung nas sngags mkhan la bya dga' cher phul nas rgya yul du bzhud par zhu phul bas/ btsan po de la thugs ma dgyes nas slob dpon la bskor ba byas nas gser bre gang phul bas/slob dpon gyi zhal nas gser 'dod pa yin te/ bod thang 'khob tu 'dre srin gdug pa can thams cad btul la btsan po chos byar btub par bya ba dang /bod yul bzang por byas la 'bangs bde ba la dgod pa'i phyir nga 'ongs na/gser 'dod na 'dug byas pas chog gsung nas rtsa dang sa rdo reg tshad gser

༄༅// chos 'byung gi yi ge zhib mo/ 181du song / 'on kyang btsan po'i ngo bsrung pa'i ched du khyor gang tsam phyag du bzhes te lhag ma phyir btsan po la phul/ der blon po zer ba ltar chad nas slob dpon yar gshegs khar rje blon nyi shu la man ngag lta ba'i phreng ba bshad nas/ rgyal po chen po nga'i sngags 'di lta ba chos kyi phyogs dang bstun la spyod pa byang chub kyi phyogs dang bstun/ lta ba'i rjes su spyod pa ma shor bar mdzod/shor na dge med sdug med du song nas chad lta skyes na phyis gso ru mi rung /spyod pa'i rjes su lta ba 'brengs na dngos po'i mtshan mas bcings nas grol bar mi 'gyur/ nga'i sngags sems phyogs 'di lta ba shas che ste/ ma 'ongs pa na tshig 'di'i rdeng ni shes/ lta ba'i deng ma rnyed nas mang po zhig ngan song du 'gro/ 'dra men 'gas sems can mang po'i don byed ces gsungs nas dpe mang po zhig mching phu'i rdza la sbas so//btsan po la rim pa mdzad nas gsang sngags kyi lung gnang / phur bu 'bum sde bshad nas smon lam btab pa/ bdag dang bstan pa med pa'i mchod bdag rnams// tshe rabs 'di dang tshe rabs gar skyes kyang // 'og min zhes bya'i gnas mchog dam pa ru// rnal 'byor theg chen 'bras bu spyod par smon zhes gsung nas/ sbyin sreg gi 'phro bya ba ma grub par yar gshegs/skyel mas chibs khrid nas yar spyan drangs pas blon po kha cig na re sngags mkhan 'di nus pa che ste bod la byad byas par 'ong par mchi nas gsod mi bco brgyad go ru la bskyon nas btang bas slob dpon mang yul du byon pa dang / sang 'o cag la 'tshe bar byed pa'i mi kha gcig kyang 'ong gsung nas/dong bas kyi 'phrang la byon pa dang / stag snar mi bco brgyad pos la las mda' bkang / la las gri byung nas slob dpon gyis phyag rgya bcings pas 'jim gzugs bzhin du gyur te smra ma shes/ mda' 'phen pa dang sdud pa ma shes te rengs pa'i bar na phar byon nas mang yul gyi la khar phyin pa dang /

182 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/slob dpon gyi zhal nas ngas bod kyi lha klu 'dre srin lan 2 'dul dgos pa'i 'phro cig lus/ de ma lus na rgyal po'i sku tshe ring chab srid che/ chos yun ring du gnas pa la 'phro lus pa de yid la gcags so gsung / chos skor cig 'byongs nas 'ong ste/ der 'khrug pa chen po cig kyang 'ong / chos la rked nyag bag re 'ong nyen yod/ khar sang gi 'tshe bar byed pa'i mi la 'di thor gsung nas yungs dkar yar gang gtad nas skyel mi mar bzlog da re shig nga la mi'i yul na gdul bya med pas lho nub mtshams su srin po 'dul du 'gro gsung nas chibs kha nas 'phur nas sprin gseb na yar chos gos yu re/ sreg shang khro le song / skyel mis gsod mi la yungs dkar gtor bas smra shes shing 'gro nus par gyur to// mi rnams slar pho brang du mchis nas sngags mkhan gsung pa rje'i snyan du gsol bas btsan po'i thugs la shin tu gcags par gyur to// de nas chos kyi mdun sa mtsho mo gur du phub/ gsas snang gnam gyi tshul du dpon du bskos/ dus der dpon po dang blon po rnams kha log ste chos mi byed bon bya'o zer bas bo lha sa to'i zhal nas rgyal khams cig chos lugs gnyis byung na shin tu sdug che/ 'o chag rtsod pa byas la khyod rgyal na bon spel nga yar 'gro/ chos rgyal na bon snubs la dam pa'i lha chos bya gsung /chos dang bon 'gran par chad pa la dpang po med/ pho brang zur phug rkyang bu tshal du btab nas chos kyi lad dpon zhang nya bzang dang / stag btsan gdong gzigs dang / seng mgo lha lung gzigs dang / myang sha mi rnams bo dhi sa to'i kha 'dzin dang shags 'debs su bskos/ stag ra klu gong dang / rtsis chen po/ khyung po dum tshugs tse tse/ cog la smon lam 'bar/ mtshe mi la sogs pa bon gyis 'dzin shags 'debs su bskos nas/ shags 'debs pa'i dus su bon khungs ngan la gtan tshigs chungs/ chos khungs bzang la rno rgya che bar byung ste/ shags bzang la rno che bar ste bon kyis chos ma thub/ sa byi

༄7// chos 'byung gi yi ge zhib mo/ 183bon pos 'phan yul du shi ba bsdur ba thams cad bse regs su gyur pas slad chad bon bya ba dang shi ba mi bsdur bar chad/ zhang zhung dang 'tshe mis rje'i sku'i bar chad sel ba'i phyir 'dre srin la bon re bya ba las gzhan mi bya ba dang /gshin gyi ched du rta gsod pa dang / dngos su sha g.yo ba dom sdom bar chad bon gyi dpe kun chu la bskur/ lhag ma phyis mchod rten nag po'i nang du mnan/ deng blan chad chos bya ba dang lha khang rtsig par chad byas pas blon 'gos rgan bshums/ rjes khyod chos byed pa la mi dga' 'am byas pas/ mon bu 'di yang smra re mkhas/ dam chos 'di yang gting re zab/ da chos byar yod tsa na nga rgas pa mchi bas/ 'o na rje blon 'or re che gsung / gser gyi lha shākya mu ne spyan drangs te slar ra mo cher bzhugs so//yos bu'i lo'i dpyid bsam yas kyi rmang gding par chad tsa na/ gsas snang gis sngon du glag mda'i lha khang brtsigs nas sba pha tshan chos la bkod/'ba' lha gzigs kyis kong la dge ba'i bshes gnyen byas/ khrims lnga phog nying ril dkar por btang / de ltar chos dang bom brtsod pas chos rgyal nas rje blon rnams chos bya bar chad nas/ slob dpon bo lha sa to dang 2 thugs dam dpal brag dmar bsams mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa bzhengs par mol nas khas spu ri'i gong du chad byas nas/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas ngas dpyad mdzad pas shang ri rgyal po gdan la bzhugs pa 'dra ste bzang / ri chung bya mas bu la bkab pa 'dra ste bzang / sman ri rin po che spungs pa 'dra ste bzang /khas spu ri btsun mo dar dkar gyi go zu gsol ba 'dra ste bzang / ri nag lcags phur sa la btab pa 'dra ste bzang / me yar tre rta chu mthung pa 'dra ste bzang / dol thang dar dkar gyi yol ba bting ba 'dra ste bzang / sa gzhi 'di mkhar gzhong gur kum gyi bkang ba 'dra ste thugs dam 'dir bzhengs na bzang bya bar bstan ste/ phyag mkhar gyis phyag bres mdzad/ sa gzhi de 'jag

184 ༄za//(sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/skya phod de phu cem me skyi ba dang gleng gal tho re 'dug pa'i steng du snyer stag tsan sdong gzigs kyis rtswa mthos skor nas nga 'dir btsan po'i chibs skyong pa byed do zer/ de nas bla blon lha khang rtsig pa'i bka' bsgros pas blon khri bzang gi mchid nas/ rje cig lags thabs kyis ma mdzad na bod 'bangs la log nas dam pa'i chos mi btub/ thugs dam kyang mi 'grub par gor ma chag mchi/thabs ji ltar bya bar mos pa la/ rje'i bka' gnyan pas bka' khrims dang bka' nan drag tu stsal nas ldem kha bor ba la sogs pa lkog tu chad nas bod 'bangs kun tshogs ste bka' (gdams)stsal pa/ 'dzam bu'i gling na bod kyi rgyal bo mi che/ bod kyi rgyal po nga las mi che ba ni sdar (sngar)ma byung na nga la phyag ris med pas nga phyag ris shig byed pas khyed bod 'bangs 'dzangs pa rnams glengs gsung / blon khri bzang langs nas rje'i bka' ni bdud pas gnyan/ khrims kyi la rtse ni dgung pas mtho/ phyag rjes gang mdzad pa bka' lung zhu'o mchi/ rgyal po'i zhal nas mkhar zhang po'i rgya yul mthong ba cig brtsig gam/ yang na shel gyi mchod rten sha ri tsam pa gcig brtsig gam/yang na wa lung grog po gser phyes dgang ngam/ yang na dka' chu'i thang la khron pa 'dom dgu brgya dang dgu bcu bru'am/ yang na spu ri zangs kyis btum mam/ yang na rtsang po zangs mi sbubs su bzhug gam/ yang na lha khang bre tsam gcig rtsig gam doms shig par bka' stsal/ rje'i bka' lung che la sgrub dka' bas 'dam kha gang yang khas len ma phod/ 'bangs kun bred pa dang /zhang nya bzang gi mchid nas/ rje cig lags mkhar po de tsam pa 'phras na ni 'jig/ ches na ni mi 'byongs/ shel rin po che bas sa'i mchod rten de tsam yang mi 'byongs/ wa lung grog po gser bas bye mas kyang mi khengs/ khas po ri gzar gog tshun chad zangs su song yang mi thums/ rtsang por dgun sbubs su tshud kyang dbyar chus 'khyer/ chu dong 'dom gang byas kyang chu rdol te brur

༄༅// chos 'byung gi yi ge zhib mo/ 185mi btub/ lha khang bre tsig gcig bya de las 'os gda' 'am mchis pas bod 'bangs kun g.yas par 'cham nas de la 'or cho btab/ de nas blon stag ra klu gong chos la gnag pas sba lcag sa la brdabs te lha khang rtsig pa de chos yin pas nga mi dga'/ nged rang bon bya zer bas/ rje'i bka' cog pa khyed kyis stag ra byang du smyugs shig ces pa dang / 'bangs rgas mi gnyis kyis rtswa thag btags te/ tsher lcag gis brab cing byang du sgyugs/ de la kun bred nas cang mi zer/ de nas lha khang gi sa chog byas te/ ya rabs kyi bu tsha pha mes kyi phyi tshang pa rgyan gyis brgyan/ rata na'i snod du mgo gsol/ kha rgyags smra'i thug pha la then/ btsan pos gser gyi 'byor khru gang pa thogs te sa brkos pas nas dkar mo phul do dang / 'bras dkar mo phul do byung bas/ a tsar+ya dgyes te pha la pha la sid rdi sid di gsung ste/ de btsan pos ma go// (lo tsu)ba la a tsa r+ya ci zer byas pas/(lo ts+tsha) ba na re bzang po grub po grub po zer gsung / der mchod rten chen po bzhi'i sla phur btab/ de nas btsan pos slob dpon la lha khang bzhengs par zhu phul bas/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas/khyod dang po byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'ang jo mo sgrol ma yin/ tha ma sangs rgyas tsa na rdo rje gdan du chos kyi 'khor bskor bar gsol ba 'debs pa'ang jo mos/ da lta rgyal po'i thugs dam gyi bar ched sel ba'ang jo mos mdzad pa yin pas/ sngon la rgyal pos jo mo'i sgrub khang rtsigs shig par lung phog/ rgyal pos kyang lho ngos su a r+ya pa lo'i khang pa brtsigs te/ thog phebs lags pa dang / slob dpon khang pa lags te lha ma mchis zhus pas/ btsan po yo byad sdogs shig lha byed pa 'ong gis gsungs pa dang / rten khang pe har na rgya mtshal bu can bya ba tshon rtsi'i skong bu kong co gang khur pir chag po gang lag na thogs te/ 'jim gzugs dang ri mo byed pa la 'dzam bu'i gling na nga mkhas te/ bod kyi lha khang rtsig pa'i lha bzo nga yin zer ba gcig byung / de

186 ༄༅//(sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/bos nas khang par btsan po dang slob dpon dang bal po phywa mkhan dang bzhis mol ba byas te/ lha bzo na re rgya gar gyi lugs su bya'am rgya nag gi lugs su bya zer/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas bud bha rgya dkar por byon pa yin pas rgya gar lugs su bya'o gsung / btsan po na re slob dpon nga bod nag po la dga' ba rnams dad pa skyer re ba yin pas lha bod kyi lugs su bya bar ci gnang byas pas/ 'o na bod 'bangs sdus shig bod kyi lugs su bya'o gsung / bod kun tshogs pa'i nang na mtshar ba khu stag tshab la dpe byas ste/ gtso bo a r+ya pa lo khar sa pa ni bzhengs/ chung za mo mtshar ba la dpe byas te lha mo 'od zer can g.yon du byas/ mo la mtshar ba co ro za lha bu sman la dpe byas te sgrol ma g.yas su byas/ thang bzas stag lo la dpe byas te a r+ya pa lo yi ge drug pa de'i g.yas su byas/ sma gsas kong la dpe byas te a r+ya pa lo rta 'grin sgo srungs su byas/de nas btsan pos dgu stong la yo byad sta gon mdzad pa dang / dar gyi beg rtse gnyis brtsigs nas lha khang la mnga' gsol zhu zhing lha bzo la bya dga' dbul byas pa dang / lha bzo gar song tol ma mchis te sprul pa yin par lta/ slob dpon gyis mchod pa shom du stsal te/ dgung rmus pa dang a r+ya pa lo'i yang thog nas 'od nyi ma shar brtsam cig byung / de ci yin zhus pa dang / bod la a mi da bas dgongs pa'i 'od yin pa rje a mi da ba'i yang thog bya'o gsung nas/ yang thog tu a mi da ba gtso 'khor lnga bzhengs su gsol/ de nas rgyal pos a tsa r+ya la sgrub lung zhus nas bsgrubs pas 'grub nas/ zla ba phyed na ha ya gri bas nam phyed na skad lan 2 bton pas rtse rgod rnams kyis thos nas byed de/ de ci dris pa dang / a tsa r+ya na re rgyal bos grub pa brnyes pas rta mgrin gyi skad lan 2 bton pas de 'dzam bu'i gling sum gnyis su thos te rgyal po'i chab srid kyang de tsam mo gsung / de nas dbu rtse'i 'gram bting bar zhus pas/ a tsa r+ya na re brag dmar bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun grub 'di

༄༅// chos 'byung gi yi ge zhib mo/ 187'dzam bu'i gling na byin che ba mdo sde dang 'dul ba dang mngon pa dang gsang sngags thams cad dang mthun zhing mi 'gal ba/ 'gran gyi do med pa cig bgyi gsung stsal/ a tsa r+ya de lta bu mkhyen nam zhus pas/ ngas shes te de lta bu cig o tan ta pu ri na yang yod/ de ci 'dra na sngon mu stegs kyi rig 'dzin sgrub pa pos ro sgrub pa'i dngos grub len pa'i g.yog mtshan rtags dang ldan kun du btsal bas ma rnyed de/ ma ga rda'i dge slong sgrub pa po'i nye gnas byed pa pa la dpon la maṇa ṭal la gser gyi nye'us bkram pa yang nas yang du phul bas dge slong na re khyod nga la man ngag 'dod dam/ rig 'dzin gyis smras pa/ nga khyod kyi nye gnas rtags can de zhu'o// des de la phul lo// de nas sgrub khang du phyin pa dang ro sog phon tsam pa gcig dkyil 'khor gyi steng na 'dug go// de la dge tshul khyod ro la dpa' ba'i rtags yod pas ma 'jigs par de'i lce de chod cig/ lce de gser gyi ral grir song ba dang nga la byin cig/ des gar gtad par 'gro bar nus pa yin te/ nga 'og min du rig 'dzin sgrub tu 'gro bas de khyod la rngan par sbyin no// der des mnyam par bzhag go// dge tshul ro la zhon nas gris lce gcod du bcug pa dang 'gul zhing mig mgul kha tab tab byed pa dang / lce dar sham tsam cig byung pa ma zin no// lan gnyis su ma zin pa dang / da res lce ma chod na dang po nged rang gnyis gsod/ de nas stong 2 srid pa 2 gyi sems can gsod du 'ong bas bsgrims la chod cig zer ro// des ro dang kha sprad nas bsgrims pa dang / lce sos zin nas bcad pas ral grir gyur nam mkha' la g.yugs pas nam mkha' la dge tshul 'phur bas/rig 'dzin na re khyed nang pa la pham pa 'ong ba yin pas ral gri de na mar shog cig zer ba la/ de ltar yin mod ngas ltad mo blta yis zer nas ri rab kyi khar song nas gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla dang bcas pa cog bzhi dang bcas pa legs par bltas nas/ 'dzam bu'i gling du ral gri g.yugs te rig 'dzin gyi

188 ༄7//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/drung du byung pas/ ro langs gser du grub pa dge slong lnga brgya'i 'tsho ba ldang ste/ rus pa ma bcad/ log 'tsho la bcad na mi skye/ gzhan du na nang par bcad kyang nub mo skye'o zer nas des ral gris nam mkha' la g.yugs te 'og min du song / dge tshul des dpon la smras pa dang / 'o cag dge slong lnga brgya'i bzhugs sa gtsug lag khang cig rtsig dgos pas mgon po las gzhi zhu ba'i gtor ma bya 'o zer nas gtor ma byas pas bya rog gis khyer nas mtsho'i dkyil na de'u yod pa cig gi khar bzhag go// der gtsug lag khang rtsig pa de'i dpe ri rab gling bzhi nyi zla gling phran dang bcas pa la dpe byas te bzhengs pa o tan ta pu ri bya ba yod/ btsan po'i thugs dam gyi dpe de la bya'o gsung /de nas yos bu'i lo la btsan pos dgung lo bcu 2 lon pa dang khas spu ri las pha bong drangs ste dbu rtse'i rmang bting / sa yar lungs gad pa stengs nas blangs/ shing shug pa dang tsan dan la byas/ lags pa dang btsan po mnal ba'i rmang (mi)lam du mi dkar po cig na re rgyal po khyod lha ji lta bu cig la bya bar sems zer/ de slob dpon la dri byas pa dang / de na re sa gzhi jo mo sgrol mas byin gyis rlabs pa yin/ dngos kyis kyang zhabs kyis bcags pa yin/ khas pu ri'i rtse na shākya thub pa gtso 'khor bcu 2/ bcom ldan 'das dngos kyis byin gyis brlabs pa yod/ de spyan drongs la gyis zer/ de ga na yod ston byas pas ba dmar mo 'us 'debs pa'i sa na yod zer/ der phyin tsa na lha bcu dgu 'dug dgyes nas ste ste byas pas snal sad nas rmi lam du red/ nang par blon kham pa khrid nas ltar phyin pas cang med/ 'di na 'dug pa yin pa la byas te btsan pos bye ma la zhabs sug byas pas ne gu bya mchu tsam cig 'dug ste de bsal bas rdo sku rang byung the'u rjes med pa gtsug gtor nag ldem me ba/ spyan khra hrig ge ba'i byang chub chen po cig gda'/ de

༄༅// chos 'byung gi yi ge zhib mo/ 189shing rta la bzhugs pas sa g.yos/ spyan drangs te shar sgor phyin pa dang sa rab tu g.yos/ dri'i gtsang khang du byon pa dang shin tu rab tu g.yos so// khri la bzhugs pa dang btsan po dgyes ste/ man de dang gser ska gsol/ phya mkhan na re btsan po'i khang pa dang sbyar na lha chu sa mchi nas 'jag ma la ras g.yogs nas/ 'dag pa la gser gyi 'jim pa lan bdun gsol nas bzhag/sgyu rdo las byas bzo ni bod kyi lugs su byas te/ g.yas lho ngos kyi gral la byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying bo/ rgyal ba byams pa/ thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs/ sa'i snying bo dang / dga' ba'i dpal dang / khams 2 rnam par rgyal ba dang drug go// g.yon byang ngos kyi gral la byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po dang / phyag na rdo rje dang / 'jam dpal dang / sgrib pa rnam par sel ba dang / dge bsnyen chen po dri ma med pa dang / khro bo mi g.yo ba dmar po dang drug ste gtso 'khor bcu 2/ gsang pa 'dus pa la 'grel pa brgya rtsa brgyad yod pa las slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi lugs lha bcu dgu mdzad pas drug ma shong nas byang chub chen po'i rgyab tu logs la ri mo bris nas yod do// lte ba'i rgyud ris ni sku gsung 'byung pa'i mdo bris/ lte ba'i kha phyir lta la mdo sde dam chos pad ma dkar po'i rgyud ris bris so// kha nang ltas skor khang la rin po che tog gi gzungs kyi rgyud ris bris/snga khang la rje'i thugs dam dkon mchog sprin gyi rgyud ris bris/ 'og khang gi chos skyong mkha' 'gro ma seng ge khri'i ral pa can la gtad/ de nas bar khang gi shing gla ba dang seng lde la byas/ lder po'i rgyu ba men gyi ko ba la byas/ bzo rgya nag po'i lugs su byas/ gtso bo dpal rnam par snang mdzad/ g.yas na 'das pa'i sangs rgyas mar me mdzad/ g.yon na ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas byams pa bzhengs kha ma/ g.yas g.yon na byang chub sems dpa' nye ba'i sras brgyad/ dge bsnyen chen po dri ma med par grags pa/ byang chub sems dpa'

190 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/dga' ba'i dpal/ khro bo ging dang gang zhes bya ste/ rgya nag po'i skad yin don 'og khang dang 'thun/ kri ya'i lha tshogs bco lnga dang bstun/ nang gi rgyud ris yum rgyas pa'i gleng gzhi'i le'u bris/ gdong la rgyal po chen po bzhi/skor khang phyir lta la mchod rten brgyad pa/ mya ngan 'das pa'i rgyud ris bris/kha nang lta la mdo sde sprin chen po'i rgyud ris bris/ snga khang la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas gshin rje gshed kyi lha tshogs dang / bsam yas na gnas pa'i chos skyong rnams kyi 'bag bris/ chos skyong rgyal po shing bya can la gtad/ de nas steng khang gi shing thang dang gsol la byas/ sder so'i rgyu sa dang 'jag ma la byas/ bzo rgya dkar po'i lugs su byas/ gtso bo sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad kun du zhal bzhi ngo bo gcig re re la 'khor gnyis gnyis byang chub sems dpa' nye ba'i sras brgyad/ nang gi lha tshogs byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje rgyal mtshan la sogs pa phyogs bcu nas lhags pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dang / khro bo mi g.yo ba 4/ phyag na rdo rje 4/ bud rda'i lha tshogs bzhi bcu zhe bzhi byas/ rgyud ris mdo sde sa bcu pa bris/ chos skyong rgyal po chen po zangs ma'i 'be log can la gtad/ thog rgya'i phebs su byas/ za 'og gi ris can pheb/ cog bzhi na steng gi zhing khams mdangs dga' ba can gyi sangs rgyas dga' ba'i dpal/ 'khor byang chub sems dpa' dga' ba byin pa la sogs pa'i rgyud ris bzhi bris/ de'i chos skyong gnod sbyin lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can bzhi la btad/ 'ga' 'ji ra gser la shel gyi tog can du byas/ de nas 'khor sa bar ma brtsigs te/ thang rtsigs khang dmig dgus bskor ba brtsigs te/ lho ngos rol kha bang mdzod 2 rol chas bkang ste/ gnod sbyin lag na dbyug pa thogs pa mched 2 la gtad/ nub ngos mdo rgyud chos kyi bang mdzod 2 rgya gar rgya nag bod rnams kyi dpe'i glegs bam gyis bkang ste/a tsa ra lag na spu gri thogs pa mched 2 la gtad/ byang ngos rin chen gter

༄༅// chos 'byung gi yi ge zhib mo/ 191gyi bang mdzod 2 gser dngul zangs ther la sogs pas bkang ste/ gshin rje lag na be con mched 2 la gtad/ rgyud ris mdo rgya che rol pa bris/ bar gyi ka sgrogs la bskal pa bzang po 'di la sangs rgyas stong 'byung / de'i 'og du ngan 'gro'i bskal ba drug bcu 'byung / de'i rjes la bskal pa snyan pa chen po la sangs rgyas khri 'byung pa bris te ma shong ba gru gas kyi rtsigs logs la bkod nas yod do// de nas 'khor sa chen mos bskor/ dpal rnam par snang mdzad ngan song sbyong ba'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs so// mda' yab kyi ngos la rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa rigs lnga'i lder so zhal phyir lta ba bzhengs/ nang du sdong pos rgyan pa'i rgyud ris dang / nor bu bzang pos dge ba'i bshes gnyen brgya rtsa bcu rten pa bris/ des ma khengs pa snang brgyad kyis bkang /rgyab tu rdo rings pad ma can la bka' rtsigs kyi yi ge'i mdo bkod/ steng du seng ge bzhag nas chos skyong sing ha mu khe la gtad do// 'khor sa chen mo'i chos skyong klu'i rgyal po a nan ta pu ris la gtad do// dbu rtse'i sgo 2 shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / smon pa med pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang bstun/ rtsig pa bskos te rmang btsugs chu khung btod/ nang du ka rmang byas/ de'i steng du ka ba/ de'i stong du ka lo// de'i steng du gdung / de'i steng du phyam/ de'i steng du spang leb/ de'i steng du so phag bkram kha lan kun gyis bskor/logs la sum cha'i 'og du skar khung phyi rub la nang yangs pa rgya mtsho lta bu/ bya mi 'jug pa'i phyir dra ba dang / sbrang bu mi 'jug pa'i phyir sgo leb/ de rlung gis mi 'byed pa'i phyir 'khor stan byas/ de 'byed pa'i dbyug gu skam kha byas/stong du 'dzeg pa'i gru skas/ rmang rdo/ bar so phag steng shing la byas/ 'ju ba'i sdang bu byas/ de mi 'gul ba'i lcags gzer btab/ gtsug lag khang rtsig pa 'dul ba dang bstun/ rgyud ris thams cad mdo sde dang bstun/ lder

192 ༄cu//(sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/so thams cad gsang sngags dang bstun/ de ltar lder so bdun bcu don drug ཿdū ga/ sa kārdo rgyud ris bcu phrag gcig dang bzhi/ ka ba brgya phrag bcu gnyis ༄ sgo mo che chung sum bcu so drug dang / sgo chung bcu phrag bzhi dang gnyis yod do// gru skas drug dang / dar thang chen po 2/ gcong chen brgyad dang /'phan chen brgyad btags so// gtsug lag khang gi bkod pa de ltar lags/ma mo'i gzhung dang bstan nas bzhengs tshul la/ gling bzhi gling phran brgyad dang nyi zlar bcas/ lhun po'i bkod pa gong du legs par bstan/ gling phran rnams kyi bzhengs tshul 'di ltar mchi/ shar lus 'phags po'i gling g.yog dang bcas pa la dpe byas te/ dang po rnam dag khrims pa'i gling zla gam du byas/ lder so shākya thub pa gtso 'khor lnga bzhugs/ zla 'od gzhon nur gyur pa'i rgyud ris/ chos skyong tshangs pa dkar po dung gi thor tshugs can/ lte ba la sgo re re/ 'khor sa la sgo gnyis gnyis gling phran bcu gnyis yo la yod do//mkhyen rab 'jam dpal gyi gling na 'jam dpal rgyu rko ba la byas pa gtso 'khor bdun/ sgo srungs gshin rje gshed gnyis/ nang gi lte ba la 'jam dpal gyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan bkod pa'i rgyud ris bris/ 'khor sa la phal po che'i rgyud ris bris/ sgo mo che drug chos skyong gshin rje mo'i 'khor lo can/brda sbyor tshang mang gling na shākya thub pa gtso 'khor bdun/ lte ba la mdo sde rin po che sna tshogs kyi rgyud ris bris/ phyi 'okhor btsun pa'i g.yos sa/ chos skyong rgyal po 'brug gi glag pa can/ lho'i gling 2 la bdud 'dul sngags pa'i gling na shākya mu ne gtso 'khor lnga/ gtso bo bdud 'dul lugs ma yin/ lte ba la nam mkha' snying po'i rgyud ris bris/ 'khor sa la gtsug na rin po che'i mdo'i rgyud ris bris/ chos skyong dbang phyug ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ a r+ya pa lo'i gling na khar sa pa ni gtso 'khor lnga/ glo 'bur na sku gsung thugs kyi rten/

༄7// chos 'byung gi yi ge zhib mo/ 193sku'i rten tsan dan gyi rus pa la gul gyi sha/ dngul gyi lpags pas g.yogs pa'i rgyal po'i 'dra 'bag gcig bla 'bum yum chen mo cig 'phra men gyi mchod rten gcig rgyud ris mdo za ma tog bkod pa/ bse'i lha mo stong rtsa gnyis bris/ 'khor sa la sa bcu'i mdo sde bris/ chos skyong drang srong rta ma ra 'khor lo la rgyab sbrel dang bcas pa/ rgya gar gling na jo bo byang chub chen po lugs ma gtso 'khor lnga/ rgyud ris mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa dang /'dul ba rnam par dag pa bris/ mdun na lo paṇa sgra sgyur ba'i khang pa gcig la sgo so sor blta ba byas/ chos skyong gnod sbyin ra to can/ nub kyi gling zlum po gsum la be+e ro tsa na'i gling na rnam par snang mdzad zangs las byas pa/'khor gsang pa'i yum bzhi/ rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud ris bris/ chos skyong gnod sbyin glang gi mgo can/ dga' ldan byams pa'i gling na 'phags pa byams pa gtso 'khor lnga/ sgo srungs gshin rje gshed gnyis te bdun/ steng na a mi ta pa gtso 'khor lnga/ rgyud ris mi dge ba spyad pas shākya thub pa'i bstan pa mar 'grib pa dang / tshe lo bcu pa nas dkar po dge ba'i las byas pas byams pa'i bstan pa yar 'phel ba bris/ sna nam rgyal btsan lha gnang (snang )lag dpon skyes pa'i rabs dang / byas thabs dang /sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal nyi shu rtsa gcig dang / byang chub ltung bshags kyi lha tshogs bris/ chos skyong mkha' 'gro ma gu ling gi gos can/ mi g.yo bsam gtan gling na rnam par snang mdzad yab kyi thugs dam gnyan po byin can rigs lnga nyan thos chen po bcu drug pa dang bcas pa/ ngan song sbyong pa gtsug rdor rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor rnam gnyis dang / rgyud ris gser 'od dam pa nye 'don gyi lugs bris/ chos skyong rgyal po dngul gyi mgo bo can/ byang gi gling gru bzhi gsum na/ rin chen sna tshogs gling na shākya mu ne+e gtso 'khor lnga/rgyud ris dga' ldan du yum la chos bshad pas drin lan bsab pa'i mdo bris/

194 ༄tsho//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/chos skyong rgyal po dbyi'i sbar ba can/ sems bskyed byang chub gling na phyag na rdo rje'i pho brang ri bo mchog na phyag na rdo rje/ phur ba/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa gsum bar chad srung pa/ gtso bo sangs rgyas ma chags pad ma'i spyan nam mkha' la byon pa la byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa rnam sel gyis zhu sna ba byas te sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje snying po la sogs pas sems bskyed zhu ba/ de'i bar bar na phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas de la byin gyis rlob pa bzhi bcu zhe bdun/ rgyud ris mdo dkon mchog sprin bris/ 'khor sa la 'phags pa rtag tu nga shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshol ba/ chos skyong mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i 'gros can ma/ skor (dkor)mdzod dpe har gling na sangs rgyas dga' ba'i dpal 'khor nye ba'i sras brgyad gtso 'khor dgu/ rgyud ris yab dang sras mjal ba'i mdo bris/ glo 'bur rnams na bsam yas 'byongs pa'i skor lhag ma 'di na 'di yod kyi ris yig gi byang shing khram kha dang / de'i srungs ma khram khang gi rgyal po/ spyi'i chos skyong dpe dkar la gtad do// yag sha go ma gang pa bzang po'i khang pa na shākya mu ne gtso 'khor lnga/ rgyud ris bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis/ chos skyong thang lha gang pa bzang po/ yag sha 'og ma gnod sbyin nor bu bzang po'i khang pa na lder so dang rgyud ris 'thun/ chos skyong sham po gnod sbyin nor bu bzang po la gtad/de gnyis nyi ma dang zla ba'i lha khang / shar phyogs kyi gling rnams kha dog dkar po/ lho phyogs kyi gling rnams kha dog 'thing kha be+e ṭu r+ya/ nub phyogs kyi gling rnams kha dog dmar po yin tra ni la/ byang phyogs kyi gling rnams kha dog ser po gser/ logs kyi zhal la gnyer ma chu gnyer 'dra ba byas/ thang ku'i zhal la rgya mtsho'i chu la dpe byas pa yang byas so//de nas tshang ma ke ru'i gling na steng khang na slob dpon bo lha sa twa'i gzims khang ba so lha khang / 'og khang na dkar thabs chos skyong lag na myu gu

༄༅// chos 'byung gi yi ge 'ib mo/ 195thogs pa/ dag byed khrus kyi khang pa na khron pa tsan dan gyis bgang ba/ so phag logs la rab tu byung ba skyo ba bskyed pa'i keng rus kyi rnam pas 'dul ba bris/ chos skyong gnod sbyin lag na bum pa thogs pa can/ mthu rtsal klu'i gling na se ba'i phung po la sbyin sreg byas pa'i yal ga brgyad la klu chen po brgyad byas de'i dbus na phyag na rdo rje 'i ba dkar po 'dul byed du bzhengs/ rgyud ris nya dang chu srin la sogs pa bris/ chos skyong sa bdag gnyan dgu rang chas su gnas pa/ nang chu shel gyis khyab pa sus kyang blta bar mi nus pa gcig byas/ de nas mchod rten dkar po byang chub chen po'i mchod rten nyan thos kyi lugs su shud pu nga mi rgyal to res lag dpon byas te seng gis brgyan pa/ chos skyong gnod sbyin skar mda' gdong la gtad/ mchod rten nag po de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdung gis brgyan pa rang sangs rgyas kyi lugs su ngan lam stag sgra klu gong gis bzhengs/ chos skyong gnod sbyin lcags kyi mchu can la gtad/ mchod rten sngon po dpal lha las babs pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdung gis brgyan pa rang sangs rgyas kyi lugs su ngan lam stag sgra klu gong gis bzhengs/ chos skyong gnod sbyin lcags kyi mchu can la gtad/ mchod rten sngon po dpal lha las babs pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i lugs su lha khang gi sgo mo bcu drug gis brgyan pa/ mchims 'dod bzher spre chung gis bzhengs/chos skyong gnod sbyin nyi ma'i gdong la gtad/ de'i tshe 'dre mo 'od can mas blon po rnams nyal ba'i mgo 'jug bzlog pa la sogs pa'i 'tshe ba mang du byas pas/ de slob dpon la zhus pas/ byams pa gling du mchod rten 'od 'bar brtsigs te mnan/ mchod rten chen po bzhi 'od 'bar dang lnga/ mchod rten dkar po gnyan grags pas lag dpon shi na shud pus khri brong khong btsan gyis rjes bsam nas brtsigs pa dang / nad rdzong ma mchis nas slob dpon la zhus pas/ ma ga rda'i rgyal po'i khab kyi sgo mdun na dhā tu tse te bya ba'i nang na rgyal

196 ༄7//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/po gzugs can snying po'i skal ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdung ring bsrel ma ga rda'i bre'i khal gcig bzhugs par grag go gsung ba dang / rgyal pos de spyan drang pa'i phyir bod kyi rta rngog chags sga mnan pa gcig kyang ma lus pa chad sa la bsngos te 'gos kyi pha rir dus btab/ slob dpon gyis brgyus pa mdzad nas thang khob kyi rta pa'i dmag drangs te/ dpal mo dpal thang du grangs la btab pas rta pa bye ba phrag bcu bzhi byung / rgya gar thang khob du phyin pa dang / yul de'i rgyal po byed nas thang khob kyi btsan po de'i rta pa'i dmag 'di 'dra na/ rkang bu chung gi tshogs dang / shing rta'i tshogs dang / glang po che'i tshogs ci 'dra bar 'gyur zer nas pho brang gi ya lan la btsan po'i lham btags te/ de'i 'og na phar 'khor dang bcas pa 'dzul te/ nga'i rgyal khams 'di btsan po khyod kyi zhabs kyi 'og tu 'dzul nas khyod kyi chab srid byed de/ bca' dang skyes lo dam du 'jal bar khas blangs nas mngar 'dus pa lags/ de nas chu bo gang ga rgal nas ma ga rda dmag drangs pa dang / ma ga rda pa thams cad nor rnams o tan ta bu rir bskyas nas/ mi thams cad rgya gar shar phyogs su bros nas g.yul sprad ma dgos par dpal rdo rje'i gdan du byang chub kyi shing la mchod pa byas nas mchod gnas spyan drangs te/ mchod rten kha bye ba'i nang na mtshon cha'i 'khor lo'i dkyil na rad na'i bum pa 'dug ste sus kyang blang bar rngo ma thog rgya gar gyi rgad po gcig 'dug pa na re nga la sngon gyi mi gleng pa'i lo rgyus yod/ tse te 'di'i byang ngos na rdo leb chen po'i dkyil gyi bug pa na mar rnga ma'i thag pa la bum pa btags te btang bas bum pa chu bo gang gar 'byung / de nas yar gzhal bas rtse te dang thad kur mnyam pa na/ rdza'i bar du rtsi shing dang bye mas bkang bas chu chad nas mtshon cha'i 'khor lo sdod pa yin zer na zhes zer nas ji skad zer ba de ltar byas pas bden par byung nas/ rad na'i bum pa nas de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub

༄7// chos 'byung gi yi ge zhib mo/ 197pa'i ring bsrel bre drug spyan drangs nas rtsi shing bsal nas chu btang pas mtshon cha'i 'khor lo snga ma ltar 'khor ro// de nas tshur byon nas chu'o gang ga'i 'gram du bod kyi mi bzhi bskos nas/ 'di tshun chad bod kyi sa bcad pa yin pas 'di rdo rings tshugs gcig ces bka' stsal/ mi 4pos bye khung du lcags kyi ka ba btsugs te/ de phyis bru sha'i dmag gis bshig pas ma shigs pas mes bzhug ba'i 'phro yod do// de'i lung phugs su 'dzugs mkhan gyi mi bzhi po chags pas bho tra tha gu ra'i rigs bya ba grong khyer chen po cig yod do//rta dmag bod du log pas shin tu nyung nas btsan po la dris pas/ rgya dkar po yul bzung bas bsdad pa min nam/ da phar song zer/ slob dpon la dris dris pas/ rgya gar cham la 'bebs pa'i ched du sprul pa byas pa ni/dmag dang po nas 'di las med gsung / bgrangs pas mi gcig kyang ma lus rta gcigā kyang ma lus par tshang pas/ btsan po khri srong lde btsan sprul par grags den//sa chos skor du byon nas rad na'i za ma tog bzhi phrugs byas pa'i bar du ring srel snyim pa gang lhag pa cig mchod rten gyi rtog (rtog) la bzhugs so// mes kyi gnyan po gsang pa dang / mes srong btsan gyi thugs dam lnga/ yab kyi thugs dam gnyis kyang der bzhugs pas lhag par byin brlabs che'o// de'i srog shing khas po ri'i rgyab na bal po bzo byed pa dang /sang srog shing 'dzugs par chad byas te/ blon po rnams kyi 'breng zhags dang shing rta sta gon byas pa dang / bal pos dgung sang ma thog bzo 'phro la phyin pas drog shing shul nas har re stor/ de'i rje'i snyan du gsol bas kun bsogs te/ nga'i 'bangs la stobs che ba ni su yin bya dga' che thang du ster ro zhes pas khas len pa su yang ma mchis/ phya mkhan na re mdang ba'i mi lam na mi bzhis srog shing btsugs te/ khyod kyis mchod rten bdun rtsigs pa la

198 ༄7//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/'di legs/ mchod rten 'di 'dzam bu'i gling na byin che ste/ 'di la su phyag dang skor ba byed pa de'i bsam pa yid bzhin du 'grub/ khyod kyi bya dga' 'di la gyis mchis nas gser gyi ya lad cig byin/ gnyid sad tsa na mi bzhi po mi snang ya lad 'di yin zer nas gser khrab cig gda'/ slob dpon na re de skad ston pa de rgyal po chen po bzhi yin bas/ dang po rgyal po bzhi'i gzugs bya gsung nas bum pa'i khar 'bag bzhi byas nas bzhag go// de nas mgon khang gi bzhi'i nang na phugs na shākya mu ne+e gtso 'khor gsum/ mdo na mgon po gnyis gnyis/ de'i sgo dra bar byas pa/ sgo'i phyi na rta babs dang /steng na chos kyi 'khor lo gser las byas pas/ sha ra na dang gdugs dang rgyan dang bcas pa bgyis te/ chos skyong rgyal po chen po bzhi la gtad/lcags ri zur mangs rdo rje'i 'gros la mchod rten stong rtsa brgyad kyis kha bskor nas re re'i nang na sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel re re bzhugs so// chos skyong rgyal po chig stong rang rgyal po stong sde bco brgyad la gtad do// bsam yas spyi'i chos skyong dpal mgon po nag po la gtad do// brag dmar dpal gyi bsam yas 'di// mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa lags// gzhi che 'phang mtho rgyu bzang ba// bkod legs dung phor gzis bkang 'dra// rje yi thugs dam yang snying 'di// 'bangs yongs kun gyi mchod gnas yin// yos bu'i lo larmang bres nas// de yi lo la 'byongs pa lags//jo mo lnga khab tu bzhes pa las mchims gza' lha mo btsan dang / 'khar rje za mtsho rgyal gnyis sgrub pa mdzad pas phyag rjes med/ 'bro za khri rgyal ma mo btsan rab tu byung ba'i mtshan byang chub rjer gsol ba'i phyag ris dge rgyas kyi gtsug lag khang bzhengs ste/ snang pa mtha' yas kyis gtso bo mdzad pa'i gtso 'khor dgu mdzad de/ lugs lugs stod du blugs nas chab la spyan drangs pas gnyis chu la shor/ 'khor drug po g.yas na rigs 2 mgon po/ g.yon

༄༅// chos 'byung gi yi ge zhib mo/ 199na sangs rgyas sman gyi bla dang sangs rgyas kun du bzang po/ mi g.yo mgon po dang gsum bzhugs so// g.yas na rdo rje sems dpa'/ g.yon na byams pa de gnyis lder so'o// sras mi mnga' bas yab mi 'brong yul thag rings/phyis gso mi mi 'ong mchi nas lha lugs mar byas/ rig pa so phag zha nye'i chus sbyar/ zangs kyi thog bkab/ rgya phebs khyung gi gzugs su pheb/ rol mo'i gcong btags/ rin po che mar gad a mi da pa'i dpral bar 'phra btab po/lte ba la rgyud ris sangs rgyas snang pa mtha' yas kyi zhing khams dang byang chub sems dpa' lnga'i bkod pa bris/ 'khor sa la bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong dang / phal po che'i rgyud ris bris/ chos skyong klu'i rgyal po stong 2 'brug sgra la gtad/ sgo srung gza' mig dmar dang pa sangs gnyis la gtad/sgo'i g.yas g.yon gnyis na rad na'i mchod rten re bzhugs so//jo mo tshes spong za me tog sgron la sras mnga' bas khams 2 zangs khang gi gtsug lag khang yab kyi dbu rtse la dpe blangs nas bzhengs su gsol lo// pho yong za rgyal mo btsun rgyal po'i yum tshe 'phos par slob dpon gyis lung bstan pas drin lan lon pa'i ched du khab tu bzhes/ de la lha lcam las mi mnga' bas lha khang nyis thog tu gnang nas dbu tshal gser khang du rnam par snang mdzad rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du bzhengs su gsol lo// lha bzo la zas sna bcu 2 drangs pas bzo sna bcu 2 bgyis te/ steng khang la phyi na rtsig pa med pa/ nang na ka ba med/ bla gor gyi sgos rje'i gyang dang btsun pa'i 'bags thub/ sgo gcod 'byed la gser gyi bye chung skad snyan sgrog pa yod/sa gzhi ra gan la byas pa/ g.yu'i gdung ma la gser gyi rta rgyug pa 'bur du btod pa/ ya thog gi rgya phebs kha phyi lta nang lta yod pa/ chu thams cad dril nas seng ge'i kha nas bab te rus sbal gyi rgyab tu 'ong ba/ nang kri ya'i lha tshogs la spyi gdugs gcig la dgos gdugs so sor pheb pa yod/ mdzad pa

200 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/bcu gnyis 'bur du stod pa yod/ lha'i bus khyung gi sgo nga nas bdud rtsi'i chus lha la khrus gsol ngo mtshar ba cig bzhengs su gsol lo// de nas slob dpon la mnga' gsol gyi zhu rten gser phye bre drug phul nas zhus pas/ bod khams mnga' ris thams cad la dpya dang yo byad bsdus la sta gon gyis shig ces lung gnang / slob dpon ke ru'i gling du 'tshams bcad nas sgrub pa la bzhugs so// ba so'i lha khang lo bcu gnyis na bzo tshar/ btsan pos mnga' 'bangs kun bsdus te/ brag dmar skye bo'i tshogs kyis bkang / slob dpon ke ru'i gling nas 'khar gzhong me tog gis bkang nas mchod rten dkar po'i gong du byon pa dang / btsan pos 'jam pa'i rdo rje zhal 2 phyag drug pa phyag na rin po che'i me tog bsnams pa cig tu gzigs/ slob dpon gyis ting nge 'dzin gyis dbu rtse'i 'og khang gi lha rnams phyir spyan drangs te/ mchod rten dkar po la bskor ba byas te/ zhal shar du gzigs nas 'khor sa'i logs na phrog zhu zing nge bzhugs pa la me tog gtor ba dang / lha thams cad dus cig du nang du gshegs te sngar gyi gral bzhin du 'khod pas/ khro bo gnyis kyi rgyab nas yos kyi me 'bar bas sa tshig pa la slob dpon gyis dri chab gsang gtor mdzad pas/ mes zhu ba'i shul gsor ma 'tshal/ btsan pos me tog tu gser phye gzhong pa gang phul/ zhal sros chen po'i dus su phyi'i lcags ri nag po'i steng du mchod rten gyi bar thams cad khur ba mar thud la sogs pa zas kyis bkang ste deng ltar bod rnams la 'tshal ma'i skal pa gnyis gnyis 2 2 thob/skal ba chad pa ni ye ma mchis/ de'i rjes la ltad mo chen po thang (thengs)re byed/ sman ri la lan 'ga' brag chu nyi ma 'de ('das) ba'i drung du sha ba byung pa la zhags pas bzung nas khrom bskor/ ltad mo dang po'i byas lugs 'khor sa'i sgo rgyab na bris nas yod do// sang na par yang slob dpon ke ru'i gling nas 'khar gzhong me tog gis bkang nas byon pas btsan pos dge slong

༄༅// chos 'byung gi yi ge zhib mo/ 201rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan can cig tu gzigs/ slob dpon gyis ting nge 'dzin gyis dbu rtse'i bar khang gi lha thams cad phyir spyan drangs te/ sngar gyi gral bzhin du rab tu 'khod do// btsan pos gser phye gzhong pa gang phul yon du phul/ zhal sros chen mo'i dus su ltad mo la 'tshal ma sngar bzhin du 'tshal nas rjes la ltad mo che thang re byed/ rtog pa la rnga mong bdun la zhon res byed cing byung / la la go ru rgyug pa'i steng na ral gri'i sgong 'phen/ la la mi gnyis brtsegs kyi 'phan 'phyar ba la sogs pa ltad mo bar pa'i byas lugs kyang 'khor sa'i sgo rgyab tu bris so//yang slob dpon ke ru'i gling nas 'khar gzhong me tog gis bkang pa bsnams nas byon pas de btsan pos dge slong 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dbu rgyan can du gzigs/ slob dpon gyis dbu rtse'i yang khang gi lha rnams bar rmug po'i khar ting nge 'dzin gyi spyan drangs nas dbu rtse'i thang nas me tog gtor/de nas lha rnams dus cig du nang du gshegs nas sngar gyi gral bzhin du 'khod/btsan pos gser phye gzhong pa gang yod du phul/ zhal sros chen po'i dus su ltad mo ba la 'tshal ma sngar bzhin du stsal/ rjes la ltad mo che ba thang re byed/'jang rgad pos seng ldeng gi gdung bcu 2 thod la btsugs nas dbu rtse thang la brgyugs nas lho sgo'i them pa tsar bor/ de re re mi res ma theg so shing btags pa mang po me shing kha na phar rgyug/ shing gi rtse la sgyu ma mkhan lus la me 'bar/ thang shing la byis chung 'phyang mo snyug pa la sogs pa byung ba/ ltad mo tha ma'i byas lugs kyang ngo mtshar che bas 'khor sa'i sgo rgyab du bris so//spyir slob dpon chen po bo lha sa twas bsam yas kyi chos skor ma bu rnams la mnga' gsol lan brgyad byas so// lan bdun byas pa'i rten de sprul pa'i sku dngos dang byin brlabs mnyam pa yin gsung / de'i rjes la btsan pos bsil khang gi mtsho nang na pad ma'i sdong po skyes pa'i khar bzhugs nas thugs

202 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/dam gyi lha khang 'byongs pa la gzigs pas shin tu dgyes te/ nga'i dbu rtse rigasagasum 'di/ brtsigs pa mi 'dra skyes pa 'dra ste nga re dga' bya ba la sogs pa rje'i dga' glu bcu 2 'gur du bzhes so//blon po rnams kyis kyang rang rang gi che ba'i nga rgyal glur blangs te/mchims kyis nga che rgyang grags la sogs pa'o// lo bcu gnyis kyi bar du skyid kyi bro mo che brdungs/ mi res glu re blangs/ rta res bang re brgyugs/ bya res skad re bton/ bod kyi bde skyid mnga' dar ba lags/ de dbu rtse'i sgo rgyab byang ngos na bris nas yod do// dus der rje blon rnams rtse bro dang longs spyod la yengs pas bsam yas kyi rtsig rmang thams cad byi khung byas te lha khang la mchod cing zhabs tog byed pa med pas btsan po thugs ma bde/ 'bangs rnams la chos bya bar rigs so gsung nas/ slob dpon gyis rgya gar gyi skad bslabs pas/ sba gsal snang dang / 'bab khri bzhir sang shing ta dang / pa gor na 'dod kyi bu be+e ro tsa na dang / mchims yu bu'i bu shākya dang / shud bu khong leb la sogs pas skad lobs/ mchims legs gzigs la sogs pa zhang blon gyi bu mang zhig rdugs nas skad ma lobs pas/ blon po 'gos rgan gyis mchid nas/ slob dpon rgan po rnams la long ma mchis pas a tsa ra'i skad slob mi khom pas rgan chos zhu mchis pas/ slob dpon gyis bod kyi skad don thog du phab ste chos skad dang 'thun par mkhyen nas/ bod skad du chos bshad pas sang skyi ta'i skad bslab ma dgos pas/ bod byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa yin pas chos byar btub po gsung / de nas lug lo'i dpyid zla ra ba'i yar ngo la slob dpon gyis thams cad yod par smra ba'i sde/ dbus pa bye brag du sma ba'i dge slong bcu gnyis spyan drangs nas bod skad byas pa dang / btsan po'i zhal nas nga'i blon po dge slong byed pas nga'i zhang dag la de btub bam mi btub ces bka' stsal pa'i lan du btub bam sad par bya'o

༄7// chos 'byung gi yi ge zhib mo/ 203gsung nas bod la dad pa che ba 'ba' khri gzigs dge slong byas ma thag tu mngon par shes pa dang ldan pas btsan po dgyes te de'i zhabs spyi bor blang nas khyod bod kyi rad na yin no zhes bka' stsal pas ming yang 'ba' rad nar btags te/ bod kyi rab tu byung ba la snga ba ni de yin no// btsan po na re slob dpon nga'i zhang blon dad pa che ba da rung rab tu phyung zhig ces gsungs pas/ sad cig gsung nas sba gsas snang dang / 'ba' khri bzher sang shi ta dang / pa gor na 'dod kyi bu be+e ro tsa na dang / ngan lam mchog dbyangs dang / rma a tsa ra rin chen mchog dang / la sum rgyal ba byang chub dang drug dge slong byas te/ ming yang ye shes dbang po dang / dpal dbyangs la sogs par btags nas sad mi mi bdun rab tu byung / btsan po'i zhal nas shākya thub pa'i bstan pa la sgrub pa byed na rab tu 'byung dgos pa yin pas/da btsun mo srid ma zin pa dang / zhang blon gyi bu tsha dad pa can thams cad rab tu 'byung cig gsung / blon po rnams na re dmag dang khral ma byas na chad pa yod zer/ de la ngas chab 'og nas bde ba byin la dbu'i mchod gnasabya yis gsung / sde snod gsum slob mi nus zer bas/ de la dge ba nyam bag tu spyod cig ces bkas gnang ngo // de nas pra ti ha ra'i mchod pa byas pa'i dus su jo mo gcen khri rgyal mo btsan dang / sru btsun mo rgyal la sogs pa rab tu byung ba'i mkhan po 'ba' rad nas byas/ spyir rab tu byung pa sum brgya tsam phyung nas dbu rtse'i bya 'dab dang / mchod rten chen po bzhi'i rtse mo lcags thag gis sbrel te/ de la 'phan btags te nam mkha' dar la bgyis/ sa gzhi gser phor dang dngul phor gyi bkang nas phul/ bka' shog chen po byung / chos kyi khrims bcas/ de nas pho mig mi dbyung pa/ mo sna mi gcad pa mtshan byang mi dgum pa/ skye bo thams cad kyis rje'i bka' nyan pa/ rje 'bangs thams cad kyis rab tu byung ba dbur phyung la phyag dang mchod

204 ༄༅//(sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/pa bya ba/ de ltar bya ba'i ched du btsan po yab sras dang / sna chen po ma gtogs pas bro bor ro// de nas rje blon kun chos bya bar mol nas rgya'i lo ts+tsha ni lo ts+tsha chen pos byas/ rgya nag gi lo ts+tsha ni bran ka legs kong dang / lha lung thugong dang / mgo gom dmul gong gsum/ de'i mchan bu khyung po tse tse la sogs pas byas/ rgya'i hwa shang ma zhang me skol spyan drangs nas rgya nag po'i chos bsgyur/ rgya gar las chos bsgyur ba yang rtsa ba'i sde bzhir gnas pa las/phal chen pa'i sde pa dang / mang pos bkur pa'i sde pa dang / gnas rtan pa'i sde pa dang 2 sha spangs pas bod la mi 'tsham pas ma bsgyur/ thams cad yod par smra ba'i sde pa dbus pa bye brag la rgyu 'bras ston pas de bod la 'tsham par mkhyenanas/ dang po lung ring po bsgyur/ de nas rtsa ba'i lung nyung ba dang /gang po'i rtogs pa brjod pa nyung ba bsgyur/ mngon pa nyan thos kyi ko sha bsgyur/ yo ga mu stegs byed dge ba la bzud pa'i ched du gtsang sbra med par bstan pa chos kyi gzhung ji lta ba ma rtogs te/ log par 'jal ba'i rtogs par 'gyur bas/ bod la mi 'tsham pas ma bsgyur/ kri ya bram ze dge ba la 'jug pa'i don du gsungs pas bod gtsang sbra chung bas ma bsgyur/ a nu sme bag can la bstan pas bod rnams rtog pa che bas ma bsgyur/ u pa ya bod la ran par mkhyen nas ye shes dbang pos gsol nas bsgyur/ mdo sde dang gzungs rgya gar yul du ma lus pa tsam/ btsan po'i thugs la gcags pa tsam bsgyur/ de nas btsan po na re ye shes dbang po rgya dang rgya gar gyi chos dar ma theg pa chen po'i chos dpe phal cher dpal shi len dra na yod pas de mes tshigade'i dpe da lta tshang bar yod pa shas cig ma bsgyur ba nga'i yid la gcags so gsung / de'i tshe nus pa yod tshad kyis bka' rnyed pa bsgyur ro// de nas bla nas 'tsho ba sbyar/ ke ru'i gling du g.yos sa byas te/ rab tu byung pa sum brgya la zas sna bcu 2 bcu 2 'dren/ de'i lag dpon jo mo byang chub rjes mdzad/

༄༅// chos 'byung gi yi ge zhib mo / 205gdan non pa dang rgyas pa bam po re la thog dril re byas nas 'bum tshar re bka' sgrog dus der blon po 'gos kyi mchid nas lha chos ni rgyas par mdzad na skye bo mi chos kyi lo rgyus ci gnang mchi nas/ rje'i gdung rabs dang /'bangs kyi sa bcad dang / bla'i rabs dkon mchog gsum la phyag dang zhe sa dang / gtam dang lo rgyus dang / dge dang yig tshang ji ltar yin lugs rgyas par bya ba gnang ngo // slar yang de'i dus su mkhan po pho brang rim dgu'i 'og khang du go rus dbu la 'phra ba brgyab ste/ zhal chems ye shes dbang po la ba'ag nas sku gshegs/ de'i spur kha spu ri'i rgyab du bzhugs nas mchod rten cig kyang bzhengs/ der btsan pos ye shes dbang po ring lugs la bskos/mdun sa yang bla'i gong du bton/ rab tu byung ba mang bas chos grwa'i slob dpon dang / nya ma'i slob dpon bskos/ na bza' mang la 'phan gyis sbyor/ring lugs la zla ba ri la khal bdun bcu/ chos grwa'i slob dpon la sum bcu rtsa lnga/ chos slob pa la bcu gnyis thang du bcad/ slad kyi ye shes dbang bo mngon shes dang ldan pas dkon mchog gi rten yun ring du gnas pa'i ched du dkon mchog gi rten la 'bangs mi khyim brgya/ ban de re la 'bangs mi khyim 2 2 bcad/ 'bangs lha ris thams cad bla nas dbang mi bya bar chad nas/dbang dge 'dun la bskur bas/ myang ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa ye shes dbang po la mi nyan pa kun mi zer dgu zer (dgu)zer bas/ ye shes dbang po bros nas lho brag mkhar btsan gyi brag phug tu song / rta la ga zha bkal/ rba zab gtsugs te bsgom pa'i lus la bya sa rdo la 'bab pa ltar babs/ khrims grogs la bya nyer yang mi btub/ de'i 'og tu dpal dbyangs ring lugs su bskas pa dang rgya'i hwa shang ma ha ya na bya ba byung nas lus ngag gi chos dge ba byas pas sangs mi rgya/ dran pa med cing yid la bya ba med pas sangs rgyas zer nas bsgom bslabs pas bod thams cad kho'i chos la slob/ bsam yas

206 ༄7//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/la mchod pa 'phro bcad/ slob gnyer dang lus ngag gi dge sbyor 'phro bcad/'ba' rad na dang / be+e ro tsa na dang / 'ba' dpal dbyangs la sogs pa nyung shas cig slob dpon bo dhi sa twa'i chos slob/ lta ba ma mthun nas rtsod par gyur/ btsan pos rgya'i ston pa'i chos min nam byas pas ston min pa bya bar grags/ drang srong bzod pas lus la me sbar nas mchod pa phul nas/brtse ba'i sgo nas sems can la tshogs sog pa gal che byas pas/ btsan po na re lus la me gtong pa'i brtse ba de yang brtse ba min nam byas pas rtsen min par grags so// lta ba dang spyod pa 'dzom pa chos yin bas chos rtsen min ba'i chos ltar yin byas pas/ ston min pa yi chad pa ltar byas nas myang sha mis rang gi sha bcad/ rngog rin po che dang / snya bi ma las rang gi pho mtshan brdungs/ rgya'i ston pas rang gi mgo la me sbar/ gzhan rnams chu gri re btsugs nas rtsen min pa ril le bsad nas nged (ded)kyang 'phrul pa'i ngos su mchi'o zer/ de btsan po'i snyan du brdas pas/ ji ltar bya ba ma shes te ban te bton/ btsan pos g.yon bskor te/ ye shes dbang po la zhu ba'i 'bod mi btang bas ma khugs/ nang blon pa gnon kham pa btang ste/ khyod kyis ye shes dbang po spyan 'drongs na zangs chen po bya dgar sbyin/ ma khugs na khyod gsod do zhes bsgo nas/ btsan pos sgrom bu bskur nas btang ngo //kham pas brag phug tu phyin bka'i sgrom bu nang du bskur nas nang du mchi bar ci gnang zhus pas/ mchi bar gnang ste zhal mjal nas/ bdag ngosabatsugs te/ byon na bya dga'ang gnang / ma byon na bdag 'gum pas brag 'di la mchongs te 'gum mo zhes byas pas/ 'dir bar chad kyi bdud chen po cig 'ongs te/ khyod kyi srog gdon pa'i phyir 'gro'o gsung nas/ nga 'ong gis rta ded la shog bya ba'i 'phrin bskur khams pa dga' ches nas pho brang du btsan po'i snyan du gsol nas/ bya dga' gnang nas go ru bcu drug ded nas ye

༄༅// chos 'byung gi yi ge zhib mo/ 207shes dbang po spyan drangs nas pho brang du btsan po la phyag bzhes te/ btsan pos btsun pa 'khrugs pa'i lo rgyus zhib tu gsungs pas ye shes dbang po na re de la bdag dgug mi 'tshal/ slob dpon bo bhi sa twa'i zhal chems bdog/bdag bsgom pa'i bar chad ma byas na nga tshe ring na btsan po nga sku tshe ring la/dam pa'i chos kyang 'phags pa byams pa byon pa'i bar du gnas pa yin pa la bod la skal ba ma mchis/ mkhan po 'da' kur 'di skad ces gsungs te/sangs rgyas kyi chos gar dar ba der/ mu stegs kyi rgol ba'i dgra re 'gran du 'ong ba yin ste/ bod yul du lnga brgya'i tha mar gyur pas sangs rgyas kyi chos dar kyang mu stegs kyi rgol ba ni mi 'ong na/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa nang lta ba ma mthun pas rtsod par gyur gyis/ de tsam na nga'i slob ma ka ma la shi la bya ba paṇa ṭi ta chung ba cig bal yul na yod/ de khug la chos kyi rtsod pa'i shags 'debs su chug cig/ rtsod pa chos phyogs su 'dum par 'gyur ro gsung zhes gsol nas btsan pos ka ma la shi la spyan 'dren pa'i pho nya btang bas/ ston min bas yum rgyas pa spyan drangs te bsam gtan gling du sgo bsdams nas zla ba bzhi'i bar du shags bslabs/ mdo dgongs pa nges par 'grel pa rdog pas 'dril zhing 'di chos min zer nas bor/ de'i bar du ye shes dbang pos mkhan po dang / hwa shang gnyis kyi lta ba dang dgongs pa ji ltar yin pa btsan po'i snyan du gsol bas/ btsan po dgongs pa grol nas dgyes ches te/ ye shes dbang po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal te/ khyod ni nga'i a tsa bya'o zhes yang yang gsung / dus phyis ka ma la rlung tshugs su byon zhes pho nya ba byung ba dang /rje blon yongs chab khar bsu ba la phyin pa dang / hwa shang 'khor dang bcas pa yang chab khar byon/ ka ma la shi las chab phar kha nas rgya'i paṇa ṭi ta la sgra tshad dri gsung nas chags shing dbu la lan 2 bskor bas/ hwa shang chab tshu kha nas per gyi thu ba nas bzung nas sprug des lan btab/ 'jigs po cig 'dug

208 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/go gsung nas byang chub gling du seng ge'i khri bcas te btsan po gung la bzhugs nas ston rtsen gnyis shags gdab pa ra byas/ hwa shang sayas gral la bzhugs te/ 'khor jo mo byang chub rje dang / sru yang dag la sogs pa gral ring po byung / a tsa r+ya ka ma la shi la sayon gral la bzhugs te/ 'khor dpal be+e ro tsa na dang / rad na la sogs pa nyung shas cig byung / btsan pos ston tsen re re'i phyag du me tog dkar po re re phul te/ bkal stsal ba/ nga'i ma/nga' ris bod kyi rgyal khams 'dir bod thams cad nag po la dga' ba'i dus su za hor rgyal po bo lha sa twa spyan drangs nas bod 'bangs nyung shas cig chos la bkod/dad pa can kha cig rab tu byung / dkon mchog 2 gyi rten btsugs pa'i skabs su/ rgya nag po hwa shang ma ha ya na 'dir byon pas bod kyi btsun pa phal che ba de la slob par gyur/ bo dhi sa twa'i slob ma nyung shas cig de la slob du ma btub nas ston rtsen du chad/ de gnyis ma mthun nas rtsod par gyur pa las ngas zhal che bcad pas ma rangs nas myang sha mi dang rngog dang / snya rnams kyis rang gi lus la na tsha bskyed/ hwa shang me 'gos rang gi mgo la me btang /btsan pos g.yon bskor/ bo bhi sa twa'i 'khor ka ma la shi la yin pas byed shags khyed la su gtan tshigs bzang ba de la su ngan pa des nga rgyal mi bya bar me tog phul cig ces bka' stsal/ de la hwa shang na re nga ga'i la snga bas ngas dri'am lan gdab zer/ ka ma la'i zhal nas khyod kyis dgongs pa ltar shags thob cig gsungs pa dang / hwa shang na re thams cad sems kyi rnam par rtog pas bskyed pas dge mi dge'i (dges) dbang gis las dge mi dge'i byed pa ri ngan song gi 'bras bu nyams su myong zhing 'khor ba na 'khor ro// gangadag cil yang mi sems ci'ang yid la mi byed pa de 'khor ba las yongs su thar par 'gyur ro// de lta bas na ci yang mi bsam mo/ sbyin pa la sogs pa chos spyod bcu spyod pa ni skye bo dge ba'i 'phro med pa blo zhan pa dbang po rtul po

༄༅// chos 'byung gi yi ge zhib mo/ 209rnams la bstan pa yin/ sngon blo sbyangs pa dbang po rnon po dag la sprin dkar nag gang gis kyang nyi ma sgrib pa ltar/ dge sdig gnyis gas sgrib pas ci la yang mi sems mi rtog mi dpyod pa ni mi dmigs pa'o// gcig car 'jug pa ni sa bcu pa dang 'dra'o gsungs pa dang / a tsa r+ya ka ma las smras pa/de ltar ci yang mi bsam zer ba de ni so sor rtog pa'i shes rab spangs pa yin no// yang dag pa'i shes rab kyi rtsal ni so sor rtog pa'i shes rab yin pas na de spangs pa ni rtsa ba bcad pa'i phyir 'jig rten las 'das pa'i shes rab kyang spangs pa yin no// so sor rtog pa'i shes rab med par rnal 'byor pa gang gis rnam par mi rtog pa la gnas par bya/ gal te chos thams cad dran pa med cing yid la bya ba med pa yin na nyams su myong pa thams cad mi dran zhing yid la bya bar mi nus so// gal te chos thams cad mi dran zhing yid la mi bya'o snyam na de shin tu yid la byas par 'gyur ro// dran pa dang yid la bya ba med pa tsam po la bya ba skad du bya na de gnyis dpyad dgos te/ med pa ni rgyur mi rung / dran pa med pa tsam gyis rnam par mi rtog par 'gyur na brgyal ba'am 'bog pa'i dus su dran pa med pas rnam par mi rtog par 'gyur ro// yang dag pa'i so sor rtog pa med par rnam par mi rtog par 'jug pa'i thabs med do// dran pa tsam po bkag kyang yang dag pa'i so sor rtog pa med na chos thams cad ngo bo nyid med pa la ji ltar 'jug nus/ stong pa nyid ma rtogs par sgrib pa spangs par mi 'gyur ba kho na'o// stong pa nyid ma rtogs kyang dran pa med pas thar par 'gyur na khams gong ma'i lha thams cad kyang thar par 'gyur ro// dran pa thams cad cang med pa'i rmongs pas ni rnal 'byor du ji ltar 'gyur/ de ni glen pa dang gnyid log dang 'dra'o// de bas na yang dag pa'i so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis phyin ci log gi snang ba rgyang bsrings pa yin no// de lta bas na dran bzhin du mi dran byar mi rung ngo // dran pa dang

210 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/yid la bya ba med pas sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa dang / thams cad mkhyen par ji ltar 'gyur nyon mongs pa yang ji ltar spong / de bas na yang dag par so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis don nges par rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas dus gsum phyi nang thams cad stong par rtags pas rtog pa nye bar zhi nas lta ba ngan pa thams cad rnam par spangs te/ de brtan nas thabs dang shes rab la mkhas pa sgrib pa thams cad bsal nas sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad thob par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs so// btsan po'i zhal nas/ khyed ston rtsen shags gang rgyal ba'i 'khor kun yang shags thob cig ces bka' stsal pas/ sang shi'i mchid nas rgya'i ltar na gcig car 'jug cing rim gyis sbyong mchi na/ pha rol du phyin pa drug kyang 'dzin pa ma mchis pa'i slad du sbyin par ming btags kyi khams btang nas yongs su 'dzin pa med pas ni sbyin pa btang ba yin/sgo 2 chags sdang bkag na tshul khrims yin/ khro ba med na bzod pa yin/ le lo 'dor na brtson 'grus yin/ sems la g.yeng ba ma mchis na bsam gtan yin/ chos spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid shes na shes rab lags/ ston pa 'das nas ring zhig tu lta ba la mi mthun pa ma mchis/ slad nas dbu ma rnam 2 ma mthun te/ ston min gcig car du 'jug mchi ste ma mjal ma rtogs pas de ltar gyur/ 'jug sgo tha dad kyang sangs rgyas par cig 'bras bu'ang cig ces don gyis mi mthun pa skad du smras/ dpal dbyangs kyis smras pa/gcig car 'jug bya ba dang rim gyis 'jug bya ba 'di gnyis dpyad dgos ste/rim gyis 'jug par 'tshal na ni nged rtsen min dang mi 'dra rgyu yang ma mchis/gcig car (nas) ma mchis 'jug na khyed da rung du ci byed/ dang po nas sangs rgyas na ci nyes/ de bas na 'jog pa yang gom pa re re 'jog pa dka' te/ gom pa gcig gis bgrod mi nus pa ltar/ sa dang po thob pa yang dka' na thams cad mkhyen pa lta ci smos/ khyed la lung bstan pa'i khungs dgos/

༄༅// chos 'byung gi yi ge zhib mo/ 211ston rtsen mi 'dra ste/ nged rtsen min pas gsung rab kun bslabs/ shes rab rnam 2 la brten nas ma nor bar shes/ chos spyod bcu bslabs/ bsgoms pas sa dang po la bzod pa thob/ yang dag pa'i skyon med par yang 'jugade nas sa dgu yang dag pa'i shes rab kyis rim par sbyangs/ pha rol tu phyin pa bcu la bslabs/ rgyud sbyangs tshogs bsags nas sangs rgyas brnyes pa lags na khyod ltar na tshogs ma bsags blo ma sbyangs pas 'jig rten gyi bya ba yang mi shes na thams cad mkhyen pa rig pa dang shes bya'i gnas thams cad la 'jug par ji ltar 'gyur/ ji ltar tshogs ma bsags par ci yang ma byas na gum na zan yang ma myong nas ltogs te mchi na/ sangs rgyas rang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pa de'i rgyu de ci las grub/ stong pa gcig pus rang la yang mi phan na gzhan gyi don lta ga la 'grub/ khungs med cing thabs shes rab ya bral ba'i chos kyis sangs rgyas la bskur pa btab ste bslus pa yin no//byang chub sems dpa' ni sems can gyi don du sems bskyed nas sems can gyi don lhur byas na tshogs bsags te thabs la mkhas par bslabs/ shes rab rnam pa 2 la blo sbyangs/ ye shes kyi tshogs bsags/ sgrib pa gnyis sbyangs/ blo'i dri ma thams cad rnam par spangs nas sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god par mdzad pa'i 'phrin las 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du lhun gyis grub pa yin par lung du ma nas gsungs so// ci la yang mi sems pa ni sgong nga dang 'dra'o// ma brtags par gom pa bor kyang rdab bsal te/ chos lta ga la rtogs/ de bas na mdo sde chud par bslabs shing /zhi gnas dang lhag mthong dben par yid la byas/ rtogs pa yid la myong bar shar/ de ltar rtogs pa'i don du tshogs bsags shing / sems ji lta bu ste/don dam par ma skyes par rtogs ste/ chos thams cad chu shing gi snying po lta bur ma bcos par rtogs na/ dus 2 mi dmigs par 'gyur te/ chos dang
