212 ༄༅//(sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/gang zag la bdag ma mchis te/ bying rgod ma mchis par zung 'brel du ngang gis 'jug pa lags te/ bsgom na'ang de ltar lags ces mchi ba dang/ston min/ shags lan smra bar ma nus te/ me tog gtor nas 'pham par khas blangs so// de nas btsan po'i zhal nas/ hwa shang gi chos gcig car 'jug mchi ba des chos spyod bcu la skyon bskal/ sems ni bying tshogs ni mi sog/ gzhan blo sbyong 'phro bcad pas chos kyang nub par gyur pas 'phro chod la khyod rang bsgoms cig deng slan chad lta ba na gwa rdzu na'i lta ba zung / spyod r+pā pha rol tu phyin pa drug la gyis la chos spyod bcu nyams su long / bsgom pa shes rab rnam 2 gyis blo sbyongs la la thabs shes rab zung du 'brel par bsgom kad slan chad nga'i bod 'bangs rje blon gang gis kyang chos byed pa rnams kyisabod thang khob tu gyur pa dang / rig pa blun zhing rang dga' ba mang ste/ chos rtogs par dka' zhing zab par gyur pas/ rgya gar gyi mkhas pa rab tu grags pa rgyal pos spyan drangs ste/ lo ts+tsha ba mkhas pas gtan la phab pa de la 'jugapar bya'o// rgyal pos yon bdag ma byas/ lo tsha ba mkhas pas gtan la phab pa'i chos gang la yang 'jug par mi bya bar bka' nan drag tu stsal nagabaka' rtsigs kyi yi ge zhib mo ni 2 du mchis te/ bse'i sgrom bur stsal nas kha la lcags bcug nas rje'i phyag sbal na mchis te/ gnod sbyin dam rgya nag po la gtad do// che long cig ni zhang blon rnams la yang dar bar byas/ de nasahwa shang ma hwa ya nas gtsug lag khang cig bzhengs nas slar rgya yul du gshegagebatsan po'i thugs dgongs grub nas/ tshong 'dus su bad rngam pa'i lha khababazhengs nas dga' ston mdzad pa'i dus su bod 'bangs thams cad tshog pa dang / 'bangs thams cad chos la bzung cing chos mi byar mi btub pa'i phyir dbus mtha' thams cad du slob dpon bskos/ zhang blon gyi bu tsha dathobatsun mo thams cad kyang ka ba li re thogs nas chos slob du bcug btsan ṣ+pe

༄༅// chos 'byung gi yi ge zhib mo/ 213la slob dpon ka ma la shi la la chos thams cad thos bsam gyis gtan la phab pa'i chos de ji ltar lags pa cig yi ger bkod par zhus pas bsgom rim dang po brtsams nas btsan po la gnang / de btsan pos gzigs pas don dgongs nas dgyes te/ de'i don stan cig gi thog du bsgom na ji ltar bsgom zhus pas/ bsgom rim bar pa brtsams nas gnang / de ltar bsgom pa de la 'bras bu ji lta bu mchi zhus pas/ bsgom rim tha ma bcoms nas 'bras bu bstan pa'i zhor la hwa shang gi lta ba de sun phyung nas gnang / de la shin du dgyes pas de'i don 'grel du bo lha sa twa'i dgongs pa la rgol ba byung gi dogs pa'i ched du lung dang rigs par 'brel pa dbu ma snang bas rtsams nas gnang / de nas chos kyi rkyen gnyis brgya lnga bcu bla nas gnang ste/ ring lugs la nas khal bdun bcu rtsa lnga/ na bza' dgu phrugs re re/ spod mar srang stong chig brgya/ chab 'og theg pa re re/ shog gu deb bzhi sna tsha yug 2/lan tshwa zad len/ mching bu'i sgom chen nyi shu la nas khal lnga bcu rtsa lnga lnga/spod mar srang brgyad brgya brgyad brgya/ chibs pa re re/ na bza' dgu phugs re re/ chos grwa'i slob dpon du sgo ba bcu 2 la nas khal lnga bcu rtsa lnga lnga/ na bza' phrug re re spod mar srang brgyad brgya/ mtshams kyi ban rte rang dga' ba rnams la gang zag re re la nas khal brgyad brgyad/ shog deb gnyis gnyis snag tsha yug re re/ slob gnyer ba nyi shu rtsa lnga la re re la nas khal nyi shu rtsa lnga lnga/gos sum phrugs re re rgyun du gnang nas lha chos dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pas rje dka' drin che ba lags/ slad kyis slob dpon pad ma sam bha ba'i chos kyis 'phro lus pa la thugs ma tshim nas be+e ro tsa na dang rtsangs legs grub chos tshol du btang / slar log pa la paṇa ṭi ta ma byon pas blo ma ches te rgya'i snyan phra'i dbang du thal nas be+e ro tsa na tsha ba rong du bskrad/ ka ma la shi la la mu stegs kyis gshed ma btang nas nub mo sgra bsgyur gyi khang par gzims mal du

214 ༄༅//(sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/mkhal ma brnyes nas bkrongs/ ye shes dbang po 'da' dkar btsan po pham babs gsol nas deng slan chad kham gyi zas spangs so// ting nge 'dzin chos kyi zas dang rje'o zhes gsungs nas grongs pa'i dus su nam mkha' la 'od dang sgra byung / bya thams cad gdung pa'i skad 'don/ gdung khang khas po ri'i rtse la rtsigs na legs bya ba byung / ye shes dbang po'i bu mo spyan ras kyi gzigs kyis rtsigs pa'i mchod rten gyi rtsar mchod rten rtsig pa'i sa klus bstan/ de'i rdo la rgya yig byung / mchod rten de la lha mo 2 bskor byed cing / su bde ba can du 'gro ba des mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad 'di la bskor ba gyis shig ces zer ba dang / btsan po na re a tsa r+ya'i gsung dang sbyar na kho bo'i tshes kyang ring por mi thub ces thugs ngan mdzad nas/ rje thugs las chung ngu la gzhol bar bzhed nas/ paṇa ṭi ta spyan 'dren du btang bas/ a tsa r+ya bi ma la mi tra byon nas/ slob dpon pad ma sam bha ba'i chos 'phro zhus nas bsgom mdzad par bzhed nas/ sras mu ne btsan po la chab srid bsgo ba dang / blon po zhang 'u ring btsan po la bgro ba'i gros dbu rtse'i bar khang gi mnga' khang na bzhugs pa jo mo me tog sgron gyis mthong ste/ thugs gtum pas dogs 'tshal nas chab srid sna nam pa la ster nges snyam ste mu rug btsan po la gsol nas/ lha sras kyis 'u ring sgo bar du btsir nas chu gri stsal nas bkum/ yab na re 'u ring gar song zhes pa dang / gri khrag can bor nas/ 'u ring rgyang ring por song zer nas bar khang du 'bros nas rje'i thugs dam 'gyangs nas g.yar mchu byung bar dogs nas thugs ma bde nas blon 'dzangs pa kun gros byas te/blon po 'gos kyi zhal che dga' 2 du bcad/ chab srid mu ne+e btsan po mnga' bar bgyis/ thun tshags skar ma mdzad nas gtad/ yab zung kur du bsgom du gshegs so// btsan po'i bka' rtsigs kyi yi ge zhib mo gsum las/gcig lha sa na yod/ gcig 'khams su khyer/ gcig rje'i phyag sbal na mchis

༄༅// chos 'byung gi yi ge zhib mo/ 215so// sras mu ne btsan po dgung lo bco lnga lon tsa na jo mo ru yong gza' mdo rgyal khab tu bzhes te/ rgyal srid gtad nas/ chab srid shin tu rgya che bas thun tshags skar ma dang mthun pa bgyi bar dgongs nas/ bla'i mchod gnas rab du byung ba'i mnga' thang dang / chos 'khor stod smad kyi zhabs thog yab kyi srol bzhin du mdzad/ dpal brag dmar bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang du dus kyi mchod pa chen po bzhi btsugs nas/ bod kyi rje blon yongs kyi 'phral gyi rkyen bzlog dang / yun gyi tshogs gsog mdzad/mchod rten chen po bzhi'i gdugs dang dbu rtse'i bya 'dab lcags thag gis sbrel nas nam mkha' dar 'phan gyis bres/ sa gzhi la man 'jim gling mangs/gser dngul gyi phor pa la sogs pas bkang / dbu rtse'i thang thams cad mchod rdzas kyis khengs par bgyis nas/ lcags ri'i phyogs bzhi nas 'bangs thams cad rgyan dang bcas mchod rdzas dang chas nas dbu rtse'i thang la rtse bro byed cing 'ong / btsan pos dbu rtse'i sgo'i thang la khri'i steng nas mchod pa phul bas dad pa skyes nas dbu'i la thod dang / na bza' phud nas lha la phul/ de nas lha btsan po'i zhal nas/ nga'i yab kyi thugs dam gyi lha khang la khyed bod 'bangs thams cad kyi go ru dang mtshon cha ma gtogs pa thams cad phul cig ces bka' stsal nas/ 'bangs thams cad kyis rje'i bka'astsal pa ltar phul te/ kha cig gis ni g.yu dang ber la sogs pa phul/kha cig gis ni ra glag la sogs pa phul bas mchod rdzas kyi phung po chen po'o//de dbon mchog gi gnyer pa/ra bskos pa kun gyis btul nas mchod pa byed/mchod pa'i 'bul rgyu bzang ngan byung bas/ btsan po'i zhal nas/ khyed dad pa che chung khyad re che/ la las gser dang g.yu 'bul nus/ la las ras glag tsam las 'bul mi nus zhes bka' stsal pas/ mi ltogs kun na re rje cig

216 ༄༅//(sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/lags nged dad pa chung ba ma lags te ltogs pas 'bul rgyu de las ma mchis so// 'bul rgyu che ba kun phyus cing nor mchis pa lags so zhes snyan du gsol bas/ kye ma nga'i mnga' ris su la las zas gos tsam yang mi 'byor/ la las lhag dang bcas pa mi rigs so gsung nas/ las mi bskos nas ru bzhi phyogs phyogs su ltogs phyug snyams te/ yo byad bsnyams so//de nas mngon par byang chub pa'i zla ba la mngon pa'i mchod pa bgyis te/zhing pa kun thong bor rmon pa btang nas rol du gshol ldem me bzhag nas mchod pa byed du 'ong / yang snga ma bzhin du mchod rdzas bzang ngan byung bas yang ltogs phyugs lan cig bsnyams/ de nas dbyar zla 'bring po'i zla ba la mdo sde'i mchod pa chen po bgyis ste/ 'ing pa kun yur gra bshig nas sngo snod rdos mnan nas mchod pa byed du 'ong / yang snga ma bzhin du mchod rdzas bzang ngan byung bas rang rang gi las su dgongs te/ bod 'bangs ltogs phyug lan cig bsnyams/ de nas ston zla tha chungs kyi zla ba la cho 'phrul chung ba la 'dul ba'i mchod pa bgyis te/ yang mchod rdzas bzang ngan byung bas rang rang gi bsnyams te/ tshong pa dang 'gron po lam du rgyu ba thams cad kyang rgyags phye khyer mi dgos te bla nas shug srog gcod pa dang rku 'phrog gis sgrub mi dgos par bod 'bangs bde ba la bkod pas bka' drin che ba lags so//slad kyis jo mo pho yong za rgyal mo btsun la yab rgyal po thugs la 'dogs pa la yum glo ba la gcags pas gshed ma mi brgyad bskos nas yab btsan po la byad bgyid du stsal/ yab 'da' khar pho yong za rgyal mo btsun lha sras kyi khab tu bzhes cig ces bka' stsal/ yab sku gshegs pa'i 'og tu tshe spong zas pho yong za dkrongs su 'ongs pas pho yong za skra sar bgyis nas rgyan ma phog par gda'/ de la snyad byas la ral gri brgyag snyam tsa na sras kyis g.yon bskor/ de glo ba la gcags nas blon dgung nga lte chung phyag tshang du bskos

༄7// chos 'byung gi yi ge zhib mo/ 217nas pho brang yun bur sras la gsang ngan drangs nas mu ne+e btsan pos srin zla ba bcu bdun mdzad nas dgung lo bcu bdun la 'das te/ bang so skye 'u ldem bu can brtsigs so//tshe yong zas pho yong za la rang gi bu'i ral gri brtsal bas sman bas gsos pas sos pa dang / nyin re la shags rgod re btab cing sen mos sha srang re bcad cing dkrongs so// de nas mu rug btsan po dbang bskur bar chad byas nas/ mon nas spyan drang rgyu la sna nam pas brang khang phye nas dkrugs te dkrongs/ bang so skya bo zang zang brtsigs/ 'bangs yongs gros byas te/cungakhri lde srong btsan dbang bskur bar byas pas/ kha cig na re rgyal bu sku nar ma son te 'bangs kyi tshis mi 'ong bas blon 'dzangs pa bskos la khrim bu chung bca'o mchi/ kha cig na re sngon kyang yab sku 'das pa'i dus na rgyal bu sku nar ma son nas 'ang blon gsum la khrims gtad pas khrims bu chung bcas nas lha chos bsnubs nas gyod ka che po la thug ste bod phung bar byas/ rgyal bu dbang bskur la blon 'dzangs pa bskos la 'bangs kun gyi tshis bgyi gsol nas/ rgyal bus 'ong mi 'ong sad par 'cham nas rgyal bu dgung lo bzhi la dbang bskur nas chab srid gtad pas sad pa bzhin du legs par byung bas rgyal po sad na legs zhes bya/ 'jang pa yo la sku dbang che bas glang 'jing yon zhes kyang grags so//rgyal po de sku nar son nas 'bro za ma mo lha rgyal khab tu bzhes/ 'bro khri zung blon du bskos te/ rgyal po de'i zhal nas 'dzam bu'i gling na bod kyi rgyal po che/ bod na rgyal po nga che bas nga lag ris lha khang nyi ma tsam pa cig rtsig go zhes bka' stsal/ de slob dpon mdzod mkhan la dris pas rgyar dpag tshad lnga bcu rtsa gcig yod pas bod kyi sa gzhi la mi shong ces pas/ 'o na zla ba tsam gcig rtsig gsung / de la rgyar dpag tshad lnga bcu yod ces pas/ nga skar

218 ༄༅//(sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/chen tsam cig rtsig go zhes bka' stsal/ de rgyang grags bco brgyad yod ces pas/ byang 'brog sa yangs pas byang 'brog la rtsig ces bka' stsal/ blon po kun gyis mchid nas bla blon gyi longs spyod dbus su byed pas lha khang stong par 'brus so zhes gsol bas/ nyang rdor cig go zhes gsungs pas/ der yang thugs dam cig bzhengs pa'i rtsigs su bzung nas rgya de skar ma chung du tsam zhig rtsig pa'i chad byas/ skar chung lha khang bzhengs su gsol te rgyar rgyang grags cig rmang bres pa dang / bzo bo rnams kheng grags byas ste/ rtsig pa mkhan na re nga'i rtseg pa med na gang byas kyang mi btub pas nga gtso che zer/shing bzo ba na re nga'i shing bzo med na gang byas kyang don la phan med pas nga gtso che zer/ lder so mkhan po na re nga'i lha bzo med na gang byas kyang don med pas gtso che zer nas/ dang po rko ba btsos nas lder so 'khrul 'khor du bzheng du gsol/ de na ka ba bskor nas rgya phebs bskal/ de nas rig pa phyi tha la bgyis te/ skar chung rtsig pas khyad par 'phags pa lags so//rgyal po des yab mes kyi srol ma shor bar mdzad/ yab mes kyi thugs dam gyi zhig ral gso ba dang / rgyan gdags pa dang / ra sa'i khyams khra mo bzhengs pa la sogs pa'i phyag rjes mang du mdzad/ rab tu byung ba'i mnga' thang bstod/ 'bangs chab srid chos bzhin du mdzad pas bka' drin che ba lags so// de'i sras ni lnga ste khri gtsug lde btsan/ lha sras gtsang ma/ khri dar ma 'u dum btsan/ lheb rje/ lhun grub bo/ gcen khri gtsug lde btsan lo bcu gnyis lon pa dang dbang bskur nas chab srid gtad/ co ro za dpal gyi ngang tshul ma la sogs pa'i btsun mo lnga khab du bzhes/ rba mang rje lha lod kyi blon byas/ ban chen po dpal gyi yon tan gyis chos kyi blon po bgyis te/ mes kyi bad rngam pa'i lha khang la dpe byas te/ thugs dam dgu rtsegs bzhengs par chad pa'i dus su rje'i zhal nas/ yab kyi ring la btsan po la bya ba rnam pa 2

༄༅// chos 'byung gi yi ge zhib mo/ 219yod de/ thugs dam du gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa dang / bod 'bangs bde ba la bkod pa dang / sku la gdo (sngo) ba la dmag drang pa'o// yab mes rnams kyis la las re re tsam mdzad/ la las gnyis gnyis tsam mdzad/ la las 2 2 tsam mdzad na yang rim par mdzad/ nga gsum ka dus gcig la byed do zhes bka' stsal nas/ thugs dam gyi gtsug lag khang gi rmang 'dings par byas tsa na/ lha sa mkhar 'dra ba/ bsam yas grong 'dra/ skar chung mchad pa 'dra/ lha khang gsha' ma cig ngas byed do zhes bka' stsal nas/ rgya dkar nag dang / bal po dang / li yul dang / kha che dang / bod yul gyi bzo gra mkhas pa thams cad bkug ste/ rgya'i ju yag mkhas pas cig gis sa btsal nas/ rdo'i bzo bo mkhas pa cig li yul lcang ra smug po na yod pa thos pas/ gla ba cig lcags kyi gra bar bcug nas/ 'di bod kyi btsan po'i yos kyi glang po che yin bas 'di bzhes la li spyod pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba'i bzo bo mkhas pa cig yod pa de bod kyi btsan po thugs dam lha khang gi/ bzo byed pa la gnang par zhu bya ba dang / de ma gnang na btsan po'i thugs khros na dmag 'dren no bya ba'i bka'i sgrom bu bskur nas pho nya btang / pho nya bas de li rje la phul bas/ li rjes bka' sgom phul ba de gzigs pas/ yos kyi glang po'i chu dang ril ma tshun chad yos su byung ba'i zhu rten la'ang mnyes/ btsan po'i bka' bzhin ma bsgrubs na dmag 'ong ba la'ang 'jigs nas/ bka' sgrom nas byung ba ltar brdzang bar chad nas/ li spyod pa'i rgyal po bod yul du mchi 'tshal bar bsgo bas/ nga rgas pa'i bu 2 btsan po'i phyag du 'bul lo mchi bas/ li rje na re khyod rang btsan po'i dang g.yar ma mjal na li yul du btsan po'i dmag 'ong / sngon yang bod kyi btsan pos rta pa'i dmag drangs nas li cham la phab ces zer nas/ li spyod pa'i rgyal pos lam du gum yang mgo btsan po'i phyag tu phul cig ces bka' drag tu stsal nas/ de'i bu li

220 ༄༅//(sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/gser gzungs/ li gser 'od/ li gser tog 2 bod du bzo byed du brdzangs/ pho nya la skyes bskur nas yar yongs/ li spyod pa'i rgyal po ma gum par btsan po dang 'al mjal/ 'dzam bu'i gling na rdo bzo mkhas pa'i bal po rdo mkhan la sogs pas bzo bgyis te/ 'og khang 2 sgo'i reb bca' man chod rdo la bgyis ste/ rdo bzos khyad par du 'phags te/ phud ra sa'i gtsug lag khang du mes kyis chos srol btod pas bka' drin che bas rdo rings phul/ ri mo'i phud dar gyi be bum brgya rtsa brgyad phul/ lder so'i phud tshangs pa dang brgya byin gnyis bzhengs su gsol/ lugs ma'i phud gcong chen po dril bu'i tshul du phul/ bar khang 2 so phag la byas/ stong khang 2 shing dang / zangs dang / rka bo ba la byas/ rgya phibs kyi 'og na rlung gi 'khor lo bskor te/rab tu byung ba mang po rgyun du bskor ba byed/ bya 'dab la phyogs bzhir lcags thag bzhis mchod rten chen po bzhi la gtod/ rlung chen po nub nas langs pa'i tshe shar gyi lcags thag lhod la rgya phebs shar du yo tsam 'gro/ rlung shar nas langs na nub kyi lcags thag lhod la rgya phibs nub tu cung zad yo/ri dag gi rtse la na bun byung ba dang / lha khang gi khyung mgo la yang na bun thul gyis 'ong ba'i mthon po cig bzhengs su gsol lo// 'bangs bde ba la bkod pa yang zas dang gos tsam gyis bde ba ni 'phral du stsal/ yun du bde ba'i lha chos la dgod pa'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa'i glegs bam las byung bar gzigs pas/ chos la la rgya nag po'i skad du smra/ chos la la rgya dkar po'i skad du smra/ chos la las bal po dang u rgyan gyi skad du smra bas/ mes kyi lha/dam pa'i chos lugs dang / chos skad sna tshogs su byung ba 'di ma legs te/ cisangs rgyas rgya dkar por byon nas chos dang po rgya dkar por gsungs pa yin bas/ nga yang chos thams cad rgya dkar po'i lugs su mgrin cig byed ces bka' stsal nas/ bod phrug blo rno ba bcu drug gser bskur nas lo ts+tsha slob du

༄༅// chos 'byung gi yi ge zhib mo/ 221btang ste/ la las sgra ma shes/ la la tshad pas gum/ la la tha tre rnam 2 la rdugs/ dka' ba dpal brtsegs dang / sna nam ye shes sde dang / cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan dang 2 gyis lo ts+tsha sgra mkhas pa bslabs nas/ paṇa ṭi ta 'dzi na mi tra dang / shi len tra bo bhi dang / da na shi la dang 2 spyan drangs te/ sgra bsgyur rgya gar gling du rkyen bla nas sbyar nas/ mes kyi lha khang na bzhugs pa dang / bod kyi yul na yod pa'i gsung rab kyi dpe ma lus pa spyan drangs nas sgra bsgyur te/ sgra thams cad rgya dkar po'i 'gyur du bcos/ skad gsar chad kyis gtan la phab nas/ kyi shod sho ma rar gtan la phab/ btsan po dad pa che bas mdun sa chung ngu rab tu byung ba la phul bas/ lo ts+tsha ba'i zhal nas bod 'bangs kun gdul dka' bas chad pa la brten nas skyong dgos pa la ded rab tu byung ba ston pa'i bka' 4na (bzhin)du bgyid 'tshal bas/ chad pa'i las bgyir mi rung zhes gsol bas/ gsung khan mi bgyid pa la ngas zhang blon dag bgyid du stsal/ chab srid bzhes par zhu zhes bka' stsal/ rje'i la thod phud nas rab tu byung ba'i gdan du 'dings/ rab tu byung ma thos gcig gi'ang zhabs spyi bor len/ gos ser po'i lhan pa skye bo'i lus la 'dug pa mthong yang rgyal pos phyag mdzad/ 'ang blon gang gis rten phul nas snyun phyag nyi shu rtsa gcig phul yang lan mi gnang / bod yongs la gsar sha bsdus te/bla'i dge 'dun la sla tsher 'bul/ rab byung re re la 'bangs mi khyim bdun bdun lha ris su phul nas zas dang na bza' sbyor/ rab byung gi gos la lhan pa gcig gzigs na'ang dris nas de'i lha ris la bka' dras tu stsal/ skye bo khyim pa'i tshis kun rab tu byung ba'i mdun sa chung ngu na bzhin chos dang bstun nas shin tu bde zhing skyid par mdzad pas bka' drin che'o// btsan pos dbon zhang sdums bya bar chad nas ma 'cham nas/ bod ru bzhi nas dmag stong sde bco brgyad bco brgyad dang dar tshan khrig ge khrid nas rgya yul du dmag

222 ༄༅//(sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/drangs/ rgya'i gyen po thams cad bkum nas rgya cham la phab/ rta pa'i nyin lam bcu bzhi mngar 'dus te/ rgya'i hwa shang dang bod kyi paṇa ṭi ta rnams kyis bar dang dpang mdzad nas rgya'i gong bu rme ru ru rgya'i gtsug lag khang cig dang / btsan po'i gtsug lag khang cig bzhengs su gsol/ de'i bar du sa la btsan po dbon zhang gnam la nyi ma dang zla ba las med do bar gleng nas pha bong la nyi ma dang zla ba'i gzugs byas/ gong bu rme ru yas chad du rgyas dmag mi drang / de man chad du btsan pos dmag mi drang pa'i mna' byas/ mtho brtsigs/ dbang du lha klu gnyan po bzhag dbon zhang ji ltar chad pa'i yi ge ni 2 du mchis te/ cig ni rgya'i ke shi'i pho brang gi mdun du rdo rings la yi ger bris/ cig ni btsan po'i ra sa'i gtsug lag khang gi rdo rings la yi ger bris so// btsan po'i mdun sa chung ngu na rab tu byung ba la phul nas chab srid chos dang bstun/ dbang dge 'dun la phul bas blon nag po la dga' ba kun gyis byi dang rku ba'i dbang med/ spyod pa shin tu dog pas rje'i snyan du zhang blon rje'i dgos pa kun sgrub pa la bca' po dam du bsdus nas dmangs rab tu byung ba la 'bul ba tsug lags/ nged kyis snyun phyag nyi shu rtsa gcig rten dang bcas pa byas kyang lan mi gnang par/ dmangs tha mal pa rab tu byung ba la phar la dgyes bzhin du phyag mdzad pa tsug lags zhes bya ba la sogs pa dris pa'i lan du/ btsan pos skya btsun bod 'bangs yongs bsdus nas rab tu byung ba'i mnga' thang bstod nas/ gser thang sha ba can gyi rigs gnang /zhang blon rnams la (tshig 'di gnyis man chad dkyus su shor ) zangs ma mjug ral can dang / rje'i bka' rtsigs can dang / yongs dga' lha dgyes can dang / ltab ma dgu rtsegs can dang / zings po sna tshogs can dang /gsang pa phyag rgya can dang / spun po can dang lnga gnang nas/ mi chos dang lha chos gnyis gtan la phab/ ra sa la sogs pa'i mes srong btsan gyi lha khang

༄khya// chos 'byung gi yi ge zhib mo/ 223rnams dang / brag dmar bsam yas dkar chung la sogs pa'i thugs dam bzhengs pa'i 'phro thams cad kyang ma lus par bzhengs/ zhig pa dang ral ba thams cad kyang gso gda' tsa na/ 'bangs nag po la dga' ba rnams kyis nged 'di tsam du spyod pa dog pa cis lan ces glengs pas/ blon po sbas kyi snying du gdon gsol nas/ 'di btsan po'i chab srid kyi dbang rmangs btsun pa la gtad pas nongs zer/ spyod pa rtsing du btang bas de la bka' nan cher stsal nas/ de pha gi kun gyis lan zer nas btsun pa la 'dzub mo btsugs pas nga'i rab tu byung ba la mdzub ker byed na de mtshang can ston pa'i brda yin pas khrims la skyon cig ces bka' bsgo nas mo bcad/ da phyin chad nga'i rab tu byung ba la 'dzub ger byed na 'dzub mo chod cig ces bka' stsal/ yang nged spyod pa dog pa pha gi kun gyis lan zer nas mchu yo byas pas/nga'i rab tu byung ba la mchu yo byed pa'i mchu bregs cig ces bka' stsal bsgo'o// de bzhin du mig log byas pas mig phyung / btsun pa'i ka cha brkus pas dkon mchog brgyad bcu chal gzhal ba la sogs pa'i chos khrims mdzad pas/ zhang blon nag po la dga' ba rnams gros byas nas chos khrims bshig pa'i gros lkog tu byas pas/ de la btsan po sngon du ma bkrongs nas chos khrims mi shigs zer/ kha cig na re ral ba can la lha sras med kyang gcung lha sras gtsang ma chos la dga' bas srid 'dzin te chos khrims mi shigs zer/gtsang ma smyugs pas chog mchi bas/ de ban chen po chos la dkar la dbang che bas chos khrims mi shigs zer/ gros byas nas chos khrims gshig pa'i slad du snyan phra bcug ste/ ban chen po dang btsun mo ngang tshul ma nal bshams so zhes snyan du gsol nas/ chad pa che thang du zhus pas ban chen po yang lcags kyi srog pa rtsa bsgrubs pas ma grub par snyan phra btsan par byas te bkum/ de ma thag tu lha sras gtsang ma rab tu phyung nas rdzongs chen po dang bcas nas spa

224 ༄7//(sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/gro mon du sgyugs/ bod kyi bsod nams nyams pa dang / 'dre srin kun mgo rgod pa dang / mi nag po kun gyi glo bar gdon gsol nas/ cog ro lha lod bsngags nas/ btsan po rgya'i 'bras chang gsol ba'i ltag pa gcus nas zhal ltag par bstan/ cog ro la bya phu byas nas bkum/ bod 'bangs chos la gnag pa kun gyi rbas rgyal to ri chos la gnag pas blon por bskos nas/btsan po khri dar ma u dum btsan po dgung lo dgu lon pa cig dbang bskur nas chab srid gtad/de nas blon po kun gyis chos khrims dang 'gal ba mang du byas su lo tsha bas mnga' bdag ral pa can gyis 'bangs kyi dang mdzad pa 'di ltar lags zhes zhib tu snyan du gsol bas/ btsan pos chos khrims sngar 4du ma byung / der rab du byung ba kun gyis mnga' bdag ral pa can la dras mi mda'/ gcung sku nar ma son pas chos khrims nyams su nyo zhes du smras pas/blon po kun gyis btsan po sku nar ma pon pas 'bangs btsun pa kun gyis mchu sngon bkrabs so zhes gsol bas/btsan po shig tu la song / der lo paṇa gyi sgra sgyuraba'i 'phro lus so/ mdo chos kyi rgyal bo dang / mya ngan las 'das pa'i mdo dang / yongs su rgyas pa rtogs pa chen po'i thugs dam tsan dan lha chos zhal sro ma grub par lus/ slad kyis btsan po sku nar son nas thugs sugadon gsol bas chos khrims la sku bsnyel gsol bar dgongs pa dang snyad yornyed/ paṇa ṭi ta dwa na shi las dme ru ru mtshams bcad nas 'dzam bha la bsgrubs pas grub nas/ tsan dan gyi sku la rdo rje rgyabs pas gser phye lte khung du slebs pa byung / de la rgyu byas te/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzhengs sagasol ba la/ sku'i rten bcom ldan 'das khar sa pa ni/ gsung gi rtenagaser khri phyed sum stong / thugs kyi rten dngul bya 'khun bu can/ nye gnas kha che ud pa las dngul gyi byams pa bzhengs nas dgung dus kyi mchod pa btsugs/ dus der lha sar sad dang ser ba/ btsa' dang mu ge mi nad dang

༄7// chos 'byung gi yi ge zhib mo/ 225phyugs nad byung bas/ de la btsan pos snyad byas nas 'bangs kun la lha sar mi nad la sogs pa byung ba ni cis lan shes sam ces dris pas mi shes zer/ngas shes te/ rgya mo kong co bya ba'i gnod sbyin mo cig gis gnod sbyin gyi lha shākya mu ne zer ba'i bkra ma shis cig kyang spyan drangs nas/ ri rab kyi rtse mor 'ongs nas lha 'khrug pa pham par byas te lha phung bar byas/ de nas u rgyan du 'ongs nas u rgyan phung bar byas/ de nas ma ga rdar 'ongs nas ma ga rda phung bar byas/ de nas rgya nag por 'ongs nas rgya nag po phung bar byas/ de nas bod yul du 'ongs na/ mo sa spyad mkhas pas dpyad bya ste lcags po ri seng ge dkar mo gnam du mchong pa la rgal tshigs nyi shu rtsa cig la mchod rten nyi shu rtsa gcig gi me btsa' bzhag spyi bor mchod rten nag po khri 'phang dgu pas mnan/ mkhal khung du lha khang byas nas btod la mnan/ de ma mnan na rgya dkar mngar 'du ba yin/ dmar po ri stag byi khung du 'dzul ba'i sna la shing sna ma'i phur pa btab/ de ma btab na rgya nag rma ngar 'du ba yin/ yar lungs me sna'i gdong la ri 'bras kyi ljang pa 'dra ba yod pa de rked pa bcad/de ma bcad na bod du mu ge mi 'ong pa yin/ nyang ro na ri stag dang seng ge 'thab pa 'dra ba yod/ de'i bar bcad/ de ma bcad na bod la dpa' bo rgyun mi 'chad par 'ong ba yin/ ri stag seng gnyis kyi mjug ma nol 'dra ba de bcad nas bar du rad na'i mchod rten gyis mnan/ de ma mnan na btsan po 'phrul mnga' ba dang / blon po rig pa can rgyun mi 'chad par 'ong pa yin/drang srong srin po ri'i sna nas rgya nag stong khung gnyis kyi bar na ri pi wang gi rgyud zeng ba 'dra ba yod pa de la rdzas dang yul gyi yon tan rgyun ma chad par 'ong ba yin/ de la mos gnod pa bya bar ma nus pas da lta yang rgyun ma chad pa yin/ bod 'bangs thams cad rab tu byung / bud med bkag nas chos byed zer nas rabs bcad nas/ bod kyi chab srid pha ming la gtod 'dod pa min

226 ༄༅//(sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/te/ bod kyi sa gnyan thams cad la bcos ka byas pas mo rang la mdze byung nas ro lha sar ba'ag ste/ bang so med pa yang de tsug yin/ rgya gar gyi skad pa ra pi ra 'di la chos tub pa ci yong / 'o cag btsun pa thams cad khyim par phab la chos sku bsnyel bsol/ chos khrims gzhig ces glengs nas/ blon po bskos nas btsun pa thams cad rtags dang phral/ rtags 'bor du ma btub pa kun mda' gzhu dang rnga shang bskur nas khyi ra la bkod/ de'ang ma btub pa kun srog dang 'phral/ po ti phal cher lha sa'i brag lte ba can la sbas/ brag dmar lags pa'i lha khang kun sgo la 'dag zhal brgyab/ lha shākya mu ne yas mar 'ongs pa yar la bskyal/ mas yar 'ongs pa mar la bskyal bar byas/blon dad pa can kun btsan po'i thugs su gdon gsol bar nges zhes mya ngan byed cing / yab mes kyi yi ge bltas pas/ mes srong btsan rje btsun spyan rasagazigs kyi sprul par 'dug de'i rjes la rgyal po 'phrul mnga' ba yang byon/ blon rba gsas snang la sogs pa rig pa can mang du byung ba'i gtam mang du glengs nas lha shākya mu ne las bod kyi bde skyid kun byung par shes te/spyan mi drang ba'i thabs byas nas rin po che'i sku bsgul bar ma nus zhes snyan du gsol bas/ rje'i zhal nas gzu ba chud la bor zhes bsgo bas/ khang pa bye mas bkang nas gzu bas bor bas lha'i snyan g.yon pa them pa la gsal/ de nas 'breng pa'i dra bar bcug nas drud pas them khar thon/ mi dang thag dza kun chad/ sngon yang zhang ma zhang gis sku sa thams su bcug go mchi nas/ skya bye dong du sbas/ ra sa'i sku yar skyol zhes bsgo bas/ byams pa'i sku smad ra kyis bkris nas sku shing sgrom du spyan drang bar byas nas ra sa'i steng du cho ngesabatab pas/ btsan po lho nub kyi dkyil 'khor gyi steng na mi dge ba'i khrims 'cha' bas thos nas ci nyes zer/ lha shākya mu ne'i 'og na rgyal pos klu mtho ba'i dug can mnan nas 'dug byas pas/ sku phyir thon nam ma thon zer/

༄7// chos 'byung gi yi ge zhib mo/ 227klu'i khar bye ma blug gam zhes gsol bas/ de yags de ltar gyis zer/ lha shākya ne'i bzhugs khang bye mas brdzangs/ sgo 'dag pas byugs/ rgyal po dgar re nas btsun pa chang 'thung ba'i gzugs la sogs pa bris te/ byams pa phyir spyan drangs/ mi dpung pa gshibs pa btsan pos gzigs tsa na mi'i bar na phar byams pa ser lhag tsam bstan nyi ma nub tsa na sku ma grud/ mi dang thag pa kun chad/ sku 'o thang gi mtshor bor ram byas pas rung zer/ byams pa sa thams su sbas/ rdo mtshor bor nas bsos btab pas/ btsan po na re de tsug yin 'dri/ lha shākya mu ne chur bor byas pas/ de shin tu yags so zer/byams pa spyan drangs nas blo 'bur de nyid du bzhugs su gsol/ nang par blon mon la bros chab khar blta zhing sked pa sgur skur byas pas btsan pos gzigs nas de na ci byed zer/ sku tshol ba yin pa la mi 'dug nyas zos sam byas pas/ de tsug yin yags zer/ de nas ring zhig na yer pa'i lugs pe'u na lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje bsgoms pa'i drung na nam phyed tsa na/ dpal lha mo chen mo bud med kyi gzugs su byung nas/ bod na grub thob mo khyod las med na/ rgyal po sdig can da bsad ran zer/ de nye gnas la rmi lam du byung pa skad byas pas/ nye gnas kyis chos snubs pa'i gleng langs zhib tu glengs pas/ dpal gyi rdo rje snying rje skyes nas de la thabs bsams/ dus 'khor dang rten 'brel brtsis te rta dkar po la sol phye byugs/ ber nang dkar la phyi nag pa gon/ lcags mda' lcags gzhu khyer nas lha sar phyin pa'i dus na/btsan po na re khams cig kyang ma bde/ mdang rmi lam ngan pa cig kyang rmis/snying cig kyang ma dga' zer zhing / rdo rings kyi yi ge klog/ dpal gyi rdo rje dang mi cig phrad pas jo bo mi nag rta nag can gar 'gro zer/ nga btsan po la phyagakhyed pa yin te rje ga na 'dug byas pas/ rje rdo rings kyi yi ge klog gin 'dug zer/ btsan pos dpal gyi rdo rje byung ba mthong bas/ mgon po nag

228 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/po byung zer nas gtsug lag khang dang dga' ldan gyi bar gyi mchod rten la sku rten byas nas bzhugs pa'i mdun du dpal gyi rdo rje rta babs nas pus mo la brten nas gzhu brdungs pas/ btsan pos phyag byed par go nas zhe sa 'bul zer/ phyag dang po byed tsa na gzhu brdungs/ gnyis pa byed tsa na mda' ltong la bcug phyag zin ral pa rgyab tu sgyur tsa na 'theb bkrol bas mda' dpral du brgyab/ rgyal po sdig can de ltar gsod nga bdud ya bzher nag po bya ba yin zer/ rgyal po phyag mda' la 'jus nas nga lo 2 gyis bsad sngas pa/yang na lo 2 gyis mchis pa zer grongs/ de'i dgongs pa 'grel pa la/ kha cig sras po 'ong ba dang / lha sras ma spyugs pa la byed/ kha cig snga na chos mi nub 'phyi na chos byed bya ba yin zer/ lha sar btsan po dkrongs ram mda' rgyugs ces sbran pas/ la la lha ri rgang rgyud nas mar byung / la la pho brang dmar po ri nas yar byung / bdud ya bzher bar gyi mtsho 'khor ma la gtad pas/ mtsho la rkyal nas phyin pas rta'i sol phye dag/ ber phyir bzlog lcags gzhu 'phyar zhing nga rnam the dkar po bya ba yin zer nas song / ded pas kha cig na re ngan pa do zin pas drang srong srin po snar sa sros nas ma mthong bas shor zer/ kha cig na re grib bse sgrom gyi phur sa sros nas ma mthong zer/ kha cig na re thal mo rdo rings su sros nas ma mthong bas shor zer/ 2 'ong pa 'di dpal gyi rdo rje'i sprul pa yin par nges/ 'di gsad do zer nas rta pa dgus de gsod du phyin pas/ dpal gyi rdo rje bsgom pa'i sgo'i mdun du thal rgyas btab/ dar dkar gyi yol ba'i nang na bya glag dang bya rgod kyi thul pa bzhag/ skar khung chung ngu ngan pa cig gi kha khyer la bya spu thul le byas nas mi 'dug/ mngon pa dang / 'du ba 'od ldan dang / las kur ma sha tam dang 2 khur nas 'khams su bros/ rgyal pos chos snubs pa'i dus su g.yo ru byang thang gi dmar shākya mu ne/ lho brag gi g.yo dge ba'i 'byung gnas/ tsang rab

༄༅// chos 'byung gi yi ge zhib mo/ 229gsal dang dge slong 2 dpal chu bo ri'i la sgom pa'i dus na/ btsun pa khyi khrid rnga gshang rdung zhing mgo la bya sgro btsugs nas sham thab snga log phyi log byas nas/ ri dgas la mda' 'phen pa mthong bas/ de la ye ma gsha' nas ban rgan 'khrul lam btsun pa smyo zer/ ci gzigs dris pas mthong ba bzhin smras/ slob dpon yang ma 'khrul btsun pa yang smyo ba ma yin/ rgyal pos chos snubs pa'i lo rgyus zhib du bshad pas/ 'o na btsun pa de 'dir bos dang zer/ de la gtam dris pas/ khyed la khrims chad ma phog pa kha rje che zer/btsun pa 2 pos gos re bas dril nas sprang chas su zhugs te khams su bros pas/ dan tig shel gyi dgon par sngar bzhin gos gyon pas/ de na yod pa'i mi kun na re a pa rgyal po'i bka' khrims kyis ma khyab pa'i mi gda'o zer bas bred nas nags su phyin 'tsho ba med bsnyel nas bsdad pas/ mun 'dzu dpal 'bar bon po'i bu mun 'dzu dge ba 'bar ra 'tsho bas mthong ste/ khyed de na ci byed dris pas/ nged rang sdod pa yin zer/ khyed ci za dris pas snga sngo 'dra za zer/ ngas ra bdag la zan blangs la khyer la yong ngam byas pas/nged 'di na 'dug pa mi la ma smra cig byas/ des zan lhag byin pas za 'phro gris bcad nas bor bas de ji ltar yin zer/ 'dul ba'i chos nas mi rung bar bshad byas pas/ kho dad pa skyes/ de nas dpal gyi rdo rje byung nas khyed 'dra ba'i mi 2 shel gyi dgon par yang byung zer da lta ga na 'dug dris pas/ra dzi de na re gning tsa na khyed 'dra ba'i mi 2 byung nas gar song cha med byas pas/ de kun 'dir byung na 'di gtod cig zer nas po ti 2 bzhag nas song kho rang gar song cha med zer/ po ti 2 po 'dir spyan drongs la shog byas pas byung ste/ mdzod dang / 'od ldan/ kur ma sha tam dang 2 byung / 'od ldan gyi gling langs bag re byas pas/ ra rdzi na re nga yang rab tu phyung dang zer/chos 'di nas byung ba bzhin du byed nus na bya'o 'di ltos cig byas pas/ kho

230 ༄༅//(sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/rang dad nas spyi bor blangs te mchi ma phyung nas bdag sangs rgyas thams cad kyis rab tu dbyung du gsol zer/ sang nang par 'di byung ba ltar byed na dga' zer bas/ g.yo dge 'byung gis mkhan po byas rtsangs rab gsal gyis slob dpon byas nas/ dge tshul gyi sdom pa phog pas ming yang dge ba gsal du btags/ de nas yang las kur ma sha tam bltar byung bas/ 'di dge tshul gyis bltar mi rung / 'di lta na bsnyen par rdzogs pa byed dgos byas pas/ nga dge slong byed do zer/ de la yul dbus su dge slong bcu/ mtha' khob tu dge slong lnga dgos te/ 'di na 2 las med do byas pas/ nga kha ning chosakhyer nas byung ba de tshol lo zer nas de btsal bas/ rgya dar tsho'i tshong 'dus nas dpal gyi rdo rje rnyed de/ las kyi kha skong zhus pas/ ngas mi btub/nga rgyal po sdig can bsad pas nga la sdom pa med/ 'on kyang ngas khyod kyi grogs bya yis zer nas song pas/ rgya nag po nas hwa shang ke ba dang / gyim phag bya ba'i dge slong gnyis khrid nas bod kyi dge slong 2 dang lngas dge slong gi sdom pa phog dge slong dang rab tu byung pa gzhan yang mang du byas so// de nas lo lnga nas bsnubs 'bab sha dang / grum ye shes rgyal mtshan rab tu byung ba mkhan po la zhus pas/ nga rgas pas skyong mi nus/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal nas/ glang po smyon pa'i sna la ral gri btags nas sems can rnams gsod du bcug pa ni bla'i rab tu phyung nas ma bskyangs pa ni de lta ma yin no zhes bka' stsal gsung / mu 'dzu dge ba gsal na re sdom pa phog cig skyong pa ngas bya'o zhes zhus pas/ sdom pa yang khyod kyis phog cig gsung / ngas lo lnga las ma song mkhan po byed par gnang pa la dge slong byas nas lo bcu lon par bka' stsal lo byas pas/ lo lnga lon nas mkhan po byas pas nyes pa gcig las med/ ston pa'i bstan pa spel ba'i ched du de khyad du gsod la mkhan po gyis cig ces lung bstan nas/ mu 'dzu dge ba gsal gyis mkhan po

༄7// chos 'byung gi yi ge zhib mo/ 231mdzad nas khong gnyis la sdom pa phog sgrubs kyi rgyud la mkhas rgyud du grags/grum gyi rgyud la btsun rgyud ces grags so//dus cig tsa na 'brel gtam byas nas/ grum gyi zhal nas da gzims par bgyi/ nga'i mchis mal gang du bgyi gsung / snubs na na re 'dir stabs su bgyi byas pas/ khyed lkog na ni skyems gsol bar grags pas/ nga bla gab bsrung 'tshal byas pas/ snubs khros te shing glag gyong po can 'di zer bas grum shing glan can bya bar grags/ dus de tsa na dbus na sdom pa dang bshad pa'i gdams ngag bka' chad nas gang yang med/ gtsug lag khang thams cad kyi lde mig ni btsun gzugs gtsug phud can dang / sham thabs gong ba can gyon pa dgra bcom du ming btags pas 'dzin/ kha cig gi lde mig ni sngags pa dbu skra lcang lo bregs te/ spyod pa 'ban por byed pa'i gos phu rung mgo zhabs bzlog nas btags pa ban 'dzi rar grags pas 'dzin/mchims yul smad na ched po rgyal ba dang / zhang lcam 'bro chung gnyis kyis klog shes pas mi shi ba'i dge ba la glegs bam klog pa la/ byis pa chung ngu shi ba la sum brgya pa 'don/ che mi shi ba la sde chen 'don/ de gnyis shin du shes rab che bas mkhan po ser po byugs pa 'di bsdus par 'dug de'i go ba yags so (po)nag por bzhag pa 'di la 'dug zer/ sto 'grel sdeb ma shes/mkhan pos dpe cha gzhigs yig chung bltas pas/ mkhan pa khar sang gi chos de'i go ba legs po ston pa'i yi ge cig 'di yang 'dug zer/ mkhan po de na re sngon gyi bgres po kun gyi bsnyel gyi yig sna lags te mchi zer/ lta rtog byas pas go ba legs mo mchan na phar gyi yig chung 'di la 'dug zer nas/bsnyel gyi yig sna la btsan bshad bag re 'phel/ dus de tsa na mdo smad kyi khams na mkhan slob kyi bka' rgyud ma chad par 'dug par grags pas/ bod

232 ༄༅/〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/dad pa can chos bya bar 'dod pa kun sdom pa khams su len du 'gro/ phyis klu mes la sogs pa mi bcu 2/ lam nas log pa gcig dang bcu gsum 'ongs/grum ye shes rgyal mtshan/ sgro man 'dzu shi ri/ de la klu mes shes rab tshul khrims/ sum pa ye shes blo gros/ 'bring ye shes yon tan/ rag shi tshul khrims 'byung gnas/ rma bya rin po che/ bod dge ba yon tan/ ya gong ye shes g.yung drung / lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug tsong btsun shes rab seng gelag bde dge bsnyen gcig tshos 'ongs tsa na/ lam du rba rgong sna dang phrad pas/ klu mes dang rag shis sdom pa phog nas ming blo gros su btags/ mdo smad du byon pas de la sdom pa med par grags/ byang thang grang pas ber nag gi phu rung phog kha bkyigs phyir bzlog mdun 'bral/ ltag tu sgros byabs pa'i zhwa rgyab tu gon nas dbus su sna su la gtad gros byas pas/ chos skor chen po na btsan po khri bya ba bzhugs/ de la sna gtad byas te bsam yas su chags phab/ btsan pos sna blangs nas khyed tsho'i dpon gang yin dris pas/klu mes yin zer bas dbu rtse'i lde mig tsan can chag pa gang gtad/ 'khor sa'i sgo phye bas nang 'dre tsher dang gya 'gal gyis gang / de yi yal ga'i chu yis ri mo thams cad byi/ mnga' khang dbus ma'i nang na ka ba li bcu gnyis 'dug pa'i bzhi sbrel thag chad/ gzhan rnams skam bu zing nge gda'/ 'khor sa bar pa'i nang na wa tshang chas/ dbu rtse'i lder so'i phyag dang dbu rgyan thams cad la bya tshang chas/ dbu rgyan thams cad bya lud kyis rul/ klu mes kyi skor mdzod dgu gzigs pas/ dkor nor gyis gang bar gzigs nas sgo thams cad la sbrul la sogs pa'i 'khrul thag byas nas/ phyir zhal la byas/lde mig btsan po la gtad/ mkhan por bsko bas mkhan bu rnams kyis skor la 'bag pas 'di mi 'dzin gsung / 'o na khams gsum bzhes par zhu zhus pas

༄༅// chos 'byung gi yi ge zhib mo/ 233ma bzhes nas 'bring la phul/ ka chu phul bas dbu g.yo ru'i lam rgyags byas/'di gzung gsung nas bzhes/ rba ras gnyis la dge rgyas phul/ dbu rtse phul/dbu tshal lo tshong gnyis la phul bas mi 'dod gdul bya so sor yod zer bas tsang du bzhud/ klu mes kyi dbu rtse gso ba'i yo byad rta khal mang po khyer 'ongs pas/ rba rag gnyis kyis gsor ma gter/ btsan pos bar byas nas klu mes kyis gsos nas zin pa dang lde mig tha rag rta la gtod par byas/ klu mes la mkhan po mang du bzhugs na yang yongs su grags pa bzhi byung te/ rdog byang chub 'byung gnas/ gru mer ye shes 'byung gnas/ glan ye shes shes rab/sna nam rdo rje dbang phyug de rnams kyis gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa ni sum pa dang / glan gnyis kyi rgya sar sgang bzhengs/ rdog gis kun dga' ra ba dang /yer pa ba rang bzhengs/ gru mer gyis sol nag thang chen bzhengs/ sna nam gyi rgyal lug glas bzhings/ de rnams kyi ya lag gtsug lag khang rnam gyi skar ma tsam cig bzhugs so//de'i mkhan po'i rgyud pa ni za hor rgyal po'i dge slong shan ta rak+ṣi ta'i mkhan bu bod kyi dge slong la snga ba 'ba' rad na/ des li ye shes rin po che/des g.yo dge ba'i 'byung gnas/ des bla dgongs pa gsal/ des g.yo dge ba'i 'byung gnas/ des bla dgongs pa gsal/ des sgro man 'dzu thi ri/des grum ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des klu mes shes rab tshul khrims/ des gru mer/ des skyogs gdan stengs pa/ des gzus rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ de la gzus kyi bu bzhi la sogs pa mang na yang gtso bo nyang 'tshams rin chen bla ma/des rgya 'dul ba 'dzin pa dbang phyug tshul khrims/ de'i mkhan bu dang slob ma dang nying slob du ma gyur pa'i rab tu byung ba ni med pa lta bu yin no// de ltar na mnga' ris bod kyi rgyal khams na sdom pa'i bka' ni ma chad/ bshad pa'i

234 ༄༅//(sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/gdams ngag dang sgrub rgyud kyi gdams ngag gi rgyal pos chos snubs pas bka' chad/ chos rtog chos song rtsa 'grel bsdebs shing rang gi shes rab kyis gzhal nas/ slob dpon sun 'don cing gzhung bshad byed/ nyams len ni shin du zhan pa'i dus su/ mnga' ris kyi rgyal po srong nges yul dbus kyi rgyal po de ba la la zhu phul nas chos zhus bas ma grub/ slad kyis srong nge'i sras lha btsun pa byang chub 'od kyis/ bod kyi rgyal khams kyi mi la phan gdags par bzhed nas phan gang che ba bsams pas/ chos rtog chos la byin brlabs mi 'byung pas paṇa ṭi ta bzang po cig spyan drangs na phan che bar dgongs nas/dge slong tshul khrims rgyal ba la sogs pa'i mi lnga la gser srang sum bcu rtsa gnyis bskur nas pho nyar btang nas/ rgya brtson 'grus seng ges lag dpon bgyis nas/ bod kyi btsan po byang chub sems dpa' slob dpon du zhus pas/paṇa ṭi pa di pang ka ra zhes bya ba 'bi kra ma shi la'i gtsug lag khang na paṇa ṭi ta sum brgya brgyad bcu rtsa gnyis bzhugs pa'i nang nas/ mkhas shing btsun pa paṇa ṭi ta sgrub pas brgyan pa gcig la zhu rten gser ling pa sras bcu gnyis phul nas zhus pas/ ngas brtag pa bya gsung nas/ do ker gyi lha khang gi mkha' 'gro mas bod la phan thogs par lung bstan/ jo mo sgrol ma'i zhal nas kyang u pa si ka gcig la brten nas kyang sems can la phan thogs 'ong gcig par lung bstan nas bod du spyan drangs te/ bod kyi rgyal po'i lha btsun pa byang chub 'od kyis mnga' ris skor gsum gyi 'bangs yongs bsdus te/paṇa ṭi ta zhing gi gtsug lan khang du chags phab nas/ lo gcig chos zhus pa'i zhu rten du gser sung drug brgya phul nas skye bo khyim pa thams cad bsnyen gnas la bkod/ mang po byang chub tu sems bskyed/ skya ban mang po la rim pa mdzad nas sgrub pa'i gdams ngag gnang / lha byang chub 'od dang lo ts+tsha ba

༄༅// chos 'byung gi yi ge zhib mo/ 235rin chen bzang po la sogs pa'i mi mang pos yi dam lha'i zhal gzigs/gsang sngags brda chos dang mdo sde drang don gyi dgongs pa ma shes par sgra'i rjes su 'brangs nas sbyin pa la sogs pa'i thabs kyi lam bslab mi dgos/stong pa nyid gcig pus sangs rgyas zer ba'i chos log smra ba dang / blo ma sbyangs kyang sngags kyi sgor zhugs pa thams cad theg pa chen po yin theg pa 'og ma la dgos pa med zer ba dang / so sor thar pa'i sdom pa med pa la byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa skye zer ba dang / chags snang sna tshogs spyod cing sdig pa'i bya ba byas kyang nged la mi gnod mi sgrib zer ba la sogs pa'i chos log smra ba thams cad lung dang rigs pas tshar bcad/ slad kyis lha byang chub 'od kyis zhus nas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gdam ngag khyed rang gis thugs su bzhes pa cig zhu zhus pas/ gang zag gi rgyud tshod dang sbyar nas nyams su len pa'i gdams ngag lkog tu sbreng chos su gnang / de'i rgyab tu bstan pa la 'jug pa'i rim pa gnang / de'i sgrub thabs mdo tsam du yi ger bkod nas byang chub lam sgron gnang / de'i sgrub thabs mdo tsam du yi ger bkod nas byang chub lam sgron gnang / gzhan yang 'gyur mang po bcos/mang po bsgyur nas phan btags so//slad kyis bod ston mang pos mnga' ris byon nas dbus su spyan drangs nas/ khu rngog 'brom 2 la sogs pa la bka' drin gyis khyab nas/ bshad rgyud dang sgrub rgyud kyi gdams ngag spel bas bka' drin che ba lags so//dam pa chos kyi me ro mdo khams smad nas langs par grags/ de'i gdams ngag mi slu ba dang / de'i bshad rgyud dang sgrub rgyud dang ma nor ba de jo bo rje lha cig gis dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pas bod thams cad bka' drin che ba lags so// chos 'byung gi lo rgyus mi 'dra ba mang du snang na yang la la na ngan

236 ༄za//(sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/smras/ la la zhe 'dod/ la la bsdus/ la la ling cho/ la la bcos ma yin te/'dini sngon gyi btsan po rje blon dang / rgya bod kyi lo paṇa chen po dang / de rnams kyi gsung dang dbus rtsang gi gtsug lag khang chen po rnams kyi bzhugs tshul dang mi 'gal bar mchis pas shin tu legs pa yin no// gong ma'i bka' drin rjes su dran pa'i phyir/ dad ldan bu la cung zad spel ba las/don med yal bar ma gtang bar/ legs par gzigs la nyams su long /chos 'byung gi yi ge mdo tsam cig bris pa rdzogs so//

237dba' bzhed bzhugs so//sangs rgyas kyi chos bod khams su ji ltar byung ba'i bka' mchid kyi yi ge/bod khams su dang po dam pa'i chos btsan po lha tho tho ri snyan btsan gyi sku ring la dbu brnyes/ btsan po khri srong btsan gyi sku ring la lha chos mdzad pa'i srol btod/ btsan po khri gtsug lde btsan gyi sku ring la dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/btsan po khri srong lde btsan gyi sku ring la shin tu gtan la phab lags pa las/lha tho tho ri snyan btsan gyi sku ring la dbu brnyes pa de la (rgya gar gyi yi ge drug pa ma ṇi pad me gser las bris pa sgom bu bcug nas nam mkha' las mnga' bdag gi drung du babs pa chos dang / bon du ngo ma shes te ) de la gnyan po gsang ba zhes ming btags te g.yu (snga zer te nas yin )mngon dang gser skyems kyis mchod/ yun bu gla sgang gnyan gyi mdzod du sbas te btsan po nyid kyang dus dus su zhal phye zhing gzigs/ zhal chems su'ang nga'i dbon sras chab srid che na yang 'di zhal phye/ chab srid chung na'ang 'di zhal phye shig ces bka' bstsal to/ dbon sras kyi sku ring la chab srid che rab tu gyur te/gnyan po gsang ba zhal phye ba las za ma tog gi snying po rgya gar gyi snying bo yi ge snying bo gser gyis bris pa cig dang mu tra'i phyag rgya (gtsug tor dri med )cig byung ngo / de nas btsan po khri srong btsan gyi sku ring la bal rje'i bu mo (khri btsun ) khab tu bzhes nas gtsug lag khang ra sa pe har gling brtsigs/gzhan yang ru bzhi'i gtsug lag khang (4bcu rtsa gnyis ) bzhengs su gsol/

238 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/brag lha bgyis/ rgya gar gyi chos dang yi ge'i dpe len par 'thon mi sasam po ra la bka' stsal te btang nas/ yig mkhan rgya gar gyi li byin zhes bgyi ba zhig kyang khrid de mchis/ chos dkon mchog sprin dang / (bad ma dkar po/rin po che tog gzungs grwa lnga dang /) dge ba bcu btsal nas mchis te/chos ni phying pa'i phyag mdzod du phyag rgyas stsal te bzhag nas/ nga'i gdung rgyud las dbon sras kyi mi rabs lnga na sangs rgyas kyi chos rgyas par byed pa cig 'byung gis de'i tshe sgrom bu 'di kha phye cig ces bka' stsal te/ (yi ge ni li byin dang gsam po ras rgya yig bod yig tu bsgyur/) zha 'bring nang pa bzhi la bslabs/ de'i (tshe )rgyal po pho brang na bzhugs te dgung lo bzhi'i bar du chab sgor yang ma gshegs (mtshams mdzad ) pa dang / 'bangs kun gyi mchid nas btsan po ni pho brang sgor yang mi gshegs te ci'i cha yang med pa zhigablon po ni 'dzangs pa zhig go zhes 'bangs byin gyis g.yar nas glings zhes btsan po'i snyan du gdas nas/ zha 'bring nang pa yi ge bslab (pa )bzhi dang mol te/ btsan pos dgongs nas zla ba bzhi'i bar du (srog gcod yang ba'i phyir stong gsos/ rku 'phrog yang ba'i phyir rku 'jal/ log g.yem spang ba'i phyir sna mig gam chal/ brdzun mna' ba'i phyir spang pa sogs )bka' khrims dge ba bcu las gzhi blangs pa zhig mdzad de yi ge bris so// de nas nang cig 'bangs kun bsogs te bka' stsal pa/ ngas pho brang 'pho skyas ma byas par mal 1na 'dug ste bya ba bskyungs te 'bangs rnams dal zhing skyid par 'dug pa las/ khyed na re btsan po ni pho brang sgor yang mi gshegs ci'i cha yang med pa zhig blon po ni 'dzangs pa zhig zer ba blon po 'dzangs pa ngas bskos sam khyed kyis bskos pa yin/ de ltar 'bangs khyed mi dga' na/ ngas zla ba bzhir bka' khrims bcas pa zhig yod kyis de bzhin du gyis shig de ltar ma byasan da ltar rgyal phran bcu 2srid khyams pa yang bka' khrims med pa las

༄༅/dba' bzhed bzhugs so// 239gyur pas/ phyi rjes su nyes pa mang bar 'gyur zhing / nga'i dbon sras rje 'bangs khrims srid kyang med par 'gyur bas bka' khrims btsan par gyis shig ces bka' stsal to/ bka' khrims dang bka' nan gyis rtsis mgo dang chos lugs bzang po ril ma nor bar snga dro thog thag 'bangs 'tshogs pa la bka' zhal gyis stsal to/ de nas 'bangs yongs kyis gtang rag btang ste/btsan po khyod las bsgam pa mi bzhugs pas mtshan yang khri srong btsan bsgam po zhes bgyi'o zhes 'bangs kyis mtshan gsol to/ zhang blon gyis bu tsha la sogs pa kun 'thon mi gsam po ra dang / rgya gar gyi li byin la yi ge slob tu stsal te yi ge ni de tshun chad bod la gda' ba lags/ slad kyis rgya rje'i (ding nga deng btsun )sras mo (ong co ) khab tu bzhes pa'i mjal dum gyi pho nyar 'gar stong btsan yul zungs ni de'i khad dpon/ snyi ba snya do ra snang btsan gyi spyan dbang / 'bro lde ru gung ston ni 'og dpon du bskos pa la bka' 'phrin gyi sgrom bu gsum bskur te pho nya dpon g.yog sum brgya btang ba las/keng shir phyin nas rgya rje la bka' sgrom cig phul ba dang / rgya rjes lan bris te 'di yar khyer la 'di'i lan ci zer ba dang sbyor gsung ba dang / pho nyas gsol pa/ 'di yar bskur mi 'tshal te de'i lan 'di lags so zhes de'i lan 2pa phul ba dang / yang rgya rje'i zhal nas de'i lan 'di yin pas 'di yar 'gas khyer la lan ma 'ongs kyi bar du pho nya khyed rnams 'dir sdod cig gsung ba la/ pho nyas gsol ba/ 'di yar bkyer mi 'tshal te de'i lan 'di lags shes gsol nas sgrom bu gsum pa phul ba las/ de klags nas rgya rje ya mtshan cher skyes nas rgya rje'i zhal nas/ nga'i bu mo dbul zhes bka' stsal nas stong btsan yul zungs la rgya rjes blonache ba'i thabs stsal nas/ pho nya rnams zla ba 2kyi bar du bton te/ mung shang yong co rje 'bangs sum brgya yar brdzangs/rgya rje'i dbon mo sum bcu yang mchis 'brang du stsal te/ rgya rje'i zhal nas

240 ༄༅/(sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/(bu mo la )bod kyi btsan po dang rgya rje gnyis 'dra bar gyis sheg ces bka' stsal nas bro yang stsal te (stong btsan sogs la )brdzangs nas slar bod yul du mchis te mum shang yong co khab tu phul/ de nas btsan po pho brang lhan kur ta mo ra na bzhugs/ ong co ni pho brang lha sa ra mo che na bzhugs/ ong cos gser gyi lha shākya mu ne+e cig rgya yul nas (rta pa 1gi pang du khyer nas )spyan drangs pa yang ra mo cher bzhugs te/ mes srong btsan bsgam po(sa )ni dam pa'i chos mdzad pa'i srol de tsam zhig btod do/ mi rnams ni btsan po khri srong btsan ar+ya pa lo lags so zhes mchi ste/ de ltar ci mngon zhe na/ sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas lo brgya na li yul du dam pa'i chos 'byung / de'i tshe li'i ban de 2kyis 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi zhal mthong bar 'tshal te/ dgung lor mchod pa dang bsnyen pa bgyis pa las/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal byon nas rigs kyi bu dag ci 'dod ces gsung nas/ bdag cag 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi zhal mthong bar 'tshal lo zhes gsol pa dang /bka' stsal pa bod kyi rgyal po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs yin pas bod yul du song shig zhal mthong bar 'gyur ro zhes gsung nas/ mod la gseg shang re re thogs nas yas kyis mchis te bod yul btsan po'i pho brang du mchis na/btsan po'i bka' khrims dang po 'cha' ba'i dus su phyin te la la ni bkum/la la ni sgyugs/ la la ni bzung nas tsher thags su stsal/ la la ni sna mig la phab pa mthong ste/ li ban de 2la ma dad par gyur te 'di 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs cang ma yin pas slar 'dong zhes rang yul du 'gro bar bgyis pa las/ btsan pos de mkhyen nas bka' lung stsal te pho brang gi chab sgo bzhi nas ban de 2 la bos nas btsan po'i bka' zhal (nas )pho brang gi nang du spyan sngar mchi zhes nang du bkug nas spyan sngar phyag 'tshal ba dang / khyed 'dir ci la 'ongs shes bkas rmas pa dang / bdag cag 'phags pa spyan ras

༄7//dba' bzhed bzhugs so// 241gzigs kyi zhal mthong bar 'tshal te 'dir mchis pa lags ces gsol pa dang / btsan po bzhengs nas 'dod zhes gsungs pa dang / li ban de 2khrid de gshegs nas thang dben pa zhig tu byon nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sku bstan pa dang / de 2dga' ste phyag 'tshal ba dang / da khyed ci 'dod ces bka' stsal pa na bdag cag slar li'i yul du phyin par 'tshal lo zhes gsol pa dang / btsan po'i zhabs la bzung ste ngus nas pho brang du gnyid log ste 'dug pa dang ldan pa la nyi ma dro bgyid de sad pa dang 'phags pa ni mi bzhugs ban de 2ni li yul na mchis nas gda'/ sngar 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs ma lags snyam nas slar li yul du 'gro ba 'ba' zhig sems pa bltas nas dngos grub gzhan ma spobs pa las the tshom ma mchis par 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs lags nges zer ro/ lung bstan chen po las kyang legs par 'byung ngo / de nas btsan po 'dus sro(nga )mang po rje rlung nam gyi sku ring la/ (khams su ) glang (gling zer ) gi (khri zer ) ri rtse bzhengs su gsol/ de nas de'i sras btsan po khri lde gtsug brtan gyi sku ring la khab tu rgya za gyim shang yong co bzhes nas/ 'ching bu nam ra dang / brag dmar du kwa chu dang / 'gran bzangs dang / 'khar brag dang / smas gong du lha khang re re bzhengs su gsol/ gyim shang yong co lo re zhing lha sa ra mo cher lha shākya mu ne la bskor ba mdzad/ ne ne mo pung shang ong co ni zhal lta gsol/ lha mi stong la chos ston gsol/ bod khams su gum pa rnams kyi bsod nams su 'tshal ma mi gsol du mi gnang / de'i ming ni tshe zhes bgyi/ btsan po khri lde gtsug btsan gyi sku ring la lha chos de tsam zhig mdzad de/ btsan po dang yong coni sku 'das so// sras po khri srong lde btsan gyi sku ring la/ dgung lo bcu gsum lon pa na chab srid phyag tu bzhes ma thag tu sna nam ma zhang khrom pa skyes kyis (khri thog rje thang la 'bar dang / cog ro skyes bzang rgyal gong 2las

242 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/ngan gyi dbang dang bdud kyi byin gyis brlabs pas sna nam bo ro 2gros byas te dang por ) sna nam ma zhang khrom pa skyes kyis thang la 'bar la bkyon phab/(bod la bkra mi shes pa byung ba shākya dam chos byas pas lan zer nas ) lha sar ra mo che nas rgya'i lha rgya yul du bskyal dgos mchi nas bteg pas dang po rta pa 1gis pang du theg pa las/ 'breng pa'i dra bar bcug ste mi sum brgyas sgor phyung ste de nas mi stong gis drud bshal nas ('bar brag gi thang grong gi thad kur phyin pa dang mi stong gis kyang ma theg pa dang de nyid du dong gi nang du sbas nas ) 'bal rje khol la gtad de bzhag nas nub mo sas g.yogs te bzhag na nang par sku stod yan chad zang nge byung zhing gda' bar gyur/ rgya'i hwa shang rgad po zhig ong co'i zha 'bring du phyin pa de ra mo che na mchis pa yang slar rgya yul du btang ba/ rgya bod kyi 'tshams su phyin pa dang hwa shang gi lham ya cigakhar sang gi dro lam du lus par gyur te/ hwa shang de'i mchid nas nga'i lham ya gcig bod yul du khar sang gi dro lam du lus pa'i ltas kyis da rung bod yul du dam pa'i chos me stag tsam zhig 'byung ngo zhes mchi skad/ gzhan yang ra sa 'khar brag gi lha khang dang / brag dmar 'dran bzang gi lha khang bshig nas gcong 'ching bu'i g.ya' la sbas te da lta bsam yas kyi gcong lags/ zhang ma zhang gis chos bshig pa'i tshe ra sa pe har du bzo gra chen po bgyis te/ sku gzugs lder tso kun gyi phyag la ni lug khog bkal/ skye la rgyu ma dkris/ zhang gis ('bangs ) yongs la bsgo ba/ da phyin chad mi shi na tshe bgyid du mi gnang / brgya la chos byed pa cig yod na pho reng du gtan sprug go zhes lung stsal te dam pa'i chos bshig go/ de nas ring po ma lon par zhang sna nam khri thog rje thang la 'bar ni thang lha'i rtsar bskyal te kwa kwa zhes yun ring du 'bod de gum/ cog ro skyes bzang rgyal gong ni lce dang rkang lag kun skamasanas gum/ zhang ma zhang ni 'chi ltas chen po byung nas bla'i ku phya ngan no zhes rdzo

༄khya/dba' bzhed bzhugs so// 243ma la rngan pa bstsal te/ sku glud kyi tshul bstan te gson khung du stsal/ bla 'og kun gyi mo dang ltas 'thun par rgya'i lha sdig gam gnod ces mchi ste/ rgya'i mes po dang phyi mo dang po rgya gar yul nas 'ongs so zhes grags pas/ lha shākya mu ne mes po'i yul du rgya gar yul dang nye ba'i bal yul du (bskyal bar mo bzang mchi nas mang yul )du dre'u gnyis la khyogs bgyis te bskyal ba'i tshe ni yul ngan chen po byung / mi gum pa rnams la ci yang byed du ma gnang bar lung stsal/ de'i rjes la dba' gsal snang gi bu tsha ming sring 2 dus 1 tu gum pa'i dus su/ sgor ni bon bgyid du stsal/ nang du gyod dang bsdos te lha mi stong 'tshal ma stsal te tshe bgyis/ ra mo che na hwa shang rgan po cig bkug nas bu tsha 2la lam bstan par gsol ba las/ hwa shang na re bu (tsha ) kun lhar skye ba dga'am slar khyed rang gi bur skye bar dga' zhes gsung / phas ni lhar gtang bar gsol/ mas ni slar bdag rang gi bur skye bar gsol ba dang / hwa shang gis bu mo'i khar mu tig ldan yon sran ma tsam zhig la ngos cig du mtshal chu bskus pa cig stsal te cho ga bgyis nas/ hwa shang gi zhal nas khye'u ni lha yul du song / bu mo ni slar khyed rang gi bur skye zhes lung stsal rtags dang mtshan ma yang mang du byung / khye'u'i rus bu la gdung shi ri ram mad du byung / de nas dgung lo gcig na gsas snang gi bu khye'u zhig btsas (pa )na/ de'i gnyil gyi steng na mu tig ldan yon ngos cig dmar ba cig gda' ba kun gyis mthong /btsas nas zhag bzhi bcu lon nas ne ne mo yang ngo 'tshal/ mi gzhan dag kyang so sor ngo 'tshal te sngon ma gum pa bzhin du 'bod/ hwa shang de la dba' gsas snang gis sgom lung mnos te gsang zhing rtag tu bsgoms te gsang zhig rtag tu bsgoms pa'i rjes la sangs rgyas kyi chos btsal ba'i slad du rgya gar gyi yul dang bal yul du pho nyar mchi bar ngos snyan du gsol ba las thugs dpag mdzad nas mang yul gyi so blon du bskos te mang yul du mchis/ de nas sngar

244 ༄7//(sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/ma zhang gis lha chos bgyid du mi gnang ba'i lung yang bcag nas/ rgya gar yul du ma hā bodhi dang shi le na len dra la mchod pa bgyis/ yon phul nas dgun zla 'bring po la char bab/ ma hā bo lha'i byang chub kyi shing la lo 'dab byung / bal yul du sarba wang se bgyis/ tem khang gtsug lag khang du yon phul nas mchod pa bgyis pa'i tshe ni nam mkha' las dge'o zhes bya ba'i sgra dang 'od byung / mang yul du gtsug lag khang 2brtsigs/ rkyen ris bcad/ rgya gar dang bal po'i mkhas pa kun la chos bslabs/ bal rjes ngo chen bgyis nas mkhan po bo d+dha sa twa mang yul du spyan drangs te/ gsas snang gi khyim du bshosagasol nas chos zhus/ de'i rjes la bod kyi rgyal po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mdzad cing bod yul du gshegs par ci gnang zhes gsol ba las/yon phul cig ces gsung nas zo rid dang za 'og dang dar dang gser rngul (dngul)dang snam gos la sogs pa rung ngo cog ma lus par phul ba las da rung phul cig gsung nas lus la 'tshal ba'i gos dang thod dang ske rags kun yang phul bas/ mkhan po'i zhal nas khyod kyi btsan po shri btsan po dang khyod 2nar son te dus la bab pas chu bo lo hi ta'i 'gram/ ri cos po ri'i drung /brag dmar du bsam yas lhun gyis grub ces bya ba'i gtsug lag khang rtsigs shig khyed cag gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen ngas bya'o/ khyod ni tshe 'di la gdod shes shing sems bskyed pa ma yin gyi/ tshe rabs du ma'i sngon rol nas sems bskyed pa'i nga'i sras kyi thu bo yin te ming yang ye shes dbang po dbyangs su gdags so zhes gsung nas phyag gis spyi bo la byugs te gnang ba stsal to/de'i tshe nam mkha' la dge'o zhes bya ba'i sgra dang 'od byung ngo / de nas yon kun slar tshur gnang ste/ 1kyang ma bzhed par mkhan po ni slar bal yul du gshegs so// de nas gsas snang ni btsan po'i zhal mthong du cig car mchi bar mkhan po'i snyan du zhu ba gsol nas gnang ste/ srungs tshugs pho brang du

༄༅/dba' bzhed bzhugs so/ 245mchis te btsan po'i spyan sngar phyag 'tshal ma thag tu khyod kyis chos sha stag (spyad )zer na khong gis ma sgyugs sam zhes bka' stsal pa dang / bal yul gyi kha na mchis pas phyugs pa dang 'dra lags shes gsol/ de nas phan phabs gnang ba'i tshe/ dben gnas su dam pa'i lha chos bzang po mdzad pa (par )rigs pa dang / lha chos bzang ba dang / de ltar mdzad pa dang / za hor gyi mkhan po bo ti sa twa zhes bgyi mad ltar bal yul na mchis te/ tshe snga ma dran pa dang yon tan zhib tu (ba) rjod nas btsan po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen du zhus pa yang zhib tu gsol nas/ mkhan po'i spyan sngar mchir 'tshal ba'i rigs ces gsol ba las/ btsan po'i zhal nas khyod ltar byas na zhang blon rnams kyis khyod bsad par 'ong bas nya bzang la bsgo ste gsol du gzhug gis khyod re shig yul du song shig ces bka' stsal pa dang / gsas snang yul du mchis/ rje blon 'tshogs shing gdan 'dzoms pa'i dus shig gi tshe/ zhang nya bzang gis snyan du gsol ba/ mes srong btsan dang lha sras kyi yab kyi dam pa'i lha chos srol btod nas mdzad pa las nongs pa'i 'og tu zhang blon gdug pa can gyis bshig ste rgya'i lha shākya mu ne dang (po )spyan drangs pa'i tshe rta pa cig gis thegs pa las slar rgya yul du bskyal bar chad pa'i tshe na mi stong gis kyang ma theg/ mang yul du bskyal ba'i tshe na ni rta dre'u 2 kyis theg chos 'jig 'jig pa'i zhang blon rnams kyang tshe 'di la yang sdug bsngal mi bzad pas gum zhing bkra mi shes pa yang mang du byung / bla 'og kun gyi phyag sbyid dang mo ltas kun 'thun par yang rgya'i lha khros zhes mchi ste/ de dang sbyar na sku dang chab srid la yang gnod par mchi nges par glo (ba )chung bas/ rgya'i lha yang slar blangs la mchod cing / sngon lha sras (kyi )yab kyis dam pa'i chos mdzad pa bzhin du mdzad pa legs so zhes gsol ba dang / btsan po'i zhal nas zhang zer ba ltar bden te/ nga yang de ltar dgongs pas zhang blon dag gi

246 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/sems la yang de ltar zhog la/ gros de ltar bya dgos so zhes bka' stsal/yang slad kyis rje blon tshogs pa dang btsan po'i zhal nas 'ang ma zhang khrom pa skyes kyis lha chos bshig pa des shin tu ma legs par gyur pa dang / da zhang nya bzang yang de skad zer bas rgya'i lha yang spyan drang dgos/ rgya gar dang bal po ('ben dhel )chos mkhas pa su yod rma dgos kyis dba' gsas snang khug cig ces bka' stsal te/ de nas gsas snang bkug nas spya ngar mchis pa la bkas rmas pa dang / gsas snang gis gsol pa/ za hor gyi rgyal po'i (sras )bu bo lha sa twa zhes bgyi ba mkhas pa zhig sngon rgya gar yul na mchis pa de da lta ni bal yul na mchis so zhes gsol pa dang / khyod kyis de mi dgug tu mi rung gis yul du ma 'gro bar bal yul du song la bal rje la khyod kyis kyang gtam gyis/ nga'i bka' sgrom 'di yang byin la/ za hor gyi mkhan po de ci khugs su sgrub la cha lan khyer la shog shig ces bka' stsal nas/ gsas snang gis thal byung / bal yul du phyin te bka' sgrom yang bal rje la phul nas/mkhan po la bod yul du gshegs par zhus pas gnang nas mang yul du spyan drangs so// de nas pho brang du pho nya brdzangs te/ mkhan po byon par gnang ste da lta mang yul na sdod cing bdog ces gsol ba dang / btsan pos nang 'khor lang 'gro snang ra la bka' lung bzangs te khyed gsas snang dang 2kyis mkhan po la rim gro cher gyis la lha sa pe har du shog shig ces bka' stsal pa dang / de bzhin du yas kyis bal po'i lo tsa ba zha 'bring du khrid de byon/mkhan po (ni)lang gro snang 2 zha 'bring du khrid de ra sa pe har du bzhugs/de'i tshe btsan po ni pho brang brag dmar na bzhugs te/ mkhan pos btsan po'i spyan sngar mjal zhing phyag 'tshal ba'i pho nya brdzangs te snyan du gdas nas mkhan po da lta kho na mjal ba ru ci lags gtol ma mchis te/ ra sa pe har du cung (zhig ) bzhugs su gsol (to/) lho bal gyi ngan sngags dang phra men

༄༅/dba' bzhed bzhugs so// 247dag yod par thugs 'phrig bzhes nas/ zhang blon chen po sbrang rgyal sbra legs gzigs dang / seng 'go lha lung gzigs dang / 'ba' sangs shi dang gsum la bka' stsal la/ blon po khyed gsum ra sa pe har du song la/ a tsar+ya bo d+dha sa twa'i zhal sngar phyag 'tshal zhing mjal nas/ lho bal gyi ngan sngags dang phra men lta bu yod dam med thugs 'phrig bzhes dgos sam mi dgos khyed kyis rtogs shig ces bka' stsal nas/ de gsum gyis ra sa pe har du mchis te/lo tsa ba ma mchis te tshong 'dus rtsa drug tu kha che dang yang le'i lo tsa ba 'tshal ba su mchis zhes tshong dpon so sor rmas nas/ ra sa'i tshong 'dus nas kha che lhas byin che chung 2dang / kha che a nan ta dang gsum rnyed pa las/ lhas byin che chung 2ni tshong gi lo tsā ba tsam las rngo ma thog/ a nan ta ni pha bram ze skyes bzang bya ba 1kha che'i yul du nyes pa rngams chen zhig byas pa las lho bal kha che'i chos lugs kyis bram ze dgum du mi rung nas/ bod yul du spyugs pa'i bu lags te bram ze'i gtsug lag dang sgra dang sman bslabs pas chos sgyur ba'i rngo thog nas/ des lo tsā ba bgyis te dgung zla 2kyi bar du dam pa'i chos brtags na/ dam pa'i chos ni mdo sde'i lugs su lags nges te/ legs so cog ni mi gtang ba med/ nyes so cog ni mi bya ba med/ srog chags kun la phan pa ni lhur bya'o zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i don rgya cher bshad pas sangs shi la sogs pa yid ches par gyur te/ btsan po'i spyan sngar phyin nas mkhan po 'di la phra men nam ngan sngags su gyur pa'i bag cung zad kyang ma mchis te thugs 'phrig bzhes mi 'tshal zhes gsol nas/ bo dhi sa twa brag dmar du spyan drangs te lo tsa btsal nas btsan po dang phyag mjal ma thag tu mkhan po'i zhal nas bdag ngo mkhyen nam zhes gsung / btsan po'i zhal nas sngar zhal ma 'dzom zhes bka' stsal pa dang / mkhan po'i zhal nas sangs rgyas 'od srung gi bstan pa la 'o skol gyi gtsug lag khang gi rgyan srung bgyis pa'i tshe bod yul du

248 ༄༅/〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/dam pa'i (lha ) chos cig gzugs par smon lam btab pa mnyel tam zhes gsungs pas/ gdod sngon gyi sku tshe (snga ma dag )dgongs nas de ltar mad ces gsung ngo / de'i tshe kha che a nan tas lo tsa bgyis nas dgung lo phyed kyi bar du dge ba bcu dang khams bco brgyad la sogs pa ma nor bar gsol na bzang bar thugs shin tu ches te/ rgya gar gyi dar ma mang du bsgyur bar dgongs pa las/ 'phang thang du chu bo che byung / lha sa'i mkhar du thogs babs nas sku mkhar tshig mu ge chen po dang / mi nad dang phyugs nad kyang byung nas bod kyi zhang blon chen po rnams chos spyad pas lan par gleng zhing rtog pa skyes pas chos bzhag ste re shig mi mdzad par chad pa las/ zhang nyang bzang dang seng 'go lha lung gzigs zha 'bring du khrid te/ mkhan po bo dhi sa twagazims sa gur khang na sgom pa la phyag bzhes lan gsum bskor ba mdzad/dpyar lag nas gser phye bre gang mkhan po la phul te/ mkhan pos pang du blangs te bsngo ba mdzad/ de 'dra ba nub gsum mdzad pa'i rjes la mkhan po la btsan po'i zhal nas bdag skal ba chung ste/ bod ril nag po la yun ring por zhen pas de las bzlog pa rab tu dka' ste thabs nongs na mi 'grub kyang lon zhing srid pas re shig slar mkhan po bal yul du bzhud cig bdag gis slad nas zhang blon dag la chos mi bgyir mi rung bar thabs kyis dal bus glengs la btub ma thog spyan 'dren gtang ngo zhes bka' stsal te/ pung shang ong co'i lha shākya mu ne dang mkhan po 2(bal yul du gshegs pa'i tshe )snam phyi ba seng 'go lha lung gzigs kyis glang sna'i gru tshugs su bskyal te/ seng 'go sha chang mi 'tshal ba las mar yang mi 'tshal ba'i khrims mnos/ de nas lang gro snang ra dang (dba' ) gsas snang 2kyis mkhan po bal yul du bskyal/slar log nas chos kyi slad du gsas snang rgya yul du pho nyar btsan pos bka' stsal nas/ mchid kyis 'tshal te slad nas dgongs pa bzhin du grub na dngul

༄za/dba' bzhed bzhugs so/ 249chen po stsal bar gtsigs gnang / btsan po(sa ) zhang blon rnams la yang chos mdzad par thabs kyis mol nas/ sbrang gtsang bzher pho nya'i khad dpon/'ba' sang shi ni 'og dpon/ dba' gsas snang spyan dbang / spyir dpon g.yog sum bcu mchi bar chad de bod yul na spags te mchi ba tsam gyi dus tshod na/ rgya'i mkhan po ha shang bdun rgyud kyi the ldag gyim ha shang bya ba cig chag chu na bzhugs pa'i zhal nas da ste zla ba bzhi na chag tsho'i dbang po'i (thad du bod kyi pho nya dag 'ong pho nya de rnams kyi nang nas byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa 2byon par 'gyur te/ de'i cha lugs dang sha tshugs 'di 'dra'o zhes sang shi dang gsas snang gi gzugs 'dra 'bag tu bgyis te bzhag go/bum sangs kyi dbang po'i )drung na gtsug lag mkhan mkhas pa zhig (mchis pa )nyin re zhing gtsug lag rtsi ba'i skad nas kyang / dbang po la gsol pa/nub phyogs nas pho nya dag cig deng sangs shul du zhugs te/ zla ba dang nyi ma'i dus 'di tsam na bum sangs du phyin par mchi/ pho nya de rnams kyi nang nas byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa 2shig byon pa'i sha tshugs 'di 'dra'o zhes 'bag tu bris te gsol te/ bum sangs kyi dbang pos rgya rje'i spya ngar pho nya btang ste gtsug lag mkhan mchi ba 4na gsol pa dang / bka' lan stsal pa/'bag dang 'thun par bod kyi pho nya de 2 'ongs na bsnyen bkur skyed la thong shig ces bka' stsal pa dang / bod kyi pho nya rnams rgya yul du phyin pa dang /gyim hwa shang dang gtsug lag mkhan mchi ba'i 'bag tu bgyi(sa )pa 2dang pho nya rnams gang dang 'thun bsdur bas 'ba' sangs shi dang dba' gsas snang 2kyis sha tshugs dang 'thun nas bsnyen bkur cher bgyis/ shing rta la bskyon dar gyi lding khang du bcug khad dpon dang pho nya gzhan ni rta 'tshal te mchis te chag chur phyin nas eg chu'i dbang po la phyag 'tshal te gtam bgyis nas phyi rol du byung ba dang / gyim hwa shang dang mjal te/ gyim hwa shang gis sang shi'i

250 ༄7//(sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/rkang pa la bzung nas phyag bzhes/ sang shis kyang hwa shang gi zhabs la bzung ste phyag 'tshal ba dang / hwa shang gis sang shi la lung bstan pa/ khyod ni rta rgod (skad zer ) ces bya ba'i byang chub sems dpa'i (sprul pa )yin te/ khyod kyis bod khams su theg pa chen po'i chos rgyas par byed de byang chub sems dpa' khyod kyis (dam pa'i chos )tshugs pa'i phyir khyod la phyag 'tshal lo zhes lung bstan pa dang / sang shes kyang hwa shang la phyag 'tshal te slar gsol pa/bod khams su dam pa'i lha chos mdzad par lha sras kyi snyan du zhu bar bdag gi blo ba la dgongs te/ keng shir rgya rje'i snyan du gsol nas theg pa chen po'i chos mdo sde bam po stong tsam zhig kyang mnos nas bod yul du phyung nas mchis na/ da lta kha na btsan po'ang sku gzhon pas gsol du'ang mi rung / sku nar son nas lha chos mdzad par mchid gros gsol na bdag stabs las 'gum mi 'gum zhes zhus pa las hwa shang gas lung bstan pa/ khyed kyi btsan po ni bod yul du dam pa'i chos 'byin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yin te/ da phyin chad lo grangs 'di tsam zhig na btsan po'i sku nar son pa na mu stegs kyi chos shig bkas med par 'gyur gyis/ de la khyod kyis shags 'di skad thob shig pa'i lung mang po zhig sang shis thob po/ sna nam nya bzang dang / mchims mes slebs dang / seng mgo lha lung gzigs dang 2 de'i tshe gnang chen du 'gyur la/ mi 'di 2ka la tshe snga ma'i las 'phro yod pas/ khyod kyis mi de 2(la )snga nas chos shod la/ de 2dad pa skyes pa dang khyed 4sdongs la btsan po sku nar son pa dang / mu stegs kyi chos bkas med pa'i tshe de'i lan thob la/ de nas thog mar las rnam par 'byed pa/ bar du sa lu ljang pa/ tha ma rdo rje gcod pa snyan du gsol cig 'on kyang thugs dad nas lha chos mdzad pa la dges par 'gyur ro/ dges par gyur ma dag tu za hor gyi mkhan po bo dhi sa twa zhes bya ba bal yul na rtag tu bzhugs kyis/ de bod kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen du spyan

༄༅//dba' bzhed bzhugs so// 251drongs sheg/ bod kyi 'dul skal mkhan po de yin no zhes lung phog go/ de nas pho nya de rnams keng shir mchi ba'i tshe sngar byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa 2shig mchi bar grags pas shul thog thag tu hwa shang dang rgya 'bangs dad pa can kun sprin bzhin du 'dus nas/ pho nya lding (khang )can la mchod pa byed do zhes gra (ga) sa so// kun gyis mchod pa bgyis te keng shir bskyal lo/de'i tshe rgya rje(sa) rtsig pa dang kwa ba dang nam mkha' kun dar gyis g.yogs de bsu nas bdug spos dang rol mos mchod de ci dga' dang nyams rangs su gnang ngo / rgya rjes bka' stsal pa/ khyed 2byang chub sems dpa' yin par nges te/ ke'u li'i glungs la phyin na yang ke'u lis ma zos par rim 'gro byas/bum sangs kyi gtsug lag mkhan na re yang byang chub sems dpa' 2shig dus 'di tsa na 'ong zer ba yang khyed rang yin/ gyim hwa shang yang khyed la sngun bsu ste phyag 'tshal ba dang / khyed kyi spyod lam dang sbyar na sangs rgyas kyi lung bstan pa las lnga brgya tha ma la nye ba'i dus su gdong dmar gyi yul du dam pa'i chos 'byin pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen cig 'byung bar grags pa yang gor ma chags par khyed yin (par nges )zhes bka' stsal pa dang / gsas snang gis gsol pa/ rje'i zhal mthong ste glo ba dga' ba'i steng du gzhan dang mi 'dra bar bka' snyan pa gnang ba de las bya dga' che ba ma mchis na/ gzhan ni mi 'tshal/ sgom lung 'bogs pa'i hwa shang cig dang sprad par ci gnang zhes gsol te/ pho nya myur ba cig rgya rje'i gor bu la bskyod te btang ba dang / chag chu nas gyim hwa shang bkug ste mchis pa de las sgom lung dang man ngag mnos so// de nas sang shi dang gsas snang 2la pho nya gzhan pas spags te/ rgya be'u shog gi khrab cig dang man ngag ma nos so// de dar yug lnga bcu/ phra men gyi bya dang gzhong pa sung brgya/ mu tig gi phreng ba 'dom re ba bcu/ za zhug be'u chen yug 1sla 'or gyi gzhong pa sboms su 'dom dos 'khor (ba )bog re can

252 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/la rin po che lngas spras pa la sogs pa stsal te pho nya de'i lan dang slar bod yul du mchis/ btsan pos kyang zhang blon dag dang thabs kyis mol nas spyir lha chos mdzad par chad de/ gsas snang yang rgya yul nas mchis te zha sngar phyag bgyis pa dang / bo d+dha sa twa spyan drang bar chad nas yang mang yul du phyin pa dang / bo d+dha sa twas pad ma sa bha ba bod yul du spyan drangs nas bzhes pa dang / bsam yas rmang rtsig pa dang lce ti sgom mangs rtsig pa'i phya mkhan (2)gsal snang gis rlungs la drangs nas gshegs par gsol ba dang / snye mo thod kur du gshegs te/ pad ma sa bha ba'i zhal nas sang gi dro lam na nyi tshe ba'i dmyal cig yod de/ der snying rje cig bya dgos ces bka' stsal te snam gyi chu khol du phyin te/ der snga dro cig dgongs pa mdzad nas gtor ma chur btang bas chu'ang 'jam tsam du red/ rlangs pa yang zhag 2du (ma )chad/ de nas gal ta la la gshegs pa dang / mkhan po'i zhal nas bod khams su chos mdzad du mi ster ba'i klu dkar po'i phrug gu mi srun ba cig yod de de dam 'og tu gzhug cing gdul/ de'i drung na yang nyi tshe ba'i dmyal ba zhig yod der yang snying rje cig bya dgos gsung nas snying drung du byon pa dang / rlung tsha ba rnams kyis mkhan po la thab blta'o zhes gsol/ mkhan pos zangs khal tshad ma cig gi nang du lung bong 1gi ro btsos nas zangs la rdog pa cig bsnun te spub pas/ dgun zla 'bring po la thang lha'i gangs rtse nas sprin cig kyang chags/klog dang 'brug sgra drag po yang byung / ser ba dang khu 'bangs bab pa cig kyang byas/ de tshun chad yul phyogs de thub te/ thab kyang sngar bas g.yung bar gyur/ de nas de nyid du dgung 2dgongs pa mdzad de gtor ma btang bas snying drung gi chu khol yang glangs pa chad nas 'jam tsam du red/ zla ba 1tsam gyis de nas mkhan po pho brang du gshegs te btsan po la phyag byas nas/btsan po'i snyan du bo lha sa twas gsol pa/ sngon bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten

༄༅spyodaba' bzhed bzhugs so/ 253na bzhugs pa'i tshe 'dzam bu'i gling gi lha klu thams cad sangs rgyas kyi bka'i dam 'og du ma chud pa yang ma mchis par rigs pa las/ bod yul 'dir lha klu dam 'og du ma chud par gyur te/ btsan po'i zha snga nas lha chos mdzad du ster ba yang mi 'dra na gsung bas/ da lta'i dus na dbu rgyan gyi mkhan po pad ma sa bha ba zhes bya ba 'di las (sngags kyi ) mthu che ba 'dzam bu'i gling na mi bzhugs te/ sngags mkhan 'dis ni na ning 'phang thang du chu bo che byung ba dang lha sa'i sku mkhar mes tshig pa la sogs te/ lha klu gnag cing mi srun pa rnams kyis btsan po'i zha snga nas chos mdzad du mi ster ba gang lags pa rgyal po chen po bzhi'i pra phab ste dri ba dang / pra se na lta ba dang / lha klu mi srun pa phal (che )ba gnad la dbab cing dam 'og tu stsal cing mna' bsgag pa dang /bsgo zhing nan tur bgyis na yul zhi ste slan chad lha chos mdzad par sngags mkhan 'dis rngo thog na de ltar mdzad pa'i rigs/ sngon yang rgya yul du (chos )byung ba'i tshe/ rgya rje chag men te'i ring la rgya gar gyi mkhan po 'ba' ting dang / bha rlan ta dang / kum shang 2gyis ge gsar du chos bstan pa'i tshe rgya'i mu stegs kyis phrag dog bgyis bgyis pa las/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po rnams dang / rgya'i mu stegs rnams chos kyi gtan tshigs dang rdzu 'phrul gyi rlabs dag 'dren te rgya gar gyi mkhan po la gnyi gas ma thub ste sangs rgyas kyi chos bzang bar bye brag phyed de kun yid ches brtan pas lha chos 'di deng sang gi bar du rgya yul du brtan par gyur pa lags/ da bod yul 'dir yang dam pa'i lha chos zhig mdzad na tshul de 4na du bgyis na bod khams kun yid ches pas lha chos 'di nam zhar yang brtan par 'gyur te/ bod kyi mu stegs kun dang gtan tshigs ni bdag dang 'dran la/ rdzu 'phrul ni u rgyan (gyi ) sngags mkhan pad ma sa bha ba dang 'dran te lha chos mdzad na (bla 'og kun thugs yid ches pas ni zhar yun du dam pa'i chos brtan par 'gyur ba )lags so//

254 ༄༅//(sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/de ltar lha chos mdzad par chad nas dkon mchog 2 kyi rten gtsug lag (khang )zhig kyang brtsigs 'tshal te/ de'i bzo bo ni bal po'i phywa mkhan 'di tsam la(sa )bzo ba ma mchis te/ gtsug lag khang dang lce ti mtshan dang ldan pa la mkhas so zhes mkhan po 2 kyis gsol pa dang / de 4na du mdzad par chad nas mkhan pos de'i gdugs la gzims mal ba gnang chen seng mgo lha lung 'tsho bzher gnyan legs la rgyal po chen po 'apra'i phab ste smrar stsal/ gzhe ni(nga )'phang thang du chu bo che 'bebs pa dang / ra sa'i (sku )mkhar mes tshig par byed pa dang /mi nad phyugs nad dang mu ge gtong ba'i rgyu bgyid pa'i lha klu gang lags pa rmas nas/ mi srun pa kun gyi ming rus bzung nas dngos su bkug ste/ mi la phab nas bsdigs shing nan tur bgyis ba ni pad ma sa bha bas bgyis/ de rnams la rgyu 'bras kyi chos bshad cing bden pa bdar ba ni (a tsar+ya )bo rnyi sa twas lo tsa ba la spring ste bod skad du chos bshad cing bsgo/de'i rjes la mkhan po pad ma sa bha bas snyan du gsol ba/ da slan chad bod khams su lha chos ci dgyes par mdzod cig lha klu dam 'og tu ni chud lags na 'on kyang lha klu la bsgo zhing dam 'og tu stsal pa'i cho ga 'di dang 'dra ba da rung lan 2shig bgyi 'tshal lo zhes bka' gsol to/ de'i rjes la di ring btsan po dbu khrus mdzad par mkhan pos thos nas/ btsan po'i dbu khrus mdzad pa'i chu gang nas bcus shes rmas pa dang / bzhes zlas 'om bu tshal gyi tsang chab las bcus shes bgyis pa dang / mkhan po'i zhal nas des mi phan te ri rab kyi rtse na chu mig rta rna zhes bgyi ba mchis te/ de las blangs te dbu bsil na sku tshe ring zhing chab srid mtho la sku 'phan par 'gyur ro zhes gsol nas mkhan po pad ma sa bha ba'i (na bza'i )ga sha'i 'og tu dngul gyi bya bum stong pa bkra shis kyi rdzas brgyad 'bur du btud pa cig stsal te/ 'dzab bgyis nas nam mkha' la 'phangs te btang bas je mtho je mtho la byang phyogs ltar

༄༅/dba' bzhed bzhugs so// 255phyad kyis song / de'i rjes la mkhan po bzhes pa gsol nas snga dro sngags kyi 'dzab par bzhugs pa dang / da nang gi bkra shis kyi bum pa slar khugs nas kha phye ste bltas na chab 'o ma 'dra ba sla ba cig gis bkang ste byung nas chab des dbu bsil zhes gsungs pa dang / zhang blon chen po rnams kyi g.yar sngar brims na zhang blon rnams kyi mchid nas 'di mon gyi bston chu nam mkha' la khugs te 'ongs pa 'di dgos pa med kyis pho te thong shig ces mchi nas pho te btang ba'i rjes la/ sngags mkhan pad ma sa bha bas gsol pa/ ngam shod stod smad kyi bye ma 'di kun gsing tshal du bgyi drwa dang dol dang gzhung gi phug shod dang stag la man chad chu mig cher phyung la bod zhing gis mi brel zhing 'tsho bar bya/ gtsang po dang mtsho kun sgrom bur bcug la mchong du thar par bya/bod yul ngan pa bzang por byas la nyams dga' bar bya ba la sogs te mkhan pos rgya cher gsol pa dang / mad dam sho'i (bden ni rdzun ) rtags su zur mkhar gyi mdar bye ma la mdzab bzlas te dgung 1 cho ga bgyis pas bye ma ne'ur gyur te chu mig snga dro byung / phyi 'bred cig bsgoms pas mtsho mo mgur gyi zhabs dang bla ba tshal gyi smad nar gyur/ klu sdings zhes bya ba skam par chu rdol ba dang / mdun sa chu du nas (blon pos mdzad du ma ster te )'di ni mthu che bas srid 'phrog ces 'phro bkum ste/ zhang blon dag gis snyan du zhus pas btsan po thugs 'phrigs bzhes te/ gong du mkhan pos gsol ba'i lha klu kun da rung lan 2dam stsal zhing nan tur bya rgyu yang bor te ma bgyis par mkhan po la bya dga' stsal nas btsan pos bka' stsal pa mkhan po khyod kyis bod khams su dam pa'i chos 'byung ba dang / nga'i yid la bsams pa 4na bsgrubs te/ lha klu dam 'og tu gzhugs la sogs pa yang (sngar byas pa )des chog ste yul ngam shod kyi bye ma tshal dang ne'u (sing )dang chu mig kyang dbyung mi dgos te nga'i (yul ) yar khyim chu bo zhes bya bas chog ste/ a tsar+ya slar
