256 ༄༅//(sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/yul du bzhud cig ces lung stsal ba dang / a tsar+ya (pad ma )sa bha ba'i zhal nas nga'i bsam pa la ni bod yul du dam pa'i chos rab tu brtan zhing / bod khams yongs dge ba la gzud pa dang / yul yang bzang zhing bde bar dgongs pa na/ bod kyi btsan po sems chung la phrag dog che bas skal ba chung ba dag gi sems la ngas rgyal srid phrogasas kyis dogs par (lta ) gda' ste/nga rgyal po 'di 'dra ba'i rgyal srid pas 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal srid kyang mi 'dod do (zhes )gsung nas rgya gar yul du chas pa na btsan pos mkhan po'i thugs bsrung ba'i slad du lan 2bskor ba mdzad nas gser phye mang po zhig mkhan po la phul bas gser phye 'dod na 'dod re gsung nas bye ma phu dung gang blangs te bye ma ril gser phyer bskyur btsan po'i thugs bsrung ba'i slas du gser phye khyor gang zhig snoms nas rgya gar yul du gshegs so// de nas mdun sa chung ngu nas bgros nas (pad ma sa bha ba ) ma bsad na bod la gnod pa bgyid par dpyad de gsod mi bkye ste/ dong 'phams kyi 'phrang du bsgugs pa dang mkhan po'i zhal nas sang ni nga la gnod pa byed pa 'ong ngo zhes skyel ma rnams la gsung / de nas dong 'phams kyi 'phrang du byon pa dang /gsod mi rnams kyis mda' bkang ba las mkhan pos phyag rgya bsdam pas (mi )nyi shu tsam smra yang ma shes 'gro yang ma nus te 'bag la bris pa 4na du 'dug pa'i nang nas yar gshegs te/ de nas mang yul khar byon nas skyel ma rnams slar bkye ste/ mkhan po'i zhal nas bod khams su lha klu dang 'dre srin dam 'og tu lan 2bcug na btsan po yang sku tshe ring / dbon sras kyang chab srid che/ bod khams su 'khrug pa yang med par 'gyur/ sangs rgyas kyi chos kyang yun ring du gnas pa zhig na 'phro lus pa thugs la gcags/ bod khams su chos lnga brgya tha ma la nye ba na byung ba mu stegs kyi rgol ba ni mi 'byung /(nam zhig )sangs rgyas pa nyid rtsod pa zhig du 'gyur/ bod khams su 'khrug

༄7spyodaba' bzhed bzhugs so/ 257pa chen po zhig kyang 'byung bar 'gyur zhes bka' stsal nas/ skyel ma la nyungs kur zhig brdzangs te nga la mda' 'phen pa rnams la ('di ) thob shig dang 'gro nus par 'gyur ro zhes gsung / dong 'phams kyi gsod mi 'bag (tu bris )pa bzhin du 'dug pa las nyungs gar btab pa dang gdod 'gro nus pa dang smra shes par gyur to/ skyel ma rnams slar log nas lo rgyus rnams snyan du gsol ba dang / btsan po thugs la rab tu gcags par gyur to/ de nas chos kyi mdun sa ni brag dmar mtsho mo'i gur du phub/ gsas snang ni snam phyi'i sa g.yas kyi tshugs dpon chos kyi blar bskos so// slad kyi chos dang bon 'dran par chad nas phag gi lo la pho brang phug skyang bu tshal du 'dus nas/chos kyi shags mkhan ni mkhan po bo dhis twa dang / sbyang sha mi go cha dang / zha rgyal nya bzang dang / zhang (mchims )mis slebs dang / snyer stag btsan ldong gzigs dang / seng mgo lha lung gzigs dang rtsig rma rma rnams kyis bgyis/ bon gyi shags mkhan ni stag ra klu gong dang / rtsis pa chen po khyung po dun tsug dang ru dpon chen po (khyung po )tshe the dang gzims mal ba gtso smon tsa ra la sogs pas bgyis nas gtan tshigs 'dran par bgyis/ rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gran par ma bgyis na('ang /) khyad che zhig chos gtan tshigs che bar gyur te/ bzang la rgya che/ zab la gting ring ste bon po shags ngan par gyur to/ 'phan yul gyi byi (shin)bon pos bdur ba rnams bse rigs su gyur te/phyin chad (bdur shin ) bon (gyis ) bgyis du mi gnang bar bcad/gshin gyi phyir gnag rta mang po dang srog chags mang po gsod cing sngas su sha 'bebs su mi gnang bar bcad/ mkhan po pad ma sa bha bas cho ga lan 1bgyis pas kyang sman par gyur te/ de tshun chad char yang dus su bab/ mi nad phyugs nad rgyun chad nas/ bsam yas yos bu'i lo la dpyid a tsar+ya bo d+dha sa twas rmang bting ba yang bal po'i phywa mkhan gyis cho ga bgyis te rtags

258 ༄༅//(sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/dang mtshan ma dag brtags na/ bod yul du lha chos tshugs pa'i ltas bzang po (sa )'og nas rin po che'i gter byung ba la sogs pa dang / lha chos bod yul du dar bar 'gyur ba'i bzang ltas phal cher byung ngo / bod la dge slong gi ming yang ma mchis pa las dba' lha btsan ban der phyung na ming yang dba' dpal dbyangs su btags/ shākya mu ne bal yul du bskyal ba yang slar spyan drangs ste/ rta pa (ga)cig gi pang du blangs te slar ra mo cher bzhugs/ de nas gsas snang gis bla'i gtsug lag khang ma brtsigs par glag gi lha khang bzhengs su gsol/ dba' pha tshan bon bzhag nas chos bgyid du stsal/dba' lha gzigs kyis grogs po myang ros kong gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen byas/chos bslab (sa ) khrims lnga phog/ ros gong gis kyang phu nu bo'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen byas te dkar por bsgyur ro/ de nas yos bu'i lo la bsam yas rtsig par bcad de/ gtsug lag khang rmang 'dings pa'i tshe/ mkhan po rnyi sa twa dang / btsan po dang / 'ba' sang shi dang / snyer stag btsan ldong gzigs dang de rnams brag dmar khas po ri'i rtse mor phyin te mkhan pos bltas na/ de tsam na sgrung pa dang / skyang kul ma dang rtsi skya can du mchis pa las/ snyer stag btsan ldong gzigs rtswa'i tho yor bgyid du stsal te sa bcad nas/ snyad ni chibs bres kyi ra ba rtsig ces glings te/ rtsa'i tho yor gyis sa bkum pa 4na phyi'i lcang ris brtsigs/ sa brtag pa dang sa gzhi byin gyis rlob pa'i cho ga bgyis pa'i tshe zhang blon gyi bu tsha pha ma 'cham pa 4dang / btsan po nyed dang lngas gser gyi nan ti btsan po'i sku la gsol te/ gser gyi gzhor phyag tu bzhes nas btsan po'i zha snga nas phyag dar de gzhor thabs bdun zhig brkos/ de nas zhang blon gyi bu tsha 4sa ra mos su brkos pa dang / khru gang gru 4ra phyin pa dang / 'bras dkar mo dang / nas dkar mo phul do tsam 'dug pa dag byung ste/ gram pa dang / rus pa dang / gyo mo dang / sol ba lta bu ni

༄7/dba' bzhed bzhugs so// 259ma byung / sang yang sa zhag skya snar du mang po zhig byung ste/ mkhan po'ang dga' ste/ btsan po'i spyi bo la byugs te si ti si ti pha la pha la bzang po grub po zhes gsung ste/ thog mar ar+ya pa lo'i gling brtsigs/ gzugs mkhan med ces btsan pos bka' stsal pa dang / mkhan po'i zhal nas dpal lha btsan po yo byad sdogs shig dang / gzugs mkhan 'ong ngo zhes gsol pa dang / rgya tshal bu can zhig tshong dus na mar bod kyi btsan po lha khang rtsig zer na nga ni sku gzugs la mkhas so shes mchi ba de bkug ste/ mkhan po'i zhal nas rgya gar dang bod kyi gzugs gang ltar bya zhes gsung ba dang / btsan po'i zhal nas bod kyi gzugs kyi cha lugs dang 'thun par byas na nag po'i phyogs pa thams cad dad pa skye bar thugs re zhes bka' stsal te/ bka' stsal pa 4na du bod kyi zhang blon rnams kyi (gzugs kyi cha lugs bgyis pa'i dpe ni bod 'bangs lagazugs kyi dpe blang ba'i phyir thams cad la sogs te skyes pa la ) bzang sdug che ba bu stag tshab/ thag bzang stag lod/ rma gsas kong de 2la dpe blangs/ lha mo'i dpe ni (bud ṇa la gzugs bzang ba )co rong lha bu sman la dpe blangs te bgyis so// sku gzugs dang ri mo dang bzo kun lags nas dral tshes nyi shu dgu'i gdugs la zhal bsro bgyi bar bgyis pa las/ phyi 'bred dgu rmongs pa dang lha khang gi steng nas 'od cig je che je che byung ste/ brag dmar gyi phu mdas su 'od kyis khyab par zla ba shar ba srin du snang ste mkhan po'i zhal nas 'od 'di ni a mi da ba gshegs pa'i 'od yin te/ sang gi nyi ma la lhang gi dbu rtse'i steng du a mi da ba'i lha khang yang thog tu byas pa cig rtsig dgos so shes gsung nas/ de 4na du lha khang chung ngu yang thog cig mdo la brtsigs nas sdod zhal bsros so// ar+ya pa lo'i zhal bsro chen po'i tshe sku gzugs mkhan rgya tshal bu can la 'tshal ma dang bya dga' stsal bar bgyis te/stan beg tse bting nas g.yar 'dren du btang ba las/ gar thal gtol ma

260 ༄༅//(sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/mchis te sprul pa zhig lags par dpyad do/ mkhan po'i zhal nas btsan po khyod dang po byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'ang lha mo sgrol mas byas/ nam zhig sangs rgyas nas rdo rje'i gdan la bzhugs pa'i tshe'ang chos kyi 'khor lo skor ba'i skul ma yang lha mo sgrol mas byed pas da yang lhag pa'i bsam pa la bgegs dang bar chad mi bar gtad lta mo sgrol ma de la gsol ba gdab pa dang bsnyen pa gyis shig par gsung ste/ btsan pos mkhan po la lung mnos nas ar+ya pa lo gling du bsgoms pa'i tshe nyin lan 2mtshan lan 2du 'phags pa rta mgrin gyis rta skad phyung ba zha 'bring nang pa dang / lha khang du srung ba rnams kyis mngon sum du thos so// sa brtags te cho ga bgyis pa'i sar ni dbu rtse brtsigs/ khams ni bgyis lags nas sku gzugs ji lta bu zhig bya snyam nas btsan po dgongs pa las/ rmang lam du mi dkar po zhig gi mchid nas/rgyal po khyod sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs ji lta bu dang ci las bya sems pa ngas bstan gyis/ sngon bcom ldan 'das kyis byin gyis brlabs pa yod kyis 'dong zhes zer te khas po rir phyin pa dang / brag kun ltar bcug pa dang /'di dang 'di ni de 4na gshegs pa'i mtshan 'di dang 'di zhes bya ba dang /byang chub sems dpa'i mtshan 'di dang 'di zhes bya ba dang zhes mtshan smos so//khro bo kun yang bstan te dgung sangs ma thag tu gshegs te rmang lam du bstan pa de gzigs pa dang / rmang lam dang 'thun par brag la lha'i gzugs 'ol byi tsam gda' nas shin du dgyes te bal po'i lde mkhan 'gugs pa btang nas/mchis ma thag tu sku gzugs ril de nyid du bgyis te/ shing rta la bzhag pa'i dus su sa g.yos so// shar sgo'i them gar phyin pa'i tshe sa lan gcig g.yos so//dri gtsang khang gi nang du phyin pa dang gdan la bzhugs su gsol ba'i tshe'ang sa g.yos so// / de nas na bza' gsol/ gser gyi ska rags bcings pa'i steng du 'jim pa g.yogs so// de nas gling gzhan 4gling phran brgyad yag sha lta

༄༅/dba' bzhed bzhugs so/ 261'og dang mchod rten 4'ang (mchod rten dkar po shud pu r+ya ldo ras mis/nag po ngan lam stag ra klu gong gis/ dmar po sna nam rgyal tsha lha snang gis/sngon po mchims mdo 4spre chung gis ) brtsigs te/ lho phyogs kyi mchod rten mthing kha'i 'khor lo shing mkhan dang / mgar bas has po ri'i (drung ) du lags nas sang drang rgyu las stor ba dang de btsal bas de ni mchod rten la btsugs nas gda'o zhes gsol pa dang / lha sras kyi zhal nas shing mkhan dang mgar ba la ltos dang zhes bka' stsal pa dang / bltas pa dang btsugs par mthong ste dga' ches nas snyan du gsol ba dang / shing mkhan dang mgar ba labya dga' cher stsal to/ de'i nub mo phywa mkhan bal po'i g.yar lam na mi gser khyab can 4sa 'khor lo khyer te btsugs/ mi de rnams na re khyod kyi mchod rten 'di da(nga )bdun brtsigs na 'di yang legs rab/ bya dga' gser khrab 'di khyer cig ces pa dang / mchod rten 'di la bskor ba byas pa ni ci 'dod 'grub po zhes smras pa/ rmis nas dgung sangs pa dang / der bltas tsa na mi ni mi gda'/ khrab ni dngos su gda'/ de4na du (byung ba )phywa mkhan gyis btsan po'i snyan du zhus (pa ) dang bya dga' yang 'khor dang bcas pa la che thang du gnang / de skad du ston pa ni rgyal po chen po4lags te/rgyal po chen po 4'i gzugs kyang bum pa'i steng du mdzad/ khor yug war ri nag pos bskor phyogs 4〈sgo 4rta babs 'byas nang du me long lta bu'i dkar zhal byas sran ma lho nas bsgril ba byang sgor 'gro ba byas wa ris nang du bya bye ma gtogs pa dud 'gro 'gror mi gnang / mi 'gro na rkang pa bkrus nas 'gro/phyi'i lha khang khams 2tshes yong zas/ dbu tshal pho yong zas/ dge rgyas 'phro zas/ gtsug lag khang kun khri bzang yab lhag yin/ gser gyi gzhi la g.yu'i 'phra bkod pa lta bu de lug lo la grub nas bo bhi sa twas rab gnas lan 2byas/tha ma'i dus su sku gzugs thams cad dbu rtse thang la byon nas chos ston nas

262 ༄7//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/gsol slar gshegs te rang rang gi gdan la bzhugs pas btsan po dgyes so//gtsug lag khang ni brtsigs/ zhal ni ma bsros pa'i skabs su (dba' )gsas snang rab tu byung ba'i ming ye shes dbang po btags so// (g.yu gi rten chos rgyas par bya ba'i phyir )zhang blon gyi bu tsha mchims legs gzigs la sogs pa mang po zhig rgya skad du bslabs pa las/ mchims a nu'i bu shākya pra bha dang / pa 'or na 'dod kyi bu be+e ro tsa na dang / dba' rma gzigs kyi bu (dba' )rad na dang / zhang nya bzang gi bu (zhang ) lha bu dang / (sna nam )bse btsan dang / shud po khong slebs rnams kyis ni skad lobs so/gzhan ni rdugs so// skad lobs pa (lo tsa ba drug po des bod la 'jam dpal kri ya/ u pa ya rgya gar du ma lus pa tsam bsgyur/ rgya'i mkhan po me kong dang lo tsa ba lha lung klu gong / 'go 'bom ldan ma yul gong / bran ka legs gong rnams kyis mdo sa lu ljang pa sogs mang du bsgyur ro/) dang dba' rma gzigs kyi bu (mkhan po bo lha sa twa las )rab tu byung ba'i mi(nga )ni rad nar btags so// lug gi lo dgun zla 'bring po la zhal bsros pra ti chen po mdzad pa'i tshe/ jo bo gcen khri rgyal dang / sru btsan mon rgyal la sogs te rje 'bangs brgya rab tu byung ba'i mkhan po yang dba' rin po ches bgyis/bka' shog chen po btang / slan chad chags (chab)'og gi 'bangs la pho mig mi dbyung / mo sna mi gcad par gnang / 'bangs phyogs su chos kyi bka' (drin ) chen po stsal bar bkas gnang / blon che man chad sna la gtogs pa 'bangs ril pos (gros 'tshal chos gtsigs mdzad de rdo rings btsugs/ de yan chad dkon mchog 2dang / dge 'dun gyi bshos ni khab so chen pos rgya las sgyur ba'i lo ts+tsha ba lha lung klu gong / beg zla gong / bran ka legs gong / mgo 'bom yul gong dang / lo ts+tsha ba'i mchan bu mkhas pa 'dan ma rtse rma/ 'gag 2 btsan/ lo khyi chung / 'big khyi'u/ khyi chung rnams

༄༅/dba' bzhed bzhugs so// 263kyis dang po las rnam 'byed/ bar du sa lu ljang pa ) sbyor te cha las gsol/na bza' ni mang la 'phan gyi brungs pas sbyor/ ban de re re zhing lo 1la nas khal bcu 2thang du stsal/ slad kyis ye shes dbang po mngon par shes pa dang yang ldan/ (btsan po na re )nged rje 'bangs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin te/ sangs rgyas kyi 'al dang 'dra bas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi ring lugs su bskos te/ chos kyi bka' las btags/ dral yang zhang blon chen po'i gong du 'dug shig chos kyi 'dun sa yang 'dun pa chung ngu'i gong du phul la/ spring pa yang ring lugs kyis zhang blon chen po'i 'dun sa chung ngu na la gsol ba gyis shig ces rje blon tshogs pa'i tshe bka' zhal gyis stsal to/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ring lugs su bskos nas/ dkon mchog 2gyi rten brtan pa dang /nam du yang mi gzhig pa'i slad du dkon mchog 2dang dge 'dun gyi bshos cha las mi gsol bar rkyen ris su bkum na slad rjes su legs par ye shes dbang pos rtan du snyan du gsol bas/ rkyen ris bcad pa btsan pos ni ban de re re la 'bangs mi khyim bdun bdun/ zhang blon gyis 'bangs khyim lnga lnga ring lugs la rmas na/ mi pha tshan 'ga' rlag pa dang / lung phu ral 'ga' phung pa dang / gnang chen 'ga' la sne bran gyis bcad pa dang / mi 1gi sgor bran khyim dgu brgya stsal ba dang sbyar na/ sangs rgyas kyi chos bzang po 'di sku dang chab srid la sman pas ma 'tshal te/ mtha' yun gyi rje 'bangs kyi shul bzang po ni phye/ ngan song 2gyi sgo ni bkum pa la sogs pa yon tan smos kyis mi lang pa zhig 'byung bar mdzad par kun bkas bkum pa bzhin bgyis na slar rjes su thugs gnod chen po brtud mar byung ngam/ mi phyugs la bro nad chen po zhig byung ngam/ nyi 'og gi dgra zhig (dbus su byang ngam mu ge chen po brtud mar byung dam/ nan dgos mthar mi phyin pa dang / dkon mchog 2gyi rten mi gnas pa dang / chad par ma yin/ 'pho bar ma yin/ rgyu chung ngu las

264 ༄zaku sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/'brus chen po 'byung ba dang / de dang 'dra ba'i rgyud du blta'o zhes 'byung ba'i skabs su btsan po khri srong lde btsan gyis gnam du gtang rag btang ba'i tshig la gnam byams lha byams nas 'di lta bu'i chos bzang po thos so// blon po 'bangs sangs shi dang dba' gsal snang zer ba ltar bden pas lha chos ni mi byar rgyud do zhes gsung ngo /) dbon sras rje 'bangs la yang dngos sdig chen por 'gyur ba la sogs pa (la legs pa ) mang po zhig 'byung bas/dkon mchog 2la 'bangs (khyim )nyis brgya/ gang zag ban de re re la khyim 2thang du bcad de dbang dge 'dun la bskur nas rkyen ris kyi 'bangs rgod dang / rang rje'u dang / khab so gnang chen can dang / thugs gnyen dang jigazhi bzang ngo 'tshal nas spu btus bzung / rje zhing ni bzang ngo 'tshal las/gnang chen 'bro khri 'jam gung rton gyis yul bzung ba 4na bcad pa na ban de myang ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa yid ma rangs te/ ye shes dbang po la yang g.yar mi snyan pa mi mchi dgu mchi skad/ de nas ye shes dbang po (myang lags pas mi snyan pa brjod pas )sgom bar gsol te/ dben sa lho brag tu mchis pa'i slad nas btsan pos (dba' )dpal dbyangs ring lugs (dge bshes )su bskos te/ ye shes dbang pos lho brag tu bsgoms na stag la ga sha bkal ba'i 'og nas sba zam btags te btsan gyi brag tu mchis te ri bya sna tshogs rdo shing la 'babs pa 4 na du ye shes dbang po'i lus la 'babs/khrims zla dag la nyer yang mi btub/ de'i tshe rgya yul nas rgya'i hwa shang ma ha ya na bod yul du mchis pa las bod kyi ban de phal gyis chos bslabs te/ lta ba ma mthun nas 'khrugs pa dang / btsan pos ji ltar mdzad kyang ma mkhyen te ma hā yan gyi slob ma las myang sha mis rang gi shwa gtubs/ gnyags bi ma la dang / gnyags rin po ches rang gi pho mtshan brdungs/ rgyas ni rang gi mgo la me btang ste/ gzhan yang chu gri re re srel zhing tsen men pa ril bsad la/

༄༅/dba' bzhed bzhugs so/ 265nged kyang ril phru mi'i ngos su mchi'o zhes mchi zhing snyan du gdas nas/ 'dir ban de kun ma mthun pas 'khrug pa langs ji ltar (bya ) zhes bkas ma spring (bar/) ye shes dbang po'i spya ngar mchi zhes pho nya zhig btang ba las spya ngar ma mchis nas/ nang 'khor gnon kham pa btang ste/ mkhan po khugs na zangs chen po sbyin ma khugs na gsad do zhes lung stsal/ (nang 'khor gyis )mkhan po la bka' sgrom brag phug tu bskur te/ (btsan po'i ) bka' zhal gyisastsal ba zhig dngos gsol te spya ngar mchi bar spring ba las brag phug tu bkug nas bka' stsal gzhan ni ma mchis/ ma khugs na gsad do zhes mchi bas gshegs su mi gnang na brag la mchongs te 'gum zhes bgyis pa dang /'di kho bar chad byed pa'i bdud chen po zhig 'ongs te/ da khyod kyi srog gdon gyis rta ded la shog ces gsungs nas/ dga' ches te pho brang du mchis na 'phral du thabs phra men dang / rgya bye'u che thang du gnang / chibs lnga bstan te btang bas/ ye shes dbang po spyan ngar mchis phyag btsal ba dang /btsan po na re ban de dag 'di ltar 'khrugs pas da ji ltar bya gsung / ye shes dbang po na re de la bdag 'dir dgug mi 'tshal/ bdag ma mchis te sgom ba'i bar chad ma byung na lha sras kyi sku tshe dang / bdag gi tshe'ang yun ring du gnas/ lha chos kyang byams pa gshegs kyi bar du gnas par 'gyur ba zhig na/ bod la skal ba ma mchis te yong ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gang byung bar mu stegs kyi rgol ba yang 'byung bas/ bod yul du bstan pa lnga brgya tha ma la nye ba na byung ste mchi bas/ mu stegs kyi rgol ba ni mi 'byung / sangs rgyas pa nyid lta ba mi mthun pas rtsod par 'gyur gyis de lta bu byung na nga'i slob ma ka ma la shi la bal yul na 'dug pa khug la shags 'debs su chug la/ rgyal pos sdum gyis sheg ces mkhan po (bo bhi sa twa )'da' kur mchi bas/ da yang de 4na du mdzad du gsol zhes nas ka ma la shi la 'gugs su btang ba dang / ton

266 ༄༅//(sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/mun pas shes rab 'bum blangs te bsam gtan gling gi sgo bcad nas zla ba 2su shags bslabs/ dgongs pa nges par 'grel pa rtog pas dril te bor/de'i tshe ka ma la shi la ma mchis kyi bar du ye shes dbang pos bo bhi sa twa'i lta ba dang / tsen men gyi lta ba ji ltar lags pa snyan du gsol bas/ lha sras kyi dgongs pa yang grol te dgyes nas dbu btud te ye shes dbang po ni nga'i a tsar+ya'o zhes bka' stsal nas phyag bzhes/ de nas ka ma la shi la 'ongs nas/byang chub kyi gling du gung la ni btsan po bzhugs/ hwa shang dang ka ma la shi la 2g.yasagayon du seng ge'i khri la bzhag/ mjug la slob ma rnams dngar te/ton mun pa'i slob ma ni jo mo byang chub/ sru yang dag ban de lang ka la sogs pa mang / tsen men pa'i slob ma dba' dpal dbyangs dang / dba' rad na srogs pa dge slong mi mang ba zhig ste/ de nas btsan pos mkhan po 2dang ban de kun la me tog gi phreng ba re re lag tu bskur nas bka' stsal pa/ nga'i mnga' ris kyi 'bangs kun bod nag po la zhen pa'i don (du )bal yul nas za hor gyi rgyal po'i bu bo bhi sa twa spyan drangs te dkon mchog gsum gyi rten btsugs nas 'bangs kun lha chos slob tu bcug pa la/ nyung shas cig rab tu byung ba'i 'og tu hwa shang ma hā yan 'dir phyin te/ bod kyi (ban de )ribs shig gis hwa shang la bslabs/ kha cig ni bo bhi sa twa'i slob ma yin pas hwa shang gi ltar slob tu ma btub ste 'khrugs pa langs zhal che bcad na hwa shang gi slob ma rnams ma rangs te/ myang sha mis ni rang gi sha gtubs te shi/ rgyas ni rang gi mgo la me btang ste shi/ gnyags bi ma las ni rang gi pho mtshan brdungs/gzhan yang chu gri re re srel zhing tsen min ril bsad la phru mi'i ngos su mchi'o zhes zer nas/ de ltar byed du mi gnang bar g.yon bskos pa yin/ da tsen men pa'i mkhan po bo bhi sa twa yin pas de'i slob ma ka ma la shi la yin pas (de )'ongs pa dang / hwa shang gnyis shes pa sdur la gtan tshigs gang che ba

༄༅/dba' bzhed bzhugs so/ 267la nga rgyal ma byed par chos lugs 4 na du me tog gi phreng ba phul cig ces bka' stsal pa dang / hwa shang gis tshig las sems kyi rnam par rtog pas bskyed pa dge ba dang mi dge ba'i las kyi dbang gis sems can rnams ngan 'gro dang mtho ris la sogs pa'i 'bras bu myong zhing 'khor ba na 'khor ro/gang dag ci la yang mi sems/ ci yang mi byed pa de dag ni 'khor ba las thar bar 'gyur ro/ de lta bas na ci yang mi bsam mo/ sbyin pa la sogs pa'i chos spyod pa rnam pa bcu bshad pa ni skye bos sa las thar bar 'gyur/ dge ba'i las 'phro med pa ma rabs dbang po brtul po blo zhan pa rnams kho na la bstan pa yin no/ sngon sbyangs pa dbang po rno ba rnams la ni nam mkha' la sprin dkar nag 2ka sgrib pa dang 'dra bar dge sdig 2ka sgrib par 'dra bas ci yang mispyod/ ci yang mi sems/ mi rtog mi dmigs pa ni 1char 'jug pas sa bcu pa dang 'dra'o zhes smras pa dang / a tsar+ya ka ma la shi las smras pa/ de ltar ci yang mi bsam zhes zer ba ni so sor rtog pa'i shes rab spangs pa yin no/ yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi rtsa ba ni don dam par so sor rtog pa yin pas de spangs pas ni rtsa ba bcad pa'i phyir 'jig rten las 'das pa'i shes rab kyang spangs pa yin no/ so sor rtog pa'i (shes rab ) med par rnal 'byor pa thabs gang gi mi rtog pa nyid la gzhag par bya/ gal te chos thams cad dran pa med par dang rang yid la bya ba med par ni nyams su myong ba'i chos thams cad (mi ) dran par bya ba dang / yid la mi bya bar khyod kyis mi nus so//gal te bdag gis chos thams cad dran par mi bya'o/ yid la mi bya'o snyam ste/de ltar bsgoms shing de dag la dran pa med par bsgoms na/ de'i tshe des dran pa (shin tu )yid la byas par 'gyur ro/ ji ste dran pa dang yid la byed pa med na de'i tshe de 2 rnam pa gang gis med par 'gyur/ de 2 dpyad dgos te/ med pa las ni rgyur mi rung ste/ gang gis mtshan ma med pa dang / yid

268 ༄7//(sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/la byed pa med par rnam par mi rtog par 'gyur/ de tsam gyis khyed rnams rnam par mi rtog par 'gyur na brgyal ba yang rnam par mi rtog par thal bar 'gyur ro/ / yang dag par so sor rtog pa med par rnam pa gzhan gyis dran pa med cing yin la byed pa med (par bya ) pa'i thabs med do/ dran pa med cing yid la bya ba'i thabs med pas de dag gis stong pa nyid rtogs par mi 'gyur ro/ (stong pa nyid ma rtogs par ni sgrib pa yong bar mi 'gyur ro/)ji ste ma rtogs kyang sgrib pa yod na dus thams cad du rang thar bar 'gyur ro/yang gal te rnal 'byor pa chos thams cad dran pa nyams pa'i rmongs pas dran pa dang yid la byed pa mi 'jug na/ de'i tshe shin tu rmongs pa yin pas rnal 'byor par ci ltar 'gyur/ yang dag par so sor rtog pa med na dran pa med pa dang yid la byed pa la goms par byed pas glen pa nyid la goms par byed pa yin no/ de'i phyir yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi snang ba rgyang ring du bsrings par 'gyur ro/ ji ste dran pa nyams pa yang ma yin/ glen pa yang ma yin na ni de'i tshe yang dag par so sor rtog pa med par ji ltar dran pa med pa dang yid la byed pa med par (byed ) nus par 'gyur/ dran 4na du'ang mi dran/mthong 4 na du'ang mi mthong bar ni mi rung ngo / dran pa med cing yid la byed pa med pa la goms par byas na ji ltar sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa la sogs par 'gyur te/ 'gal ba'i phyir dro ba dang 'gal ba grang pa sten pa'i tshe/ dro ba'i tshor ba mi 'byung ba bzhin no/ de lta bas na dam pa'i chos dran pa med pa dang yid la byed pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad mkhyen pa la sogs par med pa 'byung ba de yang don dam par so sor rtog pa sngon du 'gro ba yin bar blta bar bya ste/ gang gi phyir yang dag par so sor rtog pa nyid kyis dran pa med pa dang yid la byed pa med par nas kyi gzhan du ni ma yin te/ ji ltar rnal 'byor pas gang gi tshe yang dag pa'i shes rab kyis brtags na don dam

༄༅/dba' bzhed bzhugs so/ 269par dus 2 du chos skye ba 'ga' yang ma mthong ba de'i tshe ji ltar yid la dran par bya/ don dam par dus 2du med pa'i phyir myong ba med pa gang yin pa de ji ltar dran par bya/ de'i (phyir )spros pa thams cad nye bar zhi bas rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes la zhugs pa yin/ de la zhugs pas stong pa nyid rtogs par 'gyur ro/ de rtogs pas lta ba ngan pa'i dra ba mtha' dag spangs pa yin no/ thabs dang ldan pa'i shes rab kyis brtags pas kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i bden pa la yang dag par mkhas pa yin no/ de las ni sgrib pa med pa'i ye shes thob pa'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad thob par 'gyur ro zhes gsol pa dang / lha sras kyi zhal nas (khyed ) ton tsen gang ltar dga' ba yang mchid shags so so nas thob shig ces bka' stsal pa dang /sang shi'i mchid nas rgya'i cig car 'jug cing rim gyis sbyor ba mchis pa pha rol du phyin pa drug kyang 'dzin pa ma mchis pa'i phyir sbyin par ming btags te/khams 2yongs su btang ste/ bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa ma mchis na sbyin pa'i nang na thams cad btang ba yin/ sgo 2gyi nongs pa 'gog pa ni tshulakhrims de/ rnam par mi rtog pa la nongs pa ma mchis na lhag pa'i tshul khrims bsrung mi 'tshal lo/ chos gang la yang bzod pa dang mi bzod pa med na bzod pa'i mchog lags/ le lo yod pas brtson 'grus su ming btags/brtson pa dang mi brtson pa med na brtson 'grus kyi mchog mi shigs pa sra ba zhes bya ste brtson 'grus kyi mchog lags/ sems g.yengs pa yod pas bsam gtan du ming btags/ sems g.yeng ba med na bsam gtan du ming 'dogs/ chos nyid mi shes pas shes rab tu ming btags/ chos rang dang spyi'i mtshan nyid ma nor bar shes na shes rab kyi mchog lags ste ston pa mya ngan las 'das nas ring zhig tu lta ba mi mthun pa yang med na/ slad kyis rgya gar gyi dbu ma rnam 2ma mthun pa dang / rgya'i ton tsen zhig kyang bar du byung

270 ༄7//(sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/par gyur te ma mjal ba kun ma rtogs pa las gyur gyi/ 'jug pa'i sgo tha dad kyang don mi rtog mi dmigs par 1/ 'bras bu mya ngan las 'das pa 'tshal ba yang 1ces spyi mthun pa skad du gsol/ dba' dpal dbyangs kyis smras pa/1car 'jug cing rim gyis sbyor mchi ces pa mchi ba'i tshig 'di 2dpyad ral du smra ste/ rim gyis sbyor bar 'tshal na ni tsen men dang mi 'dra ba'i rgyu yang ci mchis/ 1car 'jug na slan chad ci byed khyed da lta kho na sangs rgyas na ci nyes dper na ri la 'dzeg na gom pa re res bgrod na yang dka' ches te/skad cig mchong pa'i mthu med pa dang 'dra bar/ sa dang po thob pa yang shin tu dka' na sangs rgyas kyi sar 1car 'jug zhugs pa'i sangs rgyas gang yin/lung bstan pa'i khungs (kyang 'tshal pa ) btsal (dgos la/) ton tsen 2shin tu mi 'dra ste/ tsen men ni gsung rab kun la mkhas par bslabs shing sbyangs te/ shes rab rnam pa 2la brten nas chos thams cad ma nor bar rig cing mi skye ba'i bzod pa thob po/ don dam par sa dang po thob pa yang chos spyod rnam pa bcu la mos pa shin tu bsgoms pa'i phyir bzod pa ni sa de las yang dag par 'das nas yang dag pa'i skyon med par 'jug go/ ltung ba phra mo'i 'khrul pa (kun du 'byung pa )shes 4na gyis spong bar mi nus pas/ de yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir 'bad pas sa 2pa 'thob po/ 'jig rten gyi ting nge 'dzin dang snyoms par 'jug pa dang / lung dang rang gi rtogs pa mtha' dag pa thob pas chog mi shes te phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas la chos zhu zhing slob po/ thos pa'i gzungs rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir 'bad pas sa 2pa thob bo/byang chub kyi phyogs dang 'thun pa'i chos thob pas de dag gis de la goms par bya ba dang / snyoms par 'jug pa la sred pa dang / chos la sred pa'i sems lhag par btang snyoms su mi 'jog pas/ de'i yan lag yongs su rdzogs pa la 'bad pas sa 4pa 'thob bo/ bden pa rnam par dpyad pa dang 'khor ba dang

༄༅/dba' bzhed bzhugs so/ 271mya ngan las 'das pa las 1tu mi 'jog par mngon sum du byas pa'i rjes la lhag par btang snyoms su gzhag pa'i thabs kyis yongs su zin pa'i byang chub kyi phyogs dang mthun par mi nus pas de yongs su rdzogs pa ma yin te 'bad pas sa lnga pa 'thob bo/ 'du byed ci lta ba mngon du byas na de la skyo ba mang ba dang / mtshan ma yid la byed pa mang du gnas par mi nus pa'i phyir 'bad pas sa drug pa 'thob bo/ bar chad med pa dang rgyun mi 'chad par mtshan ma med pa yid la byed pa la gnas par mi nas pa'i phyir 'bad pas sa bdun pa 'thob po/ mtshan ma med pa la gnas pa de lhag par btang snyoms su bzhag pa dang / mtshan ma la dbang thob pa mi dmigs pa'i phyir 'bad pas sa brgyad pa dang dgu pa 'thob po/ shes bya thams cad la chags pa med pa dang thogs pa med pa mthong bar mi nus pas de'i yan lag yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir 'bad pas thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang 'thob pa ni sa bcu pa'o/sa bcu la sbyangs shing bgrod nas brnyes pa lags na khyed ton mun pas ma bslabs ma sbyangs par ni 'jig rten gyi bya ba thams cad kyang (mi ) shes na thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes rig pa'i gnas lnga la 'jug cing shes bya thams cad kyi mthar phyin pa ci lta bu (ltar du/ zer )ci yang mi byed/ ma byas na bdag rang gi zan yang mi 'grub ste ltogs te 'chi na/ bla na med pa'i gzhan (gyi don )lta ga la nus/ byang chub sems dpa' ni sems dang po bskyed pa nas sems can gyi don lhur byas pas bsod nams kyi tshogs su 'gyur/ shes rab rnam 2la brten pas ye shes kyi tshogs su 'gyur/ nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa sbyangs pas thabs kyis 'khor ba mi gtong / shes rab kyis nyon mongs pas mi gos/ mthar sangs rgyas nas kyang 'khor ba'i mthar ma thug gi bar du sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas sems can gyi don mdzad cing 'khor ba las bsgral nas thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang la

272 ༄7//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/'jog na/ ma bslabs ma sbyang (ci yang mi shes )na bdag dang gzhan gyi don yang mi byed la/ ci yang mi (sems )pa sgong nga dang 'dra bas sangs rgyas su 'grub bam/ ma brtags ma bltas par ni tha mal du 'gro na yang zab rtab 'chos par 'gyur ro/ de bas na sangs rgyas 'thob par 'tshal bas zhi gnas dang lhag mthong la goms par bgyis tshal te/ gang de 2la ma goms pa ni dngos po'i mtha' yang mi rtogs/ bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par yang mi 'gyur bar bstan te/ de kho na nyid la sems shin tu gsal bar byung ba'i tshe zhi gnas dang lhag mthong zung du 'brel ba'i lam du 'grub pa lags te/ sgom na'ang de ltar legs zhes dpal dbyangs kyis smras pa dang / ton men gyis tsen men la shags ma thub ste me tog dor nas 'pham blangs so// de nas lha sras kyi zhal nas ton mun 1car 'jug ces mchi ba 4na du chos spyod rnam bcu skyon skal/ de mi bgyid cing bdag dang gzhan gyi (slob sbyong gi )sgo bkag na sems bying zhing chos nub par 'gyur bas lta ba ni nā gā rdzu na'i lta ba la ltos shig/ sgom ba ni shes rab rnam 2la brten te zhi gnas dang lhag mthong la sgoms shig ces bka' stsal nas/ sngar ye shes dbang po dang / bo rnyi sa twas gsol pa 4na mthar gyis 'jug par (chad de ) (sgra ) bsgyur grwa btsugs (slob sbyong / ltung 'bul/ sems 'chos kyi grwa 2btsugs/ lo tsa ba drug pos mtshan nyid sde snod 2las mdo sde dang theg pa chen po'i mngon pa'i bstan bcos ril bsgyur/ tan tra las ma hā yo ga mu stegs dge ba la gzud pa'i slad du gtsang rme med par bstan pa chos kyi dbyings ji lta ba ni ma rtogs par log par bzung du dogs te ma bsgyur/ sngags g.yog nus pa yang bod la mi 'byung nas ma bsgyur/ bram ze rnams dge ba la gzud pa'i don du kri ya gsungs pa dang / u pa ya bod la ran par ye shes dbang pos gsol te bsgyur/ 'dul ba lung sde 4las thams cad yod smra'i sde pa rgyu dang 'bras bu

༄cu/dba' bzhed bzhugs so/ 273sngon du ston pas bod la 'tsham par gsol te bsgyur/ nyan thos kyi mdo sde lung ring po dang / gang po rtogs pa nyung ngu zhig bsgyur/ nyan thos kyi mngon pa ko sha bsgyur/ dbus mtha' kun du 'bangs kun lha chos slob cing dge (ba )mi bgyid du mi gnang ba'i yul yul du slob dpon logs na bskos yod/zhang blon dang btsun mo kun yang ka pa li re re thogs nas chos slob tu stsal/sngon rgyal po gdung rabs chos ma tshugs pa de lha sras khri srong lde btsan dang /a tsar+ya bo lha sa twa dang / dba' ye shes dbang po dang / 'ba' sang shi4sa dkon mchog 2gyi rten btsugs/ bod khams su dam pa'i lha chos rgya cher bsgrags so// ye shes dbang po tshe 'da' gar mi ma yin pa dag gis bsu zhing /dri zhim po dang / nam mkha' las mchod pa dag kyang byung ngo / ye shes dbang pos 'phags pa la the tsom zhu ba'i drung du lha sras gshegs nas 'bras thug gsol ba dang / ye shes dbang po'i mchid nas lha cig gi pham phabs 'di (ma)nos nas slan chad kham gyi zas spangs/ ting nge 'dzin dang zas su brjes/ phung po dang chos su brje'o zhes mchi ste tshe 'das so// btsan po'i zhal nas a tsar+ya tshe 'das pa dang sbyar na/ kho bo'i tshe yang ring po mi thub ces gsung nas thugs ngan cher mdzad/ de nas rab tu byung ba rnams ton men pa'i tshigs ma nyan te chos slob cing dpe len du yang ma btub/ rgya gar gyi dar ma'i dpe thog thag tsam blangs te bsgyur na/ shi le na len trar rgya gar gyi dar ma mes tshig ste ma tshang ba las/ rgya yul du lo stong nyis brgya lon nas chos byung ste gsung rab kyi dpe tshang bar bzhugs pa las/ rgya'i dar ma ma 'gyur ba yid la gcags gsung ngo / rdzogs so// lha sras khri gtsug lde btsan (ral pa can ) gyi sku ring la rgya gar gyi mkhas pa mang po spyan drang te ka cog rnam 2gyis sngar ma 'gyur ba'i chos rnams (kyang ) bsgyur/ (sngar ) 'gyur ba rnams kyang skad gsar chad kyis gtan la phab/ lha khang brgya rtsa brgyad kyi

274 ༄za//(sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/grangs kyang bgrang / chos khrims dar gyi mdud pa'ang bskyar nas bsdams te lha chos gtan la phab po/ sangs rgyas kyi chos bod khams su ji ltar byung ba'i bka' mchid kyi yi ge dba'i bzhed pa rdzogs/ zhus dag/ a tsar+ya ye shes dbang po 'das nas slad kyis ye shes dbang po'i bu mo dba' za spyan ras gzigs kyis jo mo byang chub kyi snyan du gsol te rje 'bangs kyi bsod nams su chos slob btsugs/ spyan ras gzigs kyis brag dmar ma sa gong du mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad cig brtsigs pa'i tshe chu mig dang sa bzang po klus bstangs/rdo ba rgya gar gyi yi ge can byung ngo/ a tsar+ya 'ba' rad nas shes rab 'bum thog ma bod khams su rgyas par 'gyur ro/ de'i tshe de'i byin rlabs kyis 'jig rten gyi khams theg pa chen po spyod pa sha stag gi zhing dag par skye bar 'gyur ro zer/ zhes phyi lam du 'ba' rad nas lung bstan/ dba' mkhan po mdzis lha sras kyi snyan du 'bum bshad pa dang 'or che'o zhes gsungs nas spyi bo la byugs te bya dga' cher stsal/ jo mo lha rgyal gyi zhal nas de ltar chos 'chad mkhas pa zas su ci za skom du ci zhig 'thung zhes gsung gda'/ de nas 'ba' sangs shi slad kyis tshe 'da' kur 'gran bzangs lha khang gi lha yid bzhin 'khor lo la mchi ma byung / myi ma yin pa ngu ba'i sgra byung ste/ dam pa'i chos ni dang po de ltar brnyes shes gda'o/ rta'i lo'i dpyid zla ra ba'i ngo la btsan po khri srong lde btsan ni 'das/ sras mu ne btsan po ni sku chungs chos spyod pa la dga' ba'ang nyung ste/ lha sras yab kyi 'dad bgyi bar bcad pa na/ mchims btsan bzher legs gzigs dang sna nam rgyal tsha/ lha snang dang / ngan lam stag ra klu gong la sogs pa blon po nag po rnams kyis chos nub par bya ba'i phyir da bon btsun par bya ba'i phyir brag dmar mtsho mo'i 'gur du re'u chen po phub ste chibs las rta bo che dang mgyogs pa mang po dang / chibs kyi rkyen sa ra chas dang ring gur lags pa'i bzo 'drubs pas gzhi bzung ste/ bon po yang

༄༅/dba' bzhed bzhugs so// 275'phan yul gyi a gshen dang / byi spu dang / mtshe cog dang / ya ngal lags pa brgya nyi shu rtsa bdun pa sogs te 'dad bgyid par bcad pa las/ sras mu ne btsan pos zhang blon chen po'i mdun sar spring ba/ nga'i mdang gi rmang lam na 'og min gyi gnas lcang lo can gyi pho brang zer ba 'ig na/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rnam par snang mdzad dang / phyag na rdo rje dang 'jam dpal gzhon nu (gyur pa ) dang yab khri srong lde btsan rnams thabs gcig tu bzhugs te/ mdo sde'i lung khungs dang bstan bcos kyi gtam rgyud mang po gsung zhing 'dug pa mis te/ mtshan ltas 'di dang sbyar na lha sras yab kyi 'dad ni bon du byar mi rung gi dkar chos su bya dgos pas bcom ldan 'das kyi ring lugs dang / sgra sgyur gyi lo ts+tsha dang mdun sa che chung du gtogs pa'i zhang blon chen po dag zhib tu mchid gros 'thun par gnyer du khums cig ces bka' stsal brdzangs so// / de nas 'khon klu'i dbang po dang / mkhas pa rna cha can 2kyis nyin la mtshan du ma lhugs te/ tsha ba tsha shod kyi rgyal khams nas pa gor be+e ro tsa na dang / rgyal mo g.yu sgra snying po 2spyan drangs te/ ring lugs kyi ban de rnams dang / lha lung lhun gyi dpal dang lo tsha ba mchims shag kya (pra bha )dang / a tsa ra pa gor be+e ro tsa na dang / sna nam ye shes sde la sogs pa mchid gros su 'tshal ba las/ g.yas gral bon pos bzung / g.yon gral blon pos bzung / gung la rgyal bu bzhugs te ban de la gral ma ster bas 'tshoms te/ chos dang mthun pa'i gral med pa la/ slob dpon be+e ro tsa nas bsnyug zha chen po cig gsol/ ya gug ring po bsnams/ gser thul chen po 1gsol nas/ rgyal bu la zhe sa gzhu bzhin du phul nas/ mnga' bdag gi 'og g.yas gral dang po na mchims btsan bzher legs gzigs yod pa'i rgyab tu 'khar ba'i oṃ tshugs mdzad nas bzhugs pas/ btsan bzher legs gzigs nyams la ma bde nas phyir mig bltas pas/ be+e ro tsa na'i sma ra'i

276 ༄cu//(sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/gseb na khro chu nyungs dkar tsam shig sheg snang ba dang / shin tu skrag nas kog gis langs pa'i shul du be+e ro tsa nas bzhugs pas ban de la g.yas gral shor de ltar mdun sar bgrigs te bzhugs pa'i dus su rgyal bu'i 'phrin gyi byang bskangs slag par gzas pa dang / 'ang btsan bzheng legs gzigs kyis 'di skad smras te/ yum lags ring lugs kyi ban de chen po dang / a tsa ra dag spyir bdag cag gis gsal ni mi 'tshal zhing / mtha' bzhi nyi 'og dang brda' mjal te gsang sgo phye na'ang / 'o skol mnga' ris bod kyi rgyal khams su/ rje mi lde/ lha lde spu rgyal gnya' khri btsan po lta bu zhig 'greng mgo nag gi rjer gshegs pa'i tshe/ ya mtshan can gyi kong du dung dkar chen dkar chung / gnyan g.yu ru lde mdongs/ rmog rmu lugs/ rmu khrab zhol mo/ gzhu rang brdungs/ rmu mdung zang yag ral gri gshen gyi bla mtsho/ dmu phub gong khra la sogs pa mang po ni mnga'/ de tsa na 'bangs zhabs 'bring ba sku gshegs tshe chog dang stabs cig tu bzhugs te/ shing sdong po ni sku dud dud/gor pha bong ni 'phar thang thang / rdzu 'phrul dang ya mtshan che ba'i tshar 1mchis so// dus de tsam na mi gum kyang sa la 'dad gtang ba dang bang so brtsig mi 'tshal/ de nas sras chibs kha thub nas yab dgung du gshegs te 'dad btang ba tshun chad du/ lha tho tho ri snyan shal dang grang lung gi gung sman du bshos te/ gtong 'dad gdong ba yang grangs lung gi gung sman gyis gtong ngo / lha la lha 'dur zhes kyang bgyi ste/ rje'i gtong 'dad dang / 'bangs kyi 'dur lugs de tshun chad du byung ba lags te/ 'dad btang tshun chad du bzhugs kyi sku 'khar ni btsan thang sgo bzhi brtsigs pas bkra shis zhing zhal gro ba lags/ bsten pa'i sku lha ni yar la sham po/ grongs kyi bang so ra ba thang du btab ste/ yar la sham po ni gnyan zhing mthu che/ phyi lugs ra ba thang ni bkra shis/ de tsa na g.yo ru smad nas nyung shas tsam 1las/ zi po'i rje khri 'phang

༄༅/dba' bzhed bzhugs so/ 2772dang / zhang zhung gi rgyal po gnya' zhur lag mig la sogs pa rgyal rigs phra mo mnga' ris su 'dus pa lags/ mnga' thang che ba dang chab srid mtho ba ni gtsug lag dang ldan pas byung ste/ sku gshen tshe cog dag gis lto spyad kyang legs pa 'dra/ pha ba sku gshen pa dag gi stong 'dad che zhing zhal gro ba las/da 'di las bzlog ste 'dad ban des mdzad de/ rgya gar gyi chos lugs sam mdzad spyod ltar bgyis nas/ gal te bkra mi shes pa dag byung na/ bla sgo 2gyi chab srid dmas par nges pas/ ring lugs kyi ban de chen po dang blon po rnams 'thun bar gyis la 'dad bon lugs su bya bar rigs so zhes glengs so//de nas be+e ro tsa na'i zhal nas tshig des ldang mi chod pas/ g.yas klu po'i yi ge klag pa shol cig gsung nas lan btab pa/ yum byang chub sems dpa'i gdung rgyud/ rigs 2mgon po'i sprul pa/ thugs rje chen po'i mnga' bdag/mi rje lha'i dbon sras/ rin po che gser gyi gnya' shing lta bu dbu la bzhugs lags/ chabs 'og na mchis pa 'bangs kyi rad pa mang zhig mi gsol/ cung zad zhu pas sa sa nas snyan gsan par zhu lags/ dngos ngan pa su las kyi skal bas lho bal gyi skad bslabs te mtha' bzhi nyi 'og gi rgyal rigs kun gyi kha brgyud nas/ shig dong dang sprul gdug pa can gyi dong du stsal bas sha srab ca'i dbang po mi gsal bar gyur te 'tshal ba'i sgo chung gis kyang ni thos pa mang po'i sgo nas gzhi blangs te/ spyi ched nyung shas tsam 1gsol na/ yong 'dzam bu'i gling gi 'jig rten gyi khams na srid pa ji ltar spyod pa cig lags zhe na/ dper na bar snang 'di rdo rje'i pha bong cig gis rang gis rang 'gril te sa gcig nas gcig 'das kyang mi 'gyur ba bzhin du/ mi gcig kha shar phyogs su (ba)ltas te la gcig rgal/ chu gcig 'bogs thang gcig rgal te tshe'i mthar thug par song yang mi dang yul la skad pa ma mchis so// de la zhang btsan bzher na re/ bzhugs kyi sku 'khar ni btsan thang sgo bzhi/ rten gyi sku

278 ༄༅//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/lha ni yar la sham po/ grongs kyi bang so ni ra ba thang du btab pas bkra shis bgyi ba de sho pe ba lags te/ de bas bkra shis pa rgya gar gyi yul shrī na len dra'i gtsug lag khang na/ dam pa'i chos la thugs ches shing dkar phyogs la mos pa'i byin rlabs kyis rgyal po da na ta lo la sras thu re dza ha ti dang / sras mo sa la ni la sogs pa paṇ+ḍi ta nyer lngas lo stong lnga brgya dang / lo stong sum brgya lon pa bzhugs so// yang rgya gar gyi rgyal po dharma rā dzā dang / u rgyan gyi rgyal po yin dra snru ti la mi rabs bcu bzhi'i bar du pha khu yang tshe mi rje/ bu tsha yang rabs mi 'chad legs pa'i yon tan dus 1 la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gud pa ba zhig kyang mchis so/ / yang ri rab kyi rtse mo sum cu rtsa gsum dga' ldan lha'i gnas rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang (zhes )bya ba na/ gung la lha'i dbang po brgya byin bzhugs/ cog chen po bzhi na gnod sbyin bzhi bzhugs/ ba gam sum bcu rtsa lnga na 'khor nye dbang sum bcu rtsa gnyis bzhugs te dgyes pa la longs spyod cing / rin po che'i gzhal yas khang gdan mnan na nem (zhes ) byed cing / bteg na 'phar ba la bzhugs pa mchis so// yang 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa bde ba can nam/ pad ma can zhes pa na/ skye 'chi dang 'du 'bral med pa bkra shes pa bgyi ba de lta bu lags so// yar lha sham po gnyan bgyi ba de sho pe ba lags te/ de bas gnyan zhing mthu che ba rgyal po chen po bzhi'o/ mthu stobs kyi bdag po phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa rigs gsum 'gon po'am/ thugs rje che la thabs mkhas pa bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad sku mdun rgyab mi gsal ba/ srid pa'i chos thams cad la dbang sgyur ba mchis te/ gnyan zhing mthu che ba de lta bu lags so// bon gyi lto spyad dang gtsug lag legs bgyi ba de'ang sho pe ba lags te/ zing bo'i rgyal po/ khri 'phang gsum gyis lha snying rje med pa'i thang lha yang lha gsol/ 'phan yul gyi

༄༅spyodaba' bzhed bzhugs so/ 279ag gshen rnam 2kyis gnag lug dang rta la sogs pa dud 'gro mang po ni bsad/ 'dred 'grin dang gtso me la sogs pa 'dre gsung 'dod dang / bon lcags 'dod mang po bsags/ sdig snga ma'i steng du phyi ma mnan te 'khrul pa'i chos la spyad pas/ kho'i bran 2'phral gnon dang 2/ tshe spongs 'phrin dang bzhi/ mkhar khung lung rgyab bu snang dang chas nas spu rgyal bod kyi mnga' ris su 'dus pa lags te/ de lto che zhing zhal bsod pa lags sam/ zhang zhung gi rgyal po/ gnya' zhur lag mig gis lha snying rje med pa'i gye gdong dang mu thur nigasol/ zhang zhung gi chos lugs rnam pa bzhir bon shed btang bas zhang zhung gi rgyal srid (ba)rlag nas/ 'khar rtse mtho dang / rgod lta'i la sogs pa spu rgyal gyi mnga' ris su 'dus pa lags so// dbon 'a zha'i rgyal pos lha snying rje med pa'i srib ri dkar po ni gsol/ dbon 'a zha rje nyid kyi lugs su bon shin nag po btab pas 'a zha'i rgyal srid (ba)rlag ste spu rgyal gyi mnga' ris su 'dus pa lags so// mchims dgas po'i rgyal pos bon shid nag po btang bas mchims kyi rgyal srid brlag ste da lta zhang btsan bzher dag kyang 'bangs tshad mar gyur ba lags so// sgrubs rje sribs pos lha snying rje med pa'i snubs lha mthon drug ni gsol/ byar mi btub pa'i bon shed nag po btang bas/ sgrubs kyi rgyal srid rlag ste sgrubs 'khar skya mo dang chas te bod kyi mnga' ris su 'dus pa lags so// de tsam du nyes pa che ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis shed bon lugs su byar mi btub pa 'dra'o/ dam pa'i chos ni lung tshad mas zin te/ dge ba byas pas mtho ris dang / srog gcod sogs (pa )mi dge ba byas pas ngan song du ltung zhes 'byung bas/ 'o skol gyi rje khri srong lde btsan lta bu zhig gzug phung skad cig ma'i lus blangs kyis kyang dgongs pa sangs rgyas su bzhugs te gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor brgya rtsa brgyad bzhengs pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa'i mdo sde brgya rtsa brgyad bzhengs te dge

280 )za//〈sba bzhed 〉phyogs bsgrigs/ba'i 'phro bzang bas de dang rjes su 'thun par bgyid 'tshal/ 'khrul pa'i spyod pa ngan pas bslus na dper na rta dkar po la stan nag po bstad pa ltar/sngar gyi sgrib pa dang gegs su 'gyur nges pas lha sras kyi gtong 'dad 'di chos lugs su bgyid par zhu zhes gsungs pas/ mchims btsan bzher legs gzigs na re/ ban de dag khyed kyi mchid shags de khungs ni nam mkha' stong pa las byung / dus tshod ni tshe phyi ma la btab/ kha zin ni lha sras kyis mdzad/bdag cag gi mchid gros ltar mi 'gyur na ci legs par mnga' gsol/ pho brang gi mdun sa yang ban des zung / rje'i 'bas thog kyang ban des gyis/mtha'i so kha yang ban des srung zer te sprugs rdab byas song bas/ gzhan lus kyang ma spobs te smra ba ma byung ba la/ slob dpon be+e ro tsa nas slar gnyer nged rang ban des byed ces gsungs pas lha sras kyang rab tu mnyes so// de nas ban de rnams kyis lha'i bu dri ma med pa'i mdo (gtsug tor dri med ) kyi gzungs la brten nas 'dad shid dkar chos su mdzad do/ de'i dus su rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te lha sras khri srong gi 'dad btang / be+e ro tsa nas sngags bdag mdzad/ g.yu sgra snying pos cho ga mdzad/ ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs dang / 'khon klu'i dbang po dang / snums nam mkha' snying po la sogs shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa sras yum mang du klas te lha sras kyi 'dad rgyal par btang ngo / de nas mnga' bdag mu ne btsan po dang / be+e ro tsa na dang / rgyal mo g.yu sgra snying po 2 gyis lhan dkar ta mo rar bka' nges pa'i lung don man ngag rnams rgya skad las bod skad du bsgyur/ sras mu ne btsan pos bka' nges pa'i lung don man ngag zab pa rnams snod dang ldan pa lagatad/ la la dbu rtse zangs khang gi bse sgrom nag por sbas ste bzhag go/de nas g.yu sgra snying po nyid tsha ba'i yul du bzhud/ be+e ro tsa na nub phyogs gyad kyi yul ma ga dha'i brag phug tu yun gyi dgongs pa la gshegs so// la la na re

༄7//dba' bzhed bzhugs so// 281shar phyogs li'i yul sher 'khar dkar po'i nang na/ li rje dkar po'i bu mo li za tshul khrims mtsho bya ba khrid nas byang phyogs kyi lha khang gi sgo can gsos kyang zer ro/ de nas phyis ngan song sbyong rgyud la brten nas/ kun rig dang gtsug tor dgu'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas shin rnams byas so// grir shi ba la khro bo nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas shin byas/ de'i gtad yar da gri 'dul la sogs pa rnams mdo sde'i khungs dang sbyar nas mdzad/ dus de nas shed thams cad chos lugs su byed pa byung ste/ de yang bon lugs glen pa dag nor longs spyod mang po gnyer du sbed pa yod skad/ de ni gong che la phan chung bar dgongs nas chos lugs mkhas pa dag gis zas gtad kyi phyag bzhes 'di mdzad skad do/ zas gtad kyi lo rgyus rdzogs so/ / / /
